column3: An interjection for surprise, dismay or a small complaint: 哎呀，我忘了带钱包！ It is what you say on finding a mistake, often your own. 哎呀 is milder than 天啊 and more spoken than written. Both characters have 口 "mouth", as sound words do; they carry no meaning beyond the cry.
column6: Āiyā, wǒ wàng le dài yàoshi!
column7: Oh no, I forgot my keys!
column9: An interjection for surprise, dismay or a small complaint: 哎呀，我忘了帶錢包！ It is what you say on finding a mistake, often your own. 哎呀 is milder than 天啊 and more spoken than written. Both characters have 口 "mouth", as sound words do; they carry no meaning beyond the cry.

column3: A cry of pain or sudden surprise: 哎哟，好痛！ It fits a bump on the knee or a startling piece of news. 哎呀 is dismay at a slip, while 哎哟 is more bodily, and it can also be a soft protest: 哎哟，不要这样啦. Both characters have 口 "mouth"; 哟 takes 约 as its sound part.
column6: Āiyō, wǒ de jiǎo hǎo tòng!
column7: Ow, my foot really hurts!
column9: A cry of pain or sudden surprise: 哎喲，好痛！ It fits a bump on the knee or a startling piece of news. 哎呀 is dismay at a slip, while 哎喲 is more bodily, and it can also be a soft protest: 哎喲，不要這樣啦. Both characters have 口 "mouth"; 喲 takes 約 as its sound part.

column3: Cancer as a disease: 得癌症 "get cancer", 癌症病人, 癌症筛检 "cancer screening". The kind of cancer goes before 癌, as in 肺癌 and 胃癌, but 癌症 is the general name. 症 means "illness, symptom" (症状) and sits under 疒 "sickness", with 正 as its sound.
column6: Tā de bàba dé le áizhèng.
column7: His father has got cancer.
column9: Cancer as a disease: 得癌症 "get cancer", 癌症病人, 癌症篩檢 "cancer screening". The kind of cancer goes before 癌, as in 肺癌 and 胃癌, but 癌症 is the general name. 症 means "illness, symptom" (症狀) and sits under 疒 "sickness", with 正 as its sound.

column3: Cancer, mostly as the last part of a compound naming the organ: 肺癌 "lung cancer", 胃癌, 肝癌, 乳癌, 癌细胞 "cancer cell". By itself it is rare; 癌症 is the word for the disease. 疒 "sickness" is the meaning part. The sound part 嵒 is a form of 岩 "rock", and one explanation is that cancer lumps are hard like rock.
column6: Yīshēng shuō tā dé de shì fèi'ái.
column7: The doctor said what he has is lung cancer.
column9: Cancer, mostly as the last part of a compound naming the organ: 肺癌 "lung cancer", 胃癌, 肝癌, 乳癌, 癌細胞 "cancer cell". By itself it is rare; 癌症 is the word for the disease. 疒 "sickness" is the meaning part. The sound part 嵒 is a form of 岩 "rock", and one explanation is that cancer lumps are hard like rock.

column3: A case, in the sense of a legal or police case, a "record, file" or a "proposal": 破案 "solve a case", 提案 "make a proposal", 方案 "plan", 档案 "file". It is mostly a part of compounds; alone it is written style, as in 这个案. 安 gives the sound (an) and 木 "wood" points to an old sense, a wooden table.
column6: Zhège àn hái zài diàochá zhōng.
column7: This case is still under investigation.
column9: A case, in the sense of a legal or police case, a "record, file" or a "proposal": 破案 "solve a case", 提案 "make a proposal", 方案 "plan", 檔案 "file". It is mostly a part of compounds; alone it is written style, as in 這個案. 安 gives the sound (an) and 木 "wood" points to an old sense, a wooden table.

column3: A "case" (legal or police) or a "job, project" in business: 接案子 "take on a job", used of freelancers and firms, and 这个案子 "this case". It is spoken and everyday, where 案件 is the formal word for a legal case. 案 "case" + the neutral-tone suffix 子.
column4: 我们公司接了一个大案子。
column5: 我們公司接了一個大案子。
column6: Wǒmen gōngsī jiē le yī ge dà ànzi.
column7: Our company took on a big project.
column9: A "case" (legal or police) or a "job, project" in business: 接案子 "take on a job", used of freelancers and firms, and 這個案子 "this case". It is spoken and everyday, where 案件 is the formal word for a legal case. 案 "case" + the neutral-tone suffix 子.

column3: Dirty, filthy, of things you can see: 肮脏的厕所 "a filthy toilet", and also of morals: 肮脏的手段 "dirty methods", 肮脏的钱. It is stronger than 不干净. Both characters have ⺼ on the left and take their sound from the right (亢 and 庄).
column6: Zhè tiáo hé de shuǐ hěn āngzāng.
column7: The water of this river is very dirty.
column9: Dirty, filthy, of things you can see: 骯髒的廁所 "a filthy toilet", and also of morals: 骯髒的手段 "dirty methods", 骯髒的錢. It is stronger than 不乾淨. Both characters have 骨 "bone" on the left and take their sound from the right (亢 and 葬), so they are sound-borrowing forms and the "bone" says little about the meaning.

column3: Secretly, on the quiet: 暗中帮忙 "help in secret", 暗中观察 "watch quietly". It describes acting without others noticing, for good or for bad, and goes before the verb. 暗 "dark" + 中 "within": in the dark. 暗 has 日 "sun" and 音 as the sound, so "dark" is the sun's absence.
column6: Tā ànzhōng bāng le wǒ hěn duō máng.
column7: He helped me a lot in secret.
column9: Secretly, on the quiet: 暗中幫忙 "help in secret", 暗中觀察 "watch quietly". It describes acting without others noticing, for good or for bad, and goes before the verb. 暗 "dark" + 中 "within": in the dark. 暗 has 日 "sun" and 音 as the sound, so "dark" is the sun's absence.

column3: Two uses. To "simmer for a long time": 熬汤 "make soup", 熬粥 "cook congee". And to "endure a hard stretch": 熬过去 "get through it", and above all 熬夜 "stay up late". The four dots 灬 are fire, which fits the long cooking, and 敖 gives the sound.
column6: Māma zhèngzài áo tāng.
column7: Mom is simmering soup.
column9: Two uses. To "simmer for a long time": 熬湯 "make soup", 熬粥 "cook congee". And to "endure a hard stretch": 熬過去 "get through it", and above all 熬夜 "stay up late". The four dots 灬 are fire, which fits the long cooking, and 敖 gives the sound.

column3: To go on strike and "a strike": 工人罢工 "the workers strike", 罢工抗议. It is a verb that already holds its object, so you can say 罢了工, and it is also a noun. 罢 means "to stop" (as in 罢了), and 工 "work" is a picture of a worker's tool.
column6: Gōngrén juédìng míngtiān bàgōng.
column7: The workers decided to strike tomorrow.
column9: To go on strike and "a strike": 工人罷工 "the workers strike", 罷工抗議. It is a verb that already holds its object, so you can say 罷了工, and it is also a noun. 罷 means "to stop" (as in 罷了), and 工 "work" is a picture of a worker's tool.

column3: To bow, to pay respects, as in 拜神 "worship the gods" and 拜祖先, and "to visit someone", as in 拜访 and 拜会. After 拜 the person is the one you honor: 拜师 "take someone as your teacher". The character has 手 twice, two hands together, which is the gesture.
column4: 他拜了一位老师学书法。
column5: 他拜了一位老師學書法。
column6: Tā bài le yī wèi lǎoshī xué shūfǎ.
column7: He took a teacher to study calligraphy.
column9: To bow, to pay respects, as in 拜神 "worship the gods" and 拜祖先, and "to visit someone", as in 拜訪 and 拜會. After 拜 the person is the one you honor: 拜師 "take someone as your teacher". The character has 手 twice, two hands together, which is the gesture.

column3: In Taiwan, a "religious ceremony with offerings", done with incense and food at home or at the temple: 拜拜 on a god's birthday, 拜拜用的水果. It is also a casual "bye-bye": 拜拜！ borrowed from English. Context tells the two apart. 拜 is the bow of respect, doubled.
column4: 妈妈每个月初一都要拜拜。
column5: 媽媽每個月初一都要拜拜。
column6: Māma měi ge yuè chūyī dōu yào bàibai.
column7: Mom does the offering ceremony on the first of every month.
column9: In Taiwan, a "religious ceremony with offerings", done with incense and food at home or at the temple: 拜拜 on a god's birthday, 拜拜用的水果. It is also a casual "bye-bye": 拜拜！ borrowed from English. Context tells the two apart. 拜 is the bow of respect, doubled.

column3: To pay a New Year call, to wish people a happy new year in person: 去亲戚家拜年, 向长辈拜年. Children receive red envelopes (红包) when they do it. 拜 "bow" + 年 "year". The 年 picture shows a person carrying grain, an old sign of the harvest year.
column4: 大年初一我们去外婆家拜年。
column5: 大年初一我們去外婆家拜年。
column6: Dànián chūyī wǒmen qù wàipó jiā bàinián.
column7: On New Year's Day we go to Grandma's to pay our New Year call.
column9: To pay a New Year call, to wish people a happy new year in person: 去親戚家拜年, 向長輩拜年. Children receive red envelopes (紅包) when they do it. 拜 "bow" + 年 "year". The 年 picture shows a person carrying grain, an old sign of the harvest year.

column3: Please, I beg you, asking a favor: 拜托你帮我一个忙. It can be a request (拜托你帮我拿一下) or a plea of impatience: 拜托，别再说了！ "come on, stop it". 托 has 扌 "speech" and 乇 as the sound, as in 委托, "to entrust". 拜 adds the respect of a bow.
column6: Bàituō nǐ bāng wǒ ná yīxià shū.
column7: Please help me carry the book for a moment.
column9: Please, I beg you, asking a favor: 拜託你幫我一個忙. It can be a request (拜託你幫我拿一下) or a plea of impatience: 拜託，別再說了！ "come on, stop it". 託 has 言 "speech" and 乇 as the sound, as in 委託, "to entrust". 拜 adds the respect of a bow.

column3: A particle at the end of a sentence which makes light of it: "that's all, nothing more": 我只是开玩笑罢了 "I was only joking". It goes with 只是 or 不过. It is written style; speech says 而已 or just 啦. 罢 "stop" + 了 "finished": the matter ends there.
column6: Wǒ zhǐshì suíbiàn shuōshuo bàle.
column7: I was only saying it casually, that's all.
column9: A particle at the end of a sentence which makes light of it: "that's all, nothing more": 我只是開玩笑罷了 "I was only joking". It goes with 只是 or 不過. It is written style; speech says 而已 or just 啦. 罷 "stop" + 了 "finished": the matter ends there.

column3: To mix, to toss things together: 拌饭 "mix rice with something", 凉拌 "cold-dressed (dish)", 拌沙拉, 搅拌 "to stir". It is for food and sauces. 扌 "hand" is the meaning part, and 半 supplies the sound (bàn).
column4: 他把酱油和饭拌在一起。
column5: 他把醬油和飯拌在一起。
column6: Tā bǎ jiàngyóu hé fàn bàn zài yīqǐ.
column7: He mixed the soy sauce with the rice.
column9: To mix, to toss things together: 拌飯 "mix rice with something", 涼拌 "cold-dressed (dish)", 拌沙拉, 攪拌 "to stir". It is for food and sauces. 扌 "hand" is the meaning part, and 半 supplies the sound (bàn).

column3: Kind, sort, used in 一般 "ordinary, in general", 这般 "like this" and in 如…一般 or 像…一般 "like, as if": 像梦一般. Alone it is rare and written. The old picture is a tray 舟 and a hand with a tool 殳, which no longer helps with the meaning today.
column4: 她的声音像音乐一般好听。
column5: 她的聲音像音樂一般好聽。
column6: Tā de shēngyīn xiàng yīnyuè yībān hǎotīng.
column7: Her voice is as lovely as music.
column9: Kind, sort, used in 一般 "ordinary, in general", 這般 "like this" and in 如…一般 or 像…一般 "like, as if": 像夢一般. Alone it is rare and written. The old picture is a tray 舟 and a hand with a tool 殳, which no longer helps with the meaning today.

column3: Pound (the unit of weight, about 454 grams) and "to weigh on a scale": 磅秤 "platform scale", 一磅. It is borrowed from English "pound", so 石 "stone" and 旁 give only a sound near it. The same character is used for a printing "point" size.
column6: Zhè kuài niúpái yǒu yī bàng zhòng.
column7: This steak weighs a pound.
column9: Pound (the unit of weight, about 454 grams) and "to weigh on a scale": 磅秤 "platform scale", 一磅. It is borrowed from English "pound", so 石 "stone" and 旁 give only a sound near it. The same character is used for a printing "point" size.

column3: A stick, a club: 一根棒子, 木棒子, and 打人的棒子. It is a spoken word with the suffix 子 (neutral), for a thick stick you can hold. Baseball is 棒球, with 棒 "stick" and 球 "ball", and 棒 alone also means "great": 你好棒！ 棒 has 木 "wood" and 奉 as its sound.
column6: Tā shǒu lǐ názhe yī gēn bàngzi.
column7: He holds a stick in his hand.
column9: A stick, a club: 一根棒子, 木棒子, and 打人的棒子. It is a spoken word with the suffix 子 (neutral), for a thick stick you can hold. Baseball is 棒球, with 棒 "stick" and 球 "ball", and 棒 alone also means "great": 你好棒！ 棒 has 木 "wood" and 奉 as its sound.

column3: To work in an office, to do official business: 办公室 "office", 办公时间 "office hours", 在家办公 "work from home". It is a verb that comes before the place: 在公司办公. 办 "handle" + 公 "public": public matters. 办 has 力 "strength" and 八.
column6: Tā měitiān zài zhèlǐ bàngōng.
column7: He works here in this office every day.
column9: To work in an office, to do official business: 辦公室 "office", 辦公時間 "office hours", 在家辦公 "work from home". It is a verb that comes before the place: 在公司辦公. 辦 "handle" + 公 "public": public matters. 辦 has 力 "strength" between two 辛.

column3: Toward evening, at dusk: 傍晚时分, 天色渐渐暗下来. It is the time just before dark, after 下午, and it is usually followed by what happens then. 傍 means "close to, beside" (亻 "person" + 旁 "side"), and 晚 "evening, late" has 日 "sun" with 免 as the sound.
column4: 傍晚我们常常去公园散步。
column5: 傍晚我們常常去公園散步。
column6: Bàngwǎn wǒmen chángcháng qù gōngyuán sànbù.
column7: Toward evening we often go for a walk in the park.
column9: Toward evening, at dusk: 傍晚時分, 天色漸漸暗下來. It is the time just before dark, after 下午, and it is usually followed by what happens then. 傍 means "close to, beside" (亻 "person" + 旁 "side"), and 晚 "evening, late" has 日 "sun" with 免 as the sound.

column3: Halfway, midway, on the road: 在半路上 "on the way". Used for a trip (半路下车 "get off halfway") and figuratively for something stopped partway: 半路退出. 半 is "half", and the picture is a cow 牛 divided down the middle. 路 has 足 "foot" and 各 for the sound.
column4: 我在半路上遇到了老同学。
column5: 我在半路上遇到了老同學。
column6: Wǒ zài bànlù shàng yùdào le lǎo tóngxué.
column7: I met an old classmate halfway there.
column9: Halfway, midway, on the road: 在半路上 "on the way". Used for a trip (半路下車 "get off halfway") and figuratively for something stopped partway: 半路退出. 半 is "half", and the picture is a cow 牛 divided down the middle. 路 has 足 "foot" and 各 for the sound.

column3: Half of the number, half: 半数以上 "more than half", 超过半数 "over half". It is used with votes, people and amounts, in news and in meetings. 半 "half" + 数 "number", where 数 is read shù here. 数 has 攵, the "strike" part, and 娄 as the sound.
column4: 超过半数的人同意这个办法。
column5: 超過半數的人同意這個辦法。
column6: Chāoguò bànshù de rén tóngyì zhège bànfǎ.
column7: More than half of the people agree to this method.
column9: Half of the number, half: 半數以上 "more than half", 超過半數 "over half". It is used with votes, people and amounts, in news and in meetings. 半 "half" + 數 "number", where 數 is read shù here. 數 has 攵, the "strike" part, and 婁 as the sound.

column3: To carry, to transport goods: 搬运货物 "move cargo", 搬运工人 "porter, mover". It is for heavy things moved by hand or by truck, and sounds like work. 搬 "move" + 运 "transport". Both have a meaning part (扌 hand; 辶 walking) and a sound part (般; 云).
column6: Gōngrén zhèngzài bānyùn huòwù.
column7: The workers are moving the goods.
column9: To carry, to transport goods: 搬運貨物 "move cargo", 搬運工人 "porter, mover". It is for heavy things moved by hand or by truck, and sounds like work. 搬 "move" + 運 "transport". Both have a meaning part (扌 hand; 辶 walking) and a sound part (般; 軍).

column3: To take revenge: 为父亲报仇 "avenge your father". It is a verb with its object included, so you can say 报了仇, and the person you do it for comes after 为. 报 "repay" + 仇 "enemy, hatred". 仇 is 亻 "person" + 九 (the sound, but now a different one).
column6: Tā xiǎng wèi péngyou bàochóu.
column7: He wants to take revenge for his friend.
column9: To take revenge: 為父親報仇 "avenge your father". It is a verb with its object included, so you can say 報了仇, and the person you do it for comes after 為. 報 "repay" + 仇 "enemy, hatred". 仇 is 亻 "person" + 九 (the sound, but now a different one).

column3: To report in the news, and "a news report": 新闻报导 "news report", 根据报导 "according to reports", 这件事被报导了. Taiwan usually writes 报导, the mainland 报道. 报 "report, repay" and 导 "lead", with 寸 "hand" at the bottom.
column4: 这件事已经被媒体报导了。
column5: 這件事已經被媒體報導了。
column6: Zhè jiàn shì yǐjīng bèi méitǐ bàodǎo le.
column7: This matter has already been reported by the media.
column9: To report in the news, and "a news report": 新聞報導 "news report", 根據報導 "according to reports", 這件事被報導了. Taiwan usually writes 報導, the mainland 報道. 報 "report, repay" and 導 "lead", with 寸 "hand" at the bottom.

column3: Violence, force: 家庭暴力 "domestic violence", 暴力事件 "violent incident", 使用暴力 "use violence", 反对暴力. It is also an adjective with 很: 这部电影很暴力. 暴 means "violent, sudden" and 力 "strength" is a picture of an arm or plow.
column6: Wǒmen fǎnduì yīqiè bàolì.
column7: We oppose all violence.
column9: Violence, force: 家庭暴力 "domestic violence", 暴力事件 "violent incident", 使用暴力 "use violence", 反對暴力. It is also an adjective with 很: 這部電影很暴力. 暴 means "violent, sudden" and 力 "strength" is a picture of an arm or plow.

column3: Sorry, to be sorry, a polite apology: 很抱歉 "I'm very sorry", 抱歉打扰你 "sorry to disturb you". It is milder than 对不起 for small matters, and more polite, often at the start of a request or a refusal. 抱 "hold" + 歉 "regret", where 歉 has 欠 "lack" and 兼 as the sound.
column6: Hěn bàoqiàn, wǒ lái wǎn le.
column7: I'm very sorry, I'm late.
column9: Sorry, to be sorry, a polite apology: 很抱歉 "I'm very sorry", 抱歉打擾你 "sorry to disturb you". It is milder than 對不起 for small matters, and more polite, often at the start of a request or a refusal. 抱 "hold" + 歉 "regret", where 歉 has 欠 "lack" and 兼 as the sound.

column3: A newspaper company, the organization with its offices and staff: 在报社工作 "work at a newspaper", 报社记者. A paper itself is 报纸, and the body that publishes it is 报社. 报 "report" + 社 "society, company". 社 combines 礻 "spirit" and 土 "earth": a place for earth spirits, later any group.
column6: Tā zài yī jiā bàoshè dāng jìzhě.
column7: He works as a reporter at a newspaper.
column9: A newspaper company, the organization with its offices and staff: 在報社工作 "work at a newspaper", 報社記者. A paper itself is 報紙, and the body that publishes it is 報社. 報 "report" + 社 "society, company". 社 combines 礻 "spirit" and 土 "earth": a place for earth spirits, later any group.

column3: Bad-tempered, irritable: 脾气暴躁 "have a short temper", 个性暴躁. It is used about a person's nature or mood, often with 脾气. 暴 "violent" + 躁 "restless". 躁 has 足 "foot" at the left, as if tapping, and 喿 for the sound.
column6: Bàba zuìjìn píqì hěn bàozào.
column7: Dad has been very short-tempered lately.
column9: Bad-tempered, irritable: 脾氣暴躁 "have a short temper", 個性暴躁. It is used about a person's nature or mood, often with 脾氣. 暴 "violent" + 躁 "restless". 躁 has 足 "foot" at the left, as if tapping, and 喿 for the sound.

column3: To explode and "an explosion": 瓦斯爆炸 "gas explosion", 发生爆炸, and figuratively 资讯爆炸 "information explosion". Both characters have 火 "fire" and a sound part (暴; 乍). 爆 is bigger and louder, while 炸 also means "to deep-fry", as in 炸鸡.
column6: Gōngchǎng zuótiān fāshēng le bàozhà.
column7: An explosion happened at the factory yesterday.
column9: To explode and "an explosion": 瓦斯爆炸 "gas explosion", 發生爆炸, and figuratively 資訊爆炸 "information explosion". Both characters have 火 "fire" and a sound part (暴; 乍). 爆 is bigger and louder, while 炸 also means "to deep-fry", as in 炸雞.

column3: To guarantee, to protect and "a guarantee": 保障安全 "ensure safety", 保障人权, 劳工的保障. It is formal and common in news and law, where the thing protected is a right or an interest. 保 "protect" + 障 "barrier", where 阝 stands for a wall or hill.
column4: 政府要保障人民的安全。
column5: 政府要保障人民的安全。
column6: Zhèngfǔ yào bǎozhàng rénmín de ānquán.
column7: The government must guarantee the safety of its people.
column9: To guarantee, to protect and "a guarantee": 保障安全 "ensure safety", 保障人權, 勞工的保障. It is formal and common in news and law, where the thing protected is a right or an interest. 保 "protect" + 障 "barrier", where 阝 stands for a wall or hill.

column3: To prepare, to have ready, as part of a compound: 准备 "prepare", 设备 "equipment", 备用 "spare", 备份 "backup". Alone it is written style, and 备 as a verb "be fully equipped" is old. 备 is made of 夂 and 田.
column6: Chūmén qián yào bèi hǎo yǔsǎn.
column7: Get an umbrella ready before going out.
column9: To prepare, to have ready, as part of a compound: 準備 "prepare", 設備 "equipment", 備用 "spare", 備份 "backup". Alone it is written style, and 備 as a verb "be fully equipped" is old. 亻 "person" shows it was about people, and the rest was once a quiver of arrows, "ready".

column3: The back, the reverse side: 纸的背面 "the back of the paper", 照片背面. It is the side you do not see first, opposite 正面. Also a side of a matter that is hidden. 背 means "back (of the body)": 北 "north" for the sound over 月 "flesh", and 面 is a face.
column4: 请把名字写在纸的背面。
column5: 請把名字寫在紙的背面。
column6: Qǐng bǎ míngzi xiě zài zhǐ de bèimiàn.
column7: Please write your name on the back of the paper.
column9: The back, the reverse side: 紙的背面 "the back of the paper", 照片背面. It is the side you do not see first, opposite 正面. Also a side of a matter that is hidden. 背 means "back (of the body)": 北 "north" for the sound over 月 "flesh", and 面 is a face.

column3: Grief, deep sorrow, written and serious: 悲痛的心情 "grief-stricken", 沉浸在悲痛中, 表示悲痛. It is for a death or a disaster, not for small sadness, where 难过 is used. 悲 has 心 "heart" under 非 for the sound, and 痛 "pain" has 疒 "sickness" around 甬.
column4: 听到这个消息，大家都很悲痛。
column5: 聽到這個消息，大家都很悲痛。
column6: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, dàjiā dōu hěn bēitòng.
column7: On hearing the news, everyone was deeply grieved.
column9: Grief, deep sorrow, written and serious: 悲痛的心情 "grief-stricken", 沉浸在悲痛中, 表示悲痛. It is for a death or a disaster, not for small sadness, where 難過 is used. 悲 has 心 "heart" under 非 for the sound, and 痛 "pain" has 疒 "sickness" around 甬.

column3: A "vest, tank top, sleeveless garment": 一件背心, 运动背心, 防弹背心 "bulletproof vest". A thin, sleeveless undershirt or a sports top is also a 背心. 背 "back" + 心 "heart, middle": it covers the middle of the back. The 心 is a heart picture.
column6: Xiàtiān tā xǐhuan chuān bèixīn.
column7: In summer he likes to wear a tank top.
column9: A "vest, tank top, sleeveless garment": 一件背心, 運動背心, 防彈背心 "bulletproof vest". A thin, sleeveless undershirt or a sports top is also a 背心. 背 "back" + 心 "heart, middle": it covers the middle of the back. The 心 is a heart picture.

column3: To rush, to hurry: 奔向 "rush toward", 奔走 "run about on an errand", 奔流 "flow swiftly". Followed by a place it can also mean "head for": 奔向未来. Written and lively. The older picture was a person running, now a 大 above 卉 "plants", as if running through grass.
column4: 他奔向车站，想赶上最后一班车。
column5: 他奔向車站，想趕上最後一班車。
column6: Tā bēn xiàng chēzhàn, xiǎng gǎn shàng zuìhòu yī bān chē.
column7: He ran toward the station, hoping to catch the last train.
column9: To rush, to hurry: 奔向 "rush toward", 奔走 "run about on an errand", 奔流 "flow swiftly". Followed by a place it can also mean "head for": 奔向未來. Written and lively. The older picture was a person running, now a 大 above 卉 "plants", as if running through grass.

column3: To run, fast and with energy: 在草地上奔跑 "run about on the grass", 奔跑的孩子. It is a vivid verb for children, animals and athletes, not for jogging, where 跑步 is used. 奔 "rush" + 跑 "run", where 跑 has 足 "foot" and 包 as the sound.
column6: Háizimen zài cǎodì shàng bēnpǎo.
column7: The children are running about on the grass.
column9: To run, fast and with energy: 在草地上奔跑 "run about on the grass", 奔跑的孩子. It is a vivid verb for children, animals and athletes, not for jogging, where 跑步 is used. 奔 "rush" + 跑 "run", where 跑 has 足 "foot" and 包 as the sound.

column3: Itself, in itself: 问题本身 "the problem itself", 他本身就是医生 "he himself is a doctor". It follows the noun it stresses and marks it as the thing in question, apart from its surroundings. 本 "root" has a stroke marking the roots of the 木 "tree"; 身 "body".
column6: Wèntí běnshēn bìng bù nán.
column7: The problem itself is not hard.
column9: Itself, in itself: 問題本身 "the problem itself", 他本身就是醫生 "he himself is a doctor". It follows the noun it stresses and marks it as the thing in question, apart from its surroundings. 本 "root" has a stroke marking the roots of the 木 "tree"; 身 "body".

column3: Local, native and "one's own country or region": 本土文化 "native culture", 本土作家, 本土化 "localization". In Taiwan it is common in talk about identity and culture, with a positive sense of what belongs to Taiwan. 本 "root" + 土 "soil": the soil one grows from.
column4: 这是一家很有本土特色的餐厅。
column5: 這是一家很有本土特色的餐廳。
column6: Zhè shì yī jiā hěn yǒu běntǔ tèsè de cāntīng.
column7: This is a restaurant with a strong local character.
column9: Local, native and "one's own country or region": 本土文化 "native culture", 本土作家, 本土化 "localization". In Taiwan it is common in talk about identity and culture, with a positive sense of what belongs to Taiwan. 本 "root" + 土 "soil": the soil one grows from.

column3: Heavy and clumsy, bulky: 笨重的行李 "bulky luggage", 笨重的机器, and it can describe a heavy, awkward movement. It is about size and weight together, not weight alone, where 重 is enough. 笨 "stupid, clumsy" has 竹 over 本, which only gives the sound; 重 "heavy".
column6: Zhège xiāngzi yòu dà yòu bènzhòng.
column7: This box is both large and bulky.
column9: Heavy and clumsy, bulky: 笨重的行李 "bulky luggage", 笨重的機器, and it can describe a heavy, awkward movement. It is about size and weight together, not weight alone, where 重 is enough. 笨 "stupid, clumsy" has 竹 over 本, which only gives the sound; 重 "heavy".

column3: To close, to shut: 闭上眼睛 "close your eyes", 闭嘴 "shut up", 关闭 "close down", 闭幕 "the closing of an event". Doors, eyes and mouths close with 闭, and 开 is its opposite. The picture is a door 门 with a bar 才 across it.
column6: Qǐng bì shàng yǎnjing xiǎng yī xiǎng.
column7: Please close your eyes and think about it.
column9: To close, to shut: 閉上眼睛 "close your eyes", 閉嘴 "shut up", 關閉 "close down", 閉幕 "the closing of an event". Doors, eyes and mouths close with 閉, and 開 is its opposite. The picture is a door 門 with a bar 才 across it.

column3: Not the 便 of 便宜 (pián). Read biàn it means "convenient": 方便, 便利, and "informal": 便服 "casual clothes", 便饭 "a simple meal". In writing it also stands for 就 "then": 一听便懂 "understand as soon as you hear". The meaning part is 亻 "person" and 更 "change"; a person changing position to be comfortable.
column6: Zhèlǐ mǎi dōngxi hěn fāngbiàn.
column7: It is very convenient to buy things here.
column9: Not the 便 of 便宜 (pián). Read biàn it means "convenient": 方便, 便利, and "informal": 便服 "casual clothes", 便飯 "a simple meal". In writing it also stands for 就 "then": 一聽便懂 "understand as soon as you hear". The meaning part is 亻 "person" and 更 "change"; a person changing position to be comfortable.

column3: Flat: 扁的 "flat", 压扁 "squash flat", 扁平 "flat", 扁桃腺 "tonsils". Said of what should be round or thick but is flattened, like a tire or a nose. In speech it can also mean "to beat up": 被扁了. The character has 户 "door" with a board 册 over it, a flat plate.
column6: Lúntāi bèi yā biǎn le.
column7: The tire has been squashed flat.
column9: Flat: 扁的 "flat", 壓扁 "squash flat", 扁平 "flat", 扁桃腺 "tonsils". Said of what should be round or thick but is flattened, like a tire or a nose. In speech it can also mean "to beat up": 被扁了. The character has 戶 "door" with a board 冊 over it, a flat plate.

column3: The third of the ten Heavenly Stems 甲乙丙丁…, used as "third" in a list, as A, B, C are in English: 甲、乙、丙 "persons A, B and C", 丙级 "grade C". In school and in contracts, 甲方 and 乙方 are the two sides and 丙 is a third. 丙 is also a part of 病, where it gives the sound (bìng).
column6: Jiǎ, yǐ, bǐng sān ge rén dōu lái le.
column7: A, B and C, all three people came.
column9: The third of the ten Heavenly Stems 甲乙丙丁…, used as "third" in a list, as A, B, C are in English: 甲、乙、丙 "persons A, B and C", 丙級 "grade C". In school and in contracts, 甲方 and 乙方 are the two sides and 丙 is a third. 丙 is also a part of 病, where it gives the sound (bìng).

column3: A hospital ward, a sickroom: 住进病房 "be admitted to a ward", 单人病房 "private room", 加护病房 "intensive care unit". 病 "sick" + 房 "room". 病 has 疒 around 丙, which is the sound; 房 has 户 "door" and 方 for the sound.
column6: Yéye zhù zài sān lóu de bìngfáng.
column7: Grandpa is in a ward on the third floor.
column9: A hospital ward, a sickroom: 住進病房 "be admitted to a ward", 單人病房 "private room", 加護病房 "intensive care unit". 病 "sick" + 房 "room". 病 has 疒 around 丙, which is the sound; 房 has 戶 "door" and 方 for the sound.

column3: The state of an illness, how a patient is doing: 病情稳定 "the condition is stable", 病情恶化 "the condition worsens", 了解病情. It is what doctors and families discuss. 病 "illness" + 情 "situation, circumstances". 情 has 忄 "heart" and 青 as the sound.
column4: 医生向家人说明了爸爸的病情。
column5: 醫生向家人說明了爸爸的病情。
column6: Yīshēng xiàng jiārén shuōmíng le bàba de bìngqíng.
column7: The doctor explained Dad's condition to the family.
column9: The state of an illness, how a patient is doing: 病情穩定 "the condition is stable", 病情惡化 "the condition worsens", 了解病情. It is what doctors and families discuss. 病 "illness" + 情 "situation, circumstances". 情 has 忄 "heart" and 青 as the sound.

column3: A written test, as opposed to an oral one 口试: 笔试和口试, 通过笔试. It is part of job interviews, driver's license tests and civil service exams. 笔 "pen" has 竹 "bamboo" over 毛; 试 "test" has 讠 "speech" and 式 as the sound.
column4: 这家公司有笔试和面试。
column5: 這家公司有筆試和面試。
column6: Zhè jiā gōngsī yǒu bǐshì hé miànshì.
column7: This company has a written test and an interview.
column9: A written test, as opposed to an oral one 口試: 筆試和口試, 通過筆試. It is part of job interviews, driver's license tests and civil service exams. 筆 "pen" has 竹 "bamboo" over 聿, the old picture of a brush in a hand; 試 "test" has 言 "speech" and 式 as the sound.

column3: Nasal mucus, snot: 流鼻涕 "have a runny nose", 擤鼻涕 "blow your nose". Often said with a cold, 感冒. 鼻 "nose" + 涕, where 涕 has 氵 "water" and 弟 as the sound. The second syllable is read tì.
column6: Wǒ gǎnmào le, yīzhí liú bítì.
column7: I have a cold and my nose keeps running.
column9: Nasal mucus, snot: 流鼻涕 "have a runny nose", 擤鼻涕 "blow your nose". Often said with a cold, 感冒. 鼻 "nose" + 涕, where 涕 has 氵 "water" and 弟 as the sound. The second syllable is read tì.

column3: Thin, of flat things such as paper, cloth, a book or a wall: 薄纸 "thin paper", 薄外套 "light coat". Its opposite is 厚. It can also mean "weak, meager" in written style: 薄弱 "weak", 薄利 "small profit". The grass 艹 on top is a meaning part, and 溥 gives the sound.
column6: Zhè jiàn wàitào hěn bó, bù tài nuǎn.
column7: This coat is thin and not very warm.
column9: Thin, of flat things such as paper, cloth, a book or a wall: 薄紙 "thin paper", 薄外套 "light coat". Its opposite is 厚. It can also mean "weak, meager" in written style: 薄弱 "weak", 薄利 "small profit". The grass 艹 on top is a meaning part, and 溥 gives the sound.

column3: To dial and "to push aside": 拨电话 "dial a phone number", 拨号 "dial", and "to move with a finger or hand": 拨开人群 "push through a crowd", 拨弦 "pluck a string". It also means "to allocate money": 拨款. 扌 "hand" is the meaning part and 发 gives the sound.
column4: 你可以拨这个电话号码问问。
column5: 你可以撥這個電話號碼問問。
column6: Nǐ kěyǐ bō zhège diànhuà hàomǎ wènwen.
column7: You can dial this phone number and ask.
column9: To dial and "to push aside": 撥電話 "dial a phone number", 撥號 "dial", and "to move with a finger or hand": 撥開人群 "push through a crowd", 撥弦 "pluck a string". It also means "to allocate money": 撥款. 扌 "hand" is the meaning part and 發 gives the sound.

column3: Spinach: 炒菠菜 "stir-fried spinach", 菠菜汤. A leafy vegetable, usually stir-fried or in soup. 菠 appears in this word and in 菠萝 "pineapple" on the mainland, where Taiwan says 凤梨. Both characters have 艹 "plant" at the top; 波 "wave" gives the sound of 菠, and 菜 is "vegetable, dish".
column6: Māma jīntiān chǎo le bōcài.
column7: Mom stir-fried spinach today.
column9: Spinach: 炒菠菜 "stir-fried spinach", 菠菜湯. A leafy vegetable, usually stir-fried or in soup. 菠 appears in this word and in 菠蘿 "pineapple" on the mainland, where Taiwan says 鳳梨. Both characters have 艹 "plant" at the top; 波 "wave" gives the sound of 菠, and 菜 is "vegetable, dish".

column3: To fluctuate, to go up and down: 价格波动 "price fluctuation", 情绪波动 "mood swings", 股市波动. It is for numbers and moods that rise and fall, and it is used in finance and news. 波 "wave" + 动 "move". 动 has 力 "strength" and 云.
column6: Zuìjìn càijià bōdòng hěn dà.
column7: Vegetable prices have been fluctuating a lot lately.
column9: To fluctuate, to go up and down: 價格波動 "price fluctuation", 情緒波動 "mood swings", 股市波動. It is for numbers and moods that rise and fall, and it is used in finance and news. 波 "wave" + 動 "move". 動 has 力 "strength" and 重 "heavy" for the sound.

column3: To catch, to seize: 捕鱼 "catch fish", 捕鸟, 捕捉 "capture", 逮捕 "arrest", 被捕 "be arrested". It is for animals and also for criminals in news. 扌 "hand" is the meaning part and 甫 the sound (pǔ, bǔ).
column6: Yúmín chūhǎi bǔ yú.
column7: The fishermen go out to sea to catch fish.
column9: To catch, to seize: 捕魚 "catch fish", 捕鳥, 捕捉 "capture", 逮捕 "arrest", 被捕 "be arrested". It is for animals and also for criminals in news. 扌 "hand" is the meaning part and 甫 the sound (pǔ, bǔ).

column3: Two uses. At the end of a question it makes it rhetorical, often after 难道: 难道你不想去不成？ "could it be that...?" And after a verb, "will not do, cannot": 这样不成 "this won't do", 不成问题 "no problem". It is spoken and slightly old-fashioned. 不 "not" + 成 "succeed".
column4: 难道你想一个人去不成？
column5: 難道你想一個人去不成？
column6: Nándào nǐ xiǎng yī ge rén qù bùchéng?
column7: Surely you don't want to go all by yourself?
column9: Two uses. At the end of a question it makes it rhetorical, often after 難道: 難道你不想去不成？ "could it be that...?" And after a verb, "will not do, cannot": 這樣不成 "this won't do", 不成問題 "no problem". It is spoken and slightly old-fashioned. 不 "not" + 成 "succeed".

column3: Improper, inappropriate: 处理不当 "handled improperly", 用词不当 "badly chosen words", 不当行为 "improper conduct". It is formal and common in reports and law. 不 "not" + 当 "fitting": the same 当 as in 适当 "suitable". The 当 here is read dàng, not dāng.
column6: Zhège zì yòng de bùdàng.
column7: This word is used improperly.
column9: Improper, inappropriate: 處理不當 "handled improperly", 用詞不當 "badly chosen words", 不當行為 "improper conduct". It is formal and common in reports and law. 不 "not" + 當 "fitting": the same 當 as in 適當 "suitable". The 當 here is read dàng, not dāng.

column3: Not reaching, less than: 不到十分钟 "less than ten minutes", 不到一年, and with a verb, "not arriving": 没想到 is a related word. After a number it says "under". 不 "not" + 到 "arrive", where 至 "arrive" is the meaning part of 到.
column4: 从我家走到车站不到十分钟。
column5: 從我家走到車站不到十分鐘。
column6: Cóng wǒ jiā zǒu dào chēzhàn bùdào shí fēnzhōng.
column7: It takes less than ten minutes to walk from my home to the station.
column9: Not reaching, less than: 不到十分鐘 "less than ten minutes", 不到一年, and with a verb, "not arriving": 沒想到 is a related word. After a number it says "under". 不 "not" + 到 "arrive", where 至 "arrive" is the meaning part of 到.

column3: Having no choice, forced to: 不得已才这么做 "did it only because there was no choice", 万不得已 "if there's no other way". It marks an act done against your wishes. 不 "not" + 得已 "be able to stop", so "unable to do otherwise". 得 has 彳 "step" and a hand 寸 getting a shell: "to obtain".
column4: 我是不得已才这样做的。
column5: 我是不得已才這樣做的。
column6: Wǒ shì bùdéyǐ cái zhèyàng zuò de.
column7: I only did it because I had no choice.
column9: Having no choice, forced to: 不得已才這麼做 "did it only because there was no choice", 萬不得已 "if there's no other way". It marks an act done against your wishes. 不 "not" + 得已 "be able to stop", so "unable to do otherwise". 得 has 彳 "step" and a hand 寸 getting a shell: "to obtain".

column3: Troops, an army unit: 军队 is the general word, and 部队 is a unit of it: 部队出发 "the unit set out", 特种部队 "special forces". It is the word for soldiers moving as a group. 部 and 队 both have 阝, here "place": 部 "section", 队 "squad".
column6: Bùduì míngtiān jiù yào chūfā le.
column7: The unit will set out tomorrow.
column9: Troops, an army unit: 軍隊 is the general word, and 部隊 is a unit of it: 部隊出發 "the unit set out", 特種部隊 "special forces". It is the word for soldiers moving as a group. 部 and 隊 both have 阝, here "place": 部 "section", 隊 "squad".

column3: A notice, a public announcement, posted for all to read: 贴布告 "put up a notice", 学校的布告. It is the formal word for a written notice at a school, a company or the government. 布 means "spread" here, as well as "cloth", and 告 is "tell".
column6: Xuéxiào tiēchū le yī zhāng bùgào.
column7: The school put up a notice.
column9: A notice, a public announcement, posted for all to read: 貼布告 "put up a notice", 學校的布告. It is the formal word for a written notice at a school, a company or the government. 佈 "spread" has 亻 "person" and 布 "cloth" for the sound, and 告 is "tell".

column3: A bulletin board: 看布告栏 "look at the board", 贴在布告栏上. It is the board in a school corridor or a company, where notices are pinned. 布告 "notice" + 栏 "column, board". 栏 has 木 "wood" and 兰 for the sound, since such a board was wooden.
column4: 考试成绩贴在布告栏上。
column5: 考試成績貼在佈告欄上。
column6: Kǎoshì chéngjì tiē zài bùgàolán shàng.
column7: The exam results are posted on the bulletin board.
column9: A bulletin board: 看佈告欄 "look at the board", 貼在佈告欄上. It is the board in a school corridor or a company, where notices are pinned. 佈告 "notice" + 欄 "column, board". 欄 has 木 "wood" and 闌 for the sound, since such a board was wooden.

column3: Not necessarily: 不见得好 "not necessarily good", 他不见得会来 "he may well not come". It is a gentle doubt about a claim, and often answers someone: 不见得 "I'm not so sure". 见 is "see", made of 冂 and legs 儿. The 得 is neutral.
column6: Guì de dōngxi bùjiànde hǎo.
column7: Expensive things are not necessarily good.
column9: Not necessarily: 不見得好 "not necessarily good", 他不見得會來 "he may well not come". It is a gentle doubt about a claim, and often answers someone: 不見得 "I'm not so sure". 見 is "see", a big eye 目 on legs 儿. The 得 is neutral.

column3: To make up a lesson: 补课 is when a class missed is taught again, and also extra lessons given by a school to catch up or prepare for exams. 周六补课 "a make-up class on Saturday". 补 "mend" has 衤 "clothes" and 卜 as the sound: patching a garment, then filling a gap. 课 "lesson".
column4: 因为台风，学校周六要补课。
column5: 因為颱風，學校週六要補課。
column6: Yīnwèi táifēng, xuéxiào zhōuliù yào bǔkè.
column7: Because of the typhoon, the school has make-up classes on Saturday.
column9: To make up a lesson: 補課 is when a class missed is taught again, and also extra lessons given by a school to catch up or prepare for exams. 週六補課 "a make-up class on Saturday". 補 "mend" has 衤 "clothes" and 甫 as the sound: patching a garment, then filling a gap. 課 "lesson".

column3: Uneven and, more often, "unfair, indignant": 心里不平 "feel it is unfair", 打抱不平 "stand up for the wronged", 路面不平 "uneven road". 不 "not" + 平 "level". In the second sense it points to an injustice you feel, not just anger.
column4: 他觉得老板对他不公平，心里很不平。
column5: 他覺得老闆對他不公平，心裡很不平。
column6: Tā juéde lǎobǎn duì tā bù gōngpíng, xīnlǐ hěn bùpíng.
column7: He feels the boss is unfair to him and is very resentful.
column9: Uneven and, more often, "unfair, indignant": 心裡不平 "feel it is unfair", 打抱不平 "stand up for the wronged", 路面不平 "uneven road". 不 "not" + 平 "level". In the second sense it points to an injustice you feel, not just anger.

column3: To take extra lessons, at a cram school or with a tutor, outside regular school: 补习英文, 去补习, 补习费. 补 "fill in" + 习 "practice".
column4: 他每天晚上都去补习英文。
column5: 他每天晚上都去補習英文。
column6: Tā měitiān wǎnshang dōu qù bǔxí Yīngwén.
column7: Every evening he goes to take English lessons at a cram school.
column9: To take extra lessons, at a cram school or with a tutor, outside regular school: 補習英文, 去補習, 補習費. 補 "fill in" + 習 "practice". 習 is a bird's wings 羽 over 白 (older 日), young birds learning to fly.

column3: A cram school, a private school for extra lessons after school, for exams or languages: 英文补习班 "English cram school", 上补习班. 补习 "extra lessons" + 班 "class". 班 shows jade 王 cut by a knife 刂 in two, an old image of dividing into groups.
column6: Tā xiàkè hòu yào qù bǔxíbān.
column7: After class she has to go to cram school.
column9: A cram school, a private school for extra lessons after school, for exams or languages: 英文補習班 "English cram school", 上補習班. 補習 "extra lessons" + 班 "class". 班 shows jade 王 cut by a knife 刂 in two, an old image of dividing into groups.

column3: Not suitable, not advisable: 不宜久坐 "not good to sit for long", 不宜饮酒 "alcohol not advised", 儿童不宜 "not for children". It is written style, found on signs and labels. 宜 "suitable" has a roof 宀 over 且, an altar, so a house with offerings; it is also in 便宜.
column6: Gǎnmào de shíhou bùyí hē jiǔ.
column7: It is not advisable to drink alcohol when you have a cold.
column9: Not suitable, not advisable: 不宜久坐 "not good to sit for long", 不宜飲酒 "alcohol not advised", 兒童不宜 "not for children". It is written style, found on signs and labels. 宜 "suitable" has a roof 宀 over 且, an altar, so a house with offerings; it is also in 便宜.

column3: Cannot help but, "can't but": 不由得笑了 "couldn't help laughing", 不由得想起 "couldn't help recalling". It describes a reaction you do not control, and the reaction follows. 不 "not" + 由 "by, from" + 得: "not by one's own choice". 由 is a field 田 with a line coming out.
column4: 听到这个消息，他不由得笑了。
column5: 聽到這個消息，他不由得笑了。
column6: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, tā bùyóude xiào le.
column7: On hearing the news, he couldn't help laughing.
column9: Cannot help but, "can't but": 不由得笑了 "couldn't help laughing", 不由得想起 "couldn't help recalling". It describes a reaction you do not control, and the reaction follows. 不 "not" + 由 "by, from" + 得: "not by one's own choice". 由 is a field 田 with a line coming out.

column3: A subsidy, an allowance, and "to subsidize": 政府补助 "government subsidy", 补助金, 申请补助. It is money from the state or an organization to help with costs. 补 "make up" + 助 "help", where 助 has 力 "strength" and 且 as the sound.
column6: Zhèngfǔ bǔzhù dī shōurù jiātíng.
column7: The government gives subsidies to low-income families.
column9: A subsidy, an allowance, and "to subsidize": 政府補助 "government subsidy", 補助金, 申請補助. It is money from the state or an organization to help with costs. 補 "make up" + 助 "help", where 助 has 力 "strength" and 且 as the sound.

column3: To step on, to tread: 踩到 "step on", 踩煞车 "step on the brake", 踩到狗大便, 踩在地上. It is done with the foot. 足 "foot" is the meaning part and 采 the sound (cǎi). Also used for pedaling and for stepping into something by accident.
column4: 对不起，我踩到你的脚了。
column5: 對不起，我踩到你的腳了。
column6: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ cǎi dào nǐ de jiǎo le.
column7: Sorry, I stepped on your foot.
column9: To step on, to tread: 踩到 "step on", 踩煞車 "step on the brake", 踩到狗大便, 踩在地上. It is done with the foot. 足 "foot" is the meaning part and 采 the sound (cǎi). Also used for pedaling and for stepping into something by accident.

column3: To pick, to gather: 采茶 "pick tea", 采花, and "to adopt": 采用, 采取 "take (measures)", 采访 "interview". It is a verb for picking by hand.
column6: Tā qù shān shàng cǎi chá.
column7: He goes up the mountain to pick tea.
column9: To pick, to gather: 採茶 "pick tea", 採花, and "to adopt": 採用, 採取 "take (measures)", 採訪 "interview". It is a verb for picking by hand and 扌 "hand" is the meaning part of 採, with 采 as the sound.

column3: To lay off staff: 公司裁员 "the company cuts staff", 裁员一百人. It is what companies do in hard times, a normal term in the news. 裁 "cut" + 员 "staff member". 裁 has 衣 "clothing" and 戈 "weapon", cutting cloth, and 员 has 口 over 贝 "shell, money".
column4: 公司因为经济不好要裁员。
column5: 公司因為經濟不好要裁員。
column6: Gōngsī yīnwèi jīngjì bù hǎo yào cáiyuán.
column7: The company is going to lay off staff because the economy is bad.
column9: To lay off staff: 公司裁員 "the company cuts staff", 裁員一百人. It is what companies do in hard times, a normal term in the news. 裁 "cut" + 員 "staff member". 裁 has 衣 "clothing" and 戈 "weapon", cutting cloth, and 員 has 口 over 貝 "shell, money".

column3: Silkworm: 养蚕 "raise silkworms", 蚕丝 "silk thread", 蚕茧 "cocoon". Its cocoon gives silk. 蚕 has 虫 "insect" at the bottom, with 天 above as the sound.
column6: Cán chī sāngyè, ránhòu tǔ sī.
column7: Silkworms eat mulberry leaves and then spin silk.
column9: Silkworm: 養蠶 "raise silkworms", 蠶絲 "silk thread", 蠶繭 "cocoon". Its cocoon gives silk. 蠶 has 虫 "insect" twice, at the bottom, with 兓 above as the sound.

column3: Miserable, tragic: 惨了 "oh no, I'm done for" (said in speech when things go wrong), 很惨 "pitiful", 惨败 "a crushing defeat", 惨剧. 惨 has 忄 "heart" and 参 as the sound.
column6: Zhè cì kǎoshì tā kǎo de hěn cǎn.
column7: He did really badly in this exam.
column9: Miserable, tragic: 慘了 "oh no, I'm done for" (said in speech when things go wrong), 很慘 "pitiful", 慘敗 "a crushing defeat", 慘劇. 慘 has 忄 "heart" and 參 as the sound.

column3: To hide, to store: 藏起来 "hide away", 躲藏 "hide", 收藏 "to collect", 藏钱 "hide money". Read cáng. The same character read zàng is Tibet and "treasury", as in 西藏 and 宝藏. 艹 "grass" is the meaning part and 臧 gives the sound.
column6: Tā bǎ qián cáng zài chuáng dǐxia.
column7: He hid the money under the bed.
column9: To hide, to store: 藏起來 "hide away", 躲藏 "hide", 收藏 "to collect", 藏錢 "hide money". Read cáng. The same character read zàng is Tibet and "treasury", as in 西藏 and 寶藏. 艹 "grass" is the meaning part and 臧 gives the sound.

column3: A warehouse, storehouse: 仓库里有很多货, 仓库管理. Used for goods, and a garage-like storage space. 仓 was a picture of a granary: a roof, a door and a pit for grain. 库 has 广 "building" and 车 "cart": a shed for carts, then any store.
column6: Huòwù dōu fàng zài cāngkù lǐ.
column7: The goods are all kept in the warehouse.
column9: A warehouse, storehouse: 倉庫裡有很多貨, 倉庫管理. Used for goods, and a garage-like storage space. 倉 was a picture of a granary: a roof, a door and a pit for grain. 庫 has 广 "building" and 車 "cart": a shed for carts, then any store.

column3: Ashamed, with a touch of modesty: 我很惭愧 "I feel ashamed", 感到惭愧. It is also a polite reply to praise, or when you could not do better: 惭愧，惭愧 "I don't deserve it". 惭 and 愧 both have 忄 "heart", for a feeling, and 斩 and 鬼 give the sounds.
column6: Wǒ méiyǒu bāng shàng máng, zhēn cánkuì.
column7: I wasn't able to help, and I feel ashamed.
column9: Ashamed, with a touch of modesty: 我很慚愧 "I feel ashamed", 感到慚愧. It is also a polite reply to praise, or when you could not do better: 慚愧，慚愧 "I don't deserve it". 慚 and 愧 both have 忄 "heart", for a feeling, and 斬 and 鬼 give the sounds.

column3: To worry about, to fret over, of looking after a matter and its trouble: 为孩子操心 "worry about the child", 不用你操心 "no need for you to worry". The person who cares for others does it, often a parent. 操 "handle" has 扌 "hand", and 心 "heart".
column6: Māma zǒngshì wèi háizi cāoxīn.
column7: Mom is always worrying about her children.
column9: To worry about, to fret over, of looking after a matter and its trouble: 為孩子操心 "worry about the child", 不用你操心 "no need for you to worry". The person who cares for others does it, often a parent. 操 "handle" has 扌 "hand", and 心 "heart".

column3: Strategy, tactics: 行销策略 "marketing strategy", 竞争策略, 采取策略. It is for business, games and politics, and the plan is a way of reaching a goal. 策 has 竹 "bamboo" (old slips and a whip) over 朿, and 略 "outline, plan" has 田 "field" and 各.
column4: 公司需要新的销售策略。
column5: 公司需要新的銷售策略。
column6: Gōngsī xūyào xīn de xiāoshòu cèlüè.
column7: The company needs a new sales strategy.
column9: Strategy, tactics: 行銷策略 "marketing strategy", 競爭策略, 採取策略. It is for business, games and politics, and the plan is a way of reaching a goal. 策 has 竹 "bamboo" (old slips and a whip) over 朿, and 略 "outline, plan" has 田 "field" and 各.

column3: A test, a quiz, and "to test": 小考 is the usual word for a quiz in Taiwan schools (on the mainland 小测), and 测验 is a formal word, as in 智力测验 "intelligence test" or 性向测验 "aptitude test". 测 "measure" has 氵 "water", first used for depth, and 验 "check" has 马 "horse".
column4: 老师明天要给我们一个测验。
column5: 老師明天要給我們一個測驗。
column6: Lǎoshī míngtiān yào gěi wǒmen yī ge cèyàn.
column7: The teacher will give us a test tomorrow.
column9: A test, a quiz, and "to test": 小考 is the usual word for a quiz in Taiwan schools (on the mainland 小測), and 測驗 is a formal word, as in 智力測驗 "intelligence test" or 性向測驗 "aptitude test". 測 "measure" has 氵 "water", first used for depth, and 驗 "check" has 馬 "horse".

column3: A difference, mainly in arithmetic and in comparisons: 两数的差 "the difference between two numbers", 时差 "time difference", 差距 "gap". The mathematical answer of subtraction is called 差. It is also read chà "short of, bad" and chāi "to send", with other meanings. The old picture is hulling wheat by hand.
column6: Shí hé sān de chā shì qī.
column7: The difference between ten and three is seven.
column9: A difference, mainly in arithmetic and in comparisons: 兩數的差 "the difference between two numbers", 時差 "time difference", 差距 "gap". The mathematical answer of subtraction is called 差. It is also read chà "short of, bad" and chāi "to send", with other meanings. The old picture is hulling wheat by hand.

column3: A mistake, a slip: 不能有差错 "there must be no mistake", 出差错, 发生差错. It says that something went wrong in an operation where all should go right, and has a more serious feel than 错误. 差 "deviation" + 错 "error". 错 has 钅 "metal" with 昔 as the sound.
column4: 这件事不能出任何差错。
column5: 這件事不能出任何差錯。
column6: Zhè jiàn shì bù néng chū rènhé chācuò.
column7: There must not be any mistake in this matter.
column9: A mistake, a slip: 不能有差錯 "there must be no mistake", 出差錯, 發生差錯. It says that something went wrong in an operation where all should go right, and has a more serious feel than 錯誤. 差 "deviation" + 錯 "error". 錯 has 釒 "metal" with 昔 as the sound.

column3: Flower arranging, the art of putting flowers in a vase: 学插花, 插花课, 日式插花. It is a hobby and a class. 插 "insert" has 扌 "hand", and 花 "flower" has 艹 "plant" and 化 for the sound. It is a verb-object word: you 插 (put in) 花.
column6: Zhōumò wǒ qù shàng chāhuā kè.
column7: On weekends I go to a flower arranging class.
column9: Flower arranging, the art of putting flowers in a vase: 學插花, 插花課, 日式插花. It is a hobby and a class. 插 "insert" has 扌 "hand", and 花 "flower" has 艹 "plant" and 化 for the sound. It is a verb-object word: you 插 (put in) 花.

column3: A tea party, a small gathering with tea and snacks: 举办茶会, 欢迎茶会. A 茶会 can be a social event, a reception or a formal gathering. 茶 "tea" has 艹 "plant" over 人 and 木, and 会 "meeting" is a gathering.
column4: 学校为新生办了一个茶会。
column5: 學校為新生辦了一個茶會。
column6: Xuéxiào wèi xīnshēng bàn le yī ge cháhuì.
column7: The school held a tea party for the new students.
column9: A tea party, a small gathering with tea and snacks: 舉辦茶會, 歡迎茶會. A 茶會 can be a social event, a reception or a formal gathering. 茶 "tea" has 艹 "plant" over 人 and 木, and 會 "meeting" is a gathering.

column3: To produce, to give birth: 产茶 "produce tea", 产子 "give birth", and in compounds, 生产 "produce", 产品 "product", 财产 "property". Alone it is a verb in the sense of "produces": 这里产米. 产 has 亠 and 丷 over 厂, which is a sound part.
column4: 这个地方产茶，也产水果。
column5: 這個地方產茶，也產水果。
column6: Zhège dìfang chǎn chá, yě chǎn shuǐguǒ.
column7: This place produces tea and also fruit.
column9: To produce, to give birth: 產茶 "produce tea", 產子 "give birth", and in compounds, 生產 "produce", 產品 "product", 財產 "property". Alone it is a verb in the sense of "produces": 這裡產米. The old character 產 has 生 "birth" at the bottom, and the top is a sound part.

column3: A venue, a site, a space for an activity: 场地租借 "venue rental", 比赛场地 "playing field", 找场地. It is the place as a thing to be booked or prepared, not the place where something happens to be. 场 and 地 both have 土 "earth", on the left, with 勿 and 也 on the right.
column4: 我们需要找一个大一点的场地。
column5: 我們需要找一個大一點的場地。
column6: Wǒmen xūyào zhǎo yī ge dà yīdiǎn de chǎngdì.
column7: We need to find a somewhat larger venue.
column9: A venue, a site, a space for an activity: 場地租借 "venue rental", 比賽場地 "playing field", 找場地. It is the place as a thing to be booked or prepared, not the place where something happens to be. 場 and 地 both have 土 "earth", on the left, with 昜 and 也 as sounds.

column3: A rectangle: 长方形的桌子 "a rectangular table", 画一个长方形. 长 "long" + 方 "square" + 形 "shape". A square is 正方形. In 长, an old man with long hair is the picture (read cháng "long" here, not zhǎng "grow"). 形 has 彡, the marks of shape, on its right.
column6: Zhè zhāng zhuōzi shì chángfāngxíng de.
column7: This table is rectangular.
column9: A rectangle: 長方形的桌子 "a rectangular table", 畫一個長方形. 長 "long" + 方 "square" + 形 "shape". A square is 正方形. In 長, an old man with long hair is the picture (read cháng "long" here, not zhǎng "grow"). 形 has 彡, the marks of shape, on its right.

column3: Long-lasting, for a long time: 长久之计 "a long-term plan", 不能长久 "cannot last", 长久以来 "for a long time now". It is written and a little formal; the length is in time, not in distance. 长 "long" + 久 "a long time", where 久 may once have been an arrow tip.
column6: Zhè zhǒng guānxi bù huì chángjiǔ.
column7: This kind of relationship will not last.
column9: Long-lasting, for a long time: 長久之計 "a long-term plan", 不能長久 "cannot last", 長久以來 "for a long time now". It is written and a little formal; the length is in time, not in distance. 長 "long" + 久 "a long time", where 久 may once have been an arrow tip.

column3: A manufacturer, a vendor: 电脑厂商 "computer makers", 厂商提供保固 "the maker gives a warranty". It means the firms that make or supply goods, as seen by the buyer. 厂 "factory"; 商 "trade".
column4: 这家厂商提供一年保固。
column5: 這家廠商提供一年保固。
column6: Zhè jiā chǎngshāng tígōng yī nián bǎogù.
column7: This maker gives a one-year warranty.
column9: A manufacturer, a vendor: 電腦廠商 "computer makers", 廠商提供保固 "the maker gives a warranty". It means the firms that make or supply goods, as seen by the buyer. 廠 "factory" has 广 "building" and 敞 as the sound; 商 "trade".

column3: Output, yield: 年产量 "annual output", 提高产量 "raise output", 产量下降. It is for factories and farms: how much is produced in a given time. 产 "produce" + 量 "amount". 量 is read liàng here as a noun, and liáng when it means "to measure".
column4: 今年的稻米产量比去年高。
column5: 今年的稻米產量比去年高。
column6: Jīnnián de dàomǐ chǎnliàng bǐ qùnián gāo.
column7: This year's rice output is higher than last year's.
column9: Output, yield: 年產量 "annual output", 提高產量 "raise output", 產量下降. It is for factories and farms: how much is produced in a given time. 產 "produce" + 量 "amount". 量 is read liàng here as a noun, and liáng when it means "to measure".

column3: To exceed, to go beyond: 超出预算 "exceed the budget", 超出范围 "go beyond the scope", 超出想像 "beyond imagination". The thing that is passed is after it, and it is the limit or a figure. 超 "surpass" has 走 "run" with 召 as the sound; 出 "out".
column4: 这次旅行的花费超出了预算。
column5: 這次旅行的花費超出了預算。
column6: Zhè cì lǚxíng de huāfèi chāochū le yùsuàn.
column7: The cost of this trip went over the budget.
column9: To exceed, to go beyond: 超出預算 "exceed the budget", 超出範圍 "go beyond the scope", 超出想像 "beyond imagination". The thing that is passed is after it, and it is the limit or a figure. 超 "surpass" has 走 "run" with 召 as the sound; 出 "out".

column3: Noisy, and "to make a racket": 吵闹声 "the sound of noise", 孩子们吵闹 "the children are noisy". Both can be used for a noisy place or for people making noise. 闹 is a market 市 inside a gate 门; the crowd and the noise. 吵 has 口 "mouth" and 少 as the sound.
column4: 教室里太吵闹，我听不清楚。
column5: 教室裡太吵鬧，我聽不清楚。
column6: Jiàoshì lǐ tài chǎonào, wǒ tīng bù qīngchu.
column7: The classroom is too noisy and I can't hear clearly.
column9: Noisy, and "to make a racket": 吵鬧聲 "the sound of noise", 孩子們吵鬧 "the children are noisy". Both can be used for a noisy place or for people making noise. 鬧 is a market 市 inside 鬥 "fight"; the crowd and the noise. 吵 has 口 "mouth" and 少 as the sound.

column3: Banknotes, paper money: 一张钞票 "a banknote", 数钞票 "count notes", 假钞票. The measure word is 张. 钞票 is the cash itself, where 钱 is money in general. 钞 has 钅 "metal" (money) and 少 as the sound; 票 "ticket, note".
column4: 他从口袋里拿出一张钞票。
column5: 他從口袋裡拿出一張鈔票。
column6: Tā cóng kǒudài lǐ náchū yī zhāng chāopiào.
column7: He took a banknote out of his pocket.
column9: Banknotes, paper money: 一張鈔票 "a banknote", 數鈔票 "count notes", 假鈔票. The measure word is 張. 鈔票 is the cash itself, where 錢 is money in general. 鈔 has 釒 "metal" (money) and 少 as the sound; 票 "ticket, note".

column3: Superman, or "superhuman": 超人力霸王 is Ultraman, but 超人 alone is Superman, and for a person it means "extraordinary": 超人的毅力 "superhuman willpower". 超 "above" + 人 "person", where 人 is the picture of a person from the side.
column4: 小男孩喜欢穿超人的衣服。
column5: 小男孩喜歡穿超人的衣服。
column6: Xiǎo nánhái xǐhuan chuān Chāorén de yīfu.
column7: The little boy likes to wear Superman clothes.
column9: Superman, or "superhuman": 超人力霸王 is Ultraman, but 超人 alone is Superman, and for a person it means "extraordinary": 超人的毅力 "superhuman willpower". 超 "above" + 人 "person", where 人 is the picture of a person from the side.

column3: Overweight, of luggage, a truck or a person: 行李超重 "the baggage is overweight", 超重罚款. At airports it is the usual word for baggage over the allowed weight. 超 "exceed" + 重 "weight", where 重 is read zhòng, "heavy".
column4: 你的行李超重了，要多付钱。
column5: 你的行李超重了，要多付錢。
column6: Nǐ de xíngli chāozhòng le, yào duō fù qián.
column7: Your baggage is overweight and you must pay extra.
column9: Overweight, of luggage, a truck or a person: 行李超重 "the baggage is overweight", 超重罰款. At airports it is the usual word for baggage over the allowed weight. 超 "exceed" + 重 "weight", where 重 is read zhòng, "heavy".

column3: An illustration in a book or article: 书里的插图 "the pictures in the book", 这本书有很多插图. It is a picture that goes along with text. 插 "insert" + 图 "picture", where 图 is a boundary 囗 around 冬.
column4: 这本书有很多漂亮的插图。
column5: 這本書有很多漂亮的插圖。
column6: Zhè běn shū yǒu hěn duō piàoliang de chātú.
column7: This book has a lot of pretty illustrations.
column9: An illustration in a book or article: 書裡的插圖 "the pictures in the book", 這本書有很多插圖. It is a picture that goes along with text. 插 "insert" + 圖 "picture", where 圖 is a boundary 囗 around the 啚 "territory", an old map.

column3: To pull, to tear: 扯破 "tear", 扯后腿 "hold back (pull the leg)", and "to chat nonsense": 闲扯 "idle chat", 乱扯. In Taiwan 很扯 means "ridiculous, unbelievable": 这太扯了！ 扌 "hand" is the meaning part and 止 gives the sound.
column4: 这个理由太扯了，我不相信。
column5: 這個理由太扯了，我不相信。
column6: Zhège lǐyóu tài chě le, wǒ bù xiāngxìn.
column7: This reason is too ridiculous; I don't believe it.
column9: To pull, to tear: 扯破 "tear", 扯後腿 "hold back (pull the leg)", and "to chat nonsense": 閒扯 "idle chat", 亂扯. In Taiwan 很扯 means "ridiculous, unbelievable": 這太扯了！ 扌 "hand" is the meaning part and 止 gives the sound.

column3: Thorough, completely: 澈底改变 "change completely", 澈底解决 "solve once and for all". It is more often written 彻底; 澈底 is a variant. It goes before a verb and shows that nothing is left. 澈 has 氵 "water", for clear water, which suggests seeing right through.
column4: 我们要澈底解决这个问题。
column5: 我們要澈底解決這個問題。
column6: Wǒmen yào chèdǐ jiějué zhège wèntí.
column7: We must solve this problem once and for all.
column9: Thorough, completely: 澈底改變 "change completely", 澈底解決 "solve once and for all". It is more often written 徹底; 澈底 is a variant. It goes before a verb and shows that nothing is left. 澈 has 氵 "water", for clear water, which suggests seeing right through.

column3: To prop up, to support and "to open up": 撑伞 "put up an umbrella", 撑住 "hold up, hang on", 撑不下去 "can't keep going". It can also mean "stuffed full": 吃撑了 "ate too much", 撑死了. 扌 "hand" is the meaning part, and 掌 gives the sound.
column6: Xià yǔ le, tā chēng qǐ le sǎn.
column7: It was raining, and he put up his umbrella.
column9: To prop up, to support and "to open up": 撐傘 "put up an umbrella", 撐住 "hold up, hang on", 撐不下去 "can't keep going". It can also mean "stuffed full": 吃撐了 "ate too much", 撐死了. 扌 "hand" is the meaning part, and 牚 gives the sound.

column3: Ingredient, component: 食品的成分 "ingredients of a food", 化学成分, 成分表 "ingredient list". It is also a person's "class background" in old Chinese politics, but today it is a plain word for what a thing is made of. 成 "become" + 分 "part", where 分 is 八 dividing with a knife 刀.
column4: 这种饼干的成分很简单。
column5: 這種餅乾的成分很簡單。
column6: Zhè zhǒng bǐnggān de chéngfèn hěn jiǎndān.
column7: The ingredients of this cookie are simple.
column9: Ingredient, component: 食品的成分 "ingredients of a food", 化學成分, 成分表 "ingredient list". It is also a person's "class background" in old Chinese politics, but today it is a plain word for what a thing is made of. 成 "become" + 分 "part", where 分 is 八 dividing with a knife 刀.

column3: Another way of writing 成分, with the same meaning and sound: "ingredient, component": 营养成份 "nutritional content". Taiwan writes it both ways; the mainland writes 成分. 份 means "a portion, a share" (一份), with 亻 "person" and 分, so 成份 is "the portions it is made of".
column4: 牛奶里有很多营养成份。
column5: 牛奶裡有很多營養成份。
column6: Niúnǎi lǐ yǒu hěn duō yíngyǎng chéngfèn.
column7: Milk has many nutritional components.
column9: Another way of writing 成分, with the same meaning and sound: "ingredient, component": 營養成份 "nutritional content". Taiwan writes it both ways; the mainland writes 成分. 份 means "a portion, a share" (一份), with 亻 "person" and 分, so 成份 is "the portions it is made of".

column3: Sincere, earnest: 诚恳的态度 "a sincere manner", 诚恳地道歉 "apologize sincerely". It is for the way you speak and act, and for an apology or a request. 诚 and 恳 both have a meaning part (讠 "speech"; 心 "heart") and a sound part (成; 艮).
column6: Tā chéngkěn de xiàng dàjiā dàoqiàn.
column7: He apologized to everyone sincerely.
column9: Sincere, earnest: 誠懇的態度 "a sincere manner", 誠懇地道歉 "apologize sincerely". It is for the way you speak and act, and for an apology or a request. 誠 and 懇 both have a meaning part (言 "speech"; 心 "heart") and a sound part (成; 貇).

column3: All day long, all the time, spoken and often a complaint: 成天看手机 "on his phone all day", 成天玩. It says the activity fills the day. 成 "become, whole" + 天 "day". 天 is a person 大 with a line above him, the sky.
column6: Tā chéngtiān zhǐ zhīdào wán yóuxì.
column7: He does nothing but play games all day.
column9: All day long, all the time, spoken and often a complaint: 成天看手機 "on his phone all day", 成天玩. It says the activity fills the day. 成 "become, whole" + 天 "day". 天 is a person 大 with a line above him, the sky.

column3: To present, to show up: 呈现出... 的样子 "show a ... appearance", 呈现新面貌 "take on a new look". It is for how something looks or turns out, in writing, news and art. 呈 "present" has 口 over 王; 现 "appear" has 王 (jade) and 见 "see", which also gives the sound.
column4: 这幅画呈现出秋天的景色。
column5: 這幅畫呈現出秋天的景色。
column6: Zhè fú huà chéngxiàn chū qiūtiān de jǐngsè.
column7: This painting shows an autumn scene.
column9: To present, to show up: 呈現出... 的樣子 "show a ... appearance", 呈現新面貌 "take on a new look". It is for how something looks or turns out, in writing, news and art. 呈 "present" has 口 over 王; 現 "appear" has 王 (jade) and 見 "see", which also gives the sound.

column3: Sincerity, good faith: 有诚意 "be sincere", 表示诚意 "show good faith", 没有诚意 "not meant seriously". It is often used about apologies, offers and negotiations. 诚 "sincere" + 意 "intention", where 意 has 心 "heart" under 音 "sound".
column4: 他道歉一点诚意也没有。
column5: 他道歉一點誠意也沒有。
column6: Tā dàoqiàn yīdiǎn chéngyì yě méiyǒu.
column7: His apology has no sincerity at all.
column9: Sincerity, good faith: 有誠意 "be sincere", 表示誠意 "show good faith", 沒有誠意 "not meant seriously". It is often used about apologies, offers and negotiations. 誠 "sincere" + 意 "intention", where 意 has 心 "heart" under 音 "sound".

column3: To display, to exhibit: 陈列商品 "display goods", 陈列室 "showroom", 展品陈列. It is for goods in a shop or objects in a museum, set out for people to see. 陈 "lay out" has 阝 and 东; 列 "row" combines 歹 and 刂 (knife).
column4: 橱窗里陈列着新款的鞋子。
column5: 櫥窗裡陳列著新款的鞋子。
column6: Chúchuāng lǐ chénliè zhe xīnkuǎn de xiézi.
column7: New styles of shoes are displayed in the shop window.
column9: To display, to exhibit: 陳列商品 "display goods", 陳列室 "showroom", 展品陳列. It is for goods in a shop or objects in a museum, set out for people to see. 陳 "lay out" has 阝 and 東; 列 "row" combines 歹 and 刂 (knife).

column3: A wing, of a bird, insect or plane: 鸟的翅膀 "bird's wing", 张开翅膀 "spread its wings", 拍动翅膀. It is also found on chicken: 鸡翅膀. 翅 has 羽 "feather" and 支 as the sound; 膀 has ⺼ "flesh" and 旁 as the sound (bǎng here). The second syllable is read bǎng.
column6: Xiǎo niǎo zhāngkāi le chìbǎng.
column7: The little bird spread its wings.
column9: A wing, of a bird, insect or plane: 鳥的翅膀 "bird's wing", 張開翅膀 "spread its wings", 拍動翅膀. It is also found on chicken: 雞翅膀. 翅 has 羽 "feather" and 支 as the sound; 膀 has ⺼ "flesh" and 旁 as the sound (bǎng here). The second syllable is read bǎng.

column3: A wing, mostly as part of compounds: 翅膀, 鱼翅 "shark's fin" and 鸡翅 "chicken wings", 展翅 "spread wings". Alone it is written style. 羽 "feather" is the meaning part and 支 gives the sound.
column6: Lǎoyīng zhǎnchì fēi shàng tiānkōng.
column7: The eagle spread its wings and flew into the sky.
column9: A wing, mostly as part of compounds: 翅膀, 魚翅 "shark's fin" and 雞翅 "chicken wings", 展翅 "spread wings". Alone it is written style. 羽 "feather" is the meaning part and 支 gives the sound.

column3: To lose out, to come off worse: 吃亏 is to be at a disadvantage, to be cheated or to lose in a deal: 不想吃亏 "don't want to lose out", 吃亏上当 "get fooled". 吃 "eat, take" + 亏 "loss". Also in the saying 吃亏就是占便宜, "losing is gaining".
column4: 我不想吃亏，所以要问清楚。
column5: 我不想吃虧，所以要問清楚。
column6: Wǒ bù xiǎng chīkuī, suǒyǐ yào wèn qīngchu.
column7: I don't want to lose out, so I'll ask clearly.
column9: To lose out, to come off worse: 吃虧 is to be at a disadvantage, to be cheated or to lose in a deal: 不想吃虧 "don't want to lose out", 吃虧上當 "get fooled". 吃 "eat, take" + 虧 "loss". Also in the saying 吃虧就是佔便宜, "losing is gaining". 虧 has 亏 as the sound.

column3: Sooner or later: 迟早会知道 "will find out sooner or later", 他迟早要回来. It comes before the verb and is said of something that will surely happen, often with 会 or 要. 迟 "late" + 早 "early"; 迟 has 辶 "walk" for slow movement and 尺 as the sound.
column4: 你迟早会明白我的意思。
column5: 你遲早會明白我的意思。
column6: Nǐ chízǎo huì míngbai wǒ de yìsi.
column7: Sooner or later you will understand what I mean.
column9: Sooner or later: 遲早會知道 "will find out sooner or later", 他遲早要回來. It comes before the verb and is said of something that will surely happen, often with 會 or 要. 遲 "late" + 早 "early"; 遲 has 辶 "walk" for slow movement and 犀 as the sound.

column3: To worship, to admire greatly: 崇拜偶像 "idolize a star", 崇拜英雄, 个人崇拜 "personality cult". It is stronger than 喜欢 or 欣赏: you look up to someone. 崇 "high" has 山 "mountain" over 宗 as the sound; 拜 "bow".
column6: Tā hěn chóngbài zìjǐ de gēge.
column7: He greatly admires his older brother.
column9: To worship, to admire greatly: 崇拜偶像 "idolize a star", 崇拜英雄, 個人崇拜 "personality cult". It is stronger than 喜歡 or 欣賞: you look up to someone. 崇 "high" has 山 "mountain" over 宗 as the sound; 拜 "bow".

column3: Lofty, noble: 崇高的理想 "a lofty ideal", 崇高的精神 "a noble spirit". It is a written, praising word for goals, spirits and positions. 崇 "high" over 山 "mountain", and 高 "tall", whose picture is a tall building.
column6: Tā yǒu chónggāo de lǐxiǎng.
column7: He has lofty ideals.
column9: Lofty, noble: 崇高的理想 "a lofty ideal", 崇高的精神 "a noble spirit". It is a written, praising word for goals, spirits and positions. 崇 "high" over 山 "mountain", and 高 "tall", whose picture is a tall building.

column3: A drawer: 打开抽屉 "open a drawer", 放进抽屉 "put it in the drawer", 书桌的抽屉. The measure word is 个 or 层. 抽 "pull out" has 扌 "hand" and 由; 屉 has 尸 (the shape of a body or a roof) on top. The second syllable is neutral (chōuti).
column6: Yàoshi zài shūzhuō de chōuti lǐ.
column7: The key is in the desk drawer.
column9: A drawer: 打開抽屜 "open a drawer", 放進抽屜 "put it in the drawer", 書桌的抽屜. The measure word is 個 or 層. 抽 "pull out" has 扌 "hand" and 由; 屜 has 尸 (the shape of a body or a roof) on top. The second syllable is neutral (chōuti).

column3: As a verb, "to be in, to handle": 处在 "be in (a situation)", 处于 "be situated in", 相处 "get along", 处理 "deal with". Read chǔ. The same character read chù is a noun "place", as in 到处 and 好处. It is more written than spoken. 处 is made of 夂 and 卜.
column4: 他处在很困难的情况中。
column5: 他處在很困難的情況中。
column6: Tā chǔ zài hěn kùnnán de qíngkuàng zhōng.
column7: He is in a very difficult situation.
column9: As a verb, "to be in, to handle": 處在 "be in (a situation)", 處於 "be situated in", 相處 "get along", 處理 "deal with". Read chǔ. The same character read chù is a noun "place", as in 到處 and 好處. It is more written than spoken. 處 has 虍 on top and a form of 処 with 夂 and 几 below.

column3: A leaflet, a flyer: 发传单 "hand out flyers", 一张传单, 广告传单. It is a sheet of paper handed out in the street, for a shop, a class or a campaign. 传 "pass on" + 单 "sheet". 传 has 亻 "person" and 专 as the sound; 单 is read dān here.
column6: Lùbiān yǒu rén zài fā chuándān.
column7: Someone is handing out flyers by the road.
column9: A leaflet, a flyer: 發傳單 "hand out flyers", 一張傳單, 廣告傳單. It is a sheet of paper handed out in the street, for a shop, a class or a campaign. 傳 "pass on" + 單 "sheet". 傳 has 亻 "person" and 專 as the sound; 單 is read dān here.

column3: A measure word for buildings: 一幢房子 "a house", 一幢大楼 "a tall building". The word list gives zhuàng; Taiwan also reads it chuáng. It is used for whole buildings, where 间 is for rooms and shops. 巾 "cloth" is the meaning part, since 幢 first meant a banner or curtain, and 童 gives the sound.
column6: Nà zhuàng dàlóu yǒu sānshí céng.
column7: That building has thirty floors.
column9: A measure word for buildings: 一幢房子 "a house", 一幢大樓 "a tall building". The word list gives zhuàng; Taiwan also reads it chuáng. It is used for whole buildings, where 間 is for rooms and shops. 巾 "cloth" is the meaning part, since 幢 first meant a banner or curtain, and 童 gives the sound.

column3: A bed sheet: 换床单 "change the sheets", 洗床单, 一条床单. It is the flat sheet spread over the mattress. 床 "bed" combines 广 "shelter" and 木 "wood", a wooden bed; 单 "single, sheet" is read dān.
column4: 我每个星期换一次床单。
column5: 我每個星期換一次床單。
column6: Wǒ měi ge xīngqī huàn yī cì chuángdān.
column7: I change my sheets once a week.
column9: A bed sheet: 換床單 "change the sheets", 洗床單, 一條床單. It is the flat sheet spread over the mattress. 床 "bed" combines 广 "shelter" and 木 "wood", a wooden bed; 單 "single, sheet" is read dān.

column3: A window, mostly a service counter: 柜台窗口 "service window", 排队到窗口 "go to the window"; also a window on a computer screen. For a window in a wall 窗户 is used. It is where you stand to pay or ask. 窗 has 穴 "hole" and 囱 "chimney"; 口 "mouth, opening".
column4: 请到三号窗口办理手续。
column5: 請到三號窗口辦理手續。
column6: Qǐng dào sān hào chuāngkǒu bànlǐ shǒuxù.
column7: Please go to window number three to do the paperwork.
column9: A window, mostly a service counter: 櫃檯窗口 "service window", 排隊到窗口 "go to the window"; also a window on a computer screen. For a window in a wall 窗戶 is used. It is where you stand to pay or ask. 窗 has 穴 "hole" and 囪 "chimney"; 口 "mouth, opening".

column3: To infect, to spread (a disease): 传染病 "infectious disease", 容易传染 "easily spread", 被传染. It is for illness passing from person to person, and also for a mood: 笑声会传染. 传 "pass on" + 染 "dye, catch". 染 has 氵 water and 木 wood: a dye with plants.
column4: 感冒很容易传染给别人。
column5: 感冒很容易傳染給別人。
column6: Gǎnmào hěn róngyì chuánrǎn gěi biéren.
column7: A cold is easily passed on to others.
column9: To infect, to spread (a disease): 傳染病 "infectious disease", 容易傳染 "easily spread", 被傳染. It is for illness passing from person to person, and also for a mood: 笑聲會傳染. 傳 "pass on" + 染 "dye, catch". 染 has 氵 water and 木 wood: a dye with plants.

column3: To convey, to transmit: 传送档案 "send a file", 传送带 "conveyor belt", 传送资料. It is for sending things electronically or by a machine. 传 "pass" + 送 "send", where 送 has 辶 "walk" and shows someone seeing a person off.
column6: Qǐng bǎ wénjiàn chuánsòng gěi wǒ.
column7: Please send the file to me.
column9: To convey, to transmit: 傳送檔案 "send a file", 傳送帶 "conveyor belt", 傳送資料. It is for sending things electronically or by a machine. 傳 "pass" + 送 "send", where 送 has 辶 "walk" and shows someone seeing a person off.

column3: To produce, of a place that yields something: 这里出产茶叶 "this place produces tea", 出产水果. It tells what a region is known for. 出 "come out" + 产 "produce". It is a verb with a place as subject, and in news it can be a noun for the products.
column4: 这个地区出产很好的茶叶。
column5: 這個地區出產很好的茶葉。
column6: Zhège dìqū chūchǎn hěn hǎo de cháyè.
column7: This region produces very good tea.
column9: To produce, of a place that yields something: 這裡出產茶葉 "this place produces tea", 出產水果. It tells what a region is known for. 出 "come out" + 產 "produce". It is a verb with a place as subject, and in news it can be a noun for the products.

column3: Everywhere, in every respect: 处处都是 "it's everywhere", 处处为别人着想 "think of others in everything". It repeats 处 "place" and can mean places or all aspects. It comes before the verb and describes a quality.
column6: Tā chùchù wèi biéren zhuóxiǎng.
column7: He thinks of others in every way.
column9: Everywhere, in every respect: 處處都是 "it's everywhere", 處處為別人著想 "think of others in everything". It repeats 處 "place" and can mean places or all aspects. It comes before the verb and describes a quality.

column3: To store, to save: 储存档案 "save a file", 储存食物 "store food", 储存空间 "storage space". It is common for data on a computer and for goods in a store. 储 has 亻 "person" and 诸 as the sound; 存 "exist, keep" has 子 "child" and 才. The first character is read chǔ.
column4: 请把文件储存在电脑里。
column5: 請把文件儲存在電腦裡。
column6: Qǐng bǎ wénjiàn chǔcún zài diànnǎo lǐ.
column7: Please save the file on the computer.
column9: To store, to save: 儲存檔案 "save a file", 儲存食物 "store food", 儲存空間 "storage space". It is common for data on a computer and for goods in a store. 儲 has 亻 "person" and 諸 as the sound; 存 "exist, keep" has 子 "child" and 才. The first character is read chǔ.

column3: To leave the country, also "outbound": 出境手续 "exit formalities", 出入境 "entry and exit". It is the term for passing out of the border at the airport, where 入境 is its opposite. 出 "go out" + 境 "border", which has 土 "earth" and 竟 as the sound.
column6: Chūjìng qián yào xiān jiǎnchá hùzhào.
column7: Check your passport first before leaving the country.
column9: To leave the country, also "outbound": 出境手續 "exit formalities", 出入境 "entry and exit". It is the term for passing out of the border at the airport, where 入境 is its opposite. 出 "go out" + 境 "border", which has 土 "earth" and 竟 as the sound.

column3: Background, origin: 家庭出身 "family background", 农家出身 "from a farming family", 出身贫寒 "of a poor family", 军人出身. It says where a person came from: the class, family or training. 出 "come out" + 身 "body, self". 身 comes from a picture of a pregnant woman.
column4: 他出身于一个普通的家庭。
column5: 他出身於一個普通的家庭。
column6: Tā chūshēn yú yī ge pǔtōng de jiātíng.
column7: He comes from an ordinary family.
column9: Background, origin: 家庭出身 "family background", 農家出身 "from a farming family", 出身貧寒 "of a poor family", 軍人出身. It says where a person came from: the class, family or training. 出 "come out" + 身 "body, self". 身 comes from a picture of a pregnant woman.

column3: To have an accident, to have trouble: 出事了 "something has happened", 路上出事 "an accident on the road". It is spoken, and what happened is bad. 出 "come out" + 事 "matter". 事 has a hand holding a flag, then "to do a job".
column6: Qiánmiàn de lùkǒu chūshì le.
column7: There has been an accident at the junction ahead.
column9: To have an accident, to have trouble: 出事了 "something has happened", 路上出事 "an accident on the road". It is spoken, and what happened is bad. 出 "come out" + 事 "matter". 事 has a hand holding a flag, then "to do a job".

column3: Savings, and "to save money": 储蓄存款 "savings deposit", 储蓄习惯, 储蓄率. It is the formal word for money kept in a bank for the long term, where 存钱 is the spoken one. 储 "store" + 蓄 "accumulate", the second with 艹 "plant" and 畜 as the sound.
column4: 他每个月都有储蓄的习惯。
column5: 他每個月都有儲蓄的習慣。
column6: Tā měi ge yuè dōu yǒu chǔxù de xíguàn.
column7: Every month he has the habit of saving.
column9: Savings, and "to save money": 儲蓄存款 "savings deposit", 儲蓄習慣, 儲蓄率. It is the formal word for money kept in a bank for the long term, where 存錢 is the spoken one. 儲 "store" + 蓄 "accumulate", the second with 艹 "plant" and 畜 as the sound.

column3: Number of times, frequency: 次数太多 "too many times", 增加次数 "increase the number of times", 练习次数. It is the count of occurrences, 次 "time" + 数 "number" (read shù). 次 has 冫 and 欠 "yawn", a person breathing out.
column4: 我这个月去健身房的次数不多。
column5: 我這個月去健身房的次數不多。
column6: Wǒ zhège yuè qù jiànshēnfáng de cìshù bù duō.
column7: I haven't gone to the gym many times this month.
column9: Number of times, frequency: 次數太多 "too many times", 增加次數 "increase the number of times", 練習次數. It is the count of occurrences, 次 "time" + 數 "number" (read shù). 次 has 冫 and 欠 "yawn", a person breathing out.

column3: Never (in the past): 我从没去过 "I have never been", 从没见过 "never seen". It is followed by a verb with 过, and it is a short form of 从来没有. 从 "from" + 没 "not have". 没 has 氵 "water", as the old meaning was "sink", and the rest is the sound part.
column4: 我从没见过这么大的雪。
column5: 我從沒見過這麼大的雪。
column6: Wǒ cóngméi jiàn guò zhème dà de xuě.
column7: I have never seen such heavy snow.
column9: Never (in the past): 我從沒去過 "I have never been", 從沒見過 "never seen". It is followed by a verb with 過, and it is a short form of 從來沒有. 從 "from" + 沒 "not have". 沒 has 氵 "water", as the old meaning was "sink", and the rest is the sound part.

column3: To gather, to pool, to put together: 凑钱 "pool money", 凑热闹 "join in the fun", 凑合 "make do", 凑巧 "by chance". It also means "to move close": 凑近一点. 冫 is the meaning part and 奏 the sound (còu).
column4: 我们凑钱给老师买了礼物。
column5: 我們湊錢給老師買了禮物。
column6: Wǒmen còu qián gěi lǎoshī mǎi le lǐwù.
column7: We pooled our money and bought a present for the teacher.
column9: To gather, to pool, to put together: 湊錢 "pool money", 湊熱鬧 "join in the fun", 湊合 "make do", 湊巧 "by chance". It also means "to move close": 湊近一點. 氵 "water" is the meaning part and 奏 the sound (còu).

column3: To urge, to hurry someone: 催他快点 "urge him to hurry", 催促, 催缴 "send a payment reminder", and 催眠 "hypnotize". The person pushed goes after it. 亻 "person" is the meaning part and 崔 the sound (cuī).
column4: 妈妈一直催我快点起床。
column5: 媽媽一直催我快點起床。
column6: Māma yīzhí cuī wǒ kuài diǎn qǐchuáng.
column7: Mom keeps urging me to get up quickly.
column9: To urge, to hurry someone: 催他快點 "urge him to hurry", 催促, 催繳 "send a payment reminder", and 催眠 "hypnotize". The person pushed goes after it. 亻 "person" is the meaning part and 崔 the sound (cuī).

column3: To rub, to roll between the hands: 搓手 "rub one's hands", 搓汤圆 "roll glutinous rice balls", 搓洗 "scrub (clothes)", 搓麻将 is slang for playing mahjong. The action is a back-and-forth rub with the palms or fingers. 扌 "hand" is the meaning part and 差 gives a sound near cuō.
column4: 冬天很冷，他不停地搓手。
column5: 冬天很冷，他不停地搓手。
column6: Dōngtiān hěn lěng, tā bù tíng de cuō shǒu.
column7: It is very cold in winter, and he keeps rubbing his hands.
column9: To rub, to roll between the hands: 搓手 "rub one's hands", 搓湯圓 "roll glutinous rice balls", 搓洗 "scrub (clothes)", 搓麻將 is slang for playing mahjong. The action is a back-and-forth rub with the palms or fingers. 扌 "hand" is the meaning part and 差 gives a sound near cuō.

column3: To miss a chance, a train, a person: 错过机会 "miss a chance", 错过火车, 别错过 "don't miss it". It is about what slipped past you without meeting. 错 "wrong" + 过 "pass". 错 has 钅 "metal" and 昔 as the sound; the first meaning was a whetstone.
column4: 我错过了最后一班捷运。
column5: 我錯過了最後一班捷運。
column6: Wǒ cuòguò le zuìhòu yī bān jiéyùn.
column7: I missed the last MRT train.
column9: To miss a chance, a train, a person: 錯過機會 "miss a chance", 錯過火車, 別錯過 "don't miss it". It is about what slipped past you without meeting. 錯 "wrong" + 過 "pass". 錯 has 釒 "metal" and 昔 as the sound; the first meaning was a whetstone.
