column3: A wrongly written character: 写错字 "write a wrong character", 改错字 "correct the typo", 找错字 "find the wrong characters", 错字连篇 "full of mistakes". It means a character that is not right in form, and is also used for typos. 错 "wrong" + 字 "character", which is a child 子 under a roof 宀.
column4: 这篇文章里有两个错字。
column5: 這篇文章裡有兩個錯字。
column6: Zhè piān wénzhāng lǐ yǒu liǎng ge cuòzì.
column7: There are two wrongly written characters in this article.
column9: A wrongly written character: 寫錯字 "write a wrong character", 改錯字 "correct the typo", 找錯字 "find the wrong characters", 錯字連篇 "full of mistakes". It means a character that is not right in form, and is also used for typos. 錯 "wrong" + 字 "character", which is a child 子 under a roof 宀.

column3: More than half, mostly, probably: 大半个月 "more than half a month", 大半是 "mostly", 大半天 "most of the day". As an adverb before a verb it means "most likely". 大 "big" + 半 "half". 半 is a cow 牛 divided by 丷, an old picture of cutting something in two.
column6: Tā dàbàn ge yuè dōu zài chūchāi.
column7: He is away on business for most of the month.
column9: More than half, mostly, probably: 大半個月 "more than half a month", 大半是 "mostly", 大半天 "most of the day". As an adverb before a verb it means "most likely". 大 "big" + 半 "half". 半 is a cow 牛 divided by 丷, an old picture of cutting something in two.

column3: Feces, and "to defecate": 大便 and 小便 are the plain words for the two. 上大便 or 拉大便 "go to the toilet"; 大便 is used in a doctor's visit and with children. In speech the polite word is 上厕所. 大 "big" + 便 "convenience", read biàn here: 便 is only pián in 便宜.
column4: 医生问他的大便正不正常。
column5: 醫生問他的大便正不正常。
column6: Yīshēng wèn tā de dàbiàn zhèng bù zhèngcháng.
column7: The doctor asked whether his bowel movements are normal.
column9: Feces, and "to defecate": 大便 and 小便 are the plain words for the two. 上大便 or 拉大便 "go to the toilet"; 大便 is used in a doctor's visit and with children. In speech the polite word is 上廁所. 大 "big" + 便 "convenience", read biàn here: 便 is only pián in 便宜.

column3: The earth, the land, in a poetic sense: 大地回春 "spring returns to the land", 大地震动 "the earth shook". 大 "big" + 地 "ground". 地 has 土 "earth" and 也 as the sound.
column4: 春天来了，大地一片绿色。
column5: 春天來了，大地一片綠色。
column6: Chūntiān lái le, dàdì yī piàn lǜsè.
column7: Spring has come and the land is all green.
column9: The earth, the land, in a poetic sense: 大地回春 "spring returns to the land", 大地震動 "the earth shook". 大 "big" + 地 "ground". 地 has 土 "earth" and 也 as the sound.

column3: Mostly, for the most part: 大都是学生 "mostly students", 大都如此 "mostly so". It goes before a verb or 是 and says the greater part, not all. It is written. It is read dàdōu; 都 here is the adverb "all", not the noun "capital" (dū).
column4: 这里的学生大都住在附近。
column5: 這裡的學生大都住在附近。
column6: Zhèlǐ de xuésheng dàdōu zhù zài fùjìn.
column7: Most of the students here live nearby.
column9: Mostly, for the most part: 大都是學生 "mostly students", 大都如此 "mostly so". It goes before a verb or 是 and says the greater part, not all. It is written. It is read dàdōu; 都 here is the adverb "all", not the noun "capital" (dū).

column3: To interrupt: 打断别人说话 "interrupt someone", 被打断 "be interrupted", and "to break" a bone: 腿被打断. The first sense is the one to learn. 打 "hit" + 断 "break". 断 has 米 and an axe 斤.
column6: Qǐng bù yào dǎduàn biéren shuōhuà.
column7: Please don't interrupt other people when they speak.
column9: To interrupt: 打斷別人說話 "interrupt someone", 被打斷 "be interrupted", and "to break" a bone: 腿被打斷. The first sense is the one to learn. 打 "hit" + 斷 "break". 斷 shows threads 幺 cut by an axe 斤.

column3: To treat, to deal with, and "to wait": 待人 "treat people", 待客 "receive guests", 招待 "host", 对待 "treat". The spoken word for "wait" is 等, so 待 means waiting only in the written 等待 and 待会. 彳 "step" and 寺 (the sound, si) build the character; 寺 was a court.
column6: Tā dài rén hěn qīnqiè.
column7: He treats people very kindly.
column9: To treat, to deal with, and "to wait": 待人 "treat people", 待客 "receive guests", 招待 "host", 對待 "treat". The spoken word for "wait" is 等, so 待 means waiting only in the written 等待 and 待會. 彳 "step" and 寺 (the sound, si) build the character; 寺 was a court.

column3: A belt, a strap, a band: 鞋带子, 一条带子, 背包的带子 "a bag strap". Also, in speech, a tape for audio or video. The neutral 子 makes it a thing. 带 "carry, belt" is the picture of a belt, with a tie above and a cloth 巾 below.
column6: Zhège bāo de dàizi duàn le.
column7: The strap of this bag has broken.
column9: A belt, a strap, a band: 鞋帶子, 一條帶子, 揹包的帶子 "a bag strap". Also, in speech, a tape for audio or video. The neutral 子 makes it a thing. 帶 "carry, belt" is the picture of a belt, with a tie above and a cloth 巾 below.

column3: The generation gap: 有代沟 "there is a generation gap", 代沟问题, 亲子之间的代沟. It is what parents and children feel when their views differ. 代 "generation" + 沟 "ditch", the gap between them. 沟 has 氵 "water", as ditches carry water, and 勾 as the sound.
column6: Wǒ hé bàba zhījiān yǒu dàigōu.
column7: There is a generation gap between my dad and me.
column9: The generation gap: 有代溝 "there is a generation gap", 代溝問題, 親子之間的代溝. It is what parents and children feel when their views differ. 代 "generation" + 溝 "ditch", the gap between them. 溝 has 氵 "water", as ditches carry water, and 冓 as the sound.

column3: In a moment, later: 待会见 "see you later", 待会再说 "talk about it later", 我待会要去... It points to a short time ahead, in the same day. 待 "wait" + 会 "a while"; the dictionary gives the second syllable a neutral tone.
column4: 你先坐一下，我待会就来。
column5: 你先坐一下，我待會就來。
column6: Nǐ xiān zuò yīxià, wǒ dāihuì jiù lái.
column7: Sit down for a moment; I'll be there in a while.
column9: In a moment, later: 待會見 "see you later", 待會再說 "talk about it later", 我待會要去... It points to a short time ahead, in the same day. 待 "wait" + 會 "a while"; the dictionary gives the second syllable a neutral tone.

column3: In a moment, later: 待会儿见, 待会儿再说, 待会儿我打给你. It is the same as 待会, and 儿 is the spoken "r" ending, which the dictionary writes into the pinyin. It sets an action in the near future. 儿 shows an infant with a soft skull, and it is a sound in the ending.
column6: Wǒ dāihuìr gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
column7: I'll call you in a moment.
column9: In a moment, later: 待會兒見, 待會兒再說, 待會兒我打給你. It is the same as 待會, and 兒 is the spoken "r" ending, which the dictionary writes into the pinyin. It sets an action in the near future. 兒 shows an infant with a soft skull, and it is a sound in the ending.

column3: To lead the way, to show the way: 带路的人 "a guide", 帮我们带路 "lead us there", 我来带路. It is a verb with its object, so 带了路 and 带个路 are normal. 带 "bring, lead" + 路 "road". 路 has 足 "foot" and 各 as the sound.
column4: 你对这里很熟，请你带路。
column5: 你對這裡很熟，請你帶路。
column6: Nǐ duì zhèlǐ hěn shú, qǐng nǐ dàilù.
column7: You know this place well; please lead the way.
column9: To lead the way, to show the way: 帶路的人 "a guide", 幫我們帶路 "lead us there", 我來帶路. It is a verb with its object, so 帶了路 and 帶個路 are normal. 帶 "bring, lead" + 路 "road". 路 has 足 "foot" and 各 as the sound.

column3: A main street, a street: 逛大街 "stroll the streets (shopping)", 大街上人很多, 大街小巷 "every street and lane". 大 "big" + 街 "street", which has 行 "go" around 圭.
column6: Dàjiē shàng dàochù dōu shì rén.
column7: The streets are full of people everywhere.
column9: A main street, a street: 逛大街 "stroll the streets (shopping)", 大街上人很多, 大街小巷 "every street and lane". 大 "big" + 街 "street", which has 行 "go" around 圭.

column3: With great effort, vigorously: 大力支持 "give strong support", 大力推广 "promote strongly", 大力宣传. It goes before a verb of promoting or supporting, in news and speeches. 大 "big" + 力 "strength". 力 is a plow or an arm.
column4: 政府大力支持这项计划。
column5: 政府大力支持這項計劃。
column6: Zhèngfǔ dàlì zhīchí zhè xiàng jìhuà.
column7: The government strongly supports this plan.
column9: With great effort, vigorously: 大力支持 "give strong support", 大力推廣 "promote strongly", 大力宣傳. It goes before a verb of promoting or supporting, in news and speeches. 大 "big" + 力 "strength". 力 is a plow or an arm.

column3: A list, a bill, a form: 开单子 "write out a list", 购物单子 "shopping list", 菜单子. It is a sheet of paper with items. 单 "single, sheet" + the neutral suffix 子. 清单 is the more formal word for a list.
column4: 你把要买的东西写在单子上。
column5: 你把要買的東西寫在單子上。
column6: Nǐ bǎ yào mǎi de dōngxi xiě zài dānzi shàng.
column7: Write what you want to buy on the list.
column9: A list, a bill, a form: 開單子 "write out a list", 購物單子 "shopping list", 菜單子. It is a sheet of paper with items. 單 "single, sheet" + the neutral suffix 子. 清單 is the more formal word for a list.

column3: Protein: 富含蛋白质 "rich in protein", 补充蛋白质 "get more protein", 动物性蛋白质. It is a nutrition word, built from 蛋白 "egg white" + 质 "substance". 蛋 has 虫 under 疋, from a word for an egg, and 质 has 贝 "shell", which points to value.
column6: Dòufu hányǒu hěn duō dànbáizhì.
column7: Tofu contains a lot of protein.
column9: Protein: 富含蛋白質 "rich in protein", 補充蛋白質 "get more protein", 動物性蛋白質. It is a nutrition word, built from 蛋白 "egg white" + 質 "substance". 蛋 has 虫 under 疋, from a word for an egg, and 質 has 貝 "shell", which points to value.

column3: Here the word list means 当 read dàng: "to regard as, to take as", and "suitable": 把他当朋友 "treat him as a friend", 当真 "take seriously", 上当 "be fooled", 适当. It is the same character as dāng "should, when" (当时). 当 is made of ⺌ over 彐.
column4: 他把我当成他最好的朋友。
column5: 他把我當成他最好的朋友。
column6: Tā bǎ wǒ dàng chéng tā zuì hǎo de péngyou.
column7: He takes me as his best friend.
column9: Here the word list means 當 read dàng: "to regard as, to take as", and "suitable": 把他當朋友 "treat him as a friend", 當真 "take seriously", 上當 "be fooled", 適當. It is the same character as dāng "should, when" (當時). 尚 gives the sound.

column3: A file, records: 电脑档案 "computer file", 档案夹 "folder", 档案室 "records room", 建立档案. In Taiwan 档案 is the normal word for a computer file, where the mainland says 文件. It also means official records on a person. 档 has 木 "wood" and 当 as the sound, as it was a wooden shelf; 案 "case, record".
column6: Qǐng bǎ zhège dàng'àn chuán gěi wǒ.
column7: Please send me this file.
column9: A file, records: 電腦檔案 "computer file", 檔案夾 "folder", 檔案室 "records room", 建立檔案. In Taiwan 檔案 is the normal word for a computer file, where the mainland says 文件. It also means official records on a person. 檔 has 木 "wood" and 當 as the sound, as it was a wooden shelf; 案 "case, record".

column3: Courage, guts: 有胆量 "have the courage", 胆量大 "bold", 练胆量 "train one's nerve". It is what you need for something risky, like speaking in public or entering a haunted house. 胆 "gall" has ⺼ "flesh", for a body part, and 旦 as the sound; 量 "amount".
column4: 他没有胆量一个人走夜路。
column5: 他沒有膽量一個人走夜路。
column6: Tā méiyǒu dǎnliàng yī ge rén zǒu yèlù.
column7: He doesn't have the nerve to walk alone at night.
column9: Courage, guts: 有膽量 "have the courage", 膽量大 "bold", 練膽量 "train one's nerve". It is what you need for something risky, like speaking in public or entering a haunted house. 膽 "gall" has ⺼ "flesh", for a body part, and 詹 as the sound; 量 "amount".

column3: To be born, to come into being: 新生命诞生 "a new life is born", 新国家诞生, For a birthday, 生日 is the word, not 诞生. 诞生 is written style, and for people of note or things like a company. 诞 has 讠 "speech" and 延 as the sound; 生 "birth" is a sprout from the ground.
column4: 这家公司诞生于一九九八年。
column5: 這家公司誕生於一九九八年。
column6: Zhè jiā gōngsī dànshēng yú yī jiǔ jiǔ bā nián.
column7: This company was founded in 1998.
column9: To be born, to come into being: 新生命誕生 "a new life is born", 新國家誕生, For a birthday, 生日 is the word, not 誕生. 誕生 is written style, and for people of note or things like a company. 誕 has 言 "speech" and 延 as the sound; 生 "birth" is a sprout from the ground.

column3: To delay, to hold up: 耽误时间 "waste time", 耽误你的时间 "take your time", 耽误了工作. It says that something caused a delay or harm, and is said politely: 不好意思，耽误你了. 耽 has 耳 "ear" and 冘 as the sound, and 误 "mistake" has 讠 "speech" and 吴. The second syllable is neutral.
column6: Duìbuqǐ, dānwu nǐ jǐ fēnzhōng.
column7: Sorry to take a few minutes of your time.
column9: To delay, to hold up: 耽誤時間 "waste time", 耽誤你的時間 "take your time", 耽誤了工作. It says that something caused a delay or harm, and is said politely: 不好意思，耽誤你了. 耽 has 耳 "ear" and 冘 as the sound, and 誤 "mistake" has 言 "speech" and 吳. The second syllable is neutral.

column3: Unlucky, to have bad luck: 真倒楣 "what bad luck", 倒楣的人, 倒大楣 "have terrible luck". It is spoken and used for small misfortunes. Taiwan usually writes 倒楣, with the wood 木 in 楣 (a door lintel), and the mainland 倒霉. 倒 has 亻 "person" and 到 as the sound.
column4: 我今天真倒楣，又下雨又迟到。
column5: 我今天真倒楣，又下雨又遲到。
column6: Wǒ jīntiān zhēn dǎoméi, yòu xià yǔ yòu chídào.
column7: I'm so unlucky today: it rained and I was late.
column9: Unlucky, to have bad luck: 真倒楣 "what bad luck", 倒楣的人, 倒大楣 "have terrible luck". It is spoken and used for small misfortunes. Taiwan usually writes 倒楣, with the wood 木 in 楣 (a door lintel), and the mainland 倒霉. 倒 has 亻 "person" and 到 as the sound.

column3: To fall due, to expire: 护照到期 "the passport expires", 到期日 "due date", 合约到期. It is for a loan, a card, a passport or a contract that reaches its end date. 到 "arrive" + 期 "period". 到 has 至 "arrive" and 刂 (knife) as the sound; 期 has 月 "moon" and 其.
column4: 我的信用卡下个月到期。
column5: 我的信用卡下個月到期。
column6: Wǒ de xìnyòngkǎ xià ge yuè dàoqī.
column7: My credit card expires next month.
column9: To fall due, to expire: 護照到期 "the passport expires", 到期日 "due date", 合約到期. It is for a loan, a card, a passport or a contract that reaches its end date. 到 "arrive" + 期 "period". 到 has 至 "arrive" and 刂 (knife) as the sound; 期 has 月 "moon" and 其.

column3: Very early in the morning: 大清早就起床 "get up at the crack of dawn", 大清早的. It is spoken and often in complaint: 大清早的，吵什么？ 大 adds emphasis to 清早 "early morning". 清 has 氵 "water" and 青, so it is "clear".
column6: Tā dàqīngzǎo jiù chūmén le.
column7: He went out at the crack of dawn.
column9: Very early in the morning: 大清早就起床 "get up at the crack of dawn", 大清早的. It is spoken and often in complaint: 大清早的，吵什麼？ 大 adds emphasis to 清早 "early morning". 清 has 氵 "water" and 青, so it is "clear".

column3: Older brother's wife, your sister-in-law, and the way you address her: 大嫂，你好. Also a polite title for an older woman a bit like "ma'am" or "sister". 大 "big, eldest" + 嫂 "sister-in-law". 嫂 has 女 "woman" and 叟 as the sound (sǎo).
column6: Dàsǎo zuò de cài hěn hǎochī.
column7: My brother's wife cooks very well.
column9: Older brother's wife, your sister-in-law, and the way you address her: 大嫂，你好. Also a polite title for an older woman a bit like "ma'am" or "sister". 大 "big, eldest" + 嫂 "sister-in-law". 嫂 has 女 "woman" and 叟 as the sound (sǎo).

column3: The thigh: 大腿很痠 "my thighs ache", 大腿肉, 抱大腿 "to cling to a powerful person" (slang). It is the part above the knee; 小腿 is the calf. 腿 has ⺼ "flesh" and 退 as the sound. The name 大 + 腿 means "big leg".
column4: 爬山以后，我的大腿很酸。
column5: 爬山以後，我的大腿很痠。
column6: Páshān yǐhòu, wǒ de dàtuǐ hěn suān.
column7: After climbing the mountain, my thighs ache.
column9: The thigh: 大腿很痠 "my thighs ache", 大腿肉, 抱大腿 "to cling to a powerful person" (slang). It is the part above the knee; 小腿 is the calf. 腿 has ⺼ "flesh" and 退 as the sound. The name 大 + 腿 means "big leg".

column3: Read dàyì it means "general idea, main point": 文章大意 "the gist of the article", 大意是... "the gist is...", 说出大意. With a neutral second syllable, dàyi, it means "careless": 不要大意. The word list's reading is the first. 大 "big" + 意 "meaning", where 意 has 心 under 音.
column4: 请你说说这篇文章的大意。
column5: 請你說說這篇文章的大意。
column6: Qǐng nǐ shuōshuo zhè piān wénzhāng de dàyì.
column7: Please tell me the gist of this article.
column9: Read dàyì it means "general idea, main point": 文章大意 "the gist of the article", 大意是... "the gist is...", 說出大意. With a neutral second syllable, dàyi, it means "careless": 不要大意. The word list's reading is the first. 大 "big" + 意 "meaning", where 意 has 心 under 音.

column3: There is much, plenty of, in written style, before a two-syllable word: 大有希望 "very hopeful", 大有进步 "much progress", 大有可为 "a great deal to be done". It is a pattern of news and speeches. 大 "greatly" + 有 "have". 有 shows 月 "flesh" under a hand.
column6: Tā de Zhōngwén dàyǒu jìnbù.
column7: His Chinese has improved greatly.
column9: There is much, plenty of, in written style, before a two-syllable word: 大有希望 "very hopeful", 大有進步 "much progress", 大有可為 "a great deal to be done". It is a pattern of news and speeches. 大 "greatly" + 有 "have". 有 shows 月 "flesh" under a hand.

column3: To greet someone, or "to give notice": 跟他打招呼 "say hi to him", 打声招呼 "let someone know". It is a verb with its object, so it splits: 打个招呼, 打了招呼. 打 "make" + 招呼 "greeting", where 招 "beckon" has 扌 "hand" and 呼 "call" has 口 "mouth". The 呼 is neutral.
column6: Tā zài lù shàng gēn wǒ dǎzhāohu.
column7: He greeted me on the street.
column9: To greet someone, or "to give notice": 跟他打招呼 "say hi to him", 打聲招呼 "let someone know". It is a verb with its object, so it splits: 打個招呼, 打了招呼. 打 "make" + 招呼 "greeting", where 招 "beckon" has 扌 "hand" and 呼 "call" has 口 "mouth". The 呼 is neutral.

column3: To type, on a keyboard or phone: 打字很快 "type fast", 打中文 "type Chinese", 练习打字. 打 here is the general verb "do" for typing and texting. The typed word is 字 "character", a child 子 under a roof 宀. It splits: 打了很多字.
column6: Tā dǎzì dǎ de hěn kuài.
column7: He types very fast.
column9: To type, on a keyboard or phone: 打字很快 "type fast", 打中文 "type Chinese", 練習打字. 打 here is the general verb "do" for typing and texting. The typed word is 字 "character", a child 子 under a roof 宀. It splits: 打了很多字.

column3: To win a prize: 得奖 is a verb with its object, so 得了奖 and 得过奖 are normal. 得奖者 "winner", 得奖作品. 得 "get" shows a hand 寸 taking a shell, and 奖 "prize" has 大 with 丬 as the sound.
column6: Tā de diànyǐng déjiǎng le.
column7: His film won a prize.
column9: To win a prize: 得獎 is a verb with its object, so 得了獎 and 得過獎 are normal. 得獎者 "winner", 得獎作品. 得 "get" shows a hand 寸 taking a shell, and 獎 "prize" has 犬 "dog" with 將 as the sound.

column3: A stool, a bench: 板凳 "wooden bench", 椅凳. Alone it is rare; speech says 凳子. It is a seat with no back. The old meaning part is 几 "small table", and 登 gives the sound.
column6: Tā bān le yī ge dèng lái zuò.
column7: He brought a stool over to sit on.
column9: A stool, a bench: 板凳 "wooden bench", 椅凳. Alone it is rare; speech says 凳子. It is a seat with no back. The old meaning part is 几 "small table", and 登 gives the sound.

column3: A stool: 搬凳子 "carry a stool", 坐在凳子上, 小凳子. It is the spoken word for a seat with no back, where 椅子 has one. 凳 "stool" + the neutral suffix 子.
column4: 孩子坐在小凳子上画画。
column5: 孩子坐在小凳子上畫畫。
column6: Háizi zuò zài xiǎo dèngzi shàng huà huà.
column7: The child is sitting on a small stool, drawing.
column9: A stool: 搬凳子 "carry a stool", 坐在凳子上, 小凳子. It is the spoken word for a seat with no back, where 椅子 has one. 凳 "stool" + the neutral suffix 子.

column3: Cannot wait: 等不及了 "I can't wait", 等不及要... "can't wait to...". It is the potential form of 等 "wait": 等得及 "can wait", 等不及 "can't". It shows excitement, 我等不及要见你了, and also lack of patience. 等 has 竹 "bamboo" over 寺, as the bamboo slips were arranged in order.
column4: 我等不及要看这部电影了。
column5: 我等不及要看這部電影了。
column6: Wǒ děngbùjí yào kàn zhè bù diànyǐng le.
column7: I can't wait to see this film.
column9: Cannot wait: 等不及了 "I can't wait", 等不及要... "can't wait to...". It is the potential form of 等 "wait": 等得及 "can wait", 等不及 "can't". It shows excitement, 我等不及要見你了, and also lack of patience. 等 has 竹 "bamboo" over 寺, as the bamboo slips were arranged in order.

column3: To offend, to get on the wrong side of: 得罪人 "offend people", 得罪客人 "offend a customer", 不小心得罪了他. It can be a mild apology as well: 得罪了 "forgive me". 得 "get" + 罪 "fault", and 罪 has a net 罒 over 非 "wrong".
column6: Wǒ bù xiǎng dézuì rènhé rén.
column7: I don't want to offend anyone.
column9: To offend, to get on the wrong side of: 得罪人 "offend people", 得罪客人 "offend a customer", 不小心得罪了他. It can be a mild apology as well: 得罪了 "forgive me". 得 "get" + 罪 "fault", and 罪 has a net 罒 over 非 "wrong".

column3: To resist, to offset: 抵抗, 抵达 "arrive", 抵押 "mortgage", 抵销, 抵十块钱 "worth ten dollars". The word list reads it dǐ. 抵达 is common in news of flights and trains. 扌 "hand" is the meaning part and 氐 the sound.
column6: Fēijī yǐjīng dǐdá Táiběi le.
column7: The plane has arrived in Taipei.
column9: To resist, to offset: 抵抗, 抵達 "arrive", 抵押 "mortgage", 抵銷, 抵十塊錢 "worth ten dollars". The word list reads it dǐ. 抵達 is common in news of flights and trains. 扌 "hand" is the meaning part and 氐 the sound.

column3: To drip and "a drop": 滴水 "drip", 滴眼药水 "put in eye drops", 一滴水 "a drop of water" (measure word for drops). 滴 as a verb is for liquid falling in drops. 氵 "water" is the meaning part and 啇 gives the sound.
column6: Shuǐlóngtóu yīzhí zài dī shuǐ.
column7: The faucet keeps dripping.
column9: To drip and "a drop": 滴水 "drip", 滴眼藥水 "put in eye drops", 一滴水 "a drop of water" (measure word for drops). 滴 as a verb is for liquid falling in drops. 氵 "water" is the meaning part and 啇 gives the sound.

column3: A pad, a cushion, and "to put under": 垫子 "mat", 坐垫 "seat cushion", 垫高 "raise by putting something under", and "to pay for someone": 我先垫钱 "I'll pay first and you pay me later". 土 "earth" sits under 执 in 垫, as a thing laid under.
column4: 我先垫钱，你回来再还我。
column5: 我先墊錢，你回來再還我。
column6: Wǒ xiān diàn qián, nǐ huílái zài huán wǒ.
column7: I'll pay first, and you can pay me back when you return.
column9: A pad, a cushion, and "to put under": 墊子 "mat", 坐墊 "seat cushion", 墊高 "raise by putting something under", and "to pay for someone": 我先墊錢 "I'll pay first and you pay me later". 土 "earth" sits under 執 in 墊, as a thing laid under.

column3: A telegram: 发电报 "send a telegram", 电报局. The service has been outdated for years, so you find the word in history and in stories. 电 "electric" + 报 "report".
column6: Yéye niánqīng shí fā guo diànbào.
column7: Grandpa sent telegrams when he was young.
column9: A telegram: 發電報 "send a telegram", 電報局. The service has been outdated for years, so you find the word in history and in stories. 電 "electric" + 報 "report". 電 has 雨 "rain" over a lightning bolt, since lightning is the first electricity.

column3: Two meanings. "Electric-powered": 电动车 "electric vehicle", 电动牙刷 "electric toothbrush", 电动门 "automatic door". And, in Taiwan, "video games": 打电动 "play video games", 电动玩具. The second is a Taiwan usage; the mainland says 玩游戏. 电 "electric" + 动 "move".
column4: 哥哥每天晚上都打电动。
column5: 哥哥每天晚上都打電動。
column6: Gēge měitiān wǎnshang dōu dǎ diàndòng.
column7: My older brother plays video games every evening.
column9: Two meanings. "Electric-powered": 電動車 "electric vehicle", 電動牙刷 "electric toothbrush", 電動門 "automatic door". And, in Taiwan, "video games": 打電動 "play video games", 電動玩具. The second is a Taiwan usage; the mainland says 玩遊戲. 電 "electric" + 動 "move".

column3: Electrical appliances: 家用电器 "household appliances", 电器行 "appliance store", 电器用品. It covers refrigerators, fans, TVs and so on, not computers in the usual sense. 电 "electric" + 器 "device", which shows four vessels 口 around a dog 犬.
column4: 这家店卖各种家用电器。
column5: 這家店賣各種家用電器。
column6: Zhè jiā diàn mài gè zhǒng jiāyòng diànqì.
column7: This shop sells all kinds of household appliances.
column9: Electrical appliances: 家用電器 "household appliances", 電器行 "appliance store", 電器用品. It covers refrigerators, fans, TVs and so on, not computers in the usual sense. 電 "electric" + 器 "device", which shows four vessels 口 around a dog 犬.

column3: An electric fan: 开电扇 "turn on the fan", 吹电扇. 电风扇 is the full form and 电扇 the short one, both in speech. 电 "electric" + 扇 "fan", which shows a door 户 with feathers 羽, a fan like a door that swings.
column4: 天气太热了，我开电扇吧。
column5: 天氣太熱了，我開電扇吧。
column6: Tiānqì tài rè le, wǒ kāi diànshàn ba.
column7: It is too hot; let me turn on the fan.
column9: An electric fan: 開電扇 "turn on the fan", 吹電扇. 電風扇 is the full form and 電扇 the short one, both in speech. 電 "electric" + 扇 "fan", which shows a door 戶 with feathers 羽, a fan like a door that swings.

column3: An electric fan: 开电风扇 "turn on the fan", 吊扇 is a ceiling fan. It is the full form of 电扇. 电 "electric" + 风 "wind" + 扇 "fan". 风 "wind" began as a borrowed sign: an early character for the bird 凤 was used for its sound.
column6: Jiàoshì lǐ yǒu liǎng tái diànfēngshàn.
column7: There are two electric fans in the classroom.
column9: An electric fan: 開電風扇 "turn on the fan", 吊扇 is a ceiling fan. It is the full form of 電扇. 電 "electric" + 風 "wind" + 扇 "fan". 風 "wind" began as a borrowed sign: an early character for the bird 鳳 was used for its sound.

column3: Electric wire, a power cord: 拉电线 "run a wire", 电线杆 "utility pole", 电线走火 "an electrical short fire". It is the cable that carries power, and a spoken word. 电 "electric" + 线 "thread, line". 线 has 纟 "silk thread" and 戋 as the sound.
column4: 这条电线太旧了，很危险。
column5: 這條電線太舊了，很危險。
column6: Zhè tiáo diànxiàn tài jiù le, hěn wēixiǎn.
column7: This wire is too old and dangerous.
column9: Electric wire, a power cord: 拉電線 "run a wire", 電線桿 "utility pole", 電線走火 "an electrical short fire". It is the cable that carries power, and a spoken word. 電 "electric" + 線 "thread, line". 線 has 糹 "silk thread" and 泉 as the sound.

column3: Electronic, and "electron": 电子产品 "electronic products", 电子邮件 "email", 电子书 "ebook", 电子支付. It goes before the noun it describes. 电 "electric" + 子 "particle", the child-shaped 子 used as a suffix.
column4: 我在网上买了一本电子书。
column5: 我在網上買了一本電子書。
column6: Wǒ zài wǎng shàng mǎi le yī běn diànzǐ shū.
column7: I bought an ebook online.
column9: Electronic, and "electron": 電子產品 "electronic products", 電子郵件 "email", 電子書 "ebook", 電子支付. It goes before the noun it describes. 電 "electric" + 子 "particle", the child-shaped 子 used as a suffix.

column3: To hang, to suspend: 吊灯 "hanging lamp", 吊扇 "ceiling fan", 吊桥 "suspension bridge", 吊车 "crane", and 吊单杠 "hang from a bar". It is for something hanging from above. The character has 口 over 巾 "cloth", a cloth hung below an opening.
column6: Kètīng lǐ diào zhe yī zhǎn dà dēng.
column7: A big lamp hangs in the living room.
column9: To hang, to suspend: 吊燈 "hanging lamp", 吊扇 "ceiling fan", 吊橋 "suspension bridge", 吊車 "crane", and 吊單槓 "hang from a bar". It is for something hanging from above. The character has 口 over 巾 "cloth", a cloth hung below an opening.

column3: To fish with a line: 钓鱼 "go fishing", 钓竿 "fishing rod", 钓客, and "to lure": 钓到一个好对象. 钅 "metal" and 勺 give a metal hook, and 勺 is also the sound.
column4: 他钓了一整天，什么也没钓到。
column5: 他釣了一整天，什麼也沒釣到。
column6: Tā diào le yī zhěng tiān, shénme yě méi diào dào.
column7: He fished all day and caught nothing.
column9: To fish with a line: 釣魚 "go fishing", 釣竿 "fishing rod", 釣客, and "to lure": 釣到一個好對象. 釒 "metal" and 勺 give a metal hook, and 勺 is also the sound.

column3: To carve, to engrave, and "carving": 木雕刻, 雕刻家 "sculptor", 石头雕刻. It is the craft of cutting wood, stone or jade. 雕 "carve" has 隹 "bird" and 周; the bird part is a different word, 雕 "eagle". 刻 "cut" has 刂 "knife" and 亥 as the sound.
column4: 他在木头上雕刻了一只小鸟。
column5: 他在木頭上雕刻了一隻小鳥。

column3: To fish with a line: 去钓鱼 "go fishing", 钓鱼竿, 钓鱼台. The pole and the hook make it different from 捕鱼 "catch fish" by nets. 钓 "angle" + 鱼 "fish", which is a picture of a fish. It splits as a verb and its object: 钓到鱼, 钓了一条鱼.
column6: Zhōumò wǒmen qù hǎibiān diàoyú.

column9: To fish with a line: 去釣魚 "go fishing", 釣魚竿, 釣魚臺. The pole and the hook make it different from 捕魚 "catch fish" by nets. 釣 "angle" + 魚 "fish", which is a picture of a fish. It splits as a verb and its object: 釣到魚, 釣了一條魚.

column3: A low tide, and "a low point, a slump": 退潮到低潮, 低潮期 "a down period", 处于低潮 "in a slump". The second sense is common for moods, sales or a career. Opposite 高潮 "high tide, a climax". 低 "low" + 潮 "tide", which has 氵 "water" and 朝.
column4: 他最近工作不顺，心情很低潮。
column5: 他最近工作不順，心情很低潮。
column6: Tā zuìjìn gōngzuò bù shùn, xīnqíng hěn dīcháo.
column7: His work has not gone well lately, and he is in a low mood.
column9: A low tide, and "a low point, a slump": 退潮到低潮, 低潮期 "a down period", 處於低潮 "in a slump". The second sense is common for moods, sales or a career. Opposite 高潮 "high tide, a climax". 低 "low" + 潮 "tide", which has 氵 "water" and 朝.

column3: To fall, to drop: 跌倒 "fall down", 股票大跌 "stocks fall", 价格下跌 "prices drop". The word list gives diē; Taiwan also reads it dié. It is for a person falling and for numbers falling. 足 "foot" is the meaning part and 失 "lose" the sound-and-sense part: lose one's footing.
column6: Zuìjìn gǔpiào yīzhí zài diē.
column7: Stocks have been falling lately.
column9: To fall, to drop: 跌倒 "fall down", 股票大跌 "stocks fall", 價格下跌 "prices drop". The word list gives diē; Taiwan also reads it dié. It is for a person falling and for numbers falling. 足 "foot" is the meaning part and 失 "lose" the sound-and-sense part: lose one's footing.

column3: To fall down: 跌倒了 "fell down", 小心跌倒 "careful not to fall", 跌倒再爬起来 "fall and get up again". It is a person falling over, and also a figure for failure. 跌 "fall" + 倒 "collapse", the second with 亻 "person" and 到 as the sound.
column6: Xiǎohái pǎo de tài kuài, diēdǎo le.

column9: To fall down: 跌倒了 "fell down", 小心跌倒 "careful not to fall", 跌倒再爬起來 "fall and get up again". It is a person falling over, and also a figure for failure. 跌 "fall" + 倒 "collapse", the second with 亻 "person" and 到 as the sound.

column3: To resist: 抵抗力 "resistance (to disease)", 抵抗外敌 "resist an enemy", 抵抗病毒. It can be about an army or about the body's defenses. Often seen in health talk: 增加抵抗力 "build up immunity". 抵 "withstand" + 抗 "resist", both with 扌 "hand".
column4: 多运动可以增加身体的抵抗力。
column5: 多運動可以增加身體的抵抗力。
column6: Duō yùndòng kěyǐ zēngjiā shēntǐ de dǐkàng lì.

column9: To resist: 抵抗力 "resistance (to disease)", 抵抗外敵 "resist an enemy", 抵抗病毒. It can be about an army or about the body's defenses. Often seen in health talk: 增加抵抗力 "build up immunity". 抵 "withstand" + 抗 "resist", both with 扌 "hand".

column3: One of the Heavenly Stems, "the fourth": 甲乙丙丁. Also "a small cube": 肉丁, 萝卜丁 "diced radish", and a man of the household in old texts (人丁). 丁 is also a common surname. The character is a picture of a nail, and 钉 now carries that sense. It is a sound part of 盯, 订 and 打.
column6: Māma bǎ luóbo qiē chéng xiǎo dīng.
column7: Mom cut the radish into small cubes.
column9: One of the Heavenly Stems, "the fourth": 甲乙丙丁. Also "a small cube": 肉丁, 蘿蔔丁 "diced radish", and a man of the household in old texts (人丁). 丁 is also a common surname. The character is a picture of a nail, and 釘 now carries that sense. It is a sound part of 盯, 訂 and 打.

column3: To stare at, to keep watching: 盯着看 "stare at", 盯紧 "keep a close eye on", 盯人 "mark a player". It is a steady gaze or close watch, often of a screen or a person. 目 "eye" is the meaning part, and 丁 gives the sound (dīng).
column6: Tā yīzhí dīng zhe wǒ kàn.
column7: He kept staring at me.
column9: To stare at, to keep watching: 盯著看 "stare at", 盯緊 "keep a close eye on", 盯人 "mark a player". It is a steady gaze or close watch, often of a screen or a person. 目 "eye" is the meaning part, and 丁 gives the sound (dīng).

column3: To order, to place an order for goods: 订购商品 "order goods", 线上订购 "order online", 订购单 "order form". It is for goods and for subscribing to a paper. 订 "book, order" + 购 "buy". 订 has 讠 "speech" and 丁 as the sound; 购 has 贝 "shell, money".
column4: 我在网上订购了一台电脑。
column5: 我在網上訂購了一台電腦。
column6: Wǒ zài wǎng shàng dìnggòu le yī tái diànnǎo.
column7: I ordered a computer online.
column9: To order, to place an order for goods: 訂購商品 "order goods", 線上訂購 "order online", 訂購單 "order form". It is for goods and for subscribing to a paper. 訂 "book, order" + 購 "buy". 訂 has 言 "speech" and 丁 as the sound; 購 has 貝 "shell, money".

column3: To get engaged: 订婚戒指 "engagement ring", 跟他订婚. It is the step before 结婚. It often has its own ceremony, with gifts from the groom's family. 订 "fix, settle" + 婚 "marriage", which has 女 "woman" and 昏 as the sound.
column6: Tāmen dǎsuàn míngnián dìnghūn.
column7: They plan to get engaged next year.
column9: To get engaged: 訂婚戒指 "engagement ring", 跟他訂婚. It is the step before 結婚. It often has its own ceremony, with gifts from the groom's family. 訂 "fix, settle" + 婚 "marriage", which has 女 "woman" and 昏 as the sound.

column3: A carpet, a rug: 铺地毯 "lay a carpet", 红地毯 "red carpet", 地毯很脏. 地 "floor" + 毯 "blanket". 毯 has 毛 "fur" for wool, and 炎 as the sound. 毯 on its own is a blanket: 毛毯.
column4: 客厅里铺着一块红色的地毯。
column5: 客廳裡鋪著一塊紅色的地毯。
column6: Kètīng lǐ pūzhe yī kuài hóngsè de dìtǎn.
column7: A red carpet is laid in the living room.
column9: A carpet, a rug: 鋪地毯 "lay a carpet", 紅地毯 "red carpet", 地毯很臟. 地 "floor" + 毯 "blanket". 毯 has 毛 "fur" for wool, and 炎 as the sound. 毯 on its own is a blanket: 毛毯.

column3: To lose face, to be embarrassed: 丢脸 is a verb with its object, so 丢了脸 and 丢什么脸 work. 真丢脸 "how embarrassing", 让家人丢脸. It is for shame before others, and a bit stronger than 不好意思. 丢 "lose" + 脸 "face", the second with ⺼ "flesh" and 佥.
column6: Kǎoshì zuòbì tài diūliǎn le.
column7: Cheating on an exam is so disgraceful.
column9: To lose face, to be embarrassed: 丟臉 is a verb with its object, so 丟了臉 and 丟什麼臉 work. 真丟臉 "how embarrassing", 讓家人丟臉. It is for shame before others, and a bit stronger than 不好意思. 丟 "lose" + 臉 "face", the second with ⺼ "flesh" and 僉.

column3: To lose face, to be disgraced: 丢人现眼 "make a fool of oneself", 太丢人了 "so embarrassing". It means the same as 丢脸 and is more of a spoken, blunt word. 丢 "lose" + 人 "person", here as the face. 丢 shows 一 and 去: gone once.
column4: 在大家面前摔倒，真丢人。
column5: 在大家面前摔倒，真丟人。
column6: Zài dàjiā miànqián shuāidǎo, zhēn diūrén.
column7: Falling down in front of everyone was so embarrassing.
column9: To lose face, to be disgraced: 丟人現眼 "make a fool of oneself", 太丟人了 "so embarrassing". It means the same as 丟臉 and is more of a spoken, blunt word. 丟 "lose" + 人 "person", here as the face. 丟 shows 一 and 去: gone once.

column3: A measure word for houses and buildings: 一栋房子 "a house", 一栋大楼 "a tall building", 整栋 "the whole building". 栋 is the usual word for a building as a unit, and a building of apartments is counted by it too. 木 "wood" is the meaning part, since it first meant a ridgepole, and 东 gives the sound.
column6: Zhè dòng dàlóu yǒu èrshí céng.
column7: This building has twenty floors.
column9: A measure word for houses and buildings: 一棟房子 "a house", 一棟大樓 "a tall building", 整棟 "the whole building". 棟 is the usual word for a building as a unit, and a building of apartments is counted by it too. 木 "wood" is the meaning part, since it first meant a ridgepole, and 東 gives the sound.

column3: Easily, at the drop of a hat, of something happening too often and readily, usually a bad habit: 动不动就生气 "gets angry at the slightest thing", 动不动就哭. It is followed by 就. It is a complaint. 动 "move" + 不 "not" + 动 "move": "move or not move".
column6: Tā dòngbudòng jiù shēngqì.
column7: He gets angry at the slightest thing.
column9: Easily, at the drop of a hat, of something happening too often and readily, usually a bad habit: 動不動就生氣 "gets angry at the slightest thing", 動不動就哭. It is followed by 就. It is a complaint. 動 "move" + 不 "not" + 動 "move": "move or not move".

column3: A verb, the grammar word: 及物动词 "transitive verb", 不及物动词, 动词后面加「了」. 动 "move" + 词 "word", the second with 讠 "speech" and 司 as the sound. Used in a Chinese lesson, and in grammar books.
column6: Chī hé "hē" dōu shì dòngcí.
column7: Eat and "drink" are both verbs.
column9: A verb, the grammar word: 及物動詞 "transitive verb", 不及物動詞, 動詞後面加「了」. 動 "move" + 詞 "word", the second with 言 "speech" and 司 as the sound. Used in a Chinese lesson, and in grammar books.

column3: To set off on a journey: 动身去... "set out for...", 准备动身, 明天动身. It is the moment of leaving for a trip, written and spoken. 动 "move" + 身 "body": move the body. 身 is a picture of a pregnant woman.
column6: Wǒmen míngtiān yīzǎo jiù dòngshēn.
column7: We set off first thing tomorrow morning.
column9: To set off on a journey: 動身去... "set out for...", 準備動身, 明天動身. It is the moment of leaving for a trip, written and spoken. 動 "move" + 身 "body": move the body. 身 is a picture of a pregnant woman.

column3: A struggle, a fight: 斗争 is a word of political struggle and of inner struggle: 思想斗争 "an inner conflict", 阶级斗争 "class struggle". It also appears in history and in talk of power fights. 斗 shows two figures fighting, and 争 two hands over a plow.
column4: 他心里正在进行思想斗争。
column5: 他心裡正在進行思想鬥爭。
column6: Tā xīnlǐ zhèngzài jìnxíng sīxiǎng dòuzhēng.
column7: He is having an inner struggle.
column9: A struggle, a fight: 鬥爭 is a word of political struggle and of inner struggle: 思想鬥爭 "an inner conflict", 階級鬥爭 "class struggle". It also appears in history and in talk of power fights. 鬥 shows two figures fighting, and 爭 two hands over a plow.

column3: To bet, to gamble: 赌钱 "gamble", 赌博 "gambling", 打赌 "make a bet", 赌一把 "take a chance". 贝 "shell, money" is the meaning part and 者 gives the sound. The word is used for real bets and for friendly ones.
column6: Wǒ gǎn gēn nǐ dǔ tā bù huì lái.
column7: I bet you he won't come.
column9: To bet, to gamble: 賭錢 "gamble", 賭博 "gambling", 打賭 "make a bet", 賭一把 "take a chance". 貝 "shell, money" is the meaning part and 者 gives the sound. The word is used for real bets and for friendly ones.

column3: To carry with both hands: 端菜 "bring a dish", 端茶 "serve tea", 端着碗. It is for a bowl, a tray or a tea cup held level in front of you. It also means "tip, end" in 末端 and 顶端, and "upright" in 端正. 立 "stand" is the meaning part, and 耑 gives the sound.
column6: Fúwùshēng bǎ tāng duān dào zhuō shàng.
column7: The waiter carried the soup to the table.
column9: To carry with both hands: 端菜 "bring a dish", 端茶 "serve tea", 端著碗. It is for a bowl, a tray or a tea cup held level in front of you. It also means "tip, end" in 末端 and 頂端, and "upright" in 端正. 立 "stand" is the meaning part, and 耑 gives the sound.

column3: To cross, to pass through a period: 渡过难关 "get through a hard time", 渡过河 "cross the river", 渡过一个愉快的周末. It is often about getting through a difficulty or spending time. 渡 "cross" has 氵 "water" and 度; 过 "pass".
column4: 我们一起渡过了很多困难。
column5: 我們一起渡過了很多困難。
column6: Wǒmen yīqǐ dùguò le hěn duō kùnnán.
column7: We got through many difficulties together.
column9: To cross, to pass through a period: 渡過難關 "get through a hard time", 渡過河 "cross the river", 渡過一個愉快的週末. It is often about getting through a difficulty or spending time. 渡 "cross" has 氵 "water" and 度; 過 "pass".

column3: The opposite shore: 河的对岸 "the far side of the river", 海的对岸. In Taiwan news 对岸 often means mainland China, the other side of the Strait. 对 "facing" + 岸 "shore". 岸 has 山 "mountain" over a cliff 厂 and 干 as the sound.
column6: Hé de duì'àn yǒu yī zuò xiǎo shān.
column7: There is a small hill on the other side of the river.
column9: The opposite shore: 河的對岸 "the far side of the river", 海的對岸. In Taiwan news 對岸 often means mainland China, the other side of the Strait. 對 "facing" + 岸 "shore". 岸 has 山 "mountain" over a cliff 厂 and 干 as the sound.

column3: A countermeasure, a way to deal with a problem: 想对策 "think of a response", 研究对策, 因应对策. It follows a problem and tells how to meet it. 对 "face" + 策 "plan". 策 has 竹 "bamboo" over 朿; it first meant a whip or slips of bamboo.
column6: Wǒmen bìxū xiǎng chū duìcè.
column7: We must come up with a countermeasure.
column9: A countermeasure, a way to deal with a problem: 想對策 "think of a response", 研究對策, 因應對策. It follows a problem and tells how to meet it. 對 "face" + 策 "plan". 策 has 竹 "bamboo" over 朿; it first meant a whip or slips of bamboo.

column3: To oppose, to confront: 对抗赛 "a match between teams", 与...对抗 "stand against...", 对抗病毒. It suggests two sides pushing against each other, in sport, war or health. 对 "face" + 抗 "resist", the second with 扌 "hand" and 亢 as the sound.
column4: 两个队伍在比赛中互相对抗。
column5: 兩個隊伍在比賽中互相對抗。
column6: Liǎng ge duìwǔ zài bǐsài zhōng hùxiāng duìkàng.
column7: The two teams compete against each other in the match.
column9: To oppose, to confront: 對抗賽 "a match between teams", 與...對抗 "stand against...", 對抗病毒. It suggests two sides pushing against each other, in sport, war or health. 對 "face" + 抗 "resist", the second with 扌 "hand" and 亢 as the sound.

column3: To squat, to crouch: 蹲下 "squat down", 蹲着 "squatting", 蹲马步 "stand in a horse stance", 蹲厕所. It is the bent-knee position with the bottom near the heels. 足 "foot" is the meaning part, and 尊 gives the sound.
column4: 他蹲下来帮孩子系鞋带。
column5: 他蹲下來幫孩子繫鞋帶。
column6: Tā dūn xiàlái bāng háizi jì xiédài.
column7: He squatted down to tie the child's shoelaces.
column9: To squat, to crouch: 蹲下 "squat down", 蹲著 "squatting", 蹲馬步 "stand in a horse stance", 蹲廁所. It is the bent-knee position with the bottom near the heels. 足 "foot" is the meaning part, and 尊 gives the sound.

column3: To seize, to take by force: 夺得冠军 "win the championship", 抢夺 "snatch", 夺走 "take away". It is for taking a prize or something from someone. 夺 has a big 大 over a hand 寸.
column4: 他夺得了比赛的第一名。
column5: 他奪得了比賽的第一名。
column6: Tā duó dé le bǐsài de dì-yī míng.
column7: He won first place in the competition.
column9: To seize, to take by force: 奪得冠軍 "win the championship", 搶奪 "snatch", 奪走 "take away". It is for taking a prize or something from someone. 奪 shows a hand 寸 grabbing a bird 隹 under a big 大: a bird snatched away.

column3: Most likely, mostly: 他多半不会来 "he most likely won't come", 多半是 "mostly". Before a verb it expresses a guess; with a noun it means "the greater part": 多半的人. 多 "many" + 半 "half". 多 is two 夕 stacked, many nights.
column4: 今天这么晚，他多半不会来了。
column5: 今天這麼晚，他多半不會來了。
column6: Jīntiān zhème wǎn, tā duōbàn bù huì lái le.
column7: It is so late; he most likely won't come.
column9: Most likely, mostly: 他多半不會來 "he most likely won't come", 多半是 "mostly". Before a verb it expresses a guess; with a noun it means "the greater part": 多半的人. 多 "many" + 半 "half". 多 is two 夕 stacked, many nights.

column3: Many, much, more and more, in set phrases: 多多指教 "please give me your guidance", 多多益善 "the more the better", 多多少少 "more or less", 多多保重 "take good care". The doubling makes the request or wish warmer. 多 is two 夕 "evening", for "many".
column6: Qǐng dàjiā duōduō zhǐjiào.
column7: Please give us your guidance.
column9: Many, much, more and more, in set phrases: 多多指教 "please give me your guidance", 多多益善 "the more the better", 多多少少 "more or less", 多多保重 "take good care". The doubling makes the request or wish warmer. 多 is two 夕 "evening", for "many".

column3: Many thanks: 多谢你 "thank you", 多谢帮忙. It is a casual and short thanks, a little old-style, and 谢谢 is the everyday form. 多 "many" + 谢 "thank". 谢 has 讠 "speech" and 射 as the sound.
column6: Duōxiè nǐ bāng wǒ zhège máng.
column7: Many thanks for helping me.
column9: Many thanks: 多謝你 "thank you", 多謝幫忙. It is a casual and short thanks, a little old-style, and 謝謝 is the everyday form. 多 "many" + 謝 "thank". 謝 has 言 "speech" and 射 as the sound.

column3: A goose: 一只鹅 "a goose", 鹅肉 "goose meat", 大白鹅, 鹅卵石 "a pebble". It is a large water bird. 鸟 "bird" is the meaning part and 我 gives the sound (é, wǒ).
column6: Hébiān yǒu jǐ zhī bái é.
column7: There are some white geese by the river.
column9: A goose: 一隻鵝 "a goose", 鵝肉 "goose meat", 大白鵝, 鵝卵石 "a pebble". It is a large water bird. 鳥 "bird" is the meaning part and 我 gives the sound (é, wǒ).

column3: Vile, very bad, of conditions or behavior: 天气恶劣 "foul weather", 恶劣的环境 "harsh conditions", 态度恶劣 "a disgusting attitude". It is stronger than 坏 and is written. 恶 "evil" has 心 "heart" under 亚; 劣 "inferior" has 少 "little" over 力 "strength".
column4: 因为天气恶劣，航班取消了。
column5: 因為天氣惡劣，航班取消了。
column6: Yīnwèi tiānqì èliè, hángbān qǔxiāo le.
column7: The flight was cancelled because of the foul weather.
column9: Vile, very bad, of conditions or behavior: 天氣惡劣 "foul weather", 惡劣的環境 "harsh conditions", 態度惡劣 "a disgusting attitude". It is stronger than 壞 and is written. 惡 "evil" has 心 "heart" under 亞; 劣 "inferior" has 少 "little" over 力 "strength".

column3: That's all, only: 只是开玩笑而已 "it was only a joke", 如此而已 "that is all". It sits at the end of a sentence, usually after 只 or 不过, and makes light of the matter. It is formal and a bit written; speech has 罢了 or just 啦. 而 shows a beard.
column6: Wǒ zhǐshì kāi wánxiào éryǐ.
column7: I was only joking.
column9: That's all, only: 只是開玩笑而已 "it was only a joke", 如此而已 "that is all". It sits at the end of a sentence, usually after 只 or 不過, and makes light of the matter. It is formal and a bit written; speech has 罷了 or just 啦. 而 shows a beard.

column3: To tremble, to shiver: 冷得发抖 "shiver with cold", 吓得发抖 "tremble with fear", 手在发抖. It is a body reaction to cold, fear or anger. 发 "emit" + 抖 "shake", the second with 扌 "hand" and 斗 as the sound.
column6: Tā lěng de quánshēn fādǒu.
column7: He is shivering all over from the cold.
column9: To tremble, to shiver: 冷得發抖 "shiver with cold", 嚇得發抖 "tremble with fear", 手在發抖. It is a body reaction to cold, fear or anger. 發 "emit" + 抖 "shake", the second with 扌 "hand" and 斗 as the sound. 發 shows a bow 弓 shooting.

column3: A measure word for an action that takes time or effort, used with 一: 一番话 "a speech", 费了一番功夫 "took a lot of effort", 三番五次 "again and again", 翻了一番 "doubled". It also means "foreign" in old words such as 番茄 "tomato". 番 has 米 over 田, seeds in a field.
column4: 他花了一番功夫才找到这里。
column5: 他花了一番功夫才找到這裡。
column6: Tā huā le yī fān gōngfu cái zhǎodào zhèlǐ.
column7: It took him a good deal of effort to find this place.
column9: A measure word for an action that takes time or effort, used with 一: 一番話 "a speech", 費了一番功夫 "took a lot of effort", 三番五次 "again and again", 翻了一番 "doubled". It also means "foreign" in old words such as 番茄 "tomato". 番 has 米 over 田, seeds in a field.

column3: To make a mistake: 犯错误 "make an error", 不怕犯错 "not afraid of mistakes", 犯了错. 犯 "commit" has 犭 "dog" and 㔾; 错 "wrong". It is for an error of conduct as well as of fact.
column6: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu kěnéng fàncuò.
column7: Anyone can make a mistake.
column9: To make a mistake: 犯錯誤 "make an error", 不怕犯錯 "not afraid of mistakes", 犯了錯. 犯 "commit" has 犭 "dog" and 㔾; 錯 "wrong". It is for an error of conduct as well as of fact.

column3: To break the law: 犯法的事 "an illegal thing", 杀人犯法 "murder breaks the law", 知法犯法 "knowing the law and breaking it". It says that an act is against the law. 犯 "commit" + 法 "law", the second with 氵 "water" and 去, as a rule that is a course followed.
column6: Jiǔ hòu kāichē shì fànfǎ de.
column7: Driving after drinking breaks the law.
column9: To break the law: 犯法的事 "an illegal thing", 殺人犯法 "murder breaks the law", 知法犯法 "knowing the law and breaking it". It says that an act is against the law. 犯 "commit" + 法 "law", the second with 氵 "water" and 去, as a rule that is a course followed.

column3: To defend, to guard against an attack: 防守球门 "defend the goal", 防守严密 "tight defense", 全力防守. It is common in sport and in war. 防 "guard" + 守 "hold", where 守 shows a hand 寸 under a roof 宀, a thing held within walls.
column4: 我们的队伍防守得很好。
column5: 我們的隊伍防守得很好。
column6: Wǒmen de duìwǔ fángshǒu de hěn hǎo.
column7: Our team defends very well.
column9: To defend, to guard against an attack: 防守球門 "defend the goal", 防守嚴密 "tight defense", 全力防守. It is common in sport and in war. 防 "guard" + 守 "hold", where 守 shows a hand 寸 under a roof 宀, a thing held within walls.

column3: To let go: 放手吧 "let go", 不放手 "won't let go", and "to give free rein": 放手让孩子做 "let the child do it freely". It has a literal use, a hand releasing, and a figurative use, to stop holding on to a person or plan. 放 "let go" + 手 "hand", a picture of a hand with fingers spread.
column4: 你应该放手让孩子自己试试。
column5: 你應該放手讓孩子自己試試。
column6: Nǐ yīnggāi fàngshǒu ràng háizi zìjǐ shìshi.
column7: You should let go and let the child try for himself.
column9: To let go: 放手吧 "let go", 不放手 "won't let go", and "to give free rein": 放手讓孩子做 "let the child do it freely". It has a literal use, a hand releasing, and a figurative use, to stop holding on to a person or plan. 放 "let go" + 手 "hand", a picture of a hand with fingers spread.

column3: To resist, to rebel: 反抗父母 "rebel against parents", 反抗压迫 "resist oppression", 起来反抗. It is to fight back against authority or force, and a stronger word than 反对. 反 "against" + 抗 "resist". 反 shows a hand 又 against a cliff 厂.
column4: 青少年常常反抗父母的管教。
column5: 青少年常常反抗父母的管教。
column6: Qīngshàonián chángcháng fǎnkàng fùmǔ de guǎnjiào.
column7: Teenagers often rebel against their parents' discipline.
column9: To resist, to rebel: 反抗父母 "rebel against parents", 反抗壓迫 "resist oppression", 起來反抗. It is to fight back against authority or force, and a stronger word than 反對. 反 "against" + 抗 "resist". 反 shows a hand 又 against a cliff 厂.

column3: Busy, bustling: 繁忙的街道 "busy streets", 工作繁忙 "busy with work", 繁忙时间 "rush hour". It describes a place or a schedule full of activity, in a written tone. 繁 "many" + 忙 "busy". 忙 has 忄 "heart" and 亡; the heart is hurried. 繁 has 糸 "thread" and 敏.
column4: 这条街上的交通非常繁忙。
column5: 這條街上的交通非常繁忙。
column6: Zhè tiáo jiē shàng de jiāotōng fēicháng fánmáng.
column7: The traffic on this street is very busy.
column9: Busy, bustling: 繁忙的街道 "busy streets", 工作繁忙 "busy with work", 繁忙時間 "rush hour". It describes a place or a schedule full of activity, in a written tone. 繁 "many" + 忙 "busy". 忙 has 忄 "heart" and 亡; the heart is hurried. 繁 has 糸 "thread" and 敏.

column3: The reverse side, the other side: 纸的反面 "the back of the sheet", and "the negative side", opposite 正面: 反面教材 "a bad example used for teaching", 反面人物 "the villain". 反 "reverse" shows a hand 又 against a cliff 厂; 面 is a face.
column4: 请在纸的反面写你的名字。
column5: 請在紙的反面寫你的名字。
column6: Qǐng zài zhǐ de fǎnmiàn xiě nǐ de míngzi.
column7: Please write your name on the back of the paper.
column9: The reverse side, the other side: 紙的反面 "the back of the sheet", and "the negative side", opposite 正面: 反面教材 "a bad example used for teaching", 反面人物 "the villain". 反 "reverse" shows a hand 又 against a cliff 厂; 面 is a face.

column3: A criminal, a prisoner: 抓犯人 "catch the criminal", 犯人逃跑了 "the prisoner escaped". It is a person who has committed or is held for a crime. 犯 "commit" has 犭 "dog" and a sound part; 人 "person".
column6: Jǐngchá zhuādào le nàge fànrén.
column7: The police caught that criminal.
column9: A criminal, a prisoner: 抓犯人 "catch the criminal", 犯人逃跑了 "the prisoner escaped". It is a person who has committed or is held for a crime. 犯 "commit" has 犭 "dog" and a sound part; 人 "person".

column3: To ask a question back, to ask a rhetorical question: 反问他 "ask him in return", 反问句 "a rhetorical question". It answers a question with a question, to push a point: 难道你不知道吗？ is a 反问. 反 "back, in return" + 问 "ask", where 问 has 口 "mouth" inside 门.
column4: 他没回答，反问了我一个问题。
column5: 他沒回答，反問了我一個問題。
column6: Tā méi huídá, fǎnwèn le wǒ yī ge wèntí.
column7: He did not answer but asked me a question back.
column9: To ask a question back, to ask a rhetorical question: 反問他 "ask him in return", 反問句 "a rhetorical question". It answers a question with a question, to push a point: 難道你不知道嗎？ is a 反問. 反 "back, in return" + 問 "ask", where 問 has 口 "mouth" inside 門.

column3: To breed, to reproduce: 繁殖后代 "have offspring", 繁殖季节 "breeding season", 细菌繁殖. It is for animals, plants and germs multiplying. 繁 "many" + 殖 "grow". 殖 has 歹, a bone mark that stands for death and decay, and 直 as the sound.
column4: 春天是很多动物繁殖的季节。
column5: 春天是很多動物繁殖的季節。
column6: Chūntiān shì hěn duō dòngwù fánzhí de jìjié.
column7: Spring is the breeding season for many animals.
column9: To breed, to reproduce: 繁殖後代 "have offspring", 繁殖季節 "breeding season", 細菌繁殖. It is for animals, plants and germs multiplying. 繁 "many" + 殖 "grow". 殖 has 歹, a bone mark that stands for death and decay, and 直 as the sound.

column3: To commit a crime, and "crime": 犯罪率 "crime rate", 犯罪行为, 打击犯罪. It is the general term, from a petty offense to a serious crime. 犯 "commit" + 罪 "crime", which has a net 罒 over 非 "wrong".
column4: 警察正在调查这起犯罪事件。
column5: 警察正在調查這起犯罪事件。
column6: Jǐngchá zhèngzài diàochá zhè qǐ fànzuì shìjiàn.
column7: The police are investigating this criminal case.
column9: To commit a crime, and "crime": 犯罪率 "crime rate", 犯罪行為, 打擊犯罪. It is the general term, from a petty offense to a serious crime. 犯 "commit" + 罪 "crime", which has a net 罒 over 非 "wrong".

column3: To launch, to initiate: 发起活动 "launch an event", 发起人 "the organizer, the initiator", 发起连署 "start a petition". It is for being the first to propose or start something that others join. 发 "send out" + 起 "rise". 起 has 走 "walk" and 己.
column4: 几位同学发起了募款活动。
column5: 幾位同學發起了募款活動。
column6: Jǐ wèi tóngxué fāqǐ le mùkuǎn huódòng.
column7: A few classmates started a fund-raising event.
column9: To launch, to initiate: 發起活動 "launch an event", 發起人 "the organizer, the initiator", 發起連署 "start a petition". It is for being the first to propose or start something that others join. 發 "send out" + 起 "rise". 起 has 走 "walk" and 己.

column3: A hairstyle: 换发型 "change one's hairstyle", 新发型, 发型设计师 "hairstylist". The word list reads it fàxíng.
column6: Nǐ de xīn fàxíng hěn hǎokàn.
column7: Your new hairstyle looks very nice.
column9: A hairstyle: 換髮型 "change one's hairstyle", 新髮型, 髮型設計師 "hairstylist". Mind the two characters: 髮 is "hair", 發 is "send out". 髮 has 髟 "long hair" on top and 犮 as the sound. The word list reads it fàxíng.

column3: To become inflamed: 喉咙发炎 "a sore, inflamed throat", 伤口发炎 "the wound is infected", 发炎了. It is what a body part does when it is infected or irritated. 发 "emit" + 炎 "inflammation", whose picture is two fires 火 stacked.
column6: Wǒ de hóulóng fāyán le, hěn tòng.
column7: My throat is inflamed and hurts a lot.
column9: To become inflamed: 喉嚨發炎 "a sore, inflamed throat", 傷口發炎 "the wound is infected", 發炎了. It is what a body part does when it is infected or irritated. 發 "emit" + 炎 "inflammation", whose picture is two fires 火 stacked.

column3: To develop, to carry forward: 发扬传统 "carry on a tradition", 发扬光大 "develop and enlarge", 发扬精神. It is for good things, such as a tradition, a spirit or a style, that you keep alive and make bigger. 发 "send out" + 扬 "raise", the second with 扌 "hand".
column4: 我们应该发扬这种好传统。
column5: 我們應該發揚這種好傳統。
column6: Wǒmen yīnggāi fāyáng zhè zhǒng hǎo chuántǒng.
column7: We should carry forward this good tradition.
column9: To develop, to carry forward: 發揚傳統 "carry on a tradition", 發揚光大 "develop and enlarge", 發揚精神. It is for good things, such as a tradition, a spirit or a style, that you keep alive and make bigger. 發 "send out" + 揚 "raise", the second with 扌 "hand".

column3: Pronunciation, and "to pronounce": 发音标准 "standard pronunciation", 发音不准, 练习发音. It is how a sound is made. 发 "send out" + 音 "sound". 音 is 言 "speech" with a stroke added, a tongue forming a sound.
column6: Tā de Zhōngwén fāyīn hěn biāozhǔn.
column7: His Chinese pronunciation is very standard.
column9: Pronunciation, and "to pronounce": 發音標準 "standard pronunciation", 發音不準, 練習發音. It is how a sound is made. 發 "send out" + 音 "sound". 音 is 言 "speech" with a stroke added, a tongue forming a sound.

column3: A way, a method, spoken: 想法子 "think of a way", 没法子 "there's no way", 有什么法子 "what can be done". The dictionary notes the neutral second syllable and a Taiwan variant, fázi. It is about solving a problem. 法 "method" has 氵 "water" and 去, a course followed.
column4: 这个问题我想不出什么法子。
column5: 這個問題我想不出什麼法子。
column6: Zhège wèntí wǒ xiǎng bù chū shénme fǎzi.
column7: I can't think of any way to deal with this problem.
column9: A way, a method, spoken: 想法子 "think of a way", 沒法子 "there's no way", 有什麼法子 "what can be done". The dictionary notes the neutral second syllable and a Taiwan variant, fázi. It is about solving a problem. 法 "method" has 氵 "water" and 去, a course followed.

column3: The lung: 肺炎 "pneumonia", 肺癌 "lung cancer", 肺活量 "lung capacity", 肺部. It is the organ for breathing. ⺼ "flesh" is the meaning part of all body parts, and 巿 gives the sound.
column6: Xīyān duì fèi bù hǎo.
column7: Smoking is bad for the lungs.
column9: The lung: 肺炎 "pneumonia", 肺癌 "lung cancer", 肺活量 "lung capacity", 肺部. It is the organ for breathing. ⺼ "flesh" is the meaning part of all body parts, and 巿 gives the sound.

column3: Illegal: 非法入境 "illegal entry", 非法行为, 非法经营. It is the formal word for what the law forbids, and it goes before a noun. 非 "not" + 法 "law". 非 is two wings turned away from each other, so "against, not".
column4: 他因为非法入境被抓了。
column5: 他因為非法入境被抓了。
column6: Tā yīnwèi fēifǎ rùjìng bèi zhuā le.
column7: He was arrested for entering illegally.
column9: Illegal: 非法入境 "illegal entry", 非法行為, 非法經營. It is the formal word for what the law forbids, and it goes before a noun. 非 "not" + 法 "law". 非 is two wings turned away from each other, so "against, not".

column3: Nonsense, useless talk: 别说废话 "stop talking nonsense", 废话连篇 "full of empty words", 废话少说 "get to the point". As an answer, 废话！ means "no kidding, obviously" and is rude. 废 "useless" + 话 "words", the second with 讠 "speech" and 舌 "tongue".
column6: Bié shuō fèihuà, kuài diǎn zuòshì!
column7: Stop the nonsense and get on with it!
column9: Nonsense, useless talk: 別說廢話 "stop talking nonsense", 廢話連篇 "full of empty words", 廢話少說 "get to the point". As an answer, 廢話！ means "no kidding, obviously" and is rude. 廢 "useless" + 話 "words", the second with 言 "speech" and 舌 "tongue".

column3: Fat, obese: 肥胖症 "obesity", 肥胖的人, 预防肥胖. It is a medical and written word, said of health, more neutral than 很胖. 肥 and 胖 both have ⺼ "flesh" and a sound part (巴; 半). 胖 is also the everyday word for "fat".
column4: 肥胖会增加得病的机会。
column5: 肥胖會增加得病的機會。
column6: Féipàng huì zēngjiā dé bìng de jīhuì.
column7: Obesity raises the chance of falling ill.
column9: Fat, obese: 肥胖症 "obesity", 肥胖的人, 預防肥胖. It is a medical and written word, said of health, more neutral than 很胖. 肥 and 胖 both have ⺼ "flesh" and a sound part (巴; 半). 胖 is also the everyday word for "fat".

column3: Exhaust gas, waste gas: 汽车废气 "car exhaust", 工厂废气, 废气污染. It is the polluting gas from engines and factories. 废 "waste" + 气 "gas, air".
column4: 汽车的废气会造成空气污染。
column5: 汽車的廢氣會造成空氣污染。
column6: Qìchē de fèiqì huì zàochéng kōngqì wūrǎn.
column7: Car exhaust causes air pollution.
column9: Exhaust gas, waste gas: 汽車廢氣 "car exhaust", 工廠廢氣, 廢氣污染. It is the polluting gas from engines and factories. 廢 "waste" + 氣 "gas, air". 氣 has 气 "vapor" and 米 "rice", steam from cooking rice.

column3: Waste water: 工厂废水 "factory waste water", 处理废水, 排放废水. It is the used water from homes and factories. 废 "waste" + 水 "water", the picture of a stream with drops on both sides.
column4: 工厂不能随便排放废水。
column5: 工廠不能隨便排放廢水。
column6: Gōngchǎng bù néng suíbiàn páifàng fèishuǐ.
column7: Factories may not discharge waste water as they like.
column9: Waste water: 工廠廢水 "factory waste water", 處理廢水, 排放廢水. It is the used water from homes and factories. 廢 "waste" + 水 "water", the picture of a stream with drops on both sides.

column3: Waste, rubbish, and "a useless person": 废物利用 "reuse waste", 有害废物 "harmful waste", and as a rude word: 你这个废物！ "you good-for-nothing". 废 "useless" + 物 "thing". 物 has 牛 "ox" and 勿 as the sound.
column4: 这些废物应该分类处理。
column5: 這些廢物應該分類處理。
column6: Zhèxiē fèiwù yīnggāi fēnlèi chǔlǐ.
column7: This waste should be sorted and handled.
column9: Waste, rubbish, and "a useless person": 廢物利用 "reuse waste", 有害廢物 "harmful waste", and as a rude word: 你這個廢物！ "you good-for-nothing". 廢 "useless" + 物 "thing". 物 has 牛 "ox" and 勿 as the sound.

column3: A share, a portion, a part: 你的份儿 "your share", 每人一份儿 "one for each person"; also "degree, extent": 到这份儿上 "to this point". The 儿 is the spoken "r" ending, which the dictionary writes into the pinyin. 份 "portion" has 亻 "person" and 分 "divide".
column4: 这是你的份儿，快拿去吧。
column5: 這是你的份兒，快拿去吧。
column6: Zhè shì nǐ de fènr, kuài ná qù ba.
column7: This is your share; take it.
column9: A share, a portion, a part: 你的份兒 "your share", 每人一份兒 "one for each person"; also "degree, extent": 到這份兒上 "to this point". The 兒 is the spoken "r" ending, which the dictionary writes into the pinyin. 份 "portion" has 亻 "person" and 分 "divide".

column3: Chalk: 一支粉笔 "a piece of chalk", 用粉笔写字 "write with chalk", 粉笔灰 "chalk dust". It is the stick for writing on a blackboard. 粉 "powder" + 笔 "pen". 粉 has 米 "rice" and 分; 笔 has 竹 "bamboo" and 毛.
column4: 老师用粉笔在黑板上写字。
column5: 老師用粉筆在黑板上寫字。
column6: Lǎoshī yòng fěnbǐ zài hēibǎn shàng xiě zì.
column7: The teacher writes on the blackboard with chalk.
column9: Chalk: 一支粉筆 "a piece of chalk", 用粉筆寫字 "write with chalk", 粉筆灰 "chalk dust". It is the stick for writing on a blackboard. 粉 "powder" + 筆 "pen". 粉 has 米 "rice" and 分; 筆 has 竹 "bamboo" and 聿, a brush held in a hand.

column3: To instruct, to tell someone to do: 老板吩咐我... "the boss told me to...", 照你的吩咐 "as you instructed", 有事请吩咐 "tell me if you need anything". It goes from a person of higher standing to a lower one. Both characters have 口 "mouth": 吩 takes 分 and 咐 takes 付 as sounds. The second syllable is neutral.
column4: 老板吩咐我今天把报告做完。
column5: 老闆吩咐我今天把報告做完。

column9: To instruct, to tell someone to do: 老闆吩咐我... "the boss told me to...", 照你的吩咐 "as you instructed", 有事請吩咐 "tell me if you need anything". It goes from a person of higher standing to a lower one. Both characters have 口 "mouth": 吩 takes 分 and 咐 takes 付 as sounds. The second syllable is neutral.

column3: To meet, to come upon: 逢年过节 "on every festival", 逢人便说 "tell everyone one meets", 久别重逢 "meet again after a long parting", 逢星期五 "every Friday". It is a written word for a time that comes around. 辶 "walk" is the meaning part and 夆 gives the sound.
column4: 逢年过节，全家人都会回老家。
column5: 逢年過節，全家人都會回老家。

column9: To meet, to come upon: 逢年過節 "on every festival", 逢人便說 "tell everyone one meets", 久別重逢 "meet again after a long parting", 逢星期五 "every Friday". It is a written word for a time that comes around. 辶 "walk" is the meaning part and 夆 gives the sound.

column3: To sew, to stitch: 缝衣服 "sew clothes", 缝扣子 "sew on a button", 缝针 "stitch (a wound)". Read féng as a verb, and fèng as a noun, "a crack": 裂缝. 纟 "silk thread" is the meaning part, and 逢 gives the sound.
column4: 妈妈在缝衣服上的扣子。
column5: 媽媽在縫衣服上的扣子。
column6: Māma zài féng yīfu shàng de kòuzi.
column7: Mom is sewing a button on the clothes.
column9: To sew, to stitch: 縫衣服 "sew clothes", 縫扣子 "sew on a button", 縫針 "stitch (a wound)". Read féng as a verb, and fèng as a noun, "a crack": 裂縫. 糹 "silk thread" is the meaning part, and 逢 gives the sound.

column3: To satirize, to mock, and "irony, satire": 讽刺漫画 "satirical cartoon", 讽刺别人 "mock people", 真讽刺 "how ironic". It is a sharp humor against a person or a society, or an ironic situation. 讽 has 讠 "speech" with 风, and 刺 has 刂 "knife" and 朿 "thorn": a verbal stab.
column4: 这部电影讽刺了社会的问题。
column5: 這部電影諷刺了社會的問題。
column6: Zhè bù diànyǐng fěngcì le shèhuì de wèntí.
column7: This film satirizes the problems of society.
column9: To satirize, to mock, and "irony, satire": 諷刺漫畫 "satirical cartoon", 諷刺別人 "mock people", 真諷刺 "how ironic". It is a sharp humor against a person or a society, or an ironic situation. 諷 has 言 "speech" with 風, and 刺 has 刂 "knife" and 朿 "thorn": a verbal stab.

column3: Feudal: 封建社会 "feudal society", 封建思想 "feudal thinking", 封建制度. It is used for the old system of lords and vassals, and in speech for an attitude that is old-fashioned and rigid. 封 "enfeoff, seal" + 建 "set up". 封 has 圭 and 寸 "hand".
column6: Zhè zhǒng xiǎngfǎ tài fēngjiàn le.
column7: This way of thinking is too old-fashioned.
column9: Feudal: 封建社會 "feudal society", 封建思想 "feudal thinking", 封建制度. It is used for the old system of lords and vassals, and in speech for an attitude that is old-fashioned and rigid. 封 "enfeoff, seal" + 建 "set up". 封 has 圭 and 寸 "hand".

column3: Honey: 一罐蜂蜜 "a jar of honey", 蜂蜜柠檬 "honey lemon (drink)", 蜂蜜蛋糕. It is made by bees. 蜂 "bee" and 蜜 "honey" both have 虫 "insect", with 夆 and 宓 as sounds.
column4: 我喜欢在茶里放一点蜂蜜。
column5: 我喜歡在茶裡放一點蜂蜜。
column6: Wǒ xǐhuan zài chá lǐ fàng yīdiǎn fēngmì.
column7: I like to put a little honey in my tea.
column9: Honey: 一罐蜂蜜 "a jar of honey", 蜂蜜檸檬 "honey lemon (drink)", 蜂蜜蛋糕. It is made by bees. 蜂 "bee" and 蜜 "honey" both have 虫 "insect", with 夆 and 宓 as sounds.

column3: To divide the work: 分工合作 "divide the work and cooperate", 明确分工 "a clear division of labor". It is about who does which part, in a team or a company. 分 "divide" + 工 "work". 工 is the picture of a worker's tool.
column4: 我们要分工合作，才能快点完成。
column5: 我們要分工合作，才能快點完成。
column6: Wǒmen yào fēngōng hézuò, cái néng kuài diǎn wánchéng.
column7: We must divide up the work and cooperate to finish quickly.
column9: To divide the work: 分工合作 "divide the work and cooperate", 明確分工 "a clear division of labor". It is about who does which part, in a team or a company. 分 "divide" + 工 "work". 工 is the picture of a worker's tool.

column3: The general mood, custom, trend of a place: 社会风气 "social climate", 学习风气 "a culture of study", 风气很好. It is the atmosphere of a school or a society, good or bad: 败坏风气. 风 "wind" + 气 "air", so a wind that spreads.
column4: 这个学校有很好的学习风气。
column5: 這個學校有很好的學習風氣。
column6: Zhège xuéxiào yǒu hěn hǎo de xuéxí fēngqì.
column7: This school has a good atmosphere of study.
column9: The general mood, custom, trend of a place: 社會風氣 "social climate", 學習風氣 "a culture of study", 風氣很好. It is the atmosphere of a school or a society, good or bad: 敗壞風氣. 風 "wind" + 氣 "air", so a wind that spreads.

column3: Humorous, witty: 说话风趣 "speak with wit", 风趣的人, 很风趣. It is for a person whose talk is charming and funny without being coarse. 风 "style" + 趣 "interest", the second with 走 "walk" and 取.
column4: 他讲话很风趣，大家都喜欢他。
column5: 他講話很風趣，大家都喜歡他。
column6: Tā jiǎnghuà hěn fēngqù, dàjiā dōu xǐhuan tā.
column7: He talks wittily and everybody likes him.
column9: Humorous, witty: 說話風趣 "speak with wit", 風趣的人, 很風趣. It is for a person whose talk is charming and funny without being coarse. 風 "style" + 趣 "interest", the second with 走 "walk" and 取.

column3: A madman, a lunatic, rude: 你是疯子吗？ "are you crazy?", 疯子般. It is also said in jest, of someone who does wild things. 疯 "crazy" has 疒 "sickness" and 风 as the sound.
column6: Tā kāichē xiàng fēngzi yīyàng kuài.
column7: He drives as fast as a madman.
column9: A madman, a lunatic, rude: 你是瘋子嗎？ "are you crazy?", 瘋子般. It is also said in jest, of someone who does wild things. 瘋 "crazy" has 疒 "sickness" and 風 as the sound.

column3: Pink: 粉红色 "pink", 粉红泡泡 "pink bubbles (romance)", 粉红色的花. It is light red, and a girl's color in many places. 粉 "powder" + 红 "red", with 纟 "silk thread" on 红 and 工 as the sound.
column4: 她喜欢穿粉红色的衣服。
column5: 她喜歡穿粉紅色的衣服。
column6: Tā xǐhuan chuān fěnhóng sè de yīfu.
column7: She likes to wear pink clothes.
column9: Pink: 粉紅色 "pink", 粉紅泡泡 "pink bubbles (romance)", 粉紅色的花. It is light red, and a girl's color in many places. 粉 "powder" + 紅 "red", with 糹 "silk thread" on 紅 and 工 as the sound.

column3: Clearly, plainly, and "evidently (but...)": 黑白分明 "clearly black and white", 分明是你 "it was clearly you", 分明在说谎. As an adverb it points at what is obvious although someone says the opposite. 分 "divide" + 明 "bright". 明 is the sun 日 and the moon 月.
column4: 你分明知道，为什么说不知道？
column5: 你分明知道，為什麼說不知道？
column6: Nǐ fēnmíng zhīdào, wèishénme shuō bù zhīdào?
column7: You clearly know, so why do you say you don't?
column9: Clearly, plainly, and "evidently (but...)": 黑白分明 "clearly black and white", 分明是你 "it was clearly you", 分明在說謊. As an adverb it points at what is obvious although someone says the opposite. 分 "divide" + 明 "bright". 明 is the sun 日 and the moon 月.

column3: Anger, furious: 感到愤怒 "feel angry", 愤怒的民众 "angry crowds", 令人愤怒. It is strong and written: rage at injustice more than at a small matter. 愤 "indignant" has 忄 "heart" and 贲; 怒 "anger" has 心 "heart" under 奴.
column4: 大家对这件事感到非常愤怒。
column5: 大家對這件事感到非常憤怒。
column6: Dàjiā duì zhè jiàn shì gǎndào fēicháng fènnù.
column7: Everyone is very angry about this matter.
column9: Anger, furious: 感到憤怒 "feel angry", 憤怒的民眾 "angry crowds", 令人憤怒. It is strong and written: rage at injustice more than at a small matter. 憤 "indignant" has 忄 "heart" and 賁; 怒 "anger" has 心 "heart" under 奴.

column3: Several senses: "to take" medicine (服药), "to obey" (服从), "to be convinced": 我不服 "I don't accept it", 我服了你 "I give up, I admire you". As "clothes" it is a bound form, as in 衣服 and 制服. The 卩 in 服 is a kneeling person.
column6: Nǐ zhēn lìhai, wǒ fú le.
column7: You are really good; I give up.
column9: Several senses: "to take" medicine (服藥), "to obey" (服從), "to be convinced": 我不服 "I don't accept it", 我服了你 "I give up, I admire you". As "clothes" it is a bound form, as in 衣服 and 制服. The 卩 in 服 is a kneeling person.

column3: To float: 浮在水面上 "float on the water", 浮起来 "float up", and "superficial, shallow": 浮躁 "restless", 浮夸 "boastful". For things on water or in air. 氵 "water" is the meaning part and 孚 gives the sound (fú).
column6: Shùyè fú zài shuǐmiàn shàng.
column7: Leaves float on the surface of the water.
column9: To float: 浮在水面上 "float on the water", 浮起來 "float up", and "superficial, shallow": 浮躁 "restless", 浮誇 "boastful". For things on water or in air. 氵 "water" is the meaning part and 孚 gives the sound (fú).

column3: To go to, to attend: 赴约 "keep an appointment", 赴美 "go to America", 赴宴 "attend a banquet", 前往. It is written and formal, for going to a place or event for a purpose. 走 "walk" is the meaning part and 卜 gives the sound.
column6: Tā míngnián yào fù Měiguó liúxué.
column7: Next year he will go to America to study.
column9: To go to, to attend: 赴約 "keep an appointment", 赴美 "go to America", 赴宴 "attend a banquet", 前往. It is written and formal, for going to a place or event for a purpose. 走 "walk" is the meaning part and 卜 gives the sound.

column3: Two main uses. A measure word for pairs and sets: 一副眼镜 "a pair of glasses", 一副手套, 一副扑克牌. And "deputy, vice-": 副总统 "vice president", 副手, 副经理 "deputy manager", 副作用 "side effect". It is also in 副词 "adverb". 畐 gives the sound and 刂 "knife" is the old meaning part.
column6: Tā dàizhe yī fù hēikuàng yǎnjìng.
column7: He wears a pair of black-framed glasses.
column9: Two main uses. A measure word for pairs and sets: 一副眼鏡 "a pair of glasses", 一副手套, 一副撲克牌. And "deputy, vice-": 副總統 "vice president", 副手, 副經理 "deputy manager", 副作用 "side effect". It is also in 副詞 "adverb". 畐 gives the sound and 刂 "knife" is the old meaning part.

column3: To tutor, to coach, to counsel: 辅导老师 "guidance counselor", 课后辅导 "after-school tutoring", 辅导孩子功课 "help a child with homework". Schools have a 辅导室, an office for counseling. 辅 "assist" has 车 "cart" and 甫 for the sound; 导 "lead".
column4: 老师每天放学后辅导我们功课。
column5: 老師每天放學後輔導我們功課。
column6: Lǎoshī měitiān fàngxué hòu fǔdǎo wǒmen gōngkè.
column7: The teacher tutors us in our schoolwork every day after school.
column9: To tutor, to coach, to counsel: 輔導老師 "guidance counselor", 課後輔導 "after-school tutoring", 輔導孩子功課 "help a child with homework". Schools have a 輔導室, an office for counseling. 輔 "assist" has 車 "cart" and 甫 for the sound; 導 "lead".

column3: Additional, attached: 附加条件 "additional condition", 附加费 "surcharge", 附加价值 "added value". It goes before a noun and means something added on to the main thing. 附 "attach" + 加 "add". 加 combines 力 "strength" and 口 "mouth", strength added by speaking.
column4: 这个活动有一些附加条件。
column5: 這個活動有一些附加條件。
column6: Zhège huódòng yǒu yīxiē fùjiā tiáojiàn.
column7: This event has some additional conditions.
column9: Additional, attached: 附加條件 "additional condition", 附加費 "surcharge", 附加價值 "added value". It goes before a noun and means something added on to the main thing. 附 "attach" + 加 "add". 加 combines 力 "strength" and 口 "mouth", strength added by speaking.

column3: Women, as a group and in formal contexts: 妇女节 "Women's Day", 妇女权益, 妇女团体. It sounds official and social, and in ordinary talk one says 女生 or 女人. 妇 has a woman 女 and 彐, and 女 is a woman seen from the side.
column4: 政府推出了保护妇女的新办法。
column5: 政府推出了保護婦女的新辦法。
column6: Zhèngfǔ tuīchū le bǎohù fùnǚ de xīn bànfǎ.
column7: The government has introduced new measures to protect women.
column9: Women, as a group and in formal contexts: 婦女節 "Women's Day", 婦女權益, 婦女團體. It sounds official and social, and in ordinary talk one says 女生 or 女人. 婦 shows a woman 女 with a broom 帚, the housewife, and 女 is a woman seen from the side.

column3: Prosperous, well-off: 生活富裕 "a comfortable life", 富裕的家庭, 变得富裕. It describes a family, a place or a life with plenty. 富 "rich" has 宀 "roof" over 畐; 裕 "abundant" has 衤 "clothes" and 谷 as the sound.
column6: Tāmen jiā de shēnghuó hěn fùyù.
column7: Their family lives in comfort.
column9: Prosperous, well-off: 生活富裕 "a comfortable life", 富裕的家庭, 變得富裕. It describes a family, a place or a life with plenty. 富 "rich" has 宀 "roof" over 畐; 裕 "abundant" has 衤 "clothes" and 谷 as the sound.

column3: A lid, a cover: 锅盖子, 瓶盖子, 盖子盖好 "close the lid", 打开盖子. It is the part that closes a pot, a bottle or a box. 盖 "cover" has 羊 over 皿; 子 is a suffix.
column6: Qǐng bǎ guōzi de gàizi gài hǎo.
column7: Please put the lid on the pot.
column9: A lid, a cover: 鍋蓋子, 瓶蓋子, 蓋子蓋好 "close the lid", 打開蓋子. It is the part that closes a pot, a bottle or a box. 蓋 "cover" has 艹 "grass", since a cover was once of straw, and 盍 as the sound; 子 is a suffix.

column3: Liver: 肝脏 "the liver", 肝炎 "hepatitis", 猪肝 "pig liver", 护肝 "protect the liver". In Taiwan, 爆肝 means working so hard that your health pays for it. ⺼ "flesh" is the meaning part of organs; 干 gives the sound (gān).
column6: Hē tài duō jiǔ duì gān bù hǎo.
column7: Drinking too much alcohol is bad for the liver.
column9: Liver: 肝臟 "the liver", 肝炎 "hepatitis", 豬肝 "pig liver", 護肝 "protect the liver". In Taiwan, 爆肝 means working so hard that your health pays for it. ⺼ "flesh" is the meaning part of organs; 干 gives the sound (gān).

column3: A cadre, an official, a manager: on the mainland a 干部 is a Party or government official. In Taiwan it is used for those who run a club or group: 学生会干部, 社团干部 "club officers", 干部训练. 干 here means "capable, the trunk", read gàn. 部 "part" has 阝.
column6: Tā shì xuéshēnghuì de gànbù.
column7: He is an officer of the student council.
column9: A cadre, an official, a manager: on the mainland a 幹部 is a Party or government official. In Taiwan it is used for those who run a club or group: 學生會幹部, 社團幹部 "club officers", 幹部訓練. 幹 here means "capable, the trunk", read gàn. 部 "part" has 阝.

column3: To be grateful, to give thanks: 感恩的心 "a grateful heart", 感恩节 "Thanksgiving", 懂得感恩. It is a warm and slightly formal word for gratitude to someone who gave you help or care. 感 "feel" + 恩 "kindness", the second with 心 "heart" under 因 as the sound.
column4: 我们应该感恩父母的养育。
column5: 我們應該感恩父母的養育。
column6: Wǒmen yīnggāi gǎn'ēn fùmǔ de yǎngyù.
column7: We should be grateful for what our parents did in raising us.
column9: To be grateful, to give thanks: 感恩的心 "a grateful heart", 感恩節 "Thanksgiving", 懂得感恩. It is a warm and slightly formal word for gratitude to someone who gave you help or care. 感 "feel" + 恩 "kindness", the second with 心 "heart" under 因 as the sound.

column3: Steel: 钢铁 "iron and steel", 钢笔 "fountain pen", 钢琴 "piano", 不锈钢 "stainless steel", 钢筋 "reinforcing bar". 钢 is hard metal. 钅 "metal" is the meaning part and 冈 the sound.
column6: Zhè zuò qiáo shì yòng gāng zuò de.
column7: This bridge is made of steel.
column9: Steel: 鋼鐵 "iron and steel", 鋼筆 "fountain pen", 鋼琴 "piano", 不鏽鋼 "stainless steel", 鋼筋 "reinforcing bar". 鋼 is hard metal. 釒 "metal" is the meaning part and 岡 the sound.

column3: Hong Kong dollars: 一百港币 "100 Hong Kong dollars", 兑换港币 "exchange into HK dollars", 港币汇率. 港 "Hong Kong, harbor" + 币 "currency". 币 has 巾 "cloth" at the bottom, as early money was cloth.
column4: 一百港币大约等于四百多新台币。
column5: 一百港幣大約等於四百多新台幣。
column6: Yī bǎi Gǎngbì dàyuē děngyú sì bǎi duō xīn táibì.
column7: One hundred Hong Kong dollars is about four hundred-odd New Taiwan dollars.
column9: Hong Kong dollars: 一百港幣 "100 Hong Kong dollars", 兌換港幣 "exchange into HK dollars", 港幣匯率. 港 "Hong Kong, harbor" + 幣 "currency". 幣 has 巾 "cloth" at the bottom, as early money was cloth.

column3: A port, a harbor: 高雄港口 "Kaohsiung's port", 港口城市 "port city", 进出港口. It is where ships dock. 港 "harbor" + 口 "mouth, opening". 港 has 氵 "water" and 巷 as the sound.
column4: 高雄是台湾最大的港口城市。
column5: 高雄是臺灣最大的港口城市。
column6: Gāoxióng shì Táiwān zuì dà de gǎngkǒu chéngshì.
column7: Kaohsiung is Taiwan's largest port city.
column9: A port, a harbor: 高雄港口 "Kaohsiung's port", 港口城市 "port city", 進出港口. It is where ships dock. 港 "harbor" + 口 "mouth, opening". 港 has 氵 "water" and 巷 as the sound.

column3: Harbor, port: 渔港 "fishing harbor", 港湾 "bay, harbor", 出港 "leave port", 港务局. It is also the short name for Hong Kong: 港币, 港星, 去港. 氵 "water" is the meaning part and 巷 gives the sound.
column4: 这个渔港每天都有很多船。
column5: 這個漁港每天都有很多船。
column6: Zhège yúgǎng měitiān dōu yǒu hěn duō chuán.
column7: This fishing harbor has many boats every day.
column9: Harbor, port: 漁港 "fishing harbor", 港灣 "bay, harbor", 出港 "leave port", 港務局. It is also the short name for Hong Kong: 港幣, 港星, 去港. 氵 "water" is the meaning part and 巷 gives the sound.

column3: To be grateful, to appreciate: 非常感激 "very grateful", 感激你的帮助 "grateful for your help", 深表感激. It is a strong thanks said to a person for specific help. It sounds more serious than 谢谢. 感 "feel" + 激 "stir", with 氵 "water" in 激, as a splash.
column6: Wǒ fēicháng gǎnjī nǐ de bāngzhù.
column7: I am very grateful for your help.
column9: To be grateful, to appreciate: 非常感激 "very grateful", 感激你的幫助 "grateful for your help", 深表感激. It is a strong thanks said to a person for specific help. It sounds more serious than 謝謝. 感 "feel" + 激 "stir", with 氵 "water" in 激, as a splash.

column3: What for? What are you doing? in speech: 你干嘛？ "what are you up to?", 干嘛这么生气？ "why so angry?", 干嘛不去？ "why not go?". It is casual and can be sharp. 干 here is only a sound; it stands for 干什么 in short. The dictionary has the 嘛 in the second tone.
column6: Nǐ gànmá yīzhí kàn wǒ?
column7: Why do you keep looking at me?
column9: What for? What are you doing? in speech: 你幹嘛？ "what are you up to?", 幹嘛這麼生氣？ "why so angry?", 幹嘛不去？ "why not go?". It is casual and can be sharp. 幹 here is only a sound; it stands for 幹什麼 in short. The dictionary has the 嘛 in the second tone.

column3: To infect, to be infected, and "to influence": 感染病毒 "catch a virus", 伤口感染 "an infected wound", 被他的笑容感染 "be moved by his smile". It is for illness and also for a mood spreading from person to person. 感 "feel" + 染 "dye": a feeling that dyes.
column4: 他被病毒感染了，需要休息。
column5: 他被病毒感染了，需要休息。
column6: Tā bèi bìngdú gǎnrǎn le, xūyào xiūxi.
column7: He has been infected by a virus and needs rest.
column9: To infect, to be infected, and "to influence": 感染病毒 "catch a virus", 傷口感染 "an infected wound", 被他的笑容感染 "be moved by his smile". It is for illness and also for a mood spreading from person to person. 感 "feel" + 染 "dye": a feeling that dyes.

column3: To tell, to report, to sue: 告别 "say goodbye", 告诉 "tell", 报告 "report", and by itself, "to sue" or "to report someone": 我要去告他 "I'm going to report him", 告上法院. As a bare verb it is mostly "sue". 告 shows an ox 牛 over a mouth 口.
column4: 他做了坏事，我要去告他。
column5: 他做了壞事，我要去告他。
column6: Tā zuò le huài shì, wǒ yào qù gào tā.
column7: He did something bad, and I am going to report him.
column9: To tell, to report, to sue: 告別 "say goodbye", 告訴 "tell", 報告 "report", and by itself, "to sue" or "to report someone": 我要去告他 "I'm going to report him", 告上法院. As a bare verb it is mostly "sue". 告 shows an ox 牛 over a mouth 口.

column3: To take one's leave: 我该告辞了 "I should be going", 向主人告辞. A polite, a bit formal way to say goodbye when you leave a host. 告 "tell" + 辞 "leave", whose old form shows hands untangling threads.
column4: 时间不早了，我该告辞了。
column5: 時間不早了，我該告辭了。
column6: Shíjiān bù zǎo le, wǒ gāi gàocí le.
column7: It is getting late and I must be going.
column9: To take one's leave: 我該告辭了 "I should be going", 向主人告辭. A polite, a bit formal way to say goodbye when you leave a host. 告 "tell" + 辭 "leave", whose old form shows hands untangling threads.
