column3: A peak, and "rush hour": 交通高峰 "peak traffic", 上下班高峰 "the commuting peak", 高峰期 "peak period", 登上高峰 "reach the peak". It is a mountain top and a time of the most use. 高 "high" + 峰 "peak", with 山 "mountain" and 夆 as the sound.
column4: 下班高峰时，捷运上人很多。
column5: 下班高峰時，捷運上人很多。
column6: Xiàbān gāofēng shí, jiéyùn shàng rén hěn duō.
column7: At the evening rush hour, the MRT is full of people.
column9: A peak, and "rush hour": 交通高峰 "peak traffic", 上下班高峰 "the commuting peak", 高峰期 "peak period", 登上高峰 "reach the peak". It is a mountain top and a time of the most use. 高 "high" + 峰 "peak", with 山 "mountain" and 夆 as the sound.

column3: Noble, elegant: 高贵的气质 "an elegant bearing", 高贵的人, 高贵典雅. It praises the character or looks of a person, or an object of fine quality. 高 "high" + 贵 "valuable". 贵 has 贝 "shell, money" at the bottom, for what costs a lot.
column6: Tā kàn qǐlái hěn gāoguì.
column7: She looks very elegant.
column9: Noble, elegant: 高貴的氣質 "an elegant bearing", 高貴的人, 高貴典雅. It praises the character or looks of a person, or an object of fine quality. 高 "high" + 貴 "valuable". 貴 has 貝 "shell, money" at the bottom, for what costs a lot.

column3: Brilliant, wise, skillful: 高明的办法 "a clever method", 医术高明 "a skilled doctor", 你真高明 "you are clever". It praises a plan or a person's skill. 高 "high" + 明 "bright", with 日 "sun" and 月 "moon" together in 明.
column6: Nǐ zhège bànfǎ zhēn gāomíng.
column7: This method of yours is really clever.
column9: Brilliant, wise, skillful: 高明的辦法 "a clever method", 醫術高明 "a skilled doctor", 你真高明 "you are clever". It praises a plan or a person's skill. 高 "high" + 明 "bright", with 日 "sun" and 月 "moon" together in 明.

column3: An expert, a master: 电脑高手 "a computer whiz", 武林高手 "a martial arts master", 高手如云 "full of experts". It is used for a person who is far ahead of others in a skill or game. 高 "high" + 手 "hand", the picture of a hand with fingers out.
column4: 他是我们公司的电脑高手。
column5: 他是我們公司的電腦高手。
column6: Tā shì wǒmen gōngsī de diànnǎo gāoshǒu.
column7: He is the computer expert of our company.
column9: An expert, a master: 電腦高手 "a computer whiz", 武林高手 "a martial arts master", 高手如雲 "full of experts". It is used for a person who is far ahead of others in a skill or game. 高 "high" + 手 "hand", the picture of a hand with fingers out.

column3: To cut: 割草 "mow the grass", 割伤 "cut oneself", 割肉, 割破. It is for cutting with a blade, a sickle or a knife, grass, crops and skin. 刂 "knife" is the meaning part and 害 gives the sound.
column6: Bàba zài yuànzi lǐ gē cǎo.
column7: Dad is mowing the grass in the yard.
column9: To cut: 割草 "mow the grass", 割傷 "cut oneself", 割肉, 割破. It is for cutting with a blade, a sickle or a knife, grass, crops and skin. 刂 "knife" is the meaning part and 害 gives the sound.

column3: To put, to place: 把书搁在桌上 "put the book on the desk", 搁下 "put down", and "to set aside, to delay": 搁着 "leave it", 耽搁 "delay". 扌 "hand" is the meaning part and 阁 gives the sound.
column4: 他把书搁在桌子上就出去了。
column5: 他把書擱在桌子上就出去了。
column6: Tā bǎ shū gē zài zhuōzi shàng jiù chūqù le.
column7: He put the book on the table and went out.
column9: To put, to place: 把書擱在桌上 "put the book on the desk", 擱下 "put down", and "to set aside, to delay": 擱著 "leave it", 耽擱 "delay". 扌 "hand" is the meaning part and 閣 gives the sound.

column3: To sing: 歌唱比赛 "singing contest", 歌唱家 "singer", 放声歌唱 "sing out loud". It is more written and more solemn than 唱歌, and can be for praising something: 歌唱祖国. 歌 "song" has 欠 "yawn, breath" and 哥; 唱 "sing" has 口 "mouth" and 昌.
column4: 孩子们在台上快乐地歌唱。
column5: 孩子們在臺上快樂地歌唱。
column6: Háizimen zài tái shàng kuàilè de gēchàng.
column7: The children sing happily on the stage.
column9: To sing: 歌唱比賽 "singing contest", 歌唱家 "singer", 放聲歌唱 "sing out loud". It is more written and more solemn than 唱歌, and can be for praising something: 歌唱祖國. 歌 "song" has 欠 "yawn, breath" and 哥; 唱 "sing" has 口 "mouth" and 昌.

column3: All trades and professions: 各行各业的人 "people of every walk of life", 各行各业都有。 A four-character phrase; it says that something is found in every field. 行 here is read háng "trade", and 业 "business". 各 "each" is walking feet 夂 over a mouth 口.
column4: 各行各业的人都来参加了。
column5: 各行各業的人都來參加了。
column6: Gèhánggèyè de rén dōu lái cānjiā le.
column7: People from every walk of life came to join.
column9: All trades and professions: 各行各業的人 "people of every walk of life", 各行各業都有。 A four-character phrase; it says that something is found in every field. 行 here is read háng "trade", and 業 "business". 各 "each" is walking feet 夂 over a mouth 口.

column3: Opera, the Western kind: 看歌剧 "see an opera", 歌剧院 "opera house", 歌剧演员. Chinese opera is called 京剧 or 歌仔戏 (the Taiwanese kind). 歌 "song" + 剧 "drama", where 剧 has 刂 "knife" and a sound part.
column4: 我们昨天晚上去看了歌剧。
column5: 我們昨天晚上去看了歌劇。
column6: Wǒmen zuótiān wǎnshang qù kàn le gējù.
column7: We went to see an opera last night.
column9: Opera, the Western kind: 看歌劇 "see an opera", 歌劇院 "opera house", 歌劇演員. Chinese opera is called 京劇 or 歌仔戲 (the Taiwanese kind). 歌 "song" + 劇 "drama", where 劇 has 刂 "knife" and a sound part.

column3: To provide, to supply: 供电 "supply electricity", 供水 "supply water", 供不应求 "supply cannot meet demand", 供应 "supply". Read gōng, and gòng when it means "to offer" at an altar. 亻 "person" and 共 "together" (also the sound) show hands offering.
column4: 这个水库供全市的人用水。
column5: 這個水庫供全市的人用水。
column6: Zhège shuǐkù gōng quán shì de rén yòng shuǐ.
column7: This reservoir supplies water to the whole city.
column9: To provide, to supply: 供電 "supply electricity", 供水 "supply water", 供不應求 "supply cannot meet demand", 供應 "supply". Read gōng, and gòng when it means "to offer" at an altar. 亻 "person" and 共 "together" (also the sound) show hands offering.

column3: A married woman's word for her husband's father: 我公公, and 公婆 for her husband's parents together. Her husband's mother is 婆婆. In speech a child says 爷爷 for the father's father, so 公公 is the in-law term. The syllable is doubled and the second one is neutral.
column6: Wǒ gōnggong hěn xǐhuan zhòng cài.
column7: My father-in-law likes growing vegetables.
column9: A married woman's word for her husband's father: 我公公, and 公婆 for her husband's parents together. Her husband's mother is 婆婆. In speech a child says 爺爺 for the father's father, so 公公 is the in-law term. The syllable is doubled and the second one is neutral.

column3: Labor union, a workers' organization: 工会代表, 加入工会, 产业工会. 工 is "work" and 会 here is "association", as in 公会 and 商会. It names the organization; the union's members are 会员.
column6: Tā shì gōnghuì de dàibiǎo.
column7: He is the union's representative.
column9: Labor union, a workers' organization: 工會代表, 加入工會, 產業工會. 工 is "work" and 會 here is "association", as in 公會 and 商會. It names the organization; the union's members are 會員.

column3: Public, run and funded by the government, of schools and hospitals: 公立学校, 公立医院. The opposite is 私立 "private". 公 is "public" and 立 "set up, established"; with 国立 (national) and 市立 (city-run) it forms a family of words for who runs something.
column6: Zhè suǒ gōnglì xuéxiào hěn dà.
column7: This public school is big.
column9: Public, run and funded by the government, of schools and hospitals: 公立學校, 公立醫院. The opposite is 私立 "private". 公 is "public" and 立 "set up, established"; with 國立 (national) and 市立 (city-run) it forms a family of words for who runs something.

column3: Pay for a job done, wages for labor or for a service: 付工钱, 工钱很便宜. It is the money for a piece of work or a day's labor, not a regular monthly salary (that is 薪水). 钱 has 金 "metal" for the meaning, and 戋 gives the sound.
column6: Lǎobǎn hái méi fù gōngqián.
column7: The boss hasn't paid the wages yet.
column9: Pay for a job done, wages for labor or for a service: 付工錢, 工錢很便宜. It is the money for a piece of work or a day's labor, not a regular monthly salary (that is 薪水). 錢 has 金 "metal" for the meaning, and 戔 gives the sound.

column3: For public use, shared: 公用电话, 公用设备, 公用厕所. The thing belongs to nobody in particular and is used by everyone. 公 "public" + 用 "use". It describes things, and rarely stands alone as a verb.
column6: Zhè shì gōngyòng de diànhuà.
column7: This is a public telephone.
column9: For public use, shared: 公用電話, 公用設備, 公用廁所. The thing belongs to nobody in particular and is used by everyone. 公 "public" + 用 "use". It describes things, and rarely stands alone as a verb.

column3: Registered letter, sent with a receipt so that it can be traced: 寄挂号信 at the post office. 挂号 means "register" in general, and it is also what you do at a hospital before seeing a doctor. 挂 has 扌 "hand" for the meaning, since it means to hang something up.
column4: 这封挂号信是寄给你的。
column5: 這封掛號信是寄給你的。
column6: Zhè fēng guàhàoxìn shì jì gěi nǐ de.
column7: This registered letter was sent to you.
column9: Registered letter, sent with a receipt so that it can be traced: 寄掛號信 at the post office. 掛號 means "register" in general, and it is also what you do at a hospital before seeing a doctor. 掛 has 扌 "hand" for the meaning, since it means to hang something up.

column3: No wonder, said when you have just learned the reason for something: 怪不得你这么累, 原来你昨天没睡. The explanation comes before or after it. Literally "cannot blame" (怪 "blame" + 不得 "cannot"). The last two syllables are neutral.
column6: Guàibude tā zhème gāoxìng.
column7: No wonder he is so happy.
column9: No wonder, said when you have just learned the reason for something: 怪不得你這麼累, 原來你昨天沒睡. The explanation comes before or after it. Literally "cannot blame" (怪 "blame" + 不得 "cannot"). The last two syllables are neutral.

column3: Two senses: "to be used to" (吃不惯 "cannot get used to eating it", 看不惯 "cannot stand the sight of") and "to spoil" a child: 把孩子惯坏了. It mostly occurs in 习惯 and 惯例. 忄 "heart" is the meaning part and 贯 gives the sound (guàn, the same); a habit is something you do by heart.
column6: Nǐ bié bǎ háizi guàn huài le.
column7: Don't spoil the child.
column9: Two senses: "to be used to" (吃不慣 "cannot get used to eating it", 看不慣 "cannot stand the sight of") and "to spoil" a child: 把孩子慣壞了. It mostly occurs in 習慣 and 慣例. 忄 "heart" is the meaning part and 貫 gives the sound (guàn, the same); a habit is something you do by heart.

column3: Jar, pot, can with a lid or a narrow mouth: 玻璃罐子, 茶叶罐子, 糖罐子. 罐 has 缶 "pottery jar" for the meaning and 雚 for the sound (guàn, the same). 雚 is also the sound part of 观 and 欢.
column6: Guànzi lǐ zhuāngmǎn le táng.
column7: The jar is full of sugar.
column9: Jar, pot, can with a lid or a narrow mouth: 玻璃罐子, 茶葉罐子, 糖罐子. 罐 has 缶 "pottery jar" for the meaning and 雚 for the sound (guàn, the same). 雚 is also the sound part of 觀 and 歡.

column3: Literally "pipes": 瓦斯管道, 水管道, 输油管道 for gas, water and oil. Figuratively "channel, means": 合法管道 "legal channels", 透过管道 "through channels", 沟通管道. 管 has 竹 "bamboo" on top, a hollow tube, and 官 for the sound.
column6: Dìxià de guǎndào huài le.
column7: The pipes underground are broken.
column9: Literally "pipes": 瓦斯管道, 水管道, 輸油管道 for gas, water and oil. Figuratively "channel, means": 合法管道 "legal channels", 透過管道 "through channels", 溝通管道. 管 has 竹 "bamboo" on top, a hollow tube, and 官 for the sound.

column3: Wide, vast, of land, sea and also of ideas: 广阔的草原, 视野广阔, 前景广阔 "broad prospects". It describes size and range, not narrow things. In 广, 黄 no longer sounds like guǎng. 阔 has 门 "gate" and 活, which still hints at the sound (kuò, huó).
column6: Cǎoyuán fēicháng guǎngkuò.
column7: The grassland is very vast.
column9: Wide, vast, of land, sea and also of ideas: 廣闊的草原, 視野廣闊, 前景廣闊 "broad prospects". It describes size and range, not narrow things. In 廣, 黃 no longer sounds like guǎng. 闊 has 門 "gate" and 活, which still hints at the sound (kuò, huó).

column3: Bright, well lit or shiny: 光亮的地板, 房间很光亮, and as a noun "brightness, light": 一点光亮. 光 "light" + 亮 "bright". It is about brightness; to say a room has good light you can also use 明亮.
column6: Zhè jiān fángjiān hěn guāngliàng.
column7: This room is very bright.
column9: Bright, well lit or shiny: 光亮的地板, 房間很光亮, and as a noun "brightness, light": 一點光亮. 光 "light" + 亮 "bright". It is about brightness; to say a room has good light you can also use 明亮.

column3: Just, only, on its own, before a noun or verb phrase, usually answered by 就: 光是机票就要一万块 "the plane ticket alone costs ten thousand". It stresses that even this one item is already a lot. 光 here is an adverb ("only"), not "light".
column6: Guāngshì jīpiào jiù yào yī wàn kuài.
column7: The plane ticket alone costs ten thousand dollars.
column9: Just, only, on its own, before a noun or verb phrase, usually answered by 就: 光是機票就要一萬塊 "the plane ticket alone costs ten thousand". It stresses that even this one item is already a lot. 光 here is an adverb ("only"), not "light".

column3: Tourism, sightseeing, the standard word in Taiwan, where the mainland more often says 旅游: 观光客 "tourist", 观光景点, 观光夜市, 观光局 "tourism bureau". It is both noun and verb: 来台湾观光. 观 has 见 "see" and 又; 光 here is "scenery".
column4: 来台湾观光的人越来越多。
column5: 來台灣觀光的人越來越多。
column6: Lái Táiwān guānguāng de rén yuè lái yuè duō.
column7: More and more people come to Taiwan as tourists.
column9: Tourism, sightseeing, the standard word in Taiwan, where the mainland more often says 旅遊: 觀光客 "tourist", 觀光景點, 觀光夜市, 觀光局 "tourism bureau". It is both noun and verb: 來台灣觀光. 觀 has 見 "see" and 雚 for the sound; 光 here is "scenery".

column3: Convention, usual practice, what is normally done: 按照惯例 "as is customary", 打破惯例 "break with convention", 国际惯例. It is firmer than 习惯, which describes a person's habit. 惯 "customary" + 例 "example, rule".
column6: Ànzhào guànlì, wǒmen xiān kāihuì.
column7: As usual, we hold a meeting first.
column9: Convention, usual practice, what is normally done: 按照慣例 "as is customary", 打破慣例 "break with convention", 國際慣例. It is firmer than 習慣, which describes a person's habit. 慣 "customary" + 例 "example, rule".

column3: Canned food, or a can: 凤梨罐头, 开罐头, 罐头食品. It also appears in 罐头笑声 "canned laughter" on TV and 罐头音乐 for ready-made, repeated stuff. 罐 "jar, can" + the neutral suffix 头.
column4: 他带了几个罐头去露营。
column5: 他帶了幾個罐頭去露營。
column6: Tā dài le jǐ ge guàntou qù lùyíng.
column7: He took a few cans of food camping.
column9: Canned food, or a can: 鳳梨罐頭, 開罐頭, 罐頭食品. It also appears in 罐頭笑聲 "canned laughter" on TV and 罐頭音樂 for ready-made, repeated stuff. 罐 "jar, can" + the neutral suffix 頭.

column3: Official, a person with a position in government or a large organization: 政府官员, 高级官员, 外交官员. 官 shows a roof 宀 over a building where officials work, and 员 means a person in a role (演员, 公务员). It is neutral to formal.
column4: 政府官员今天开了记者会。
column5: 政府官員今天開了記者會。
column6: Zhèngfǔ guānyuán jīntiān kāi le jìzhěhuì.
column7: Government officials held a press conference today.
column9: Official, a person with a position in government or a large organization: 政府官員, 高級官員, 外交官員. 官 shows a roof 宀 over a building where officials work, and 員 means a person in a role (演員, 公務員). It is neutral to formal.

column3: To control, restrict, by the authorities: 交通管制 "traffic control", 管制进口, 管制药品 "controlled drugs", 管制区. It is about rules imposed from above, closer to "regulate and limit" than to just "manage" (管理).
column6: Zhè tiáo lù jīntiān jiāotōng guǎnzhì.
column7: Traffic on this road is controlled today.
column9: To control, restrict, by the authorities: 交通管制 "traffic control", 管制進口, 管制藥品 "controlled drugs", 管制區. It is about rules imposed from above, closer to "regulate and limit" than to just "manage" (管理).

column3: Melon seeds, really the roasted, salted seeds of watermelon, pumpkin or sunflower that people crack open with their teeth as a snack: 嗑瓜子. 瓜 is a picture of a melon hanging from its vine. The dictionary reads the last syllable zǐ here.
column4: 看电视的时候，他喜欢嗑瓜子。
column5: 看電視的時候，他喜歡嗑瓜子。
column6: Kàn diànshì de shíhou, tā xǐhuan kè guāzǐ.
column7: When he watches TV, he likes to crack melon seeds.
column9: Melon seeds, really the roasted, salted seeds of watermelon, pumpkin or sunflower that people crack open with their teeth as a snack: 嗑瓜子. 瓜 is a picture of a melon hanging from its vine. The dictionary reads the last syllable zǐ here.

column3: Lonely, the feeling of being alone: 感到孤单, 一个人很孤单. Compare 寂寞, which stresses an inner emptiness; 孤单 is more about having nobody beside you. 孤 has 子 "child" and 瓜 for the sound (not alike now), and recalls the orphan; 单 is "single".
column4: 一个人在国外，他觉得很孤单。
column5: 一個人在國外，他覺得很孤單。
column6: Yī ge rén zài guówài, tā juéde hěn gūdān.
column7: Alone abroad, he feels lonely.
column9: Lonely, the feeling of being alone: 感到孤單, 一個人很孤單. Compare 寂寞, which stresses an inner emptiness; 孤單 is more about having nobody beside you. 孤 has 子 "child" and 瓜 for the sound (not alike now), and recalls the orphan; 單 is "single".

column3: Classical, of art, music, literature, style: 古典音乐, 古典文学, 古典舞, 古典美. It points to the old, established tradition. 典 shows two hands holding a book 册 on a stand, an authoritative text, as in 字典 "dictionary".
column6: Wǒ xǐhuan tīng gǔdiǎn yīnyuè.
column7: I like listening to classical music.
column9: Classical, of art, music, literature, style: 古典音樂, 古典文學, 古典舞, 古典美. It points to the old, established tradition. 典 shows two hands holding a book 冊 on a stand, an authoritative text, as in 字典 "dictionary".

column3: To kneel: 跪下, 下跪, 跪着, 跪在地上; also in 跪坐 "sit on one's heels", as in a Japanese tatami room. 足 "foot" is the meaning part, and 危 gives a sound that has since drifted (wēi, guì). It also turns up in internet slang for "I give up".
column6: Tā guì xiàlái xiàng tā qiúhūn.
column7: He knelt down to propose to her.
column9: To kneel: 跪下, 下跪, 跪著, 跪在地上; also in 跪坐 "sit on one's heels", as in a Japanese tatami room. 足 "foot" is the meaning part, and 危 gives a sound that has since drifted (wēi, guì). It also turns up in internet slang for "I give up".

column3: Counter in a shop, bank or at a check-in desk: 服务柜台, 柜台人员, 去柜台结账. 柜 has 木 "wood" and 巨 for the sound, because a cabinet is made of wood. 台 is the "platform" in 舞台 and 电台.
column6: Qǐng dào guìtái fù qián.
column7: Please pay at the counter.
column9: Counter in a shop, bank or at a check-in desk: 服務櫃臺, 櫃臺人員, 去櫃臺結帳. 櫃 has 木 "wood" and 貴 for the sound (guì, the same), because a cabinet is made of wood. 臺 is the "platform" in 舞臺 and 電臺.

column3: Nobility, aristocrat: 欧洲贵族, 贵族家庭, 贵族血统. It also gives a flavor of luxury, as in 贵族学校, a pricey private school with a posh image. 贵 "noble, expensive" + 族 "clan, group"; 族 shows a flag 方 and an arrow 矢, a group that gathers under one banner.
column4: 这座城堡以前是贵族的家。
column5: 這座城堡以前是貴族的家。
column6: Zhè zuò chéngbǎo yǐqián shì guìzú de jiā.
column7: This castle used to be a nobleman's home.
column9: Nobility, aristocrat: 歐洲貴族, 貴族家庭, 貴族血統. It also gives a flavor of luxury, as in 貴族學校, a pricey private school with a posh image. 貴 "noble, expensive" + 族 "clan, group"; 族 shows a flag 方 and an arrow 矢, a group that gathers under one banner.

column3: To wrap, bundle up: 裹着毯子 "wrapped in a blanket", 裹起来, 包裹 "parcel". It means wrapping something around a body or an object. 衣 "clothes" is the meaning part, and 果 gives the sound (guǒ, the same); the character puts 果 inside 衣.
column4: 天冷，他裹着毯子看电视。
column5: 天冷，他裹著毯子看電視。
column6: Tiān lěng, tā guǒ zhe tǎnzi kàn diànshì.
column7: It's cold, so he watches TV wrapped in a blanket.
column9: To wrap, bundle up: 裹著毯子 "wrapped in a blanket", 裹起來, 包裹 "parcel". It means wrapping something around a body or an object. 衣 "clothes" is the meaning part, and 果 gives the sound (guǒ, the same); the character puts 果 inside 衣.

column3: Pot, pan: a cooking pot with a handle, as in 煮饭的锅子, 炒菜锅子. Also in 火锅 "hotpot". 锅 has 金 "metal" and 呙, the same sound part as in 过 and 祸. 呙 is no longer pronounced like any of the three (guō, guò, huò). 子 is neutral.
column6: Guōzi lǐ yǒu rè tāng.
column7: There is hot soup in the pot.
column9: Pot, pan: a cooking pot with a handle, as in 煮飯的鍋子, 炒菜鍋子. Also in 火鍋 "hotpot". 鍋 has 金 "metal" and 咼, the same sound part as in 過 and 禍. 咼 is no longer pronounced like any of the three (guō, guò, huò). 子 is neutral.

column3: Transition, the stage between two states: 过渡期 "transition period", 过渡阶段, 过渡政府. As a verb, "to cross over" water. 渡 has 氵 "water" and 度 for the sound (dù, the same), a crossing of a river. 过 "pass" + 渡 "cross".
column4: 这只是一个过渡的办法。
column5: 這只是一個過渡的辦法。
column6: Zhè zhǐ shì yī ge guòdù de bànfǎ.
column7: This is only a temporary solution.
column9: Transition, the stage between two states: 過渡期 "transition period", 過渡階段, 過渡政府. As a verb, "to cross over" water. 渡 has 氵 "water" and 度 for the sound (dù, the same), a crossing of a river. 過 "pass" + 渡 "cross".

column3: National legislature, parliament: 美国国会 "the U.S. Congress", 国会议员. Taiwan's own body is the 立法院, but 国会 is the word for the institution in general: 国会改革. 国 "country" + 会 "assembly".
column4: 美国国会通过了新法律。
column5: 美國國會通過了新法律。
column6: Měiguó guóhuì tōngguò le xīn fǎlǜ.
column7: The U.S. Congress passed a new law.
column9: National legislature, parliament: 美國國會 "the U.S. Congress", 國會議員. Taiwan's own body is the 立法院, but 國會 is the word for the institution in general: 國會改革. 國 "country" + 會 "assembly".

column3: National, set up and run by the state, of universities and museums: 国立大学, 国立故宫博物院, 国立台湾大学. It is a part of many official names in Taiwan. The opposites are 私立 and 市立.
column6: Tā kǎoshàng le guólì dàxué.
column7: He got into a national university.
column9: National, set up and run by the state, of universities and museums: 國立大學, 國立故宮博物院, 國立臺灣大學. It is a part of many official names in Taiwan. The opposites are 私立 and 市立.

column3: To celebrate a holiday, mainly Chinese festivals such as the Lunar New Year and the Mid-Autumn Festival: 过节回家, 过节的气氛. 过 here is "to spend, to celebrate" (as in 过年), and 节 "festival". In another sense, 过节 is an old grudge.
column4: 过节的时候，全家人都回来了。
column5: 過節的時候，全家人都回來了。
column6: Guòjié de shíhou, quánjiārén dōu huílái le.
column7: At the holiday, the whole family came home.
column9: To celebrate a holiday, mainly Chinese festivals such as the Lunar New Year and the Mid-Autumn Festival: 過節回家, 過節的氣氛. 過 here is "to spend, to celebrate" (as in 過年), and 節 "festival". In another sense, 過節 is an old grudge.

column3: To filter: 过滤水, 过滤网, 过滤杂质 "filter out impurities". It is also used for information: 过滤资讯, 过滤垃圾邮件 "filter spam". 滤 has 氵 "water" and 虑 for the sound (lǜ, the same).
column6: Zhè tái jīqì kěyǐ guòlǜ shuǐ.
column7: This machine can filter water.
column9: To filter: 過濾水, 過濾網, 過濾雜質 "filter out impurities". It is also used for information: 過濾資訊, 過濾垃圾郵件 "filter spam". 濾 has 氵 "water" and 慮 for the sound (lǜ, the same).

column3: National flag: 升国旗 "raise the flag", 挂国旗, 国旗飘扬. 旗 has 㫃 "flag" for the meaning and 其 for the sound (qí, the same).
column6: Xuéxiào měi tiān zǎoshang shēng guóqí.
column7: The school raises the flag every morning.
column9: National flag: 升國旗 "raise the flag", 掛國旗, 國旗飄揚. 旗 has 㫃 "flag" for the meaning and 其 for the sound (qí, the same).

column3: To expire, be overdue: 过期牛奶, 护照过期, 过期不候 "no waiting after the deadline". It is the standard word for expired food, a visa or a coupon. 过 "pass" + 期 "term, date". 期 has 月 "moon" and 其 for the sound.
column6: Zhè píng niúnǎi yǐjīng guòqí le.
column7: This bottle of milk has expired.
column9: To expire, be overdue: 過期牛奶, 護照過期, 過期不候 "no waiting after the deadline". It is the standard word for expired food, a visa or a coupon. 過 "pass" + 期 "term, date". 期 has 月 "moon" and 其 for the sound.

column3: To pass away, a gentle word for death, used about someone you know, usually an older person: 他的爷爷去年过世了. It softens what 死 states bluntly, and is polite in condolences. 过 "pass" + 世 "world, life".
column6: Tā de yéye qùnián guòshì le.
column7: His grandfather passed away last year.
column9: To pass away, a gentle word for death, used about someone you know, usually an older person: 他的爺爺去年過世了. It softens what 死 states bluntly, and is polite in condolences. 過 "pass" + 世 "world, life".

column3: In Taiwan, "junior high school", short for 国民中学, grades seven to nine: 国中生, 上国中. It sits between 国小 (elementary school) and 高中 (senior high). The mainland says 初中.
column6: Wǒ dìdi jīnnián shàng guózhōng.
column7: My younger brother starts junior high this year.
column9: In Taiwan, "junior high school", short for 國民中學, grades seven to nine: 國中生, 上國中. It sits between 國小 (elementary school) and 高中 (senior high). The mainland says 初中.

column3: Bone: 骨头 "bone", 骨折 "fracture", 骨科 "orthopedics", 骨瘦如柴 "skin and bones". 骨 has a bone shape 冎 on top and 肉 "flesh" (⺼) added under it. The word 骨头 has a neutral second syllable.
column6: Gǒu zài kěn yī gēn gǔtou.
column7: The dog is gnawing a bone.
column9: Bone: 骨頭 "bone", 骨折 "fracture", 骨科 "orthopedics", 骨瘦如柴 "skin and bones". 骨 has a bone shape 冎 on top and 肉 "flesh" (⺼) added under it. The word 骨頭 has a neutral second syllable.

column3: To inspire, encourage, boost morale: 受到鼓舞, 鼓舞士气, 令人鼓舞 "encouraging". The person is lifted up in spirit. 鼓 "drum" + 舞 "dance": drums and dancing lift a crowd. 鼓 has a drum 壴 and a hand 支 holding the stick.
column6: Lǎoshī de huà gǔwǔ le dàjiā.
column7: The teacher's words encouraged everyone.
column9: To inspire, encourage, boost morale: 受到鼓舞, 鼓舞士氣, 令人鼓舞 "encouraging". The person is lifted up in spirit. 鼓 "drum" + 舞 "dance": drums and dancing lift a crowd. 鼓 has a drum 壴 and a hand 支 holding the stick.

column3: Husband of one's father's sister, an uncle by marriage: 我姑丈. Also written 姑父. The father's sister is 姑姑. 姑 has 女 "woman" and 古 for the sound (gǔ and gū are close); 丈 here means a man of the older generation (as in 丈夫 "husband").
column6: Wǒ gūzhàng zài yīyuàn gōngzuò.
column7: My uncle (my aunt's husband) works in a hospital.
column9: Husband of one's father's sister, an uncle by marriage: 我姑丈. Also written 姑父. The father's sister is 姑姑. 姑 has 女 "woman" and 古 for the sound (gǔ and gū are close); 丈 here means a man of the older generation (as in 丈夫 "husband").

column3: Might as well, would be better to, comparing two choices and saying the second wins: 还不如自己做, 还不如不去. It is used when something is pointless or worse than the alternative. 还 "even more" + 不如 "not as good as".
column4: 等这么久，还不如自己走路去。
column5: 等這麼久，還不如自己走路去。
column6: Děng zhème jiǔ, háibùrú zìjǐ zǒulù qù.
column7: Waiting this long, I might as well walk.
column9: Might as well, would be better to, comparing two choices and saying the second wins: 還不如自己做, 還不如不去. It is used when something is pointless or worse than the alternative. 還 "even more" + 不如 "not as good as".

column3: Harm, disadvantage, the opposite of 好处: 有害处, 对身体有害处, 没有什么害处. 害 "harm" + 处 "place, aspect", and 处 is read neutral here. Unlike 坏处, it says what damage something causes.
column4: 抽烟对身体有很多害处。
column5: 抽菸對身體有很多害處。
column6: Chōuyān duì shēntǐ yǒu hěn duō hàichu.
column7: Smoking does a lot of harm to the body.
column9: Harm, disadvantage, the opposite of 好處: 有害處, 對身體有害處, 沒有什麼害處. 害 "harm" + 處 "place, aspect", and 處 is read neutral here. Unlike 壞處, it says what damage something causes.

column3: Navy: 海军军官, 海军陆战队 "Marine Corps". 海 "sea" + 军 "army", with 陆军 "army" and 空军 "air force" as the other two. 军 is also the sound part in 挥, though 挥 (huī) no longer sounds like it.
column4: 他在海军工作了二十年。
column5: 他在海軍工作了二十年。
column6: Tā zài hǎijūn gōngzuò le èrshí nián.
column7: He has worked in the navy for twenty years.
column9: Navy: 海軍軍官, 海軍陸戰隊 "Marine Corps". 海 "sea" + 軍 "army", with 陸軍 "army" and 空軍 "air force" as the other two. 軍 is also the sound part in 揮, though 揮 (huī) no longer sounds like it.

column3: Overseas, abroad: 海外华人, 海外留学, 海外市场, 旅居海外. It means across the sea from where you are: anywhere abroad. 海 has 氵 "water" and 每, which still hints at the sound (hǎi, měi).
column6: Tā de jiārén dōu zài hǎiwài.
column7: His family are all overseas.
column9: Overseas, abroad: 海外華人, 海外留學, 海外市場, 旅居海外. It means across the sea from where you are: anywhere abroad. 海 has 氵 "water" and 每, which still hints at the sound (hǎi, měi).

column3: Strait, channel: 台湾海峡, 英吉利海峡. In Taiwan 海峡两岸 means the two sides of the Taiwan Strait, Taiwan and mainland China, a stock phrase in news and politics. 峡 has 山 "mountain" and 夹, a gap between two mountains (the same sound part as in 夹).
column4: 台湾海峡在台湾和大陆之间。
column5: 台灣海峽在台灣和大陸之間。
column6: Táiwān hǎixiá zài Táiwān hé dàlù zhījiān.
column7: The Taiwan Strait lies between Taiwan and the mainland.
column9: Strait, channel: 臺灣海峽, 英吉利海峽. In Taiwan 海峽兩岸 means the two sides of the Taiwan Strait, Taiwan and mainland China, a stock phrase in news and politics. 峽 has 山 "mountain" and 夾, a gap between two mountains (the same sound part as in 夾).

column3: To use up, consume, waste: 耗时 "time-consuming", 耗电 "power-hungry", 耗费, 耗掉 "burn through", 耗体力. It is something that drains a resource. The old form 秏 had 禾; today's 耗 has 耒 "plow" with 毛 as the (loose) sound.
column6: Zhège ruǎntǐ hěn hào diàn.
column7: This software uses a lot of battery.
column9: To use up, consume, waste: 耗時 "time-consuming", 耗電 "power-hungry", 耗費, 耗掉 "burn through", 耗體力. It is something that drains a resource. The old form 秏 had 禾; today's 耗 has 耒 "plow" with 毛 as the (loose) sound.

column3: Hospitable, fond of having guests: 热情好客, 好客的主人. Note the reading: 好 is hào "to like", so the word means "likes guests", not "good guest". 客 shows a roof 宀 with the person under it, and 各 gives the sound.
column6: Tāmen yījiārén dōu hěn hàokè.
column7: His whole family is very hospitable.
column9: Hospitable, fond of having guests: 熱情好客, 好客的主人. Note the reading: 好 is hào "to like", so the word means "likes guests", not "good guest". 客 shows a roof 宀 with the person under it, and 各 gives the sound.

column3: Not at all, completely without, before a noun and mainly in writing: 毫无疑问 "without doubt", 毫无意义, 毫无根据 "baseless", 毫无办法. 毫 is a hair's breadth (it contains 毛 "hair"), so 毫无 is "not even a hair of". For spoken use, 一点也没有.
column6: Zhège juédìng háowú dàolǐ.
column7: This decision makes no sense at all.
column9: Not at all, completely without, before a noun and mainly in writing: 毫無疑問 "without doubt", 毫無意義, 毫無根據 "baseless", 毫無辦法. 毫 is a hair's breadth (it contains 毛 "hair"), so 毫無 is "not even a hair of". For spoken use, 一點也沒有.

column3: Luckily, fortunately, pointing to what saved the situation: 好在我带了伞, 好在没有人受伤. It comes before the clause naming the lucky fact. 好 "good" + 在 "being there": a good thing that ...
column6: Hǎozài wǒ dài le sǎn.
column7: Luckily I brought an umbrella.
column9: Luckily, fortunately, pointing to what saved the situation: 好在我帶了傘, 好在沒有人受傷. It comes before the clause naming the lucky fact. 好 "good" + 在 "being there": a good thing that ...

column3: Why bother, there's no need, a rhetorical question: 何必生气, 何必这么麻烦? It says the effort or the feeling is unnecessary. 何 "why" is literary and 必 "must": "why must you".
column4: 事情这么小，你何必生气？
column5: 事情這麼小，你何必生氣？
column6: Shìqing zhème xiǎo, nǐ hébì shēngqì?
column7: It's such a small matter, why get angry?
column9: Why bother, there's no need, a rhetorical question: 何必生氣, 何必這麼麻煩? It says the effort or the feeling is unnecessary. 何 "why" is literary and 必 "must": "why must you".

column3: Cannot get along, of people whose personalities clash: 我跟他合不来, 性格合不来. The opposite is 合得来. The pattern 合不来 is the "can't" form of 合来, "fit together".
column4: 我跟他的性格不同，合不来。
column5: 我跟他的性格不同，合不來。
column6: Wǒ gēn tā de xìnggé bùtóng, hébùlái.
column7: His personality differs from mine, and we don't get along.
column9: Cannot get along, of people whose personalities clash: 我跟他合不來, 性格合不來. The opposite is 合得來. The pattern 合不來 is the "can't" form of 合來, "fit together".

column3: To get along well, be compatible: 我们很合得来, 跟同事合得来. It is the positive partner of 合不来. It is for personality fit, not for similar likes. The 得 is neutral, as in other "can" forms.
column6: Wǒmen liǎ hěn hédelái.
column7: We two get along very well.
column9: To get along well, be compatible: 我們很合得來, 跟同事合得來. It is the positive partner of 合不來. It is for personality fit, not for similar likes. The 得 is neutral, as in other "can" forms.

column3: To make up, be reconciled: 吵架后和好, 和好如初 "be as good as before". It is used for friends, couples or families after a quarrel. 和 here is hé "peace, harmony", not hàn or huò.
column4: 他们吵架以后很快就和好了。
column5: 他們吵架以後很快就和好了。
column6: Tāmen chǎojià yǐhòu hěn kuài jiù héhǎo le.
column7: After their quarrel they soon made up.
column9: To make up, be reconciled: 吵架後和好, 和好如初 "be as good as before". It is used for friends, couples or families after a quarrel. 和 here is hé "peace, harmony", not hàn or huò.

column3: To conform to, meet a standard, rule or expectation: 合乎标准, 合乎规定, 合乎逻辑 "logical", 合乎要求. It is formal, written style. 合 "match" + 乎, a literary particle that works like 于 here.
column6: Zhège chǎnpǐn héhū biāozhǔn.
column7: This product meets the standard.
column9: To conform to, meet a standard, rule or expectation: 合乎標準, 合乎規定, 合乎邏輯 "logical", 合乎要求. It is formal, written style. 合 "match" + 乎, a literary particle that works like 於 here.

column3: Hey!, to get someone's attention or to greet: 嘿, 你在这里做什么? Doubled, 嘿嘿 is a sly laugh. It is spoken and casual. 口 shows the mouth, and 黑 gives the sound (hēi, the same).
column6: Hēi, nǐ zài zhèlǐ zuò shénme?
column7: Hey, what are you doing here?
column9: Hey!, to get someone's attention or to greet: 嘿, 你在這裡做什麼? Doubled, 嘿嘿 is a sly laugh. It is spoken and casual. 口 shows the mouth, and 黑 gives the sound (hēi, the same).

column3: Night, the dark of night, used with some feeling: 在黑夜里, 黑夜过去，黎明到来. The plain word for night is 晚上 or 夜晚. 黑 shows a face blackened by soot, with 灬 "fire" under it; 夜 is "night".
column6: Tā yī ge rén zǒu zài hēiyè lǐ.
column7: He walks alone in the dark of night.
column9: Night, the dark of night, used with some feeling: 在黑夜裡, 黑夜過去，黎明到來. The plain word for night is 晚上 or 夜晚. 黑 shows a face blackened by soot, with 灬 "fire" under it; 夜 is "night".

column3: Let alone, moreover: A都…，何况B: 大人都做不到，何况小孩 "even adults can't, let alone children". The second case is clearer than the first. 况 has 冫, and its sound part 兄 is not like kuàng any more.
column4: 大人都做不到，何况小孩。
column5: 大人都做不到，何況小孩。
column6: Dàrén dōu zuòbùdào, hékuàng xiǎohái.
column7: Even adults can't do it, let alone children.
column9: Let alone, moreover: A都…，何況B: 大人都做不到，何況小孩 "even adults can't, let alone children". The second case is clearer than the first. 況 has 氵 "water", and its sound part 兄 is not like kuàng any more.

column3: Rivers, as a group or in geography: 河流污染, 河流的上游, 台湾的河流. 河流 speaks of rivers in general, where 河 or 溪 names a single one. 河 has 氵 "water" and 可 for the sound (hé, kě); 流 adds 㐬 for the sound.
column6: Táiwān de héliú dàduō hěn duǎn.
column7: Most of Taiwan's rivers are short.
column9: Rivers, as a group or in geography: 河流污染, 河流的上游, 臺灣的河流. 河流 speaks of rivers in general, where 河 or 溪 names a single one. 河 has 氵 "water" and 可 for the sound (hé, kě); 流 adds 㐬 for the sound.

column3: Horizontal, across, sideways: 横线, 横过马路 "cross the road", 把桌子横着放. Also the horizontal stroke 一 in a character. The opposite is 直 or 竖. In words like 蛮横 "overbearing" it is read hèng. 木 "wood" is the meaning (a beam) and 黄 gives a sound that is close.
column6: Wǒ bǎ zhuōzi héng zhe fàng.
column7: I put the table down sideways.
column9: Horizontal, across, sideways: 橫線, 橫過馬路 "cross the road", 把桌子橫著放. Also the horizontal stroke 一 in a character. The opposite is 直 or 豎. In words like 蠻橫 "overbearing" it is read hèng. 木 "wood" is the meaning (a beam) and 黃 gives a sound that is close.

column3: Trace, mark, vestige: 留下痕迹, 岁月的痕迹, 没有留下任何痕迹. 痕 has 疒 "sickness", like a mark left on the skin, and 艮; 迹 has 辶 and 亦.
column6: Qiáng shàng liúxià le shuǐ de hénjì.
column7: The water left marks on the wall.
column9: Trace, mark, vestige: 留下痕跡, 歲月的痕跡, 沒有留下任何痕跡. 痕 has 疒 "sickness", like a mark left on the skin, and 艮; 跡 has 足 "foot", a footprint. Both parts describe something left behind.

column3: Friendly, amiable, polite in manner: 对人和气, 和和气气, 和气生财 "friendliness brings wealth". It describes a pleasant, mild attitude. The second syllable is neutral.
column6: Lǎobǎn duì kèrén hěn héqi.
column7: The boss is very friendly to customers.
column9: Friendly, amiable, polite in manner: 對人和氣, 和和氣氣, 和氣生財 "friendliness brings wealth". It describes a pleasant, mild attitude. The second syllable is neutral.

column3: Worth the price, a good deal: 买大包装比较合算, 这样合算吗? 划算 means the same and is more common. It is about whether money is well spent. 算 has 竹 "bamboo" on top, since counting rods were bamboo, and a figure with hands below.
column6: Mǎi dà bāozhuāng bǐjiào hésuàn.
column7: It's a better deal to buy the large pack.
column9: Worth the price, a good deal: 買大包裝比較合算, 這樣合算嗎? 划算 means the same and is more common. It is about whether money is well spent. 算 has 竹 "bamboo" on top, since counting rods were bamboo, and a figure with hands below.

column3: Contract, agreement: 签合约, 合约到期, 租屋合约 "rental contract", 手机合约. In Taiwan 合约 is the usual word, 合同 being the mainland one. 合 "fit together" + 约 "bind, appoint"; 约 has 纟 "thread" for something that binds.
column6: Wǒmen míngtiān yào qiān héyuē.
column7: We will sign the contract tomorrow.
column9: Contract, agreement: 簽合約, 合約到期, 租屋合約 "rental contract", 手機合約. In Taiwan 合約 is the usual word, 合同 being the mainland one. 合 "fit together" + 約 "bind, appoint"; 約 has 糹 "thread" for something that binds.

column3: Monkey: 一只猴子, 猴子爬树, and the saying 猴子捞月. 猴 has 犭 "animal" and 侯 for the sound (hóu, the same). 子 is a neutral suffix.
column4: 动物园里的猴子很可爱。
column5: 動物園裡的猴子很可愛。
column6: Dòngwùyuán lǐ de hóuzi hěn kě'ài.
column7: The monkeys in the zoo are cute.
column9: Monkey: 一隻猴子, 猴子爬樹, and the saying 猴子撈月. 猴 has 犭 "animal" and 侯 for the sound (hóu, the same). 子 is a neutral suffix.

column3: Descendants, later generations: 子孙后代, 留给后代, 为后代着想. It looks at the family or humanity from the point of view of the future.
column4: 我们要为后代保护环境。
column5: 我們要為後代保護環境。
column6: Wǒmen yào wèi hòudài bǎohù huánjìng.
column7: We must protect the environment for later generations.
column9: Descendants, later generations: 子孫後代, 留給後代, 為後代著想. It looks at the family or humanity from the point of view of the future. 後 shows a step 彳 and a foot 夂 tied by thread 幺, a foot that lags behind.

column3: The rear, behind: 车子后方, 后方来车 "traffic from behind", a common road warning. It also means the area behind the front line in war. It is more formal and technical than 后面.
column6: Qǐng zhùyì hòufāng lái chē.
column7: Watch out for traffic from behind.
column9: The rear, behind: 車子後方, 後方來車 "traffic from behind", a common road warning. It also means the area behind the front line in war. It is more formal and technical than 後面.

column3: Throat: 喉咙痛 "sore throat", 喉咙发炎, 清喉咙 "clear one's throat". Both characters have 口 "mouth" for the meaning; 喉 is sounded by 侯 (hóu, the same) and 咙 by 龙 (lóng, the same).
column6: Wǒ hóulóng hěn tòng.
column7: My throat is very sore.
column9: Throat: 喉嚨痛 "sore throat", 喉嚨發炎, 清喉嚨 "clear one's throat". Both characters have 口 "mouth" for the meaning; 喉 is sounded by 侯 (hóu, the same) and 嚨 by 龍 (lóng, the same).

column3: Throat, larynx, mostly in compounds: 喉咙, 喉结 "Adam's apple", 咽喉 "throat", 喉科 "ear-nose-throat". 口 "mouth" is the meaning part and 侯 gives the sound (hóu, the same).
column6: Tā de hóujié hěn míngxiǎn.
column7: His Adam's apple is very noticeable.
column9: Throat, larynx, mostly in compounds: 喉嚨, 喉結 "Adam's apple", 咽喉 "throat", 喉科 "ear-nose-throat". 口 "mouth" is the meaning part and 侯 gives the sound (hóu, the same).

column3: To move back, retreat: 向后退, 请后退, 车子慢慢后退. Said to a crowd as an instruction, and also for armies and for falling behind in a competition. 退 has 辶 "walk" and 艮, and the old form was about leaving the table after a meal.
column6: Chēzi mànmàn hòutuì.
column7: The car slowly backs up.
column9: To move back, retreat: 向後退, 請後退, 車子慢慢後退. Said to a crowd as an instruction, and also for armies and for falling behind in a competition. 退 has 辶 "walk" and 艮, and the old form was about leaving the table after a meal.

column3: Backyard, behind a house: 后院种菜, and in figurative speech 后院起火 "trouble at home". 院 has 阝 "mound, place" and 完 for the sound (yuàn, wán). It is the opposite of 前院.
column4: 我家的后院种了很多花。
column5: 我家的後院種了很多花。
column6: Wǒ jiā de hòuyuàn zhòng le hěn duō huā.
column7: We have planted many flowers in our backyard.
column9: Backyard, behind a house: 後院種菜, and in figurative speech 後院起火 "trouble at home". 院 has 阝 "mound, place" and 完 for the sound (yuàn, wán). It is the opposite of 前院.

column3: To breathe out; to call: 呼吸 "breathe", 呼叫 "call out", 呼喊 "shout", 招呼, 打招呼 "greet", 称呼 "address as". It is mostly in compounds. 口 "mouth" is the meaning and 乎 the sound (hū, the same). Its opposite is 吸 "breathe in".
column6: Tā qīngqīng hū chū yī kǒu qì.
column7: She breathed out softly.
column9: To breathe out; to call: 呼吸 "breathe", 呼叫 "call out", 呼喊 "shout", 招呼, 打招呼 "greet", 稱呼 "address as". It is mostly in compounds. 口 "mouth" is the meaning and 乎 the sound (hū, the same). Its opposite is 吸 "breathe in".

column3: The word is "beard", whiskers: 胡子, 胡须, 刮胡子 "to shave". 胡 has ⺼ and 古 for the sound. 胡子 is the spoken word and 胡须 sounds more written.
column6: Bàba měi tiān zǎoshang guā húzi.
column7: Dad shaves every morning.
column9: The word is "beard", whiskers: 鬍子, 鬍鬚, 刮鬍子 "to shave". 鬍 has 髟 "long hair" with 胡 for the sound. 鬍子 is the spoken word and 鬍鬚 sounds more written. 鬍 comes from the old sense of 胡, the dewlap, what hangs down from the chin.

column3: Flowers and plants, the greenery of a garden or balcony: 种花草, 照顾花草, 花草树木. It names plants grown for looks. 花 has 艹 "plant" with 化 for the sound (huā, huà are close), and 草 has 艹 and 早, whose sound is also close (cǎo, zǎo).
column6: Yángtái shàng bǎimǎn le huācǎo.
column7: The balcony is full of flowers and plants.
column9: Flowers and plants, the greenery of a garden or balcony: 種花草, 照顧花草, 花草樹木. It names plants grown for looks. 花 has 艹 "plant" with 化 for the sound (huā, huà are close), and 草 has 艹 and 早, whose sound is also close (cǎo, zǎo).

column3: Cost, expense, and the verb "to spend" (money, time, effort): 旅行的花费, 花费很多时间, 花费不少. It is used for the total spent on something. 费 has 贝 "shell", the old money, with 弗 for the sound.
column6: Zhè cì lǚxíng de huāfèi bù shǎo.
column7: This trip cost quite a lot.
column9: Cost, expense, and the verb "to spend" (money, time, effort): 旅行的花費, 花費很多時間, 花費不少. It is used for the total spent on something. 費 has 貝 "shell", the old money, with 弗 for the sound.

column3: Scoundrel, literally "bad egg": 大坏蛋, 坏蛋被抓住了. It is mild, common with children and in stories and films. 坏 has 土 "earth" for something that collapses, and 蛋 has 虫 "insect" for the creature and 延 for the sound.
column4: 电影里的坏蛋被抓住了。
column5: 電影裡的壞蛋被抓住了。
column6: Diànyǐng lǐ de huàidàn bèi zhuāzhù le.
column7: The villain in the film was caught.
column9: Scoundrel, literally "bad egg": 大壞蛋, 壞蛋被抓住了. It is mild, common with children and in stories and films. 壞 has 土 "earth" for something that collapses, and 蛋 has 虫 "insect" for the creature and 延 for the sound.

column3: Pregnant, to become pregnant: 她怀孕了, 怀孕三个月, 孕妇 "pregnant woman". It is neutral and polite. 怀 has 忄 "heart" and means to carry in the bosom; 孕 is a picture of a woman with a child inside.
column6: Tā huáiyùn sān ge yuè le.
column7: She is three months pregnant.
column9: Pregnant, to become pregnant: 她懷孕了, 懷孕三個月, 孕婦 "pregnant woman". It is neutral and polite. 懷 has 忄 "heart" and means to carry in the bosom; 孕 is a picture of a woman with a child inside.

column3: Emperor: 中国的皇帝, 秦始皇 "the first emperor", 皇帝的新衣 "the emperor's new clothes". 皇 and 帝 each mean "sovereign" alone, and 皇帝 joins them. 皇 shows a crown 白 above 王 "king".
column4: 他是中国最后一个皇帝。
column5: 他是中國最後一個皇帝。
column6: Tā shì Zhōngguó zuìhòu yī ge huángdì.
column7: He was China's last emperor.
column9: Emperor: 中國的皇帝, 秦始皇 "the first emperor", 皇帝的新衣 "the emperor's new clothes". 皇 and 帝 each mean "sovereign" alone, and 皇帝 joins them. 皇 shows a crown 白 above 王 "king".

column3: Soybean, the dry yellow bean from which soy milk, tofu and soy sauce are made: 黄豆浆, 黄豆粉. The green young pods eaten as a snack are 毛豆. 豆 began as a picture of a serving dish on a stand and was later used for beans.
column6: Dòujiāng shì yòng huángdòu zuò de.
column7: Soy milk is made from soybeans.
column9: Soybean, the dry yellow bean from which soy milk, tofu and soy sauce are made: 黃豆漿, 黃豆粉. The green young pods eaten as a snack are 毛豆. 豆 began as a picture of a serving dish on a stand and was later used for beans.

column3: Dusk, twilight: 黄昏的海边, 黄昏时分, 黄昏市场 "evening market". It has a poetic feel; the everyday words are 傍晚 or 晚上. 昏 shows the sun 日 going down under 氏; the same character means "dim" and "faint" in 昏倒 and 昏迷.
column4: 黄昏的时候，天空变成了橘红色。
column5: 黃昏的時候，天空變成了橘紅色。
column6: Huánghūn de shíhou, tiānkōng biànchéng le júhóngsè.
column7: At dusk the sky turns orange.
column9: Dusk, twilight: 黃昏的海邊, 黃昏時分, 黃昏市場 "evening market". It has a poetic feel; the everyday words are 傍晚 or 晚上. 昏 shows the sun 日 going down under 氏; the same character means "dim" and "faint" in 昏倒 and 昏迷.

column3: To ease, relax tension or a situation: 缓和气氛, 缓和紧张, 局势缓和. Also an adjective, "mild, gentle". It is about making something less sharp. 缓 has 纟 "thread" and 爰; 和 here is hé, not hè.
column4: 他开了个玩笑，缓和了气氛。
column5: 他開了個玩笑，緩和了氣氛。
column6: Tā kāi le ge wánxiào, huǎnhé le qìfēn.
column7: He made a joke and eased the mood.
column9: To ease, relax tension or a situation: 緩和氣氛, 緩和緊張, 局勢緩和. Also an adjective, "mild, gentle". It is about making something less sharp. 緩 has 糹 "thread" and 爰; 和 here is hé, not hè.

column3: To cheer, hail: 欢呼声, 为他欢呼, 欢呼起来. It is a cry of joy from a crowd. 欢 has 欠 "breath, yawn" and 又. 呼 is "to call out".
column6: Guānzhòng wèi xuǎnshǒu huānhū.
column7: The audience cheered for the athlete.
column9: To cheer, hail: 歡呼聲, 為他歡呼, 歡呼起來. It is a cry of joy from a crowd. 歡 has 欠 "breath, yawn" and 雚 for the sound; 雚 is also in 觀 and 罐 (guān, guàn). 呼 is "to call out".

column3: Slow, formal and descriptive: 速度缓慢, 动作缓慢, 发展缓慢. 缓 "gentle" + 慢 "slow". 慢 has 忄 "heart" and 曼; in speech use plain 慢.
column6: Héshuǐ liú de hěn huǎnmàn.
column7: The river flows very slowly.
column9: Slow, formal and descriptive: 速度緩慢, 動作緩慢, 發展緩慢. 緩 "gentle" + 慢 "slow". 慢 has 忄 "heart" and 曼; in speech use plain 慢.

column3: Happy, delighted: 满心欢喜, 欢欢喜喜, 皆大欢喜 "everyone is happy". It is also a verb, "to like", in some regions. 喜 shows a drum 壴 above a mouth 口, singing and drumming.
column4: 他满心欢喜地接过礼物。
column5: 他滿心歡喜地接過禮物。
column6: Tā mǎnxīn huānxǐ de jiēguò lǐwù.
column7: He took the gift, full of joy.
column9: Happy, delighted: 滿心歡喜, 歡歡喜喜, 皆大歡喜 "everyone is happy". It is also a verb, "to like", in some regions. 喜 shows a drum 壴 above a mouth 口, singing and drumming.

column3: To fantasize; a fantasy: 不要幻想, 幻想成真, 沉迷于幻想. The ideas are unrealistic or hopeful. 幻 "illusion" + 想 "think". 想 has 心 "heart" and 相 for the sound (xiǎng, xiāng).
column4: 他常常幻想自己是超人。
column5: 他常常幻想自己是超人。
column6: Tā chángcháng huànxiǎng zìjǐ shì chāorén.
column7: He often fantasizes that he is Superman.
column9: To fantasize; a fantasy: 不要幻想, 幻想成真, 沉迷於幻想. The ideas are unrealistic or hopeful. 幻 "illusion" + 想 "think". 想 has 心 "heart" and 相 for the sound (xiǎng, xiāng).

column3: Flowerpot: 一个花盆, 换花盆, 花盆里的土. 盆 shows a dish 皿 under 分, whose sound is close (pén, fēn). 盆 alone is a basin, as in 脸盆 and 盆栽 "potted plant".
column4: 他在花盆里种了一棵小树。
column5: 他在花盆裡種了一棵小樹。
column6: Tā zài huāpén lǐ zhòng le yī kē xiǎoshù.
column7: He planted a small tree in a flowerpot.
column9: Flowerpot: 一個花盆, 換花盆, 花盆裡的土. 盆 shows a dish 皿 under 分, whose sound is close (pén, fēn). 盆 alone is a basin, as in 臉盆 and 盆栽 "potted plant".

column3: Vase: 插花的花瓶, 一个花瓶. Figuratively, for a woman or a man valued only for looks: 他只是个花瓶. 瓶 has 瓦 "earthenware", for something made of clay, and 并 for the sound (píng, bìng).
column4: 桌上有一个漂亮的花瓶。
column5: 桌上有一個漂亮的花瓶。
column6: Zhuō shàng yǒu yī ge piàoliang de huāpíng.
column7: There is a pretty vase on the table.
column9: Vase: 插花的花瓶, 一個花瓶. Figuratively, for a woman or a man valued only for looks: 他只是個花瓶. 瓶 has 瓦 "earthenware", for something made of clay, and 并 for the sound (píng, bìng).

column3: Overseas Chinese, strictly a Chinese person who lives abroad but keeps Chinese nationality; 华人 is a person of Chinese origin of any nationality. In Taiwan, 华侨 and 侨生 (an overseas Chinese student studying in Taiwan) are common. 华 was once the older form of 花 "flower", then "splendid", hence "Chinese". 侨 has 亻 "person" with 乔 for the sound.
column6: Tā shì zhù zài Tàiguó de huáqiáo.
column7: He is an overseas Chinese living in Thailand.
column9: Overseas Chinese, strictly a Chinese person who lives abroad but keeps Chinese nationality; 華人 is a person of Chinese origin of any nationality. In Taiwan, 華僑 and 僑生 (an overseas Chinese student studying in Taiwan) are common. 華 was once the older form of 花 "flower", then "splendid", hence "Chinese". 僑 has 亻 "person" with 喬 for the sound.

column3: Pattern and color, the design of cloth, paper or goods: 花色很多, 这种布的花色 "the pattern of this cloth". It is also the suit of playing cards. 花 here is "patterned".
column6: Zhè kuài bù yǒu hěn duō huāsè.
column7: This cloth comes in many patterns.
column9: Pattern and color, the design of cloth, paper or goods: 花色很多, 這種布的花色 "the pattern of this cloth". It is also the suit of playing cards. 花 here is "patterned".

column3: Peanut: 花生酱 "peanut butter", 花生油, 花生糖, 花生过敏. 花 "flower" + 生 "grow": the plant flowers above ground, and the pod grows in the soil.
column6: Wǒ duì huāshēng guòmǐn.
column7: I am allergic to peanuts.
column9: Peanut: 花生醬 "peanut butter", 花生油, 花生糖, 花生過敏. 花 "flower" + 生 "grow": the plant flowers above ground, and the pod grows in the soil.

column3: Chemistry, also "chemical": 化学课, 化学作用, 化学药品. 化 is made of two people, one upright 亻 and one upside-down, a picture of change; 学 is "study". So it is "the study of change".
column6: Tā de huàxué chéngjì hěn hǎo.
column7: His chemistry grades are very good.
column9: Chemistry, also "chemical": 化學課, 化學作用, 化學藥品. 化 is made of two people, one upright 亻 and one upside-down, a picture of change; 學 is "study". So it is "the study of change".

column3: To put on makeup: 化妆品 "cosmetics", 化妆台, 化妆师 "makeup artist", 卸妆 "remove makeup". Write it 化妆 (with 女 "woman") for everyday makeup and not 化装, with 衣, which means to dress up as someone else. They sound the same.
column6: Tā měi tiān zǎoshang dōu huàzhuāng.
column7: She puts on makeup every morning.
column9: To put on makeup: 化妝品 "cosmetics", 化妝台, 化妝師 "makeup artist", 卸妝 "remove makeup". Write it 化妝 (with 女 "woman") for everyday makeup and not 化裝, with 衣, which means to dress up as someone else. They sound the same.

column3: To disguise oneself, dress up, as an actor or at a masquerade: 化装舞会, 化装成鬼 "dress up as a ghost". The focus is on costume and a different identity, as opposed to 化妆 (ordinary makeup). 装 has 衣 "clothes" for the meaning and 壮 for the sound (zhuāng, zhuàng).
column6: Wànshèngjié wǒmen huàzhuāng chéng guǐ.
column7: At Halloween we dress up as ghosts.
column9: To disguise oneself, dress up, as an actor or at a masquerade: 化裝舞會, 化裝成鬼 "dress up as a ghost". The focus is on costume and a different identity, as opposed to 化妝 (ordinary makeup). 裝 has 衣 "clothes" for the meaning and 壯 for the sound (zhuāng, zhuàng).

column3: Butterfly: 一只蝴蝶, 蝴蝶结 "bow (ribbon)", 蝴蝶效应 "butterfly effect". Each character has 虫 "insect" and a sound part (胡 hú, 枼 dié), and neither is used alone. 蝶 can stand for butterflies in compounds, such as 蝶泳 "butterfly stroke".
column4: 花园里飞来了一只蝴蝶。
column5: 花園裡飛來了一隻蝴蝶。
column6: Huāyuán lǐ fēilái le yī zhī húdié.
column7: A butterfly flew into the garden.
column9: Butterfly: 一隻蝴蝶, 蝴蝶結 "bow (ribbon)", 蝴蝶效應 "butterfly effect". Each character has 虫 "insect" and a sound part (胡 hú, 枼 dié), and neither is used alone. 蝶 can stand for butterflies in compounds, such as 蝶泳 "butterfly stroke".

column3: To interact; interaction: 师生互动, 互动良好, 互动式, 与观众互动. It is the exchange of actions or words between two sides. 互 shows two hooks hooked together, "mutual"; 动 "move" has 力 "strength" as its meaning part.
column4: 老师和学生有很多互动。
column5: 老師和學生有很多互動。
column6: Lǎoshī hé xuésheng yǒu hěn duō hùdòng.
column7: The teacher and students interact a lot.
column9: To interact; interaction: 師生互動, 互動良好, 互動式, 與觀眾互動. It is the exchange of actions or words between two sides. 互 shows two hooks hooked together, "mutual"; 動 "move" has 力 "strength" as its meaning part.

column3: Gray, and "ash, dust": 灰色, 烟灰 "cigarette ash", 灰尘 "dust", 灰姑娘 "Cinderella". It is the color of ashes. 灰 shows fire 火 with a hand, what a fire leaves that you can touch.
column6: Zhuōzi shàng yǒu yī céng huī.
column7: There is a layer of dust on the table.
column9: Gray, and "ash, dust": 灰色, 煙灰 "cigarette ash", 灰塵 "dust", 灰姑娘 "Cinderella". It is the color of ashes. 灰 shows fire 火 with a hand, what a fire leaves that you can touch.

column3: To wave, swing: 挥手 "wave", 挥动, 挥舞, and in 指挥 "to conduct", 发挥 "to bring into play". It is an arm movement. 挥 has 扌 "hand" and 军 "army", for directing troops by hand; the sound part 军 (jūn) no longer sounds like huī.
column6: Tā huī le huī shǒu, jiù zǒu le.
column7: He waved and left.
column9: To wave, swing: 揮手 "wave", 揮動, 揮舞, and in 指揮 "to conduct", 發揮 "to bring into play". It is an arm movement. 揮 has 扌 "hand" and 軍 "army", for directing troops by hand; the sound part 軍 (jūn) no longer sounds like huī.

column3: To call back, return a call, formal: 请回电, 回电给我, 速回电. It is typical for written messages, such as a note left for a caller. In speech, 回电话 is used.
column4: 我现在不方便，晚一点回电给你。
column5: 我現在不方便，晚一點回電給你。
column6: Wǒ xiànzài bù fāngbiàn, wǎn yīdiǎn huídiàn gěi nǐ.
column7: It's not convenient now; I'll call you back a bit later.
column9: To call back, return a call, formal: 請回電, 回電給我, 速回電. It is typical for written messages, such as a note left for a caller. In speech, 回電話 is used. 電 has 雨 "rain" over lightning 申.

column3: Islam, the older and popular name, from 回 as in the Hui people. 回教徒 is a Muslim, and 回教国家 a Muslim country. The more formal name is 伊斯兰教. 回 is a spiral, "to turn back".
column4: 他信回教，所以不吃猪肉。
column5: 他信回教，所以不吃豬肉。
column6: Tā xìn Huíjiào, suǒyǐ bù chī zhūròu.
column7: He is Muslim, so he does not eat pork.
column9: Islam, the older and popular name, from 回 as in the Hui people. 回教徒 is a Muslim, and 回教國家 a Muslim country. The more formal name is 伊斯蘭教. 回 is a spiral, "to turn back".

column3: Islam, the formal name. The first three characters 伊斯兰 only represent the sound of "Islam" (yī-sī-lán), and 教 means "religion". The related words are 穆斯林 "Muslim" and 清真寺 "mosque".
column4: 伊斯兰教在世界上有很多信徒。
column5: 伊斯蘭教在世界上有很多信徒。
column6: Yīsīlánjiào zài shìjiè shàng yǒu hěn duō xìntú.
column7: Islam has many followers in the world.
column9: Islam, the formal name. The first three characters 伊斯蘭 only represent the sound of "Islam" (yī-sī-lán), and 教 means "religion". The related words are 穆斯林 "Muslim" and 清真寺 "mosque".

column3: To lose heart, be discouraged: 不要灰心, 别灰心 "don't give up", 灰心丧气. 灰 "ash" + 心 "heart": a heart gone cold like ashes. Said after failure or a setback.
column6: Kǎoshì méi kǎo hǎo, bié huīxīn.
column7: You didn't do well on the exam; don't lose heart.
column9: To lose heart, be discouraged: 不要灰心, 別灰心 "don't give up", 灰心喪氣. 灰 "ash" + 心 "heart": a heart gone cold like ashes. Said after failure or a setback.

column3: To overlook, neglect, by accident or by carelessness: 忽略细节, 容易被忽略, 不能忽略的问题. A step more neglectful than 注意, and softer than 忽视, which can be deliberate. 忽 has 心 "heart" and 勿 for the sound (hū, wù); 略 means "outline, omit".
column4: 我们不能忽略这个问题。
column5: 我們不能忽略這個問題。
column6: Wǒmen bù néng hūlüè zhège wèntí.
column7: We cannot overlook this problem.
column9: To overlook, neglect, by accident or by carelessness: 忽略細節, 容易被忽略, 不能忽略的問題. A step more neglectful than 注意, and softer than 忽視, which can be deliberate. 忽 has 心 "heart" and 勿 for the sound (hū, wù); 略 means "outline, omit".

column3: To mix; to muddle through; to hang out: 混乱 "chaos", 混熟 "get to know", 混日子 "drift through the days", 在演艺圈混 "make one's way in showbiz". Its sense of getting by with little effort is often negative. 混 has 氵 "water" with 昆 for the sound.
column6: Tā zài yǎnyìquān hùn le shí nián.
column7: He has made his way in showbiz for ten years.
column9: To mix; to muddle through; to hang out: 混亂 "chaos", 混熟 "get to know", 混日子 "drift through the days", 在演藝圈混 "make one's way in showbiz". Its sense of getting by with little effort is often negative. 混 has 氵 "water" with 昆 for the sound.

column3: To faint, collapse: 昏倒在地, 突然昏倒, 中暑昏倒. 昏 "dim, unconscious" + 倒 "fall". It means a short loss of consciousness; it is often followed by being taken to hospital. 倒 is read dǎo, not dào.
column6: Tā zhòngshǔ hūndǎo le.
column7: He fainted from heatstroke.
column9: To faint, collapse: 昏倒在地, 突然昏倒, 中暑昏倒. 昏 "dim, unconscious" + 倒 "fall". It means a short loss of consciousness; it is often followed by being taken to hospital. 倒 is read dǎo, not dào.

column3: To mix, blend; mixed: 混合物, 混合动力 "hybrid" (cars), 混合两种颜色. The result is one uniform or combined whole. 混 "mix" + 合 "join". 合 is read hé.
column4: 把红色和黄色混合起来。
column5: 把紅色和黃色混合起來。
column6: Bǎ hóngsè hé huángsè hùnhé qǐlái.
column7: Mix the red and the yellow together.
column9: To mix, blend; mixed: 混合物, 混合動力 "hybrid" (cars), 混合兩種顏色. The result is one uniform or combined whole. 混 "mix" + 合 "join". 合 is read hé.

column3: To be unconscious, in a coma: 昏迷不醒, 昏迷指数, 陷入昏迷. It describes a medical condition lasting a time, more serious than 昏倒. 迷 has 辶 "walk" and 米 whose sound is close (mí, mǐ).
column6: Bìngrén hūnmí le sān tiān.
column7: The patient was unconscious for three days.
column9: To be unconscious, in a coma: 昏迷不醒, 昏迷指數, 陷入昏迷. It describes a medical condition lasting a time, more serious than 昏倒. 迷 has 辶 "walk" and 米 whose sound is close (mí, mǐ).

column3: Disaster, misfortune: 车祸 "car accident", 闯祸 "cause trouble", 惹祸, 祸从口出 "trouble comes from the mouth". 祸 has 礻 "spirit, altar" for omens and 呙 for the sound, shared with 锅 and 过.
column6: Tā kāichē chuǎng le dà huò.
column7: He caused a disaster while driving.
column9: Disaster, misfortune: 車禍 "car accident", 闖禍 "cause trouble", 惹禍, 禍從口出 "trouble comes from the mouth". 禍 has 礻 "spirit, altar" for omens and 咼 for the sound, shared with 鍋 and 過.

column3: More or less, to some extent: 或多或少都有 "everyone has some". A set phrase that comes before the verb: 或 A 或 B "either A or B", with 多 and 少 as opposites. It says there is some amount without stating it.
column4: 每个人或多或少都有压力。
column5: 每個人或多或少都有壓力。
column6: Měi ge rén huòduōhuòshǎo dōu yǒu yālì.
column7: Everyone has some stress, more or less.
column9: More or less, to some extent: 或多或少都有 "everyone has some". A set phrase that comes before the verb: 或 A 或 B "either A or B", with 多 and 少 as opposites. It says there is some amount without stating it.

column3: Serves you right, said without pity: 活该, 你活该, 他活该被骂. It is spoken and can be harsh. It also means "ought to, deserve". 该 has 讠 "speech" and 亥 for the sound (gāi, the same).
column6: Tā bù tīng quàn, huógāi!
column7: He wouldn't listen to advice; serves him right!
column9: Serves you right, said without pity: 活該, 你活該, 他活該被罵. It is spoken and can be harsh. It also means "ought to, deserve". 該 has 言 "speech" and 亥 for the sound (gāi, the same).

column3: Goods, cargo, freight to be moved or sold: 货物运输, 货物清单, 装卸货物. It is used for items being shipped, in a general way, rather than for shop products (商品). 货 has 贝 "shell, money" with 化 for the sound (huò, huà).
column6: Zhèxiē huòwù míngtiān sòngdào.
column7: These goods will arrive tomorrow.
column9: Goods, cargo, freight to be moved or sold: 貨物運輸, 貨物清單, 裝卸貨物. It is used for items being shipped, in a general way, rather than for shop products (商品). 貨 has 貝 "shell, money" with 化 for the sound (huò, huà).

column3: Active, lively: 活跃的气氛, 在班上很活跃, 活跃于... "active in...". It is for people, a market, a group, or a place that has plenty going on. 跃 has 足 "foot", for jumping, and 夭 for the sound.
column6: Tā zài bān shàng hěn huóyuè.
column7: He is very active in the class.
column9: Active, lively: 活躍的氣氛, 在班上很活躍, 活躍於... "active in...". It is for people, a market, a group, or a place that has plenty going on. 躍 has 足 "foot", for jumping, and 翟 for the sound.

column3: Outdoors: 户外活动, 户外运动, 户外教学 "outdoor learning". It is the opposite of 室内. 户 is a picture of a door, half of 门; 外 means "outside".
column6: Wǒmen xǐhuan zài hùwài yùndòng.
column7: We like exercising outdoors.
column9: Outdoors: 戶外活動, 戶外運動, 戶外教學 "outdoor learning". It is the opposite of 室內. 戶 is a picture of a door, half of 門; 外 means "outside".

column3: Mutual help: 互助合作, 邻居互助, 互助会. Each helps the other. 互 "mutual" + 助 "help"; 助 has 力 "strength" and 且 for the sound (zhù, qiě).
column6: Línjū zhījiān yīnggāi hùzhù.
column7: Neighbors should help each other.
column9: Mutual help: 互助合作, 鄰居互助, 互助會. Each helps the other. 互 "mutual" + 助 "help"; 助 has 力 "strength" and 且 for the sound (zhù, qiě).

column3: To gather, collect: 集合 "assemble", 集中 "concentrate", 收集 "collect", 集点 "collect points" (stamps at a shop), and a "set" or an "episode": 诗集, 这一集. 集 shows birds 隹 gathered on a tree 木. It is also the measure word for a TV episode.
column4: 这部电视剧一共有三十集。
column5: 這部電視劇一共有三十集。
column6: Zhè bù diànshìjù yīgòng yǒu sānshí jí.
column7: This TV series has thirty episodes in all.
column9: To gather, collect: 集合 "assemble", 集中 "concentrate", 收集 "collect", 集點 "collect points" (stamps at a shop), and a "set" or an "episode": 詩集, 這一集. 集 shows birds 隹 gathered on a tree 木. It is also the measure word for a TV episode.

column3: To marry, of a woman, "marry into" a family: 嫁给, 嫁人, 嫁女儿 "marry off a daughter", 出嫁. A man "marries" a wife with 娶. 嫁 has 女 "woman" and 家 "home": the woman goes to her husband's home.
column6: Tā jià gěi le yī ge yīshēng.
column7: She married a doctor.
column9: To marry, of a woman, "marry into" a family: 嫁給, 嫁人, 嫁女兒 "marry off a daughter", 出嫁. A man "marries" a wife with 娶. 嫁 has 女 "woman" and 家 "home": the woman goes to her husband's home.

column3: Household appliances: 家电用品, 家电行 "appliance shop", 小家电 "small appliances". It is short for 家用电器. It covers machines such as refrigerators, TVs and washing machines.
column6: Zhè jiā shāngdiàn mài gèzhǒng jiādiàn.
column7: This store sells all kinds of household appliances.
column9: Household appliances: 家電用品, 家電行 "appliance shop", 小家電 "small appliances". It is short for 家用電器. It covers machines such as refrigerators, TVs and washing machines.

column3: Arrow: 一支箭, 射箭 "archery", 箭头 "arrowhead, also an arrow sign", 归心似箭 "so eager to get home". 箭 has 竹 "bamboo", the old arrow shaft, and 前 for the sound (jiàn, qián).
column6: Tā yī jiàn shèzhòng le bǎxīn.
column7: He hit the bullseye with one arrow.
column9: Arrow: 一支箭, 射箭 "archery", 箭頭 "arrowhead, also an arrow sign", 歸心似箭 "so eager to get home". 箭 has 竹 "bamboo", the old arrow shaft, and 前 for the sound (jiàn, qián).

column3: To choose, pick out: 拣选, 挑拣 "pick and choose", 拣一个. It is about selecting from several. Be careful with 捡 (the next word), which means to pick up from the ground; both are jiǎn and both have 扌. 拣 has 柬 for the sound.
column6: Qǐng nǐ jiǎn yī ge xǐhuan de.
column7: Please pick one you like.
column9: To choose, pick out: 揀選, 挑揀 "pick and choose", 揀一個. It is about selecting from several. Be careful with 撿 (the next word), which means to pick up from the ground; both are jiǎn and both have 扌. 揀 has 柬 for the sound.

column3: To pick up something from the ground or by chance: 捡到钱, 捡垃圾, 捡起来. It is not "choose" (that is 拣, also jiǎn). 捡 has 扌 "hand" and 佥 for the sound. 捡到 means you find something that you had not looked for.
column4: 我在路上捡到一个钱包。
column5: 我在路上撿到一個錢包。
column6: Wǒ zài lù shàng jiǎn dào yī ge qiánbāo.
column7: I found a wallet on the road.
column9: To pick up something from the ground or by chance: 撿到錢, 撿垃圾, 撿起來. It is not "choose" (that is 揀, also jiǎn). 撿 has 扌 "hand" and 僉 for the sound. 撿到 means you find something that you had not looked for.

column3: Pointed, sharp; also "tip": 尖的, 笔尖 "pen tip", 尖叫 "scream", 尖峰时间 "rush hour", 耳朵很尖 "sharp ears". 尖 puts 小 "small" over 大 "big", something that narrows to a point.
column6: Lǎoshǔ de zuǐba shì jiān de.
column7: A mouse's snout is pointed.
column9: Pointed, sharp; also "tip": 尖的, 筆尖 "pen tip", 尖叫 "scream", 尖峰時間 "rush hour", 耳朵很尖 "sharp ears". 尖 puts 小 "small" over 大 "big", something that narrows to a point.

column3: Also, at the same time: 兼职 "part-time job", 兼任 "hold a second post", 兼顾 "look after both", 一人兼数职. It joins a second role or job to the main one. 兼 shows a hand holding two ears of grain 禾, two at once.
column6: Tā jiān le liǎng fèn gōngzuò.
column7: He holds two jobs at once.
column9: Also, at the same time: 兼職 "part-time job", 兼任 "hold a second post", 兼顧 "look after both", 一人兼數職. It joins a second role or job to the main one. 兼 shows a hand holding two ears of grain 禾, two at once.

column3: To pan-fry: 煎蛋, 煎鱼, 煎饺, 煎牛排; also to simmer herbal medicine in water, 煎药. It uses a little oil in a shallow pan, unlike 炸 (deep fry). 煎 has 灬 "fire" and 前 for the sound (jiān, qián).
column6: Māma jiān le liǎng ge dàn.
column7: Mom fried two eggs.
column9: To pan-fry: 煎蛋, 煎魚, 煎餃, 煎牛排; also to simmer herbal medicine in water, 煎藥. It uses a little oil in a shallow pan, unlike 炸 (deep fry). 煎 has 灬 "fire" and 前 for the sound (jiān, qián).

column3: Prize as a thing given: 得到奖品, 抽奖品, 比赛的奖品. Different from 奖金 (prize money) and 奖 (the award itself). 品 is three mouths 口 stacked, "many things".
column4: 比赛的奖品是一台电脑。
column5: 比賽的獎品是一台電腦。
column6: Bǐsài de jiǎngpǐn shì yī tái diànnǎo.
column7: The prize of the contest is a computer.
column9: Prize as a thing given: 得到獎品, 抽獎品, 比賽的獎品. Different from 獎金 (prize money) and 獎 (the award itself). 品 is three mouths 口 stacked, "many things".

column3: To found a state: 建国大业, 建国初期. It also appears in street and school names, such as 建国路. 建 "build" + 国 "country"; 国 has 囗 as a border around 玉.
column6: Zhège guójiā gāng jiànguó bù jiǔ.
column7: This country was founded not long ago.
column9: To found a state: 建國大業, 建國初期. It also appears in street and school names, such as 建國路. 建 "build" + 國 "country"; 國 has 囗 as a border around 或, the land and its people.

column3: Sharp, piercing: 尖锐的声音 "a shrill sound", 尖锐的批评 "sharp criticism", 矛盾尖锐 "a sharp conflict". It can be a pointed object, a sound, or an argument. 锐 has 金 "metal" and 兑 for the sound (ruì, duì).
column6: Tā de shēngyīn yòu gāo yòu jiānruì.
column7: Her voice is high and shrill.
column9: Sharp, piercing: 尖銳的聲音 "a shrill sound", 尖銳的批評 "sharp criticism", 矛盾尖銳 "a sharp conflict". It can be a pointed object, a sound, or an argument. 銳 has 金 "metal" and 兌 for the sound (ruì, duì).

column3: To watch closely, keep under surveillance: 监视行动, 被监视. 监视器 is Taiwan's everyday word for a CCTV or security camera; the mainland says 监控 or 摄像头. 监 shows a person with a big eye looking into a container, and 视 has 见 "see".
column6: Jǐngchá zài jiānshì tā de xíngdòng.
column7: The police are watching his movements.
column9: To watch closely, keep under surveillance: 監視行動, 被監視. 監視器 is Taiwan's everyday word for a CCTV or security camera; the mainland says 監控 or 攝像頭. 監 shows a person with a big eye looking into a container, and 視 has 見 "see".

column3: Prison: 坐监狱, 关进监狱, 监狱生活. It is the building, as against 坐牢 "serve time". 狱 has two dogs 犭犬 on either side of 讠 "words", where guard dogs bark.
column4: 他因为偷东西进了监狱。
column5: 他因為偷東西進了監獄。
column6: Tā yīnwèi tōu dōngxi jìn le jiānyù.
column7: He went to prison for stealing.
column9: Prison: 坐監獄, 關進監獄, 監獄生活. It is the building, as against 坐牢 "serve time". 獄 has two dogs 犭犬 on either side of 言 "words", where guard dogs bark.

column3: To hand in, pay to an authority: 缴费, 缴税, 缴交作业 "hand in homework", 缴款. It is for compulsory or official payments; shopping uses 付. 缴 has 纟 "thread" and 敫 for the sound.
column6: Míngtiān yào jiǎo xuéfèi.
column7: The tuition is due tomorrow.
column9: To hand in, pay to an authority: 繳費, 繳稅, 繳交作業 "hand in homework", 繳款. It is for compulsory or official payments; shopping uses 付. 繳 has 糹 "thread" and 敫 for the sound.

column3: To water, pour: 浇花, 浇水 "water (plants)", 浇熄 "put out (by pouring)". It means pouring liquid over something. 浇 has 氵 "water" and 尧 for the sound (jiāo, yáo).
column6: Tā měi tiān zǎoshang jiāo huā.
column7: She waters the flowers every morning.
column9: To water, pour: 澆花, 澆水 "water (plants)", 澆熄 "put out (by pouring)". It means pouring liquid over something. 澆 has 氵 "water" and 堯 for the sound (jiāo, yáo).

column3: To shout, yell: 大声叫喊, 叫喊声, 拚命叫喊. It means calling out loudly, often in pain, fear or anger. 叫 and 喊 both have 口 "mouth" and are sounded by 丩 and 咸.
column6: Tā zài chuāngkǒu dàshēng jiàohǎn.
column7: He yelled at the window.
column9: To shout, yell: 大聲叫喊, 叫喊聲, 拚命叫喊. It means calling out loudly, often in pain, fear or anger. 叫 and 喊 both have 口 "mouth" and are sounded by 丩 and 咸.

column3: Church as an organization or congregation: 去教会 "go to church", 教会学校, 基督教会. The building is 教堂. 教 "teach, religion" is read jiào here, and 会 "assembly".
column4: 她每个星期天都去教会。
column5: 她每個星期天都去教會。
column6: Tā měi ge xīngqītiān dōu qù jiàohuì.
column7: She goes to church every Sunday.
column9: Church as an organization or congregation: 去教會 "go to church", 教會學校, 基督教會. The building is 教堂. 教 "teach, religion" is read jiào here, and 會 "assembly".

column3: Corner, nook: 房间的角落, 世界的每个角落 "every corner of the world", 角落里. It is a hidden or remote spot; for an outside street corner use 街角. 角 is a picture of an animal's horn.
column6: Tā zuò zài jiàoshì de jiǎoluò.
column7: He sits in the corner of the classroom.
column9: Corner, nook: 房間的角落, 世界的每個角落 "every corner of the world", 角落裡. It is a hidden or remote spot; for an outside street corner use 街角. 角 is a picture of an animal's horn.

column3: Outskirts, countryside near a city: 到郊外走走, 郊外踏青, 在郊外野餐. It is where city people go for fresh air. 郊 has 阝 "town" and 交 for the sound (jiāo, the same).
column4: 星期天我们去郊外野餐。
column5: 星期天我們去郊外野餐。
column6: Xīngqītiān wǒmen qù jiāowài yěcān.
column7: On Sunday we go on a picnic in the countryside.
column9: Outskirts, countryside near a city: 到郊外走走, 郊外踏青, 在郊外野餐. It is where city people go for fresh air. 郊 has 阝 "town" and 交 for the sound (jiāo, the same).

column3: Housework, chores in Taiwan, where the mainland says 家务: 做家事, 分担家事 "share the chores", and "family matters": 家事法庭 "family court". 家 shows a roof 宀 over a pig 豕. 事 is "matter, task".
column6: Wǒ hé xiānsheng yīqǐ zuò jiāshì.
column7: My husband and I do the chores together.
column9: Housework, chores in Taiwan, where the mainland says 家務: 做家事, 分擔家事 "share the chores", and "family matters": 家事法庭 "family court". 家 shows a roof 宀 over a pig 豕. 事 is "matter, task".

column3: To drive, pilot a vehicle, formal: 驾车, 驾驶 "drive", 驾照 "driver's license", 酒驾 "drunk driving". 驾 has 马 "horse", since it first meant to harness horses, and 加 for the sound (jià, jiā).
column6: Tā jià chē qù le Táizhōng.
column7: He drove to Taichung.
column9: To drive, pilot a vehicle, formal: 駕車, 駕駛 "drive", 駕照 "driver's license", 酒駕 "drunk driving". 駕 has 馬 "horse", since it first meant to harness horses, and 加 for the sound (jià, jiā).

column3: Disease, illness, formal: 慢性疾病, 预防疾病, 疾病管制署 "the Centers for Disease Control". It is the general or medical word for being ill; in speech people say 病. 疾 and 病 both have 疒 "sickness".
column4: 运动可以预防很多疾病。
column5: 運動可以預防很多疾病。
column6: Yùndòng kěyǐ yùfáng hěn duō jíbìng.
column7: Exercise can prevent many illnesses.
column9: Disease, illness, formal: 慢性疾病, 預防疾病, 疾病管制署 "the Centers for Disease Control". It is the general or medical word for being ill; in speech people say 病. 疾 and 病 both have 疒 "sickness".

column3: To be jealous of, envy: 嫉妒别人, 嫉妒心, 令人嫉妒. It is used for envy of a person's success or of a relationship. Both characters have 女 "woman". 嫉 takes 疾 as the sound (jí, the same); 妒 has 户.
column6: Tā hěn jídù péngyou de chéngjì.
column7: He is very jealous of his friend's grades.
column9: To be jealous of, envy: 嫉妒別人, 嫉妒心, 令人嫉妒. It is used for envy of a person's success or of a relationship. Both characters have 女 "woman". 嫉 takes 疾 as the sound (jí, the same); 妒 has 戶.

column3: To be jealous of, envy, the same word as 嫉妒, with the same range of use: 忌妒别人, 不要忌妒. The first character differs: 忌 has 心 "heart" and 己 for the sound (jì, jǐ). The second syllable is neutral in the dictionary's reading.
column6: Bié jìdu biérén de chénggōng.
column7: Don't envy other people's success.
column9: To be jealous of, envy, the same word as 嫉妒, with the same range of use: 忌妒別人, 不要忌妒. The first character differs: 忌 has 心 "heart" and 己 for the sound (jì, jǐ). The second syllable is neutral in the dictionary's reading.

column3: To untie, solve, explain: 解开 "untie", 解决 "solve", 解释 "explain", 了解 "understand", 解散 "dissolve". The idea is to take something apart. 解 shows a knife 刀 cutting the horn 角 from an ox 牛.
column6: Tā mànmàn jiě kāi le shéngzi.
column7: He slowly untied the rope.
column9: To untie, solve, explain: 解開 "untie", 解決 "solve", 解釋 "explain", 了解 "understand", 解散 "dissolve". The idea is to take something apart. 解 shows a knife 刀 cutting the horn 角 from an ox 牛.

column3: To answer, solve a question or problem: 解答问题, 为你解答, 专家解答, and "an answer". It is used for explaining things that were unclear. 解 "untie" + 答 "answer".
column4: 老师耐心地解答我们的问题。
column5: 老師耐心地解答我們的問題。
column6: Lǎoshī nàixīn de jiědá wǒmen de wèntí.
column7: The teacher patiently answered our questions.
column9: To answer, solve a question or problem: 解答問題, 為你解答, 專家解答, and "an answer". It is used for explaining things that were unclear. 解 "untie" + 答 "answer".

column3: To receive a visitor in an official capacity, "grant an audience": 总统接见外宾, 接见记者. The one who receives is the senior person. It is formal. 接 has 扌 "hand" and 妾 for the sound; 见 "see".
column4: 总统接见了外国的客人。
column5: 總統接見了外國的客人。
column6: Zǒngtǒng jiējiàn le wàiguó de kèrén.
column7: The president received the foreign guests.
column9: To receive a visitor in an official capacity, "grant an audience": 總統接見外賓, 接見記者. The one who receives is the senior person. It is formal. 接 has 扌 "hand" and 妾 for the sound; 見 "see".

column3: Festival, festivities: 传统节庆, 节庆活动, 节庆气氛. It covers the holiday and what is done to celebrate it. 节 "festival" has 艹; 庆 means "celebrate".
column6: Chūnjié shì zuì zhòngyào de jiéqìng.
column7: The Lunar New Year is the most important festival.
column9: Festival, festivities: 傳統節慶, 節慶活動, 節慶氣氛. It covers the holiday and what is done to celebrate it. 節 "festival" has 竹 "bamboo" and 即 for the sound; 慶 means "celebrate".

column3: To settle accounts, close the books: 月底结算, 结算薪水, 结算金额. It is the final calculation of what is owed. 结 "tie up, end" + 算 "calculate".
column4: 公司每个月底都要结算。
column5: 公司每個月底都要結算。
column6: Gōngsī měi ge yuèdǐ dōu yào jiésuàn.
column7: The company settles accounts at the end of every month.
column9: To settle accounts, close the books: 月底結算, 結算薪水, 結算金額. It is the final calculation of what is owed. 結 "tie up, end" + 算 "calculate".

column3: The street, in an expression of public life: 街头艺人 "street performer", 街头小吃 "street snacks", 街头抗议, 流落街头 "end up on the street". 头 as a suffix means "head, end". 街 has 行 "walk" with 圭 for a sound that has drifted.
column4: 街头有很多卖小吃的摊子。
column5: 街頭有很多賣小吃的攤子。
column6: Jiētóu yǒu hěn duō mài xiǎochī de tānzi.
column7: There are many snack stalls in the street.
column9: The street, in an expression of public life: 街頭藝人 "street performer", 街頭小吃 "street snacks", 街頭抗議, 流落街頭 "end up on the street". 頭 as a suffix means "head, end". 街 has 行 "walk" with 圭 for a sound that has drifted.

column3: Boundary line: 划清界线 "draw a clear line", 国界线, 两地的界线. It is also an abstract line between right and wrong. 界 has 田 "field" with 介 for the sound (jiè, the same).
column4: 白色的线是两块地的界线。
column5: 白色的線是兩塊地的界線。
column6: Báisè de xiàn shì liǎng kuài dì de jièxiàn.
column7: The white line is the border between the two plots.
column9: Boundary line: 劃清界線 "draw a clear line", 國界線, 兩地的界線. It is also an abstract line between right and wrong. 界 has 田 "field" with 介 for the sound (jiè, the same).

column3: To pay the bill, check out: 请结账, 去柜台结账, 结账柜台. It is what you say to a waiter or cashier when you finish: 我要结账. 结 "tie up" + 帐 "account".
column6: Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ yào jiézhàng.
column7: Excuse me, I'd like to pay.
column9: To pay the bill, check out: 請結帳, 去櫃臺結帳, 結帳櫃臺. It is what you say to a waiter or cashier when you finish: 我要結帳. 結 "tie up" + 帳 "account".

column3: To close, end at a set time: 报名截止, 截止日期 "deadline", 截止到今天. It is used for deadlines and cut-off dates. 截 "cut off" + 止 "stop". 截 shows a bird 隹 cut off by a weapon 戈.
column6: Bàomíng dào míngtiān jiézhǐ.
column7: Registration closes tomorrow.
column9: To close, end at a set time: 報名截止, 截止日期 "deadline", 截止到今天. It is used for deadlines and cut-off dates. 截 "cut off" + 止 "stop". 截 shows a bird 隹 cut off by a weapon 戈.

column3: Finger ring: 戴戒指, 结婚戒指, 钻石戒指. 戒 shows two hands 廾 holding a weapon 戈, a warning; 指 "finger" has 扌 "hand" and 旨. The second syllable is neutral.
column6: Tā sòng tā yī ge zuànshí jièzhi.
column7: He gave her a diamond ring.
column9: Finger ring: 戴戒指, 結婚戒指, 鑽石戒指. 戒 shows two hands 廾 holding a weapon 戈, a warning; 指 "finger" has 扌 "hand" and 旨. The second syllable is neutral.

column3: Office, agency, a government body: 政府机关, 公家机关, 机关团体. Another sense is "mechanism, trap": 机关枪, 机关算尽. 机 has 木 "wood" and 几 for the sound (jī, the same); 关 has 丷 and 天. The mechanism sense comes from something that opens or closes a gate.
column6: Tā zài zhèngfǔ jīguān gōngzuò.
column7: He works in a government agency.
column9: Office, agency, a government body: 政府機關, 公家機關, 機關團體. Another sense is "mechanism, trap": 機關槍, 機關算盡. 機 has 木 "wood" and 幾 for the sound (jī, the same); 關 has 門 "gate". The mechanism sense comes from something that opens or closes a gate.

column3: To haggle, quibble, mind small things: 斤斤计较 "nitpick", 不要计较, 别跟他计较 "don't make an issue of it". It is used for fussing about small gains and losses. 计 has 讠 "speech" and 十 "ten", counting out loud.
column6: Tā cóng bù jìjiào zhèxiē xiǎoshì.
column7: He never fusses over such small matters.
column9: To haggle, quibble, mind small things: 斤斤計較 "nitpick", 不要計較, 別跟他計較 "don't make an issue of it". It is used for fussing about small gains and losses. 計 has 言 "speech" and 十 "ten", counting out loud.

column3: Lonely: 感到寂寞, 一个人很寂寞. It names the empty feeling of missing company, while 孤单 stresses being alone. It can also say a place is quiet. Both characters have 宀 "roof"; 寂 takes 叔 for a sound that has drifted (jì, shū).
column4: 一个人住，有时候会觉得寂寞。
column5: 一個人住，有時候會覺得寂寞。
column6: Yī ge rén zhù, yǒu shíhou huì juéde jìmò.
column7: Living alone, one sometimes feels lonely.
column9: Lonely: 感到寂寞, 一個人很寂寞. It names the empty feeling of missing company, while 孤單 stresses being alone. It can also say a place is quiet. Both characters have 宀 "roof"; 寂 takes 叔 for a sound that has drifted (jì, shū).

column3: To soak, steep: 浸泡, 浸湿 "soak through", 浸在水里, 浸水. It means staying in liquid, whether wanted (to soften beans) or not (a flood). 浸 has 氵 "water".
column4: 把豆子浸在水里一个晚上。
column5: 把豆子浸在水裡一個晚上。
column6: Bǎ dòuzi jìn zài shuǐ lǐ yī ge wǎnshang.
column7: Soak the beans in water overnight.
column9: To soak, steep: 浸泡, 浸濕 "soak through", 浸在水裡, 浸水. It means staying in liquid, whether wanted (to soften beans) or not (a flood). 浸 has 氵 "water".

column3: Amount of money, sum: 金额太大, 总金额, 请确认金额, 交易金额. It is the figure on a bill, receipt or transfer. 金 "gold, money" + 额 "quantity". 额 first meant the forehead (it has 页 "head"), and later "a fixed amount".
column6: Qǐng quèrèn jīn'é shìfǒu zhèngquè.
