column7: Please confirm the amount is correct.
column9: Amount of money, sum: 金額太大, 總金額, 請確認金額, 交易金額. It is the figure on a bill, receipt or transfer. 金 "gold, money" + 額 "quantity". 額 first meant the forehead (it has 頁 "head"), and later "a fixed amount".

column3: Unexpectedly, to one's surprise, before a verb: 他竟忘了今天是我的生日 "he actually forgot". It marks a result that the speaker did not expect. 竟然 is the more usual form; 竟 alone is a bit more literary. It can also mean "to go so far as to" (竟敢).
column4: 他竟忘了今天是我的生日。
column5: 他竟忘了今天是我的生日。
column6: Tā jìng wàng le jīntiān shì wǒ de shēngrì.
column7: He actually forgot that today is my birthday.
column9: Unexpectedly, to one's surprise, before a verb: 他竟忘了今天是我的生日 "he actually forgot". It marks a result that the speaker did not expect. 竟然 is the more usual form; 竟 alone is a bit more literary. It can also mean "to go so far as to" (竟敢).

column3: Mirror, lens: 镜子, 眼镜 "glasses", 镜头 "camera lens", 照镜子 "look in the mirror", 太阳眼镜 "sunglasses". 镜 has 金 "metal" for the old bronze mirrors and 竟 for the sound (jìng, the same). It appears mostly in compounds.
column4: 她站在镜子前面看自己。
column5: 她站在鏡子前面看自己。
column6: Tā zhàn zài jìngzi qiánmiàn kàn zìjǐ.
column7: She stands in front of the mirror and looks at herself.
column9: Mirror, lens: 鏡子, 眼鏡 "glasses", 鏡頭 "camera lens", 照鏡子 "look in the mirror", 太陽眼鏡 "sunglasses". 鏡 has 金 "metal" for the old bronze mirrors and 竟 for the sound (jìng, the same). It appears mostly in compounds.

column3: To respect and love: 敬爱的老师 "dear teacher", a form of address in letters and school compositions, and 我很敬爱他. It is used for elders, teachers and leaders. 敬 "respect" + 爱 "love".
column6: Wǒ hěn jìng'ài wǒ de lǎoshī.
column7: I love and respect my teacher dearly.
column9: To respect and love: 敬愛的老師 "dear teacher", a form of address in letters and school compositions, and 我很敬愛他. It is used for elders, teachers and leaders. 敬 "respect" + 愛 "love".

column3: To purify, clean up: 净化空气, 净化水质, 空气净化器 "air purifier", 净化心灵 "cleanse the mind". 净 "clean" + 化 "turn into": make something clean. 净 has 冫.
column4: 这台机器可以净化空气。
column5: 這台機器可以淨化空氣。
column6: Zhè tái jīqì kěyǐ jìnghuà kōngqì.
column7: This machine can purify the air.
column9: To purify, clean up: 淨化空氣, 淨化水質, 空氣淨化器 "air purifier", 淨化心靈 "cleanse the mind". 淨 "clean" + 化 "turn into": make something clean. 淨 has 氵 "water".

column3: To toast, to offer a drink to someone as a mark of respect: 向客人敬酒, 敬你一杯. At banquets and weddings, people go from table to table to do this. 酒 has 氵 "water" with 酉, the old picture of a wine jar.
column6: Xīnláng xīnniáng xiàng kèrén jìngjiǔ.
column7: The bride and groom toast their guests.
column9: To toast, to offer a drink to someone as a mark of respect: 向客人敬酒, 敬你一杯. At banquets and weddings, people go from table to table to do this. 酒 has 氵 "water" with 酉, the old picture of a wine jar.

column3: To salute; to bow: 向老师敬礼, 起立、敬礼、坐下 (what the class monitor calls out at the start of a lesson in Taiwan), 举手敬礼. 敬 "respect" + 礼 "courtesy". 礼 has 礻 "altar" and 乚.
column6: Xuésheng qǐlì xiàng lǎoshī jìnglǐ.
column7: The students stood and saluted the teacher.
column9: To salute; to bow: 向老師敬禮, 起立、敬禮、坐下 (what the class monitor calls out at the start of a lesson in Taiwan), 舉手敬禮. 敬 "respect" + 禮 "courtesy". 禮 has 礻 "altar" and 豊, a ritual.

column3: Astonishing, startling: 惊人的速度, 成绩惊人, 数字惊人. It describes something so large, fast or good that it astonishes. 惊 "startle" has 忄 and 京 for the sound.
column4: 这个城市发展的速度很惊人。
column5: 這個城市發展的速度很驚人。
column6: Zhège chéngshì fāzhǎn de sùdù hěn jīngrén.
column7: This city is developing at an astonishing speed.
column9: Astonishing, startling: 驚人的速度, 成績驚人, 數字驚人. It describes something so large, fast or good that it astonishes. 驚 "startle" has 馬 "horse", since horses shy easily, and 敬 for the sound (jīng, jìng).

column3: Fine, meticulous, delicate: 做工精细, 精细的工艺, 精细的分工. It describes work or a design done with great care and detail. 精 "refined" has 米 "rice", polished rice, and 青 for the sound; 细 "thin, fine" has 纟 "thread".
column4: 这件手工艺品做得很精细。
column5: 這件手工藝品做得很精細。
column6: Zhè jiàn shǒugōngyìpǐn zuò de hěn jīngxì.
column7: This handicraft is made very finely.
column9: Fine, meticulous, delicate: 做工精細, 精細的工藝, 精細的分工. It describes work or a design done with great care and detail. 精 "refined" has 米 "rice", polished rice, and 青 for the sound; 細 "thin, fine" has 糹 "thread".

column3: As much as possible, to the best of one's ability, before a verb: 尽量早点来, 尽量不要迟到. It softens a request into "try to". 尽 "exhaust" + 量 "measure": use up the measure.
column6: Qǐng jìnliàng zǎo diǎn lái.
column7: Please come as early as you can.
column9: As much as possible, to the best of one's ability, before a verb: 盡量早點來, 盡量不要遲到. It softens a request into "try to". 盡 "exhaust" + 量 "measure": use up the measure. 盡 shows a brush 聿 cleaning a dish 皿.

column3: Money as an idea, wealth: 金钱观 "attitude toward money", 金钱关系, 金钱不是万能的. It is more abstract and a little more formal than 钱, which is for actual amounts. Both characters have 金 "metal".
column6: Jīnqián bù shì zuì zhòngyào de.
column7: Money is not the most important thing.
column9: Money as an idea, wealth: 金錢觀 "attitude toward money", 金錢關係, 金錢不是萬能的. It is more abstract and a little more formal than 錢, which is for actual amounts. Both characters have 金 "metal".

column3: Finance, banking: 金融业, 金融危机 "financial crisis", 金融海啸 "the financial tsunami" (the 2008 crisis), 金融卡 "bank card". 金 "money" + 融 "melt, flow": money in circulation. 融 has 鬲 "cauldron" and 虫 for the sound.
column6: Tā zài jīnróng gōngsī shàngbān.
column7: He works at a financial company.
column9: Finance, banking: 金融業, 金融危機 "financial crisis", 金融海嘯 "the financial tsunami" (the 2008 crisis), 金融卡 "bank card". 金 "money" + 融 "melt, flow": money in circulation. 融 has 鬲 "cauldron" and 虫 for the sound.

column3: Nearsighted: 近视眼, 近视三百度 "minus three hundred" (eyesight is counted in 度), 近视手术. The opposite is 远视 "farsighted". Figuratively "shortsighted". 近 "near" + 视 "sight"; 视 has 见 "see".
column6: Wǒ jìnshì sānbǎi dù.
column7: I am nearsighted by three hundred degrees.
column9: Nearsighted: 近視眼, 近視三百度 "minus three hundred" (eyesight is counted in 度), 近視手術. The opposite is 遠視 "farsighted". Figuratively "shortsighted". 近 "near" + 視 "sight"; 視 has 見 "see".

column3: Metal: 金属制品, 金属探测器, 重金属 "heavy metals", 金属疲劳. 金 is the metal radical, 属 "belong to, category": the whole group of metals. 属 has 尸 and 禹 for the sound.
column6: Tiě hé tóng dōu shì jīnshǔ.
column7: Iron and copper are both metals.
column9: Metal: 金屬製品, 金屬探測器, 重金屬 "heavy metals", 金屬疲勞. 金 is the metal radical, 屬 "belong to, category": the whole group of metals. 屬 has 尸 and 蜀 for the sound (shǔ, the same).

column3: Cocktail party, reception with drinks, often standing: 参加酒会, 欢迎酒会, 庆功酒会. It is a social or business event, a step less formal than a banquet (宴会). 酒 "alcohol" + 会 "gathering".
column4: 公司明天晚上有一个酒会。
column5: 公司明天晚上有一個酒會。
column6: Gōngsī míngtiān wǎnshang yǒu yī ge jiǔhuì.
column7: The company has a reception tomorrow evening.
column9: Cocktail party, reception with drinks, often standing: 參加酒會, 歡迎酒會, 慶功酒會. It is a social or business event, a step less formal than a banquet (宴會). 酒 "alcohol" + 會 "gathering".

column3: To put out a fire, and so "firefighting": 救火车, 救火英雄, 救火员. Figuratively it is rushing in to solve an urgent problem. The usual word for a firefighter is 消防员. 救 has 求 "seek" for the sound (jiù, qiú) and 攵 "hand with a stick".
column6: Xiāofángyuán chōng jìnqù jiùhuǒ.
column7: The firefighters rushed in to fight the fire.
column9: To put out a fire, and so "firefighting": 救火車, 救火英雄, 救火員. Figuratively it is rushing in to solve an urgent problem. The usual word for a firefighter is 消防員. 救 has 求 "seek" for the sound (jiù, qiú) and 攵 "hand with a stick".

column3: That is to say, in other words, restating or checking what someone has said: 就是说, 你明天不来了? "so, you're not coming tomorrow?". 也就是说 is common in explanations. Literally "that is to say".
column6: Jiùshìshuō, nǐ míngtiān bù lái le?
column7: So, you're not coming tomorrow?
column9: That is to say, in other words, restating or checking what someone has said: 就是說, 你明天不來了? "so, you're not coming tomorrow?". 也就是說 is common in explanations. Literally "that is to say".

column3: To correct a mistake, behavior, pronunciation or posture: 纠正发音, 纠正错误, 纠正姿势. The correcting is done to something that is off. 纠 shows threads 纟 twisted together and 丩 for the sound (jiū, the same).
column6: Lǎoshī jiūzhèng le wǒ de fāyīn.
column7: The teacher corrected my pronunciation.
column9: To correct a mistake, behavior, pronunciation or posture: 糾正發音, 糾正錯誤, 糾正姿勢. The correcting is done to something that is off. 糾 shows threads 糹 twisted together and 丩 for the sound (jiū, the same).

column3: Machinery; mechanical: 机械工程, 机械设备, 机械式的动作. Figuratively "mechanical, rigid, lacking flexibility": 机械化的生活. 机 "machine" + 械 "tool, device"; both have 木 "wood", from early wooden devices.
column6: Tā zài jīxiè gōngchǎng gōngzuò.
column7: He works in a machinery factory.
column9: Machinery; mechanical: 機械工程, 機械設備, 機械式的動作. Figuratively "mechanical, rigid, lacking flexibility": 機械化的生活. 機 "machine" + 械 "tool, device"; both have 木 "wood", from early wooden devices.

column3: Memory, the ability to remember things: 记性好, 记性不好, 记性差 "poor memory". It is colloquial; 记忆力 is the formal one. 记 has 讠 "speech" and 己 for the sound (jì, jǐ). 性 is neutral here.
column4: 我记性不好，常常忘记东西。
column5: 我記性不好，常常忘記東西。
column6: Wǒ jìxing bù hǎo, chángcháng wàngjì dōngxi.
column7: I have a poor memory and often forget things.
column9: Memory, the ability to remember things: 記性好, 記性不好, 記性差 "poor memory". It is colloquial; 記憶力 is the formal one. 記 has 言 "speech" and 己 for the sound (jì, jǐ). 性 is neutral here.

column3: Stamp collecting: 集邮, 集邮册 "stamp album", 集邮爱好者, as a hobby. 集 shows birds 隹 gathered on a tree 木, "to gather". 邮 "post" has 阝 "town" and 由 for the sound.
column6: Tā de àihào shì jíyóu.
column7: His hobby is stamp collecting.
column9: Stamp collecting: 集郵, 集郵冊 "stamp album", 集郵愛好者, as a hobby. 集 shows birds 隹 gathered on a tree 木, "to gather". 郵 "post" has 阝 "town" and 垂, an old relay station.

column3: Emergency treatment at a hospital: 挂急诊 "register at the emergency room", 急诊室, 去急诊. It is what you do when you cannot wait for an ordinary appointment. 急 "urgent" has 心 "heart"; 诊 has 讠 "speech", asking about symptoms.
column4: 他半夜肚子痛，去了急诊。
column5: 他半夜肚子痛，去了急診。
column6: Tā bànyè dùzi tòng, qù le jízhěn.
column7: His stomach hurt at midnight, so he went to the emergency room.
column9: Emergency treatment at a hospital: 掛急診 "register at the emergency room", 急診室, 去急診. It is what you do when you cannot wait for an ordinary appointment. 急 "urgent" has 心 "heart"; 診 has 言 "speech", asking about symptoms.

column3: Tool, utensil; "to have, possess": 工具, 玩具, 餐具, 具有 "have" (formal), 具备 "be equipped with", 具体 "concrete". Also a classifier for bodies, tools. 具 shows two hands 八 under an item. The older form had hands carrying a vessel, to provide something.
column4: 这座城市具有悠久的历史。
column5: 這座城市具有悠久的歷史。
column6: Zhè zuò chéngshì jùyǒu yōujiǔ de lìshǐ.
column7: This city has a long history.
column9: Tool, utensil; "to have, possess": 工具, 玩具, 餐具, 具有 "have" (formal), 具備 "be equipped with", 具體 "concrete". Also a classifier for bodies, tools. 具 shows two hands 八 under an item. The older form had hands carrying a vessel, to provide something.

column3: To donate, contribute: 捐钱, 捐血 "donate blood", 捐款, 捐赠, 捐给. Also "tax, levy" in 税捐. 捐 has 扌 "hand" and 肙 for the sound (juān, the same). It is for giving money, goods or blood to a cause.
column4: 他每年都捐钱给孤儿院。
column5: 他每年都捐錢給孤兒院。
column6: Tā měi nián dōu juān qián gěi gū'éryuàn.
column7: Every year he donates money to the orphanage.
column9: To donate, contribute: 捐錢, 捐血 "donate blood", 捐款, 捐贈, 捐給. Also "tax, levy" in 稅捐. 捐 has 扌 "hand" and 肙 for the sound (juān, the same). It is for giving money, goods or blood to a cause.

column3: To donate money; a donation: 向灾区捐款, 一笔捐款, 捐款给... It is both verb-object and noun. 捐 "donate" + 款 "sum of money". 款 also means "type, style", as in 款式.
column6: Hěn duō rén xiàng zāiqū juānkuǎn.
column7: Many people donate money to the disaster area.
column9: To donate money; a donation: 向災區捐款, 一筆捐款, 捐款給... It is both verb-object and noun. 捐 "donate" + 款 "sum of money". 款 also means "type, style", as in 款式.

column3: To have a meal together as a group: 同学聚餐, 公司聚餐, 家庭聚餐. It stresses the get-together; 吃饭 only says eating. 聚 "gather" and 餐 "meal", whose 食 radical shows food.
column4: 我们这个星期六要聚餐。
column5: 我們這個星期六要聚餐。
column6: Wǒmen zhège xīngqīliù yào jùcān.
column7: We will have a group dinner this Saturday.
column9: To have a meal together as a group: 同學聚餐, 公司聚餐, 家庭聚餐. It stresses the get-together; 吃飯 only says eating. 聚 "gather" and 餐 "meal", whose 食 radical shows food.

column3: Huge, giant, mostly in compounds: 巨大 "enormous", 巨人 "giant", 巨星 "superstar", 巨额 "huge sum". In young people's slang it is also an intensifier, 巨贵 "super expensive". It began as a carpenter's square, borrowed for "large".
column6: Zhè shì yī ge jùdà de gōngchéng.
column7: This is an enormous project.
column9: Huge, giant, mostly in compounds: 巨大 "enormous", 巨人 "giant", 巨星 "superstar", 巨額 "huge sum". In young people's slang it is also an intensifier, 巨貴 "super expensive". It began as a carpenter's square, borrowed for "large".

column3: To decide; definitely: 决定 "decide", 决心 "resolve", 解决 "solve", 决赛 "final", and before a negative, 决不 "never". 决 has 冫 and 夬; the dictionary also gives "to burst", of a dam.
column6: Wǒ jué bù fàngqì.
column7: I will never give up.
column9: To decide; definitely: 決定 "decide", 決心 "resolve", 解決 "solve", 決賽 "final", and before a negative, 決不 "never". 決 has 氵 "water" and 夬; the dictionary also gives "to burst", of a dam, which is the image: water breaks through and the matter is settled.

column3: To cut off; extinct; absolute: 绝种 "become extinct", 绝交 "break off a friendship", 绝望 "despair", 绝佳 "superb", 绝对 "absolute". 绝 has 纟 "thread" and 色. Whatever is cut off ends, so "very" or "completely" in some words.
column6: Zhè zhǒng dòngwù yǐjīng juézhǒng le.
column7: This kind of animal has become extinct.
column9: To cut off; extinct; absolute: 絕種 "become extinct", 絕交 "break off a friendship", 絕望 "despair", 絕佳 "superb", 絕對 "absolute". 絕 shows a knife 刀 cutting thread 糹. Whatever is cut off ends, so "very" or "completely" in some words.

column3: Absolutely not, never, strong denial before a verb: 绝不放弃, 绝不原谅, 绝不可能. It is stronger than 不. 绝 "completely" + 不 "not"; the tone of 不 is bù here.
column6: Wǒ juébù huì fàngqì.
column7: I will never give up.
column9: Absolutely not, never, strong denial before a verb: 絕不放棄, 絕不原諒, 絕不可能. It is stronger than 不. 絕 "completely" + 不 "not"; the tone of 不 is bù here.

column3: The vast majority: 绝大部分的人, 绝大部分时间. Another way to say it is 绝大多数. 绝 "extreme" + 大部分 "most". After it comes a plural or a mass noun, often followed by 都.
column4: 绝大部分学生都通过了考试。
column5: 絕大部分學生都通過了考試。
column6: Juédàbùfen xuésheng dōu tōngguò le kǎoshì.
column7: The vast majority of students passed the exam.
column9: The vast majority: 絕大部分的人, 絕大部分時間. Another way to say it is 絕大多數. 絕 "extreme" + 大部分 "most". After it comes a plural or a mass noun, often followed by 都.

column3: To realize, wake up to a truth: 觉悟到自己的错误, 终于觉悟. It is a sudden clear understanding, after a failure or a lesson. It is also the Buddhist word for enlightenment. 悟 has 忄 "heart" and 吾 for the sound (wù, wú). 觉 here is jué, not jiào.
column4: 经过这次失败，他终于觉悟了。
column5: 經過這次失敗，他終於覺悟了。
column6: Jīngguò zhè cì shībài, tā zhōngyú juéwù le.
column7: After this failure he finally realized.
column9: To realize, wake up to a truth: 覺悟到自己的錯誤, 終於覺悟. It is a sudden clear understanding, after a failure or a lesson. It is also the Buddhist word for enlightenment. 悟 has 忄 "heart" and 吾 for the sound (wù, wú). 覺 here is jué, not jiào.

column3: To bow from the waist: 向老师鞠躬, 鞠躬道歉 "bow in apology", 鞠躬谢幕. The bow is a form of respect or thanks. 躬 shows a body 身 and a bow 弓: bending the body like a bow.
column4: 演出结束后，他向观众鞠躬。
column5: 演出結束後，他向觀眾鞠躬。
column6: Yǎnchū jiéshù hòu, tā xiàng guānzhòng jūgōng.
column7: After the show he bowed to the audience.
column9: To bow from the waist: 向老師鞠躬, 鞠躬道歉 "bow in apology", 鞠躬謝幕. The bow is a form of respect or thanks. 躬 shows a body 身 and a bow 弓: bending the body like a bow.

column3: To gather, assemble: 人群聚集, 聚集在广场上, 聚集力量. It works for people and things. 聚 shows three people 乑 under 取, and 集 birds on a tree, both ideas of gathering.
column6: Hěn duō rén jùjí zài guǎngchǎng shàng.
column7: Many people gathered in the square.
column9: To gather, assemble: 人群聚集, 聚集在廣場上, 聚集力量. It works for people and things. 聚 shows three people 乑 under 取, and 集 birds on a tree, both ideas of gathering.

column3: To give an example: 举例说明, 举个例子, and the connector 举例来说 "for example", which is common. 举 "raise" + 例 "example": raise one as evidence. 例 has 亻 "person" and 列 for the sound (lì, liè).
column6: Qǐng nǐ jǔlì shuōmíng.
column7: Please explain with an example.
column9: To give an example: 舉例說明, 舉個例子, and the connector 舉例來說 "for example", which is common. 舉 "raise" + 例 "example": raise one as evidence. 例 has 亻 "person" and 列 for the sound (lì, liè).

column3: Violent, intense, severe: 剧烈运动 "vigorous exercise", 剧烈的疼痛, 剧烈变化. It describes strong action, pain or change. 剧 has 刂 "knife"; 烈 has 灬 "fire" and 列 for the sound (liè, the same).
column6: Fàn hòu bùyào zuò jùliè yùndòng.
column7: Don't exercise hard after a meal.
column9: Violent, intense, severe: 劇烈運動 "vigorous exercise", 劇烈的疼痛, 劇烈變化. It describes strong action, pain or change. 劇 has 刂 "knife"; 烈 has 灬 "fire" and 列 for the sound (liè, the same).

column3: Army, military, in compounds: 军人 "soldier", 军队 "army", 军官 "officer", 空军 "air force", 从军 "join the army". 军 is the sound part of 挥 (huī), though they no longer sound alike.
column6: Tā de yéye shì jūnrén.
column7: His grandfather was a soldier.
column9: Army, military, in compounds: 軍人 "soldier", 軍隊 "army", 軍官 "officer", 空軍 "air force", 從軍 "join the army". 軍 is the sound part of 揮 (huī), though they no longer sound alike.

column3: Military affairs: 军事演习, 军事基地, 军事训练, 军事力量. It either names the field or describes something as military. 军 "army" + 事 "matter"; 事 shows a hand holding a flag.
column4: 这个国家的军事力量很强。
column5: 這個國家的軍事力量很強。
column6: Zhège guójiā de jūnshì lìliàng hěn qiáng.
column7: This country's military strength is great.
column9: Military affairs: 軍事演習, 軍事基地, 軍事訓練, 軍事力量. It either names the field or describes something as military. 軍 "army" + 事 "matter"; 事 shows a hand holding a flag.

column3: Theater for stage plays, opera and dance: 国家戏剧院, 在剧院看表演. A cinema is a 电影院. 剧 "drama" has 刂 "knife", from a sense of intensity; 院 has 阝 and 完 for the sound.
column4: 我们明天晚上去剧院看表演。
column5: 我們明天晚上去劇院看表演。
column6: Wǒmen míngtiān wǎnshang qù jùyuàn kàn biǎoyǎn.
column7: We are going to a show at the theater tomorrow evening.
column9: Theater for stage plays, opera and dance: 國家戲劇院, 在劇院看表演. A cinema is a 電影院. 劇 "drama" has 刂 "knife", from a sense of intensity; 院 has 阝 and 完 for the sound.

column3: To expel, fire: 被开除, 开除学籍 "expel a student", 开除员工. The decision is made by the school or company. In speech, 炒鱿鱼 is "to be fired". 开 shows hands 廾 lifting a bar 一; 除 has 阝 and 余.
column4: 他迟到太多次，被公司开除了。
column5: 他遲到太多次，被公司開除了。
column6: Tā chídào tài duō cì, bèi gōngsī kāichú le.
column7: He was late too many times and got fired.
column9: To expel, fire: 被開除, 開除學籍 "expel a student", 開除員工. The decision is made by the school or company. In speech, 炒魷魚 is "to be fired". 開 shows hands lifting the bar of a gate 門; 除 has 阝 and 余.

column3: To have an operation: 去医院开刀, 开刀房 "operating room", 开刀住院. A formal word for surgery is 手术. Figuratively 拿...开刀 is to make an example of someone. 刀 is a picture of a knife.
column6: Tā míngtiān yào qù yīyuàn kāidāo.
column7: He will have an operation at the hospital tomorrow.
column9: To have an operation: 去醫院開刀, 開刀房 "operating room", 開刀住院. A formal word for surgery is 手術. Figuratively 拿...開刀 is to make an example of someone. 刀 is a picture of a knife.

column3: To start up a machine or vehicle: 开动机器, 开动车子, and 开动脑筋 "put your mind to work". It is about getting something moving. 开 "open" + 动 "move"; 动 has 力 "strength".
column6: Gōngrén kāidòng le jīqì.
column7: The worker started the machine.
column9: To start up a machine or vehicle: 開動機器, 開動車子, and 開動腦筋 "put your mind to work". It is about getting something moving. 開 "open" + 動 "move"; 動 has 力 "strength".

column3: To open an account, at a bank or broker: 开户, 开户手续, 网路开户. 户 is a picture of a door, and by extension a "household" or "account", so 账户 is an account and 户头 an account holder.
column6: Wǒ xiǎng zài zhè jiā yínháng kāihù.
column7: I would like to open an account at this bank.
column9: To open an account, at a bank or broker: 開戶, 開戶手續, 網路開戶. 戶 is a picture of a door, and by extension a "household" or "account", so 帳戶 is an account and 戶頭 an account holder.

column3: To start a term; to offer a course: 学校开课, 下周开课, 开了一门新课. It is the start of classes. 开 "begin" + 课 "class, lesson", a verb-object. 课 has 讠 "speech" and 果 for the sound (kè, guǒ).
column6: Xuéxiào xià xīngqī kāikè.
column7: School starts next week.
column9: To start a term; to offer a course: 學校開課, 下週開課, 開了一門新課. It is the start of classes. 開 "begin" + 課 "class, lesson", a verb-object. 課 has 言 "speech" and 果 for the sound (kè, guǒ).

column3: Enlightened, open-minded: 开明的父母, 思想开明, 开明人士. It describes people or attitudes that accept change and new ideas. 开 "open" + 明 "bright" (the sun 日 and the moon 月 together).
column6: Tā de fùmǔ hěn kāimíng.
column7: His parents are very open-minded.
column9: Enlightened, open-minded: 開明的父母, 思想開明, 開明人士. It describes people or attitudes that accept change and new ideas. 開 "open" + 明 "bright" (the sun 日 and the moon 月 together).

column3: To set up, open a business, a course or an account: 开设分店, 开设课程, 开设账户. It is formal and a step above 开. 设 has 讠 "speech" and 殳, and means "set up, establish".
column4: 这家银行在全国开设了很多分行。
column5: 這家銀行在全國開設了很多分行。
column6: Zhè jiā yínháng zài quánguó kāishè le hěn duō fēnháng.
column7: This bank has opened many branches across the country.
column9: To set up, open a business, a course or an account: 開設分店, 開設課程, 開設帳戶. It is formal and a step above 開. 設 has 言 "speech" and 殳, and means "set up, establish".

column3: To open up, develop new ground, markets, horizons: 开拓市场, 开拓视野 "broaden one's horizons", 开拓者 "pioneer". It first meant clearing land. 拓 has 扌 "hand" and 石 for the sound (tuò, shí).
column6: Gōngsī xiǎng kāituò xīn de shìchǎng.
column7: The company wants to open up new markets.
column9: To open up, develop new ground, markets, horizons: 開拓市場, 開拓視野 "broaden one's horizons", 開拓者 "pioneer". It first meant clearing land. 拓 has 扌 "hand" and 石 for the sound (tuò, shí).

column3: To begin a show or film: 电影开演, 准时开演, 开演前十分钟. It is on tickets and announcements. 开 "begin" + 演 "perform"; 演 has 氵 "water" and 寅 for a close sound.
column6: Diànyǐng shí fēnzhōng hòu kāiyǎn.
column7: The film starts in ten minutes.
column9: To begin a show or film: 電影開演, 準時開演, 開演前十分鐘. It is on tickets and announcements. 開 "begin" + 演 "perform"; 演 has 氵 "water" and 寅 for a close sound.

column3: To chop, cut down: 砍树, 砍柴, 砍价 "bargain a price down", 砍头 "behead". It is a heavy swing with an axe or knife. 砍 has 石 "stone" and 欠 for a close sound (kǎn, qiàn).
column6: Tā yòng fǔtou kǎn le yī kē shù.
column7: He cut down a tree with an axe.
column9: To chop, cut down: 砍樹, 砍柴, 砍價 "bargain a price down", 砍頭 "behead". It is a heavy swing with an axe or knife. 砍 has 石 "stone" and 欠 for a close sound (kǎn, qiàn).

column3: To think highly of, respect: 谢谢你看得起我, 看得起别人. The opposite is 看不起 "look down on". Both are potential forms of 看起. 看 shows a hand over the eyes, looking.
column6: Xièxie nǐ kàndeqǐ wǒ.
column7: Thank you for thinking highly of me.
column9: To think highly of, respect: 謝謝你看得起我, 看得起別人. The opposite is 看不起 "look down on". Both are potential forms of 看起. 看 shows a hand over the eyes, looking.

column3: To protest; a protest: 抗议活动, 提出抗议, 向政府抗议. It is for open objection, in words or in action. 抗 has 扌 "hand" and 亢 for the sound (kàng, the same); 议 "discuss" has 讠 and 义.
column4: 居民抗议在这里盖工厂。
column5: 居民抗議在這裡蓋工廠。
column6: Jūmín kàngyì zài zhèlǐ gài gōngchǎng.
column7: Residents protest against building a factory here.
column9: To protest; a protest: 抗議活動, 提出抗議, 向政府抗議. It is for open objection, in words or in action. 抗 has 扌 "hand" and 亢 for the sound (kàng, the same); 議 "discuss" has 言 and 義.

column3: To guard the house while others are out: 在家看家, 看家的狗. Here 看 is read kān "to watch over, guard", as in 看门 and 看护. 看家本领 is "one's signature skill". 家 shows a roof 宀 over a pig 豕.
column4: 我出去买菜，你在家看家。
column5: 我出去買菜，你在家看家。
column6: Wǒ chūqù mǎi cài, nǐ zài jiā kānjiā.
column7: I'm going shopping; you stay home and mind the house.
column9: To guard the house while others are out: 在家看家, 看家的狗. Here 看 is read kān "to watch over, guard", as in 看門 and 看護. 看家本領 is "one's signature skill". 家 shows a roof 宀 over a pig 豕.

column3: Take a look, a doubled verb that softens the action, "have a look, try": 让我看看, 看看有没有. The second 看 is neutral. It can also mean "let's see how it goes".
column6: Ràng wǒ kànkan nǐ de shǒujī.
column7: Let me take a look at your phone.
column9: Take a look, a doubled verb that softens the action, "have a look, try": 讓我看看, 看看有沒有. The second 看 is neutral. It can also mean "let's see how it goes".

column3: It looks as if, judging by appearances: 看样子要下雨了. It introduces a guess from what you can see. 样 has 木 "wood" and 羊 for the sound. 子 is neutral.
column6: Kànyàngzi yào xià yǔ le.
column7: It looks like it's going to rain.
column9: It looks as if, judging by appearances: 看樣子要下雨了. It introduces a guess from what you can see. 樣 has 木 "wood" and 羕 for the sound (yàng, the same). 子 is neutral.

column3: Exam paper: 发考卷, 收考卷, 改考卷 "mark exams", 考卷上的名字. It is the sheet being filled in or marked. 卷 here is juàn, and it shows a curled scroll. 考 shows an old person with a cane.
column6: Lǎoshī zhèngzài fā kǎojuàn.
column7: The teacher is handing out the exam papers.
column9: Exam paper: 發考卷, 收考卷, 改考卷 "mark exams", 考卷上的名字. It is the sheet being filled in or marked. 卷 here is juàn, and it shows a curled scroll. 考 shows an old person with a cane.

column3: To pass an entrance exam, be admitted: 考取大学, 考取执照 "pass a license exam", 考取研究所. The thing passed for is something selective. 取 shows a hand 又 taking an ear 耳.
column6: Tā kǎoqǔ le Táiwān dàxué.
column7: She was admitted to National Taiwan University.
column9: To pass an entrance exam, be admitted: 考取大學, 考取執照 "pass a license exam", 考取研究所. The thing passed for is something selective. 取 shows a hand 又 taking an ear 耳.

column3: Cartoon, an animated film: 看卡通, 卡通人物, 卡通频道. It is a loanword from "cartoon", and 动画 is also used. 卡 alone means "card" (卡片), "get stuck" (卡住) or "calorie"; it is made of 上 above 下 with the stroke fused.
column6: Háizimen xǐhuan kàn kǎtōng.
column7: Children like watching cartoons.
column9: Cartoon, an animated film: 看卡通, 卡通人物, 卡通頻道. It is a loanword from "cartoon", and 動畫 is also used. 卡 alone means "card" (卡片), "get stuck" (卡住) or "calorie"; it is made of 上 above 下 with the stroke fused.

column3: Guest room; hotel room: 客房服务 "room service", 客房清洁, 一间客房. It can be a room for guests in a home or a room in a hotel. 房 has 户 "door" and 方 for the sound.
column4: 这家旅馆有两百间客房。
column5: 這家旅館有兩百間客房。
column6: Zhè jiā lǚguǎn yǒu liǎngbǎi jiān kèfáng.
column7: This hotel has two hundred guest rooms.
column9: Guest room; hotel room: 客房服務 "room service", 客房清潔, 一間客房. It can be a room for guests in a home or a room in a hotel. 房 has 戶 "door" and 方 for the sound.

column3: Subject, of study or exams: 考试科目, 必修科目, 选修科目, and in accounting 会计科目. 科 "branch, category" + 目 "item". 科 shows grain 禾 and a measure 斗; 目 is an eye turned on its side, and in compounds it means "item" (项目, 目录).
column6: Nǐ zuì xǐhuan nǎge kēmù?
column7: Which subject do you like best?
column9: Subject, of study or exams: 考試科目, 必修科目, 選修科目, and in accounting 會計科目. 科 "branch, category" + 目 "item". 科 shows grain 禾 and a measure 斗; 目 is an eye turned on its side, and in compounds it means "item" (項目, 目錄).

column3: Outside class, extracurricular: 课外活动, 课外读物 "extra reading", 课外辅导. Activities and reading that are not part of the lessons. 课 "class" + 外 "outside". 课 has 讠 "speech" and 果.
column4: 他参加了很多课外活动。
column5: 他參加了很多課外活動。
column6: Tā cānjiā le hěn duō kèwài huódòng.
column7: He joined many extracurricular activities.
column9: Outside class, extracurricular: 課外活動, 課外讀物 "extra reading", 課外輔導. Activities and reading that are not part of the lessons. 課 "class" + 外 "outside". 課 has 言 "speech" and 果.

column3: Gratifying, encouraging: 可喜的成绩, 可喜的进步, 可喜可贺 "worth celebrating". The structure is 可 + a verb, "worthy of": 可喜 "worth being happy about", like 可爱, 可怕. It is written style.
column4: 他的成绩有了可喜的进步。
column5: 他的成績有了可喜的進步。
column6: Tā de chéngjì yǒu le kěxǐ de jìnbù.
column7: His grades show gratifying progress.
column9: Gratifying, encouraging: 可喜的成績, 可喜的進步, 可喜可賀 "worth celebrating". The structure is 可 + a verb, "worthy of": 可喜 "worth being happy about", like 可愛, 可怕. It is written style.

column3: Ridiculous, laughable, more often absurd than amusing: 真可笑, 可笑的想法. For something funny that makes you laugh, use 好笑. 可 + 笑 "laugh at": "worthy of laughter", in a critical sense.
column6: Tā de xiǎngfǎ zhēn kěxiào.
column7: His idea is really ridiculous.
column9: Ridiculous, laughable, more often absurd than amusing: 真可笑, 可笑的想法. For something funny that makes you laugh, use 好笑. 可 + 笑 "laugh at": "worthy of laughter", in a critical sense.

column3: Terrifying; terror: 恐怖电影 "horror film", 恐怖攻击 "terrorist attack", 恐怖分子 "terrorist", 恐怖的经验. It covers both the feeling of dread and violent terror. Both characters have 心 "heart" in the form 忄 or 心: 恐 "fear", 怖 "dread".
column6: Wǒ bù gǎn kàn kǒngbù diànyǐng.
column7: I don't dare watch horror films.
column9: Terrifying; terror: 恐怖電影 "horror film", 恐怖攻擊 "terrorist attack", 恐怖分子 "terrorist", 恐怖的經驗. It covers both the feeling of dread and violent terror. Both characters have 心 "heart" in the form 忄 or 心: 恐 "fear", 怖 "dread".

column3: Unprecedented: 空前成功, 盛况空前 "a record-breaking turnout", 空前绝后 "never before and never again". 空 "empty" + 前 "before": nothing like it came before. It is written style.
column6: Zhè chǎng yǎnchànghuì shèngkuàng kōngqián.
column7: The concert was a record-breaking success.
column9: Unprecedented: 空前成功, 盛況空前 "a record-breaking turnout", 空前絕後 "never before and never again". 空 "empty" + 前 "before": nothing like it came before. It is written style.

column3: To fasten; to deduct: 扣子 "button", 扣好 "button up", 扣钱 "dock pay", 扣分 "take off points", 打折扣 "give a discount", 扣除 "subtract". 扣 has 扌 "hand" and 口 for the sound (kòu, kǒu).
column6: Chídào yào kòu fēn.
column7: You lose points for being late.
column9: To fasten; to deduct: 扣子 "button", 扣好 "button up", 扣錢 "dock pay", 扣分 "take off points", 打折扣 "give a discount", 扣除 "subtract". 扣 has 扌 "hand" and 口 for the sound (kòu, kǒu).

column3: Eloquence, speaking skill: 口才好, 很有口才, 训练口才. It says someone can express themselves well and persuade. 口 "mouth" + 才 "talent"; 才 began as a sprout.
column6: Tā kǒucái hěn hǎo.
column7: He is very eloquent.
column9: Eloquence, speaking skill: 口才好, 很有口才, 訓練口才. It says someone can express themselves well and persuade. 口 "mouth" + 才 "talent"; 才 began as a sprout.

column3: Lipstick: 擦口红, 涂口红, 一支口红. 口 "mouth" + 红 "red", and 红 has 纟 "silk" and 工 for the sound (hóng, gōng). A word for the whole range of lip color is 唇彩.
column6: Tā mǎi le yī zhī xīn kǒuhóng.
column7: She bought a new lipstick.
column9: Lipstick: 擦口紅, 塗口紅, 一支口紅. 口 "mouth" + 紅 "red", and 紅 has 糹 "silk" and 工 for the sound (hóng, gōng). A word for the whole range of lip color is 脣彩.

column3: Tone of voice, way of speaking: 口气很差, 用命令的口气, 好大的口气 "big talk". It conveys attitude. It is a different word from the 口气 in 松了一口气 "breathe a sigh of relief". 口 "mouth" + 气 "air".
column6: Tā de kǒuqì hěn bù kèqi.
column7: His tone is very rude.
column9: Tone of voice, way of speaking: 口氣很差, 用命令的口氣, 好大的口氣 "big talk". It conveys attitude. It is a different word from the 口氣 in 鬆了一口氣 "breathe a sigh of relief". 口 "mouth" + 氣 "air".

column3: Oral exam: 英文口试, 口试委员, 论文口试 "thesis defense". For a job interview 面试 is the usual word. 口 "mouth" + 试 "test"; 试 has 讠 "speech" and 式 for the sound (shì, the same).
column6: Míngtiān yǒu yī ge Yīngwén kǒushì.
column7: Tomorrow there is an English oral exam.
column9: Oral exam: 英文口試, 口試委員, 論文口試 "thesis defense". For a job interview 面試 is the usual word. 口 "mouth" + 試 "test"; 試 has 言 "speech" and 式 for the sound (shì, the same).

column3: Saliva, spit: 流口水 "drool", 吞口水 "swallow", 吐口水 "spit". Figuratively 口水战 is a war of words. 口 "mouth" + 水 "water".
column6: Kàndào dàngāo, tā jiù liú kǒushuǐ.
column7: At the sight of the cake he started to drool.
column9: Saliva, spit: 流口水 "drool", 吞口水 "swallow", 吐口水 "spit". Figuratively 口水戰 is a war of words. 口 "mouth" + 水 "water".

column3: Accent in speech: 有口音, 台湾口音, 南方口音, 听得出口音. The dictionary reads the second syllable light. 口 "mouth" + 音 "sound"; 音 shows a tongue 立 and 日 in a mouth.
column6: Tā shuō Zhōngwén yǒu yīdiǎn kǒuyin.
column7: He speaks Chinese with a slight accent.
column9: Accent in speech: 有口音, 台灣口音, 南方口音, 聽得出口音. The dictionary reads the second syllable light. 口 "mouth" + 音 "sound"; 音 shows a tongue 立 and 日 in a mouth.

column3: To step across, straddle: 跨过, 一步跨过去, 跨国公司 "multinational", 跨年 "see in the new year" (the New Year's Eve countdown), 跨领域 "cross-disciplinary". 跨 has 足 "foot" and 夸 for the sound (kuà, the same).
column6: Tā yī bù kuà guò le shuǐgōu.
column7: He stepped over the ditch in one stride.
column9: To step across, straddle: 跨過, 一步跨過去, 跨國公司 "multinational", 跨年 "see in the new year" (the New Year's Eve countdown), 跨領域 "cross-disciplinary". 跨 has 足 "foot" and 夸 for the sound (kuà, the same).

column3: To boast; to praise: 夸奖 "praise", 夸张 "exaggerated", 夸口 "brag", 夸下海口. It has both a bad sense (brag) and a good one (praise). 夸 "extravagant" has 大 and 亏 for the sound.
column6: Lǎoshī kuā tā hěn cōngming.
column7: The teacher praised him for being clever.
column9: To boast; to praise: 誇獎 "praise", 誇張 "exaggerated", 誇口 "brag", 誇下海口. It has both a bad sense (brag) and a good one (praise). 誇 shows 言 "speech" with 夸 "extravagant", which also gives the sound.

column3: To praise, compliment: 受到夸奖, 夸奖孩子, 夸奖他很有礼貌. You can also answer a compliment with 过奖了 "you flatter me". 夸 "boast, praise" + 奖 "reward, encourage".
column6: Lǎoshī kuājiǎng le tā de zuòyè.
column7: The teacher praised his homework.
column9: To praise, compliment: 受到誇獎, 誇獎孩子, 誇獎他很有禮貌. You can also answer a compliment with 過獎了 "you flatter me". 誇 "boast, praise" + 獎 "reward, encourage".

column3: Style, design, model of clothes, shoes, products: 款式很多, 新款式, 各种款式. It means the cut or shape, not the color. 款 here is "type, style", and 式 "form, style" as in 西式, 日式.
column4: 这家店的鞋子款式很多。
column5: 這家店的鞋子款式很多。
column6: Zhè jiā diàn de xiézi kuǎnshì hěn duō.
column7: This shop has many styles of shoes.
column9: Style, design, model of clothes, shoes, products: 款式很多, 新款式, 各種款式. It means the cut or shape, not the color. 款 here is "type, style", and 式 "form, style" as in 西式, 日式.

column3: Horn; loudspeaker; trumpet: 按喇叭 "honk", 喇叭声, 吹喇叭 "play the trumpet", 喇叭 as the speaker of a stereo. Both characters have 口 "mouth" (the instrument is blown) and occur only here. 叭 has 八 for the sound; the second syllable is neutral.
column6: Hòumiàn de chē yīzhí àn lǎba.
column7: The car behind keeps honking.
column9: Horn; loudspeaker; trumpet: 按喇叭 "honk", 喇叭聲, 吹喇叭 "play the trumpet", 喇叭 as the speaker of a stereo. Both characters have 口 "mouth" (the instrument is blown) and occur only here. 叭 has 八 for the sound; the second syllable is neutral.

column3: Round trip; back and forth: 来回票 "round-trip ticket", 来回走动 "pace", 来回一趟, 来回两小时. In the first sense it adds going and coming back. 来 "come" + 回 "return"; 回 is a spiral, "to circle back".
column6: Tā zài fángjiān lǐ láihuí zǒu.
column7: He paces back and forth in the room.
column9: Round trip; back and forth: 來回票 "round-trip ticket", 來回走動 "pace", 來回一趟, 來回兩小時. In the first sense it adds going and coming back. 來 "come" + 回 "return"; 回 is a spiral, "to circle back".

column3: To arrive, draw near, of a season, event or time: 春天来临, 夜晚来临, 危机来临. It is formal and is not used of a person coming.
column4: 夜晚来临，大家都回家了。
column5: 夜晚來臨，大家都回家了。
column6: Yèwǎn láilín, dàjiā dōu huí jiā le.
column7: Night came and everyone went home.
column9: To arrive, draw near, of a season, event or time: 春天來臨, 夜晚來臨, 危機來臨. It is formal and is not used of a person coming. 臨 shows an eye 臣 looking down over things 品: facing something.

column3: To come and go; to have dealings: 来往的行人, 我们很少来往 "we rarely see each other", 来往密切. For people, it is about being in touch socially. 来 "come" + 往 "go". 往 has 彳 "step" and 王 for the sound.
column6: Jiē shàng láiwǎng de rén hěn duō.
column7: There are many people coming and going on the street.
column9: To come and go; to have dealings: 來往的行人, 我們很少來往 "we rarely see each other", 來往密切. For people, it is about being in touch socially. 來 "come" + 往 "go". 往 has 彳 "step" and 王 for the sound.

column3: Chili pepper: 辣椒酱 "chili sauce", 红辣椒, 青辣椒, 不吃辣椒. 辣 "spicy" has 辛 "acrid", and 椒 "pepper" has 木 "tree" with 叔, a sound that has drifted (jiāo, shū).
column6: Tā bù gǎn chī làjiāo.
column7: He doesn't dare eat chili.
column9: Chili pepper: 辣椒醬 "chili sauce", 紅辣椒, 青辣椒, 不吃辣椒. 辣 "spicy" has 辛 "acrid", and 椒 "pepper" has 木 "tree" with 叔, a sound that has drifted (jiāo, shū).

column3: Lazy: 懒惰, 偷懒 "slack off", 懒人, 懒洋洋 "listless". It is blunt when said about a person: 他很懒. 懒 has 忄 "heart" and 赖 for the sound (lǎn, lài).
column6: Tā tài lǎn le, bù ài zuò jiāshì.
column7: He is too lazy and doesn't like doing chores.
column9: Lazy: 懶惰, 偷懶 "slack off", 懶人, 懶洋洋 "listless". It is blunt when said about a person: 他很懶. 懶 has 忄 "heart" and 賴 for the sound (lǎn, lài).

column3: Can't be bothered to, followed by a verb: 懒得出门, 懒得说, 懒得理他. It says the effort is not worth it, or that you don't feel like it. 懒 "lazy" + 得, neutral.
column6: Wàimiàn tài lěng, wǒ lǎnde chūmén.
column7: It's too cold outside; I can't be bothered to go out.
column9: Can't be bothered to, followed by a verb: 懶得出門, 懶得說, 懶得理他. It says the effort is not worth it, or that you don't feel like it. 懶 "lazy" + 得, neutral.

column3: Wolf: 大野狼 "big bad wolf", 狼群 "pack", 色狼 "pervert". 狼 has 犭 "animal" and 良 for the sound (láng, liáng).
column6: Sēnlín lǐ yǒu yī zhī láng.
column7: There is a wolf in the forest.
column9: Wolf: 大野狼 "big bad wolf", 狼群 "pack", 色狼 "pervert". 狼 has 犭 "animal" and 良 for the sound (láng, liáng).

column3: Wave, breaker: 海浪, 浪花 "spray", 浪漫 "romantic", 浪费 "waste", 流浪 "wander". It also means "unrestrained". 浪 has 氵 "water" and 良 for the sound (làng, liáng).
column6: Hǎibiān de làng hěn dà.
column7: The waves at the seaside are big.
column9: Wave, breaker: 海浪, 浪花 "spray", 浪漫 "romantic", 浪費 "waste", 流浪 "wander". It also means "unrestrained". 浪 has 氵 "water" and 良 for the sound (làng, liáng).

column3: To misuse, abuse: 滥用权力, 滥用药物 "drug abuse", 滥用资源. It is using something far beyond what is proper. 滥 first meant "overflowing" (氵 "water" with 监) and now "excessive". 用 is "use".
column6: Bù néng lànyòng quánlì.
column7: Power must not be abused.
column9: To misuse, abuse: 濫用權力, 濫用藥物 "drug abuse", 濫用資源. It is using something far beyond what is proper. 濫 first meant "overflowing" (氵 "water" with 監) and now "excessive". 用 is "use".

column3: Prison; firm: 坐牢 "be in prison", 牢房 "cell", 牢固 "sturdy", 牢记 "remember firmly". 牢 shows a roof 宀 over an ox 牛, a livestock pen, then a cell. From a place that holds fast comes "firm".
column4: 他因为犯法坐了三年牢。
column5: 他因為犯法坐了三年牢。
column6: Tā yīnwèi fànfǎ zuò le sān nián láo.
column7: He spent three years in prison for breaking the law.
column9: Prison; firm: 坐牢 "be in prison", 牢房 "cell", 牢固 "sturdy", 牢記 "remember firmly". 牢 shows a roof 宀 over an ox 牛, a livestock pen, then a cell. From a place that holds fast comes "firm".

column3: To fish out, scoop up from liquid: 捞鱼, 捞面, 打捞 "salvage", 捞出来, and informally 捞钱 "rake in money" (not always honestly). 捞 has 扌 "hand" and 劳, which still sounds alike (lāo, láo).
column4: 他用网子把鱼捞了起来。
column5: 他用網子把魚撈了起來。
column6: Tā yòng wǎngzi bǎ yú lāo le qǐlái.
column7: He scooped the fish up with a net.
column9: To fish out, scoop up from liquid: 撈魚, 撈麵, 打撈 "salvage", 撈出來, and informally 撈錢 "rake in money" (not always honestly). 撈 has 扌 "hand" and 勞, which still sounds alike (lāo, láo).

column3: The eldest child: 我是老大. Also "boss, leader" of a group or gang: 这里谁是老大? 老 shows an old person with long hair and a cane; 大 "big". Among siblings it goes on: 老二, 老三.
column4: 我是家里的老大，有两个弟弟。
column5: 我是家裡的老大，有兩個弟弟。
column6: Wǒ shì jiālǐ de lǎodà, yǒu liǎng ge dìdi.
column7: I am the eldest in my family and have two younger brothers.
column9: The eldest child: 我是老大. Also "boss, leader" of a group or gang: 這裡誰是老大? 老 shows an old person with long hair and a cane; 大 "big". Among siblings it goes on: 老二, 老三.

column3: To nag, go on and on: 妈妈老爱唠叨, 唠叨个不停. It is also a noun, "nagging". Both characters have 口 "mouth": 唠 gets its sound from 劳 (láo), and 叨 from 刀 (dāo). The second syllable is neutral.
column4: 妈妈每天都唠叨我早点睡。
column5: 媽媽每天都嘮叨我早點睡。
column6: Māma měi tiān dōu láodao wǒ zǎo diǎn shuì.
column7: Mom nags me every day to go to bed early.
column9: To nag, go on and on: 媽媽老愛嘮叨, 嘮叨個不停. It is also a noun, "nagging". Both characters have 口 "mouth": 嘮 gets its sound from 勞 (láo), and 叨 from 刀 (dāo). The second syllable is neutral.

column3: Laborer, workers as a class: 劳工局, 劳工保险 "labor insurance", 外籍劳工 "migrant worker", 劳工权益. It is the standard word in Taiwan for wage workers in law and news. 劳 "toil" contains 力 "strength"; 工 is "work".
column4: 很多外籍劳工在台湾工作。
column5: 很多外籍勞工在台灣工作。
column6: Hěn duō wàijí láogōng zài Táiwān gōngzuò.
column7: Many migrant workers work in Taiwan.
column9: Laborer, workers as a class: 勞工局, 勞工保險 "labor insurance", 外籍勞工 "migrant worker", 勞工權益. It is the standard word in Taiwan for wage workers in law and news. 勞 "toil" contains 力 "strength"; 工 is "work".

column3: Physical labor; labor force: 出卖劳力, 劳力密集 "labor-intensive", 劳力与劳心. It is the bodily work of a person, as against mental work (劳心). 劳 "toil" + 力 "strength".
column6: Tā kào láolì zhuàn qián.
column7: He earns his money by physical labor.
column9: Physical labor; labor force: 出賣勞力, 勞力密集 "labor-intensive", 勞力與勞心. It is the bodily work of a person, as against mental work (勞心). 勞 "toil" + 力 "strength".

column3: Complaint, grumble: 发牢骚 "to grumble", 满肚子牢骚, 牢骚话. It is a spoken word for letting off steam. 骚 shows a horse 马 troubled by a flea 蚤, an uneasy, restless creature. 牢 is a pen, a cell.
column6: Tā zhěngtiān fā láosāo.
column7: He grumbles all day.
column9: Complaint, grumble: 發牢騷 "to grumble", 滿肚子牢騷, 牢騷話. It is a spoken word for letting off steam. 騷 shows a horse 馬 troubled by a flea 蚤, an uneasy, restless creature. 牢 is a pen, a cell.

column3: To be honest, frankly, opening a sentence before an opinion: 老实说, 我不太喜欢. It makes a statement sound more candid and less polite. 老实 "honest" + 说. 实 shows a roof over wealth, a house full of things: solid and real.
column4: 老实说，我不太喜欢这家店。
column5: 老實說，我不太喜歡這家店。
column6: Lǎoshíshuō, wǒ bù tài xǐhuan zhè jiā diàn.
column7: Honestly, I don't like this shop very much.
column9: To be honest, frankly, opening a sentence before an opinion: 老實說, 我不太喜歡. It makes a statement sound more candid and less polite. 老實 "honest" + 說. 實 shows a roof over wealth, a house full of things: solid and real.

column3: Candle: 点蜡烛 "light a candle", 吹蜡烛 "blow out the candles" on a birthday, 一根蜡烛. 蜡 "wax" has 虫 "insect" (bees' wax), and 烛 has 火 "fire".
column4: 他吹熄了生日蛋糕上的蜡烛。
column5: 他吹熄了生日蛋糕上的蠟燭。
column6: Tā chuīxī le shēngrì dàngāo shàng de làzhú.
column7: He blew out the candles on his birthday cake.
column9: Candle: 點蠟燭 "light a candle", 吹蠟燭 "blow out the candles" on a birthday, 一根蠟燭. 蠟 "wax" has 虫 "insect" (bees' wax), and 燭 has 火 "fire".

column3: Neglected, unpopular: 冷门科系 "an unpopular department or major", 冷门景点 "off-the-beaten-path sight", and 爆冷门 "an upset (a dark horse wins)". The opposite is 热门. 冷 has 冫 "ice" and 令 for the sound (lěng, lìng).
column6: Zhège zhuānyè bǐjiào lěngmén.
column7: This major is rather unpopular.
column9: Neglected, unpopular: 冷門科系 "an unpopular department or major", 冷門景點 "off-the-beaten-path sight", and 爆冷門 "an upset (a dark horse wins)". The opposite is 熱門. 冷 has 冫 "ice" and 令 for the sound (lěng, lìng).

column3: Cold drink: 冷饮店 "cold-drink shop", 冷饮和热饮, 喝冷饮. It includes iced tea, juice and soda. 饮 "drink" has 饣 "food" and 欠 "open mouth".
column6: Xiàtiān wǒ cháng hē lěngyǐn.
column7: In summer I often drink cold drinks.
column9: Cold drink: 冷飲店 "cold-drink shop", 冷飲和熱飲, 喝冷飲. It includes iced tea, juice and soda. 飲 "drink" has 飠 "food" and 欠 "open mouth".

column3: Willing, glad to: 乐意帮忙, 我很乐意, 不乐意. Here 乐 is lè "happy", not yuè "music". 乐意 + verb says you are ready to do it.
column6: Wǒ hěn lèyì bāng nǐ de máng.
column7: I am glad to help you.
column9: Willing, glad to: 樂意幫忙, 我很樂意, 不樂意. Here 樂 is lè "happy", not yuè "music". 樂 shows a wooden frame 木 with strings 幺, a musical instrument. 樂意 + verb says you are ready to do it.

column3: Reason, logic; "to manage, pay attention to": 道理 "reason", 理由, 理想 "ideal", 整理 "tidy", 管理, and 不理他 "ignore him". 理 has 王 "jade" and 里 for the sound (lǐ, the same): working jade along its grain.
column6: Wǒ jiào tā, tā bù lǐ wǒ.
column7: I called him, but he ignored me.
column9: Reason, logic; "to manage, pay attention to": 道理 "reason", 理由, 理想 "ideal", 整理 "tidy", 管理, and 不理他 "ignore him". 理 has 王 "jade" and 里 for the sound (lǐ, the same): working jade along its grain.

column3: Sharp; "benefit, profit": 有利 "advantageous", 利息 "interest", 利益, 顺利 "smoothly", 胜利 "victory", 方便. 利 shows grain 禾 and a knife 刂, harvesting; a sharp knife gives an edge and a profit.
column6: Zhèyàng zuò duì wǒmen yǒulì.
column7: Doing it this way is good for us.
column9: Sharp; "benefit, profit": 有利 "advantageous", 利息 "interest", 利益, 順利 "smoothly", 勝利 "victory", 方便. 利 shows grain 禾 and a knife 刂, harvesting; a sharp knife gives an edge and a profit.

column3: Grain; measure word for small round things: 一粒米, 一粒糖, 一粒种子. In Taiwan people also use it in speech for larger round things such as an egg or a ball. 粒 has 米 "rice" and 立 for the sound (lì, the same).
column6: Dì shàng diào le jǐ lì mǐ.
column7: A few grains of rice fell on the ground.
column9: Grain; measure word for small round things: 一粒米, 一粒糖, 一粒種子. In Taiwan people also use it in speech for larger round things such as an egg or a ball. 粒 has 米 "rice" and 立 for the sound (lì, the same).

column3: Pear: 一个梨子, 水梨, 梨子汁. 梨 alone is also used. 梨 has 木 "tree" and 利 for a sound that is close (lí, lì). 子 is a neutral suffix.
column6: Zhège lízi yòu tián yòu duō zhī.
column7: This pear is sweet and juicy.
column9: Pear: 一個梨子, 水梨, 梨子汁. 梨 alone is also used. 梨 has 木 "tree" and 利 for a sound that is close (lí, lì). 子 is a neutral suffix.

column3: Two persons, "the two of": 我们俩 "the two of us", 他们俩, 夫妻俩. It follows a pronoun or noun, and means 两个 without needing 个, and is read liǎ. In the word 伎俩 "trick, scheme" it is read liǎng. 俩 has 亻 "person" and 两 "two", which gives the sound.
column6: Wǒmen liǎ shì tóngxué.
column7: The two of us are classmates.
column9: Two persons, "the two of": 我們倆 "the two of us", 他們倆, 夫妻倆. It follows a pronoun or noun, and means 兩個 without needing 個, and is read liǎ. In the word 伎倆 "trick, scheme" it is read liǎng. 倆 has 亻 "person" and 兩 "two", which gives the sound.

column3: To understand and forgive, to make allowances: 请多多谅解, 取得谅解, 互相谅解. Notices end with 敬请谅解 "your understanding is requested" after a disruption. 谅 has 讠 "speech" and 京 for a sound that has drifted. 解 is "untie".
column6: Xièxie nǐ de liàngjiě.
column7: Thank you for your understanding.
column9: To understand and forgive, to make allowances: 請多多諒解, 取得諒解, 互相諒解. Notices end with 敬請諒解 "your understanding is requested" after a disruption. 諒 has 言 "speech" and 京 for a sound that has drifted. 解 is "untie".

column7: Her singing voice is lovely.
column9: Wonderful, lovely, for something that is a delight to hear or feel: 美妙的音樂, 美妙的夜晚. It is a bit literary, used in praise of music, voices, feelings or moments. 美 "beautiful" + 妙 "subtle, marvelous"; 妙 has 女 and 少 and is read miào.

column3: Beauty salon, a place for hair, skin and nails: 去美容院做脸 "go to a beauty salon for a facial". 美容 "beautify the looks" + 院, a place or institution. 美发 is for hair only, and 美容院 covers facials and body care. The "salon" for hair is also called 美发院.
column6: Tā měi ge yuè qù měiróngyuàn.
column7: She goes to the beauty salon every month.
column9: Beauty salon, a place for hair, skin and nails: 去美容院做臉 "go to a beauty salon for a facial". 美容 "beautify the looks" + 院, a place or institution. 美髮 is for hair only, and 美容院 covers facials and body care. The "salon" for hair is also called 美髮院.

column3: Fierce, violent for force: 猛烈, 火很猛, 风很猛. As an adverb it means "suddenly, abruptly": 他猛地站起来. In speech 猛 can also be slang praise, "awesome": 你好猛！ 猛 has 犭 "dog, animal" for the meaning and 孟 for the sound; a fierce animal is the picture.
column6: Tā měng de zhàn le qǐlái.
column7: He suddenly stood up.
column9: Fierce, violent for force: 猛烈, 火很猛, 風很猛. As an adverb it means "suddenly, abruptly": 他猛地站起來. In speech 猛 can also be slang praise, "awesome": 你好猛！ 猛 has 犭 "dog, animal" for the meaning and 孟 for the sound; a fierce animal is the picture.

column3: To dream of: 昨晚我梦到你了. 梦 is "dream" and 到 "arrive, reach", so the dream reaches a person or thing. The person or thing dreamed of comes right after: 梦到老朋友. 梦见 means almost the same; 梦到 is the more spoken form.
column4: 我昨天梦到了小时候的家。
column5: 我昨天夢到了小時候的家。
column6: Wǒ zuótiān mèngdào le xiǎoshíhou de jiā.
column7: Yesterday I dreamed of the home I had as a child.
column9: To dream of: 昨晚我夢到你了. 夢 is "dream" and 到 "arrive, reach", so the dream reaches a person or thing. The person or thing dreamed of comes right after: 夢到老朋友. 夢見 means almost the same; 夢到 is the more spoken form.

column3: Sultry, hot and stuffy: 天气闷热, 闷热的夏天. It is for heat with no breeze and heavy humidity, as in summer before a storm. 闷 is "stuffy, depressed" and 热 "hot". Here 闷 is read mēn, while in 烦闷 it is mèn.
column6: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn mēnrè.
column7: The weather is sultry today.
column9: Sultry, hot and stuffy: 天氣悶熱, 悶熱的夏天. It is for heat with no breeze and heavy humidity, as in summer before a storm. 悶 is "stuffy, depressed" and 熱 "hot". Here 悶 is read mēn, while in 煩悶 it is mèn.

column3: Cotton, the plant and the material: 棉布 "cotton cloth", 纯棉 "pure cotton", 棉质. It is usually part of a compound. The character is a variant of 绵 "silk floss" with 木 "tree" in place of 糸 "silk", because cotton grows on a plant.
column6: Zhè jiàn chènshān shì chúnmián de.
column7: This shirt is pure cotton.
column9: Cotton, the plant and the material: 棉布 "cotton cloth", 純棉 "pure cotton", 棉質. It is usually part of a compound. The character is a variant of 綿 "silk floss" with 木 "tree" in place of 糸 "silk", because cotton grows on a plant.

column3: Quilt, comforter, the padded bedcover: 盖棉被 "sleep under a quilt", 一条棉被. It is 棉 "cotton" + 被 "quilt", the padding being cotton. 被子 is the general word for a bedcover; 棉被 says it is filled with cotton.
column6: Tiānqì lěng le, yào gài miánbèi.
column7: It has turned cold, so we need a quilt.
column9: Quilt, comforter, the padded bedcover: 蓋棉被 "sleep under a quilt", 一條棉被. It is 棉 "cotton" + 被 "quilt", the padding being cotton. 被子 is the general word for a bedcover; 棉被 says it is filled with cotton.

column3: So as not to, lest: it begins the second part of a sentence and names a bad result that the first part is meant to prevent: 带把伞，免得淋湿. 免 "avoid" + 得 "get". The result is always unwanted, so 免得 is not used for good outcomes. The 得 is neutral.
column6: Dài bǎ sǎn ba, miǎnde línshī.
column7: Take an umbrella so you don't get wet.
column9: So as not to, lest: it begins the second part of a sentence and names a bad result that the first part is meant to prevent: 帶把傘，免得淋濕. 免 "avoid" + 得 "get". The result is always unwanted, so 免得 is not used for good outcomes. The 得 is neutral.

column3: Flour, the wheat flour for noodles, dumplings and bread: 一包面粉. 面 is "noodles, wheat flour" and 粉 "powder". It is 面粉 even for bread and cake; 米粉 is a different thing, rice flour or rice noodles.
column6: Zuò miànbāo yào yòng miànfěn.
column7: You need flour to make bread.
column9: Flour, the wheat flour for noodles, dumplings and bread: 一包麵粉. 麵 is "noodles, wheat flour" and 粉 "powder". It is 麵粉 even for bread and cake; 米粉 is a different thing, rice flour or rice noodles. 麵 has 麥 "wheat" on its left.

column3: Cotton the fiber, the wad of it: 棉花糖 "cotton candy", 一团棉花. It is 棉 "cotton" + 花 "flower", the white boll opening like a flower. The 花 is neutral. Also found: 棉花棒 "cotton swab".
column6: Yīshēng yòng miánhua cā shāngkǒu.
column7: The doctor wipes the wound with cotton.
column9: Cotton the fiber, the wad of it: 棉花糖 "cotton candy", 一團棉花. It is 棉 "cotton" + 花 "flower", the white boll opening like a flower. The 花 is neutral. Also found: 棉花棒 "cotton swab".

column3: Barely, reluctantly, or "to force someone": 勉强可以 "just about all right", 勉强笑了笑 "force a smile", 不要勉强他 "don't force him". As an adjective it says something is only just enough or done against one's will. 勉 means "make an effort" (力 "strength" is its meaning part, 免 the sound) and 强 "strong", so effort with strain.
column6: Zhège bànfǎ miǎnqiǎng kěyǐ.
column7: This method will just about do.
column9: Barely, reluctantly, or "to force someone": 勉強可以 "just about all right", 勉強笑了笑 "force a smile", 不要勉強他 "don't force him". As an adjective it says something is only just enough or done against one's will. 勉 means "make an effort" (力 "strength" is its meaning part, 免 the sound) and 強 "strong", so effort with strain.

column3: Face-to-face talk, an interview, for a job or admission: 面谈时间, 通过面谈. It is 面 "face" + 谈 "talk". It is a formal word for an interview, with 面试 more common for a job interview and 面谈 also for a talk with a teacher or a counselor.
column6: Lǎoshī xiǎng hé jiāzhǎng miàntán.
column7: The teacher wants to talk to the parents face to face.
column9: Face-to-face talk, an interview, for a job or admission: 面談時間, 通過面談. It is 面 "face" + 談 "talk". It is a formal word for an interview, with 面試 more common for a job interview and 面談 also for a talk with a teacher or a counselor.

column3: Wonderful, clever, and in speech as an exclamation: 妙！ or 这个主意很妙. It has a trace of surprise: the idea is neat and unexpected. Common in 美妙, 巧妙 and 奇妙. 妙 has 女 and 少; the sound is that of 少 (shào or shǎo), changed to miào.
column6: Zhège zhǔyi zhēn miào!
column7: What a clever idea!
column9: Wonderful, clever, and in speech as an exclamation: 妙！ or 這個主意很妙. It has a trace of surprise: the idea is neat and unexpected. Common in 美妙, 巧妙 and 奇妙. 妙 has 女 and 少; the sound is that of 少 (shào or shǎo), changed to miào.

column3: To be destroyed, to become extinct, and with an object "to destroy": 恐龙灭亡了 "the dinosaurs died out", 国家灭亡. It suits peoples, states and species, not a single person or a fire. 灭 "wipe out" + 亡 "perish". The meaning is large and final.
column6: Kǒnglóng wèishénme huì mièwáng?
column7: Why did the dinosaurs die out?
column9: To be destroyed, to become extinct, and with an object "to destroy": 恐龍滅亡了 "the dinosaurs died out", 國家滅亡. It suits peoples, states and species, not a single person or a fire. 滅 "wipe out" + 亡 "perish". The meaning is large and final.

column3: Honeybee, the bee that makes honey: 一只蜜蜂, 蜜蜂采蜜. 蜜 "honey" and 蜂 "bee", each with 虫 "insect" in it, the part for insects and bugs. 蜜蜂 is the insect; the honey is 蜂蜜.
column6: Mìfēng zài huā shàng cǎi mì.
column7: The bee collects honey from the flowers.
column9: Honeybee, the bee that makes honey: 一隻蜜蜂, 蜜蜂採蜜. 蜜 "honey" and 蜂 "bee", each with 虫 "insect" in it, the part for insects and bugs. 蜜蜂 is the insect; the honey is 蜂蜜.

column3: Bee, wasp, mostly in compounds: 蜜蜂, 蜂蜜 "honey", 蜂巢 "hive, honeycomb", 黄蜂 "wasp". It is also a verb part in 蜂拥 "swarm like bees". 虫 "insect" is the meaning part, and 夆 supplies the sound (fēng, nearly the same).
column6: Fēngcháo lǐ yǒu hěn duō mìfēng.
column7: There are many bees in the hive.
column9: Bee, wasp, mostly in compounds: 蜜蜂, 蜂蜜 "honey", 蜂巢 "hive, honeycomb", 黃蜂 "wasp". It is also a verb part in 蜂擁 "swarm like bees". 虫 "insect" is the meaning part, and 夆 supplies the sound (fēng, nearly the same).

column3: Muddled, dazed: 迷糊 describes a half-conscious or confused state, such as after waking: 我还迷糊着. It is also someone who is forgetful and scatterbrained, "absent-minded": 她很迷糊. Both characters mean "confused" and the second is neutral.
column6: Wǒ gāng shuìxǐng, nǎozi hái míhu.
column7: I just woke up and my head is still foggy.
column9: Muddled, dazed: 迷糊 describes a half-conscious or confused state, such as after waking: 我還迷糊著. It is also someone who is forgetful and scatterbrained, "absent-minded": 她很迷糊. Both characters mean "confused" and the second is neutral.

column3: Famous brand: 名牌包 "a designer bag", 穿名牌 "wear designer clothes". 名 "name, fame" + 牌 "sign, brand". It also means a plaque or name tag, but the brand is the common sense. Something labeled 名牌 is expensive and known.
column6: Tā xǐhuān mǎi míngpái bāo.
column7: She likes to buy designer bags.
column9: Famous brand: 名牌包 "a designer bag", 穿名牌 "wear designer clothes". 名 "name, fame" + 牌 "sign, brand". It also means a plaque or name tag, but the brand is the common sense. Something labeled 名牌 is expensive and known.

column3: Folk song, ballad: 民谣 "folk song" + 民 "people" + 谣 "song, rumor". In Taiwan it covers both the traditional songs, such as 恒春民谣, and the acoustic folk music of the 1970s on, which was called 民歌. 谣 has 讠 "speech" on its left.
column4: 他会弹吉他，也会唱民谣。
column5: 他會彈吉他，也會唱民謠。
column6: Tā huì tán jítā, yě huì chàng mínyáo.
column7: He can play the guitar and also sing folk songs.
column9: Folk song, ballad: 民謠 "folk song" + 民 "people" + 謠 "song, rumor". In Taiwan it covers both the traditional songs, such as 恆春民謠, and the acoustic folk music of the 1970s on, which was called 民歌. 謠 has 言 "speech" on its left.

column3: The public, the people, in news and speeches: 民众的意见, 一般民众. 民 "people" + 众 "crowd". It speaks of ordinary people against the government or the police: 民众服务, 保护民众. 众 shows three 人 "people" pressed together.
column6: Zhèngfǔ yào bǎohù mínzhòng.
column7: The government must protect the public.
column9: The public, the people, in news and speeches: 民眾的意見, 一般民眾. 民 "people" + 眾 "crowd". It speaks of ordinary people against the government or the police: 民眾服務, 保護民眾. 眾 shows three 人 "people" pressed together.

column3: Democracy and "democratic": 民主国家, 民主制度, 民主选举. It is 民 "people" + 主 "master", the people as master. 民主 also describes a manner of leading, as in 他的作风很民主.
column4: 台湾是一个民主的地方。
column5: 臺灣是一個民主的地方。
column6: Táiwān shì yī ge mínzhǔ de dìfang.
column7: Taiwan is a democratic place.
column9: Democracy and "democratic": 民主國家, 民主制度, 民主選舉. It is 民 "people" + 主 "master", the people as master. 民主 also describes a manner of leading, as in 他的作風很民主.

column3: To lose one's way, to lose one's bearings: 在森林里迷失方向, 迷失自我 "lose oneself". 迷 "be lost" + 失 "lose". It can be about a place or about one's direction in life. 迷 has 辶 "walk" at its base, since being lost is a matter of the road.
column4: 我们在山里迷失了方向。
column5: 我們在山裡迷失了方向。
column6: Wǒmen zài shān lǐ míshī le fāngxiàng.
column7: We lost our way in the mountains.
column9: To lose one's way, to lose one's bearings: 在森林裡迷失方向, 迷失自我 "lose oneself". 迷 "be lost" + 失 "lose". It can be about a place or about one's direction in life. 迷 has 辶 "walk" at its base, since being lost is a matter of the road.

column3: To smear, to wipe: 抹药 "apply ointment", 抹桌子 "wipe the table", 抹防晒乳. You spread something over a surface with your hand or a cloth. It also counts wisps of light or cloud: 一抹微笑 "a trace of a smile". 扌 "hand" is the meaning part.
column6: Chūmén qián yào mǒ fángshàirǔ.
column7: Put on sunscreen before you go out.
column9: To smear, to wipe: 抹藥 "apply ointment", 抹桌子 "wipe the table", 抹防曬乳. You spread something over a surface with your hand or a cloth. It also counts wisps of light or cloud: 一抹微笑 "a trace of a smile". 扌 "hand" is the meaning part.

column3: To rub, to grind, to wear down: 磨刀 "sharpen a knife", 磨豆浆 "grind soybeans", 磨牙 "grind one's teeth". It also means to wear down or to dawdle, as in 磨蹭 "dawdle". 石 "stone" is at the bottom, because grinding was done with a stone.
column6: Tā měitiān mó kāfēi dòu.
column7: He grinds coffee beans every day.
column9: To rub, to grind, to wear down: 磨刀 "sharpen a knife", 磨豆漿 "grind soybeans", 磨牙 "grind one's teeth". It also means to wear down or to dawdle, as in 磨蹭 "dawdle". 石 "stone" is at the bottom, because grinding was done with a stone.

column3: Destination, the place one is going to: 目的地是台南 "the destination is Tainan", 到达目的地. 目的 "purpose" + 地 "place". The 地 comes twice in the pinyin, since 的 is read di here, and 地 di as well.
column6: Wǒmen kuài dào mùdìdì le.
column7: We are almost at our destination.
column9: Destination, the place one is going to: 目的地是台南 "the destination is Tainan", 到達目的地. 目的 "purpose" + 地 "place". The 地 comes twice in the pinyin, since 的 is read di here, and 地 di as well.

column3: Table of contents, catalog, directory: 书的目录 "a book's contents", 目录 on a computer is also a folder, though for a folder Taiwan more often says 资料夹 and the mainland 文件夹. 目 "item, eye" + 录 "record". 录 has 金 "metal" for engraving, hence "record".
column6: Qǐng xiān kàn mùlù, zài zhǎo yèshù.
column7: Look at the table of contents first, then find the page.
column9: Table of contents, catalog, directory: 書的目錄 "a book's contents", 目錄 on a computer is also a folder, though for a folder Taiwan more often says 資料夾 and the mainland 文件夾. 目 "item, eye" + 錄 "record". 錄 has 金 "metal" for engraving, hence "record".

column3: Milk powder: 奶粉 for babies and for adults who make milk drinks: 冲奶粉 "make up milk from powder". 奶 "milk" + 粉 "powder". It is a common baby product, and 婴儿奶粉 is "infant formula". 冲 is the verb that goes with it.
column6: Bǎobao hē nǎifěn.
column7: The baby drinks formula.
column9: Milk powder: 奶粉 for babies and for adults who make milk drinks: 沖奶粉 "make up milk from powder". 奶 "milk" + 粉 "powder". It is a common baby product, and 嬰兒奶粉 is "infant formula". 沖 is the verb that goes with it.

column3: Durable, hard-wearing: 这双鞋很耐用. 耐 "withstand" + 用 "use". It is for things, not for people, with the idea that they last many years of use. 耐 appears in other words, 耐心 "patience", 耐烦, 耐吃. 耐 has 而 and a 寸 "hand-measure".
column6: Zhège guō yòu piányí yòu nàiyòng.
column7: This pot is both cheap and durable.
column9: Durable, hard-wearing: 這雙鞋很耐用. 耐 "withstand" + 用 "use". It is for things, not for people, with the idea that they last many years of use. 耐 appears in other words, 耐心 "patience", 耐煩, 耐吃. 耐 has 而 and a 寸 "hand-measure".

column3: Brains, mind, the way one thinks: 动脑筋 "use one's head", 伤脑筋 "to be a headache", 他脑筋很好. It is spoken and speaks of the mind as the tool for solving problems. 脑 "brain" + 筋 "sinew, nerve".
column4: 这个问题要动一下脑筋。
column5: 這個問題要動一下腦筋。
column6: Zhège wèntí yào dòng yīxià nǎojīn.
column7: This problem takes some thinking.
column9: Brains, mind, the way one thinks: 動腦筋 "use one's head", 傷腦筋 "to be a headache", 他腦筋很好. It is spoken and speaks of the mind as the tool for solving problems. 腦 "brain" + 筋 "sinew, nerve".

column3: Busy commercial district, downtown: 逛闹区 "stroll the shopping area", 台北东区的闹区. This is mostly a Taiwan word; the mainland more often says 闹市. 闹 "noisy, lively" + 区 "district". It names an area full of shops, crowds and lights, as 西门町 is.
column6: Zhōumò de nàoqū rén hěn duō.
column7: The downtown area is crowded on weekends.
column9: Busy commercial district, downtown: 逛鬧區 "stroll the shopping area", 台北東區的鬧區. This is mostly a Taiwan word; the mainland more often says 鬧市. 鬧 "noisy, lively" + 區 "district". It names an area full of shops, crowds and lights, as 西門町 is.

column3: Inland, the interior of a country, away from the coast: 内地的气候, 内地和沿海 "inland and coastal areas". 内 "inside" + 地 "land". It is a place word, not a person word.
column4: 内地的天气比海边干燥。
column5: 內地的天氣比海邊乾燥。
column6: Nèidì de tiānqì bǐ hǎibiān gānzào.
column7: The weather inland is drier than by the sea.
column9: Inland, the interior of a country, away from the coast: 內地的氣候, 內地和沿海 "inland and coastal areas". 內 "inside" + 地 "land". It is a place word, not a person word.

column3: Expert, adept, someone who knows a field well: 他是内行 "he is an expert", 内行人 "an insider", 外行 is its opposite, "layman". 内 "inside" + 行 "trade, line of work", so someone inside the trade. The 行 is read háng, not xíng.
column6: Tā duì diànnǎo hěn nèiháng.
column7: He is an expert on computers.
column9: Expert, adept, someone who knows a field well: 他是內行 "he is an expert", 內行人 "an insider", 外行 is its opposite, "layman". 內 "inside" + 行 "trade, line of work", so someone inside the trade. The 行 is read háng, not xíng.

column3: Energy source, energy as a resource: 再生能源 "renewable energy", 能源危机 "energy crisis", 节省能源. It is the word of news, policy and school texts, for oil, coal, solar and so on. 能 "ability, capacity to do work" + 源 "source". 源 has 氵 "water" in it, as a spring is where a river starts.
column6: Wǒmen yīnggāi jiéshěng néngyuán.
column7: We should save energy.
column9: Energy source, energy as a resource: 再生能源 "renewable energy", 能源危機 "energy crisis", 節省能源. It is the word of news, policy and school texts, for oil, coal, solar and so on. 能 "ability, capacity to do work" + 源 "source". 源 has 氵 "water" in it, as a spring is where a river starts.

column3: Mud, clay: 泥巴 "mud", 泥土 "soil", 烂泥 "sludge", 水泥 "cement". On its own it is mud on shoes or hands: 鞋子上都是泥. 氵 "water" is the meaning part, since mud is soil with water, and 尼 gives the sound (ní, the same).
column6: Tā de xiézi shàng dōu shì ní.
column7: His shoes are covered in mud.
column9: Mud, clay: 泥巴 "mud", 泥土 "soil", 爛泥 "sludge", 水泥 "cement". On its own it is mud on shoes or hands: 鞋子上都是泥. 氵 "water" is the meaning part, since mud is soil with water, and 尼 gives the sound (ní, the same).

column3: Greasy, rich, for food that is too oily or sweet: 太油腻了 "too greasy". It also means "tired of" something from having too much: 吃腻了 "sick of eating it", 看腻了. 腻 has 月 as flesh on its left, as it began with fatty meat, and 贰 for the sound.
column6: Zhè dào cài tài yóunì le.
column7: This dish is too greasy.
column9: Greasy, rich, for food that is too oily or sweet: 太油膩了 "too greasy". It also means "tired of" something from having too much: 吃膩了 "sick of eating it", 看膩了. 膩 has 月 as flesh on its left, as it began with fatty meat, and 貳 for the sound.

column3: Sticky, and in Taiwan the verb "to stick, to glue": 黏黏的 "sticky", 黏在一起, 黏贴 "paste". It is also in 黏土 "clay" and 黏胶. The mainland writes the verb 粘, read zhān. 黍 "millet" is the meaning part, since sticky grain was the thing that clung, and 占 gives the sound.
column6: Tángguǒ nián zài yáchǐ shàng le.
column7: The candy stuck to my teeth.
column9: Sticky, and in Taiwan the verb "to stick, to glue": 黏黏的 "sticky", 黏在一起, 黏貼 "paste". It is also in 黏土 "clay" and 黏膠. The mainland writes the verb 粘, read zhān. 黍 "millet" is the meaning part, since sticky grain was the thing that clung, and 占 gives the sound.

column3: Sticky, and in Taiwan "to stick, to glue", the same word as 黏, written with 米 "rice" in place of 黍 "millet": sticky rice is what the character began as. Taiwan reads it nián here: 粘贴 "paste", 粘在墙上. In 黏 and 粘 the right side 占 gives the sound.
column6: Qǐng bǎ zhàopiàn nián zài zhèlǐ.
column7: Please stick the photo here.
column9: Sticky, and in Taiwan "to stick, to glue", the same word as 黏, written with 米 "rice" in place of 黍 "millet": sticky rice is what the character began as. Taiwan reads it nián here: 粘貼 "paste", 粘在牆上. In 黏 and 粘 the right side 占 gives the sound.

column3: To urinate and "urine": 尿尿 in baby talk, 尿床 "wet the bed", 尿布 "diaper", 尿液 in a medical test. It is plain, and in polite speech people say 上厕所. The character is 尸 "a person" over 水 "water", which is just what it says.
column6: Bǎobao niào chuáng le.
column7: The baby wet the bed.
column9: To urinate and "urine": 尿尿 in baby talk, 尿床 "wet the bed", 尿布 "diaper", 尿液 in a medical test. It is plain, and in polite speech people say 上廁所. The character is 尸 "a person" over 水 "water", which is just what it says.

column3: To pinch, to hold between thumb and fingers: 捏鼻子 "hold one's nose", 捏面团 "knead dough", 捏一把冷汗 "break into a cold sweat", where one is anxious for someone. 扌 "hand" is the meaning part. Doing it with the fingers is the point.
column6: Tā niē zhe bízi zǒu guòqù.
column7: He walked past holding his nose.
column9: To pinch, to hold between thumb and fingers: 捏鼻子 "hold one's nose", 捏麵團 "knead dough", 捏一把冷汗 "break into a cold sweat", where one is anxious for someone. 扌 "hand" is the meaning part. Doing it with the fingers is the point.

column3: Would rather, preferably: 宁可 A 也不 B, "rather A than B": 我宁可走路也不坐车. It gives your choice between two things you dislike. 宁 is "peaceful" and 可 "may"; the two together are about preferring. Often with 也不 or 也要. It is a written-flavored word; 宁愿 means the same.
column4: 我宁可走路，也不想挤公车。
column5: 我寧可走路，也不想擠公車。
column6: Wǒ nìngkě zǒulù, yě bù xiǎng jǐ gōngchē.
column7: I would rather walk than squeeze onto a bus.
column9: Would rather, preferably: 寧可 A 也不 B, "rather A than B": 我寧可走路也不坐車. It gives your choice between two things you dislike. 寧 is "peaceful" and 可 "may"; the two together are about preferring. Often with 也不 or 也要. It is a written-flavored word; 寧願 means the same.

column3: Would rather ... (than ...): 宁愿 A 也不 B, as in 我宁愿待在家里，也不想出去. 愿 is "be willing", so 宁愿 stresses that you are willing to accept the first thing. It is close to 宁可, and the two can usually be swapped.
column4: 我宁愿早点出门，也不想迟到。
column5: 我寧願早點出門，也不想遲到。
column6: Wǒ nìngyuàn zǎodiǎn chūmén, yě bù xiǎng chídào.
column7: I would rather leave early than be late.
column9: Would rather ... (than ...): 寧願 A 也不 B, as in 我寧願待在家裡，也不想出去. 願 is "be willing", so 寧願 stresses that you are willing to accept the first thing. It is close to 寧可, and the two can usually be swapped.

column3: Soil, earth, the stuff you dig or walk on: 泥土的味道 "the smell of earth", 一堆泥土. 泥 "mud" + 土 "earth". It is more about the material than about a field or a place, and it carries a sense of the countryside, of the earth.
column4: 雨后泥土的味道很好闻。
column5: 雨後泥土的味道很好聞。
column6: Yǔ hòu nítǔ de wèidào hěn hǎo wén.
column7: The smell of the earth after rain is lovely.
column9: Soil, earth, the stuff you dig or walk on: 泥土的味道 "the smell of earth", 一堆泥土. 泥 "mud" + 土 "earth". It is more about the material than about a field or a place, and it carries a sense of the countryside, of the earth.

column3: Farm: 农场 is a piece of land with crops or animals: 牧场 "ranch", 养鸡场 "poultry farm". 农 "agriculture" + 场 "a place for activities". A 休闲农场 is a farm open to visitors to pick fruit and stay.
column4: 我们周末去农场摘草莓。
column5: 我們週末去農場摘草莓。
column6: Wǒmen zhōumò qù nóngchǎng zhāi cǎoméi.
column7: At the weekend we go to a farm to pick strawberries.
column9: Farm: 農場 is a piece of land with crops or animals: 牧場 "ranch", 養雞場 "poultry farm". 農 "agriculture" + 場 "a place for activities". A 休閒農場 is a farm open to visitors to pick fruit and stay.

column3: To get something wrong, to mix up: 弄 "do, handle" + 错 "wrong". It follows what was mixed: 弄错日期 "get the date wrong", 弄错人 "mistake someone for another". It is a mistake of fact or identity, and the speaker often says "sorry, I made a mistake" with 我弄错了.
column6: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ nòngcuò shíjiān le.
column7: Sorry, I got the time wrong.
column9: To get something wrong, to mix up: 弄 "do, handle" + 錯 "wrong". It follows what was mixed: 弄錯日期 "get the date wrong", 弄錯人 "mistake someone for another". It is a mistake of fact or identity, and the speaker often says "sorry, I made a mistake" with 我弄錯了.

column3: Thick, strong, dense, for feelings, atmosphere or interest in an abstract way: 兴趣浓厚 "a strong interest", 浓厚的乡土味 "a strong local flavor". 浓 is "thick, strong" (tea, color, fog) and 厚 "thick". It goes with abstract nouns, not with a cup of coffee, where 浓 alone is used.
column4: 他对历史有浓厚的兴趣。
column5: 他對歷史有濃厚的興趣。
column6: Tā duì lìshǐ yǒu nónghòu de xìngqù.
column7: He has a strong interest in history.
column9: Thick, strong, dense, for feelings, atmosphere or interest in an abstract way: 興趣濃厚 "a strong interest", 濃厚的鄉土味 "a strong local flavor". 濃 is "thick, strong" (tea, color, fog) and 厚 "thick". It goes with abstract nouns, not with a cup of coffee, where 濃 alone is used.

column3: Farmer, a man who works the land: 一位农夫. 农 "farming" + 夫 "man, worker". It sounds a little like a story: 农夫与蛇 "The Farmer and the Snake". For a person's job today, 农民 is the more usual word.
column4: 农夫早上很早就下田了。
column5: 農夫早上很早就下田了。
column6: Nóngfū zǎoshang hěn zǎo jiù xià tián le.
column7: The farmer goes down to the fields very early in the morning.
column9: Farmer, a man who works the land: 一位農夫. 農 "farming" + 夫 "man, worker". It sounds a little like a story: 農夫與蛇 "The Farmer and the Snake". For a person's job today, 農民 is the more usual word.

column3: Pesticide: 喷农药 "spray pesticide", 农药残留 "pesticide residue", a common worry about vegetables and fruit. 农 "farming" + 药 "medicine", so medicine for crops. Grocery shoppers talk of 有机 "organic" produce as having no 农药.
column6: Zhèxiē shūcài méiyǒu nóngyào.
column7: These vegetables have no pesticide.
column9: Pesticide: 噴農藥 "spray pesticide", 農藥殘留 "pesticide residue", a common worry about vegetables and fruit. 農 "farming" + 藥 "medicine", so medicine for crops. Grocery shoppers talk of 有機 "organic" produce as having no 農藥.

column3: Occasionally, once in a while: 偶而吃一次 "eat it now and then". 偶 means "by chance" and 而 is a particle, so a thing that happens by chance. The same meaning is written 偶尔, and the pronunciation in the dictionary is ǒu'ér for both; 偶尔 is the standard form. It goes before the verb.
column6: Wǒ ǒu'ér huì qù páshān.
column7: I occasionally go hiking.
column9: Occasionally, once in a while: 偶而吃一次 "eat it now and then". 偶 means "by chance" and 而 is a particle, so a thing that happens by chance. The same meaning is written 偶爾, and the pronunciation in the dictionary is ǒu'ér for both; 偶爾 is the standard form. It goes before the verb.

column3: To reject, to exclude, to repel: 排斥外人 "shut outsiders out", 排斥反应 "rejection" of a transplant, and 排斥新事物 "resist what is new". It is something done by a group or by the body to what does not belong. 排 "push aside" + 斥 "reject". The feeling is stronger than 不喜欢.
column6: Tāmen páichì xīn lái de tóngxué.
column7: They shut out the new classmate.
column9: To reject, to exclude, to repel: 排斥外人 "shut outsiders out", 排斥反應 "rejection" of a transplant, and 排斥新事物 "resist what is new". It is something done by a group or by the body to what does not belong. 排 "push aside" + 斥 "reject". The feeling is stronger than 不喜歡.

column3: To climb by pulling oneself up: 攀岩 "rock climbing", 攀登 "climb", 攀爬. And "to claim connections with someone above": 攀关系. 手 "hand" is at the bottom, and 樊 above gives the sound (fán, close to pān). The climbing is done with the hands, on a cliff or a rope.
column6: Tāmen yīqǐ qù pānyán.
column7: They go rock climbing together.
column9: To climb by pulling oneself up: 攀岩 "rock climbing", 攀登 "climb", 攀爬. And "to claim connections with someone above": 攀關係. 手 "hand" is at the bottom, and 樊 above gives the sound (fán, close to pān). The climbing is done with the hands, on a cliff or a rope.

column3: Cannon, firework: 大炮 "cannon", 鞭炮 "firecrackers", 放炮 "set off fireworks". 鞭炮 are set off at weddings, temple events and the New Year. 炮 has 火 "fire" and 包 for the sound (the old sound was close to pào).
column6: Xīnnián shí dàjiā huì fàng biānpào.
column7: At New Year people set off firecrackers.
column9: Cannon, firework: 大炮 "cannon", 鞭炮 "firecrackers", 放炮 "set off fireworks". 鞭炮 are set off at weddings, temple events and the New Year. 炮 has 火 "fire" and 包 for the sound (the old sound was close to pào).

column3: To admire, for a person's skill or character: 我很佩服你 "I really admire you", 令人佩服. It is said to someone's face or about them, and means respect for what they can do. 佩 once meant a sash worn at the waist; 服 here is "to be convinced".
column6: Wǒ hěn pèifú tā de yǒngqì.
column7: I really admire his courage.
column9: To admire, for a person's skill or character: 我很佩服你 "I really admire you", 令人佩服. It is said to someone's face or about them, and means respect for what they can do. 佩 once meant a sash worn at the waist; 服 here is "to be convinced".

column3: To accompany, a formal word for going along with a guest or an official: 由老师陪同 "accompanied by the teacher", 陪同参观. 陪 "keep company" + 同 "together". In speech 陪 alone or 陪着 is used.
column4: 家长陪同孩子一起参加。
column5: 家長陪同孩子一起參加。
column6: Jiāzhǎng péitóng háizi yīqǐ cānjiā.
column7: Parents take part together with their children.
column9: To accompany, a formal word for going along with a guest or an official: 由老師陪同 "accompanied by the teacher", 陪同參觀. 陪 "keep company" + 同 "together". In speech 陪 alone or 陪著 is used.

column3: To hold in both hands, cupped, and "to praise": 捧着一杯茶 "holding a cup of tea in both hands", 捧场 "support an event by coming". 扌 "hand" and 奉, "offer with both hands"; the sound is that of 奉 (fèng, close to pěng). A classifier for what both hands can hold: 一捧米.
column6: Tā shǒu lǐ pěng zhe yī wǎn rè tāng.
column7: She holds a bowl of hot soup in both hands.
column9: To hold in both hands, cupped, and "to praise": 捧著一杯茶 "holding a cup of tea in both hands", 捧場 "support an event by coming". 扌 "hand" and 奉, "offer with both hands"; the sound is that of 奉 (fèng, close to pěng). A classifier for what both hands can hold: 一捧米.

column3: To expand, to swell: 通货膨胀 "inflation", 膨胀的气球 "a swelling balloon", and for pride: 自信心膨胀. Both characters have 月 "flesh" on the left, which fits swelling. 膨's sound part 彭 is read péng, the same.
column4: 通货膨胀让东西变贵了。
column5: 通貨膨脹讓東西變貴了。
column6: Tōnghuò péngzhàng ràng dōngxi biàn guì le.
column7: Inflation makes things more expensive.
column9: To expand, to swell: 通貨膨脹 "inflation", 膨脹的氣球 "a swelling balloon", and for pride: 自信心膨脹. Both characters have 月 "flesh" on the left, which fits swelling. 膨's sound part 彭 is read péng, the same.

column3: Leaning, off to one side: 偏左, 偏高 "on the high side", 偏远 "remote". As an adverb it is "stubbornly, just to spite": 你不让我去，我偏要去. 亻 "person" is the meaning part and 扁 gives the sound (piān, close). The doubled 偏偏 has a note of its own.
column6: Zhège fángjiān piān xiǎo.
column7: This room is on the small side.
column9: Leaning, off to one side: 偏左, 偏高 "on the high side", 偏遠 "remote". As an adverb it is "stubbornly, just to spite": 你不讓我去，我偏要去. 亻 "person" is the meaning part and 扁 gives the sound (piān, close). The doubled 偏偏 has a note of its own.

column3: Of all things, just then: it marks that events turn out the opposite of what the speaker wanted: 我一出门，偏偏下起雨来. It also shows stubbornness: 偏偏要这样做, "insist on doing it", and singles someone out: 为什么偏偏是我？ "why me, of all people?". It is spoken and has a complaint in it.
column6: Wǒ gāng chūmén, piānpiān xiàyǔ le.
