column7: Just as I went out, of all times, it started to rain.
column9: Of all things, just then: it marks that events turn out the opposite of what the speaker wanted: 我一出門，偏偏下起雨來. It also shows stubbornness: 偏偏要這樣做, "insist on doing it", and singles someone out: 為什麼偏偏是我？ "why me, of all people?". It is spoken and has a complaint in it.

column3: Picky eating, being partial to some foods: 小孩偏食 "the child is a picky eater", 偏食不好. 偏 "lean to one side" + 食 "food", eating from one side only. It means a bad habit of not eating some kinds of food, often vegetables.
column6: Háizi piānshí, bù chī qīngcài.
column7: The child is a picky eater and doesn't eat green vegetables.
column9: Picky eating, being partial to some foods: 小孩偏食 "the child is a picky eater", 偏食不好. 偏 "lean to one side" + 食 "food", eating from one side only. It means a bad habit of not eating some kinds of food, often vegetables.

column3: To lean toward, to favor: 我偏向选这个 "I lean toward choosing this one", 偏向某一方 "take someone's side". It is for preference or tendency, and in a complaint it means unfair favoring. 偏 "to one side" + 向 "toward".
column6: Wǒ piānxiàng mǎi piányi yīdiǎn de.
column7: I lean toward buying the cheaper one.
column9: To lean toward, to favor: 我偏向選這個 "I lean toward choosing this one", 偏向某一方 "take someone's side". It is for preference or tendency, and in a complaint it means unfair favoring. 偏 "to one side" + 向 "toward".

column3: Film, movie in speech, and "a thin slice": 看片子 "watch a film", 一部片子, 好片子. 片子 is a casual word for a movie or a disc, and 电影 is the neutral word. 片 "slice" + 子, a suffix that is neutral in tone. The thin piece is the older sense.
column6: Zhè bù piānzi hěn hǎokàn.
column7: This film is really good.
column9: Film, movie in speech, and "a thin slice": 看片子 "watch a film", 一部片子, 好片子. 片子 is a casual word for a movie or a disc, and 電影 is the neutral word. 片 "slice" + 子, a suffix that is neutral in tone. The thin piece is the older sense.

column3: To float, to drift in the air: 雪花飘下来 "snowflakes drift down", 飘着香味, 飘扬 "flutter" of a flag. 风 "wind" is the meaning part, and 票 gives the sound (piào, close to piāo). Things that the wind carries.
column6: Shùyè zài fēng zhōng piāo zhe.
column7: The leaves drift in the wind.
column9: To float, to drift in the air: 雪花飄下來 "snowflakes drift down", 飄著香味, 飄揚 "flutter" of a flag. 風 "wind" is the meaning part, and 票 gives the sound (piào, close to piāo). Things that the wind carries.

column3: Buttocks, bottom: 打屁股 "spank", 摔到屁股. It is the everyday word and a bit rude in formal talk. The second syllable is neutral. 屁 "a fart" has 尸 "body" as its top part and 比 as the sound. Also used for the back end of things, such as 车屁股.
column6: Tā shuāi le yī jiāo, pìgu hěn tòng.
column7: He fell and his bottom hurts.
column9: Buttocks, bottom: 打屁股 "spank", 摔到屁股. It is the everyday word and a bit rude in formal talk. The second syllable is neutral. 屁 "a fart" has 尸 "body" as its top part and 比 as the sound. Also used for the back end of things, such as 車屁股.

column3: Tired, weary, for the feeling of the whole body or the mind: 感到疲倦 "feel tired", 疲倦的脸. A little more literary than 累, and suits long-lasting tiredness. 疲 has 疒 "sickness" and 皮; 倦 has 亻 "person" and 卷 "curl", a person who curls up with fatigue.
column6: Liánxù gōngzuò hòu tā hěn píjuàn.
column7: After working nonstop he is very tired.
column9: Tired, weary, for the feeling of the whole body or the mind: 感到疲倦 "feel tired", 疲倦的臉. A little more literary than 累, and suits long-lasting tiredness. 疲 has 疒 "sickness" and 皮; 倦 has 亻 "person" and 卷 "curl", a person who curls up with fatigue.

column3: Fatigue: 疲劳驾驶 "driving while tired", 视觉疲劳 "eye strain", 消除疲劳. It is a noun for a state and the word of warnings and health talk. 疲 "tired" + 劳 "labor". It speaks of tiredness from work or effort, built up over time.
column6: Píláo jiàshǐ hěn wēixiǎn.
column7: Driving while tired is dangerous.
column9: Fatigue: 疲勞駕駛 "driving while tired", 視覺疲勞 "eye strain", 消除疲勞. It is a noun for a state and the word of warnings and health talk. 疲 "tired" + 勞 "labor". It speaks of tiredness from work or effort, built up over time.

column3: Moral character: 品德高尚 "of high moral character", 品德教育 "moral education" in schools. 品 "quality" + 德 "virtue". It is about a person's conduct and values, and is a written word used in schools and recommendations.
column4: 老师很重视学生的品德。
column5: 老師很重視學生的品德。
column6: Lǎoshī hěn zhòngshì xuéshēng de pǐndé.
column7: The teacher cares a lot about students' character.
column9: Moral character: 品德高尚 "of high moral character", 品德教育 "moral education" in schools. 品 "quality" + 德 "virtue". It is about a person's conduct and values, and is a written word used in schools and recommendations.

column3: Balance: 保持平衡 "keep balance", 失去平衡 "lose balance", 收支平衡 "income and spending balanced". It is used for the body and for abstract things such as work and life: 工作与生活的平衡. 平 "level" + 衡 "weigh", where 衡 once meant a balance beam with a horn on it. It can be a verb: 平衡一下.
column6: Qí jiǎotàchē yào bǎochí pínghéng.
column7: You have to keep your balance when riding a bicycle.
column9: Balance: 保持平衡 "keep balance", 失去平衡 "lose balance", 收支平衡 "income and spending balanced". It is used for the body and for abstract things such as work and life: 工作與生活的平衡. 平 "level" + 衡 "weigh", where 衡 once meant a balance beam with a horn on it. It can be a verb: 平衡一下.

column3: Table tennis, ping-pong: 打乒乓球, and also the little ball. 乒乓 imitates the sound of the ball and both characters show a ball bouncing back and forth. In Taiwan 桌球 is the usual name for the sport, and 乒乓球 for the ball or for a game played for fun.
column6: Tāmen zài dǎ pīngpāngqiú.
column7: They are playing table tennis.
column9: Table tennis, ping-pong: 打乒乓球, and also the little ball. 乒乓 imitates the sound of the ball and both characters show a ball bouncing back and forth. In Taiwan 桌球 is the usual name for the sport, and 乒乓球 for the ball or for a game played for fun.

column3: Table tennis, Taiwan's usual name for the sport: 打桌球, 桌球比赛. 桌 "table" + 球 "ball". 乒乓球 is the same game and also the ball itself. The word also means billiards in Hong Kong and some places, but in Taiwan billiards is 撞球 and 桌球 is table tennis.
column6: Wǒ gēge xǐhuān dǎ zhuōqiú.
column7: My older brother likes to play table tennis.
column9: Table tennis, Taiwan's usual name for the sport: 打桌球, 桌球比賽. 桌 "table" + 球 "ball". 乒乓球 is the same game and also the ball itself. The word also means billiards in Hong Kong and some places, but in Taiwan billiards is 撞球 and 桌球 is table tennis.

column3: With all one's might, desperately: 拼命工作 "work flat out", 拼命跑 "run for dear life", 拼命道歉. It goes before a verb and shows effort to the limit, almost risking one's life: 命 is "life". 拼 "put together, go all out".
column6: Tā pīnmìng de pǎo xiàng chēzhàn.
column7: He ran to the station as hard as he could.
column9: With all one's might, desperately: 拼命工作 "work flat out", 拼命跑 "run for dear life", 拼命道歉. It goes before a verb and shows effort to the limit, almost risking one's life: 命 is "life". 拼 "put together, go all out".

column3: To hire, to engage a professional, a teacher or an expert, with some formality: 聘请律师 "hire a lawyer", 聘请专家. The person is hired for their skill, and the employer is a school, company or family. 聘 has 耳 "ear" and 甹 as the sound. The form 聘用 is also used for hiring.
column4: 公司聘请了一位新律师。
column5: 公司聘請了一位新律師。
column6: Gōngsī pìnqǐng le yī wèi xīn lǜshī.
column7: The company hired a new lawyer.
column9: To hire, to engage a professional, a teacher or an expert, with some formality: 聘請律師 "hire a lawyer", 聘請專家. The person is hired for their skill, and the employer is a school, company or family. 聘 has 耳 "ear" and 甹 as the sound. The form 聘用 is also used for hiring.

column3: Poor, in poverty: 贫穷的家庭, 摆脱贫穷 "escape poverty". Both characters mean poor, and the word is a state of being short of money and means. It is the written word; in speech people say 穷 alone. 贫 shows 贝 "money" under 分 "divide", money divided up until little is left.
column6: Tā xiǎoshíhou jiālǐ hěn pínqióng.
column7: His family was very poor when he was little.
column9: Poor, in poverty: 貧窮的家庭, 擺脫貧窮 "escape poverty". Both characters mean poor, and the word is a state of being short of money and means. It is the written word; in speech people say 窮 alone. 貧 shows 貝 "money" under 分 "divide", money divided up until little is left.

column3: Poor, lacking: it is mostly in compounds: 贫穷, 贫血 "anemia", 贫富 "rich and poor", 清贫 "poor but honest". It is not used alone as an adjective in speech. 贝 "money" and 分 "divide": money divided away. 分 is also the sound, fen to pin, only roughly alike.
column6: Pínfù chājù yuèláiyuè dà.
column7: The gap between rich and poor keeps growing.
column9: Poor, lacking: it is mostly in compounds: 貧窮, 貧血 "anemia", 貧富 "rich and poor", 清貧 "poor but honest". It is not used alone as an adjective in speech. 貝 "money" and 分 "divide": money divided away. 分 is also the sound, fen to pin, only roughly alike.

column3: To criticize, to critique, seriously and in public: 批判政府, 受到批判. It is stronger and more formal than 批评, with a judgment of what is wrong at its core. 批 "comment" + 判 "judge". Used of ideas, policies and behavior of a group more than of one person's slip.
column4: 这篇文章批判了社会问题。
column5: 這篇文章批判了社會問題。
column6: Zhè piān wénzhāng pīpàn le shèhuì wèntí.
column7: This article criticizes problems in society.
column9: To criticize, to critique, seriously and in public: 批判政府, 受到批判. It is stronger and more formal than 批評, with a judgment of what is wrong at its core. 批 "comment" + 判 "judge". Used of ideas, policies and behavior of a group more than of one person's slip.

column3: Rather, quite, an adverb of degree, written in more formal style: 颇有名 "rather famous", 颇为满意 "quite satisfied", 颇有道理. It goes before an adjective or a verb with 有. In Taiwan it is read pǒ. The dictionary's other reading is pō, as in 偏颇 "biased".
column6: Zhè jiā cāntīng pō yǒumíng.
column7: This restaurant is quite well known.
column9: Rather, quite, an adverb of degree, written in more formal style: 頗有名 "rather famous", 頗為滿意 "quite satisfied", 頗有道理. It goes before an adjective or a verb with 有. In Taiwan it is read pǒ. The dictionary's other reading is pō, as in 偏頗 "biased".

column3: Worn-out, tattered, and "junk, rubbish": 破烂的衣服 "tattered clothes", 收破烂 "collect junk". 破 "broken" + 烂 "rotten". It is about things in poor shape, such as clothes, a car or a house. It looks down on its object.
column4: 他穿着一件破烂的外套。
column5: 他穿著一件破爛的外套。
column6: Tā chuān zhe yī jiàn pòlàn de wàitào.
column7: He wore a tattered coat.
column9: Worn-out, tattered, and "junk, rubbish": 破爛的衣服 "tattered clothes", 收破爛 "collect junk". 破 "broken" + 爛 "rotten". It is about things in poor shape, such as clothes, a car or a house. It looks down on its object.

column3: To burst, to rupture, and for relations "to break down": 血管破裂 "a blood vessel ruptures", 谈判破裂 "talks break down", 关系破裂. 破 "broken" + 裂 "split". It is for things that give way along a line or at a point.
column6: Liǎng guó de tánpàn pòliè le.
column7: The talks between the two countries broke down.
column9: To burst, to rupture, and for relations "to break down": 血管破裂 "a blood vessel ruptures", 談判破裂 "talks break down", 關係破裂. 破 "broken" + 裂 "split". It is for things that give way along a line or at a point.

column3: Mother-in-law from the wife's side, her husband's mother: 我婆婆. The second 婆 is neutral. 婆 is 女 "woman" with 波 for the sound (bō, close to pó). The same word is used for an old woman, kindly: "granny". A husband's mother is 婆婆, and a wife's mother is 岳母.
column6: Wǒ pópo zhù zài Táinán.
column7: My mother-in-law lives in Tainan.
column9: Mother-in-law from the wife's side, her husband's mother: 我婆婆. The second 婆 is neutral. 婆 is 女 "woman" with 波 for the sound (bō, close to pó). The same word is used for an old woman, kindly: "granny". A husband's mother is 婆婆, and a wife's mother is 岳母.

column3: To throw oneself at, to pounce on, and "to beat, to flap": 扑向 "rush toward", 扑过来, 扑克 "playing cards" (a loan from "poker"; the 克 is for the sound), 扑了个空 "grab at nothing". The hand 扌 is the meaning part. A dog or a child that jumps at someone does it.
column6: Xiǎogǒu pū dào wǒ shēnshang.
column7: The puppy jumped onto me.
column9: To throw oneself at, to pounce on, and "to beat, to flap": 撲向 "rush toward", 撲過來, 撲克 "playing cards" (a loan from "poker"; the 克 is for the sound), 撲了個空 "grab at nothing". The hand 扌 is the meaning part. A dog or a child that jumps at someone does it.

column3: To spread out, to lay: 铺床 "make the bed", 铺桌布 "spread a tablecloth", 铺地毯, 铺路 "pave a road". As a verb it is pū; the noun "shop" is pù, as in 店铺. 钅 "metal" is the left part and 甫 gives the sound (fǔ, close to pū).
column6: Qǐng bāng wǒ pū chuáng.
column7: Please help me make the bed.
column9: To spread out, to lay: 鋪床 "make the bed", 鋪桌布 "spread a tablecloth", 鋪地毯, 鋪路 "pave a road". As a verb it is pū; the noun "shop" is pù, as in 店鋪. 釒 "metal" is the left part and 甫 gives the sound (fǔ, close to pū).

column3: Waterfall: 一座瀑布, 看瀑布. 十分瀑布 in New Taipei is a famous one. 瀑 has 氵 "water" and 暴 "violent, sudden", which gives both the sound (bào, close to pù) and a hint of how the water falls. 布 "cloth" is the second part: the water hangs like a sheet of cloth.
column4: 山里有一座很高的瀑布。
column5: 山裡有一座很高的瀑布。
column6: Shān lǐ yǒu yī zuò hěn gāo de pùbù.
column7: There is a very tall waterfall in the mountains.
column9: Waterfall: 一座瀑布, 看瀑布. 十分瀑布 in New Taipei is a famous one. 瀑 has 氵 "water" and 暴 "violent, sudden", which gives both the sound (bào, close to pù) and a hint of how the water falls. 布 "cloth" is the second part: the water hangs like a sheet of cloth.

column3: To put out, to stamp out, of fire or of something that spreads: 扑灭火灾 "put out a fire", 扑灭疫情 "stamp out an outbreak", 扑灭害虫. 扑 "beat down" + 灭 "extinguish". It is a written, newspaper word and means ending something by force.
column4: 消防员很快扑灭了大火。
column5: 消防員很快撲滅了大火。
column6: Xiāofángyuán hěn kuài pūmiè le dàhuǒ.
column7: The firefighters quickly put out the big fire.
column9: To put out, to stamp out, of fire or of something that spreads: 撲滅火災 "put out a fire", 撲滅疫情 "stamp out an outbreak", 撲滅害蟲. 撲 "beat down" + 滅 "extinguish". It is a written, newspaper word and means ending something by force.

column3: Chess, board game, and a game piece: 下棋 "play chess", 象棋 "Chinese chess", 围棋 "go", 棋子 "piece". The verb for playing is 下, as in 下棋. 木 "wood" is the meaning part, since the pieces were wooden, and 其 gives the sound (qí, the same).
column6: Yéye xǐhuān xià qí.
column7: Grandpa likes to play chess.
column9: Chess, board game, and a game piece: 下棋 "play chess", 象棋 "Chinese chess", 圍棋 "go", 棋子 "piece". The verb for playing is 下, as in 下棋. 木 "wood" is the meaning part, since the pieces were wooden, and 其 gives the sound (qí, the same).

column3: Flag, banner: 国旗 "national flag", 升旗 "raise the flag", 旗杆 "flagpole", 红旗. The left part 方 stands for the old flag character 㫃, and 其 gives the sound (qí, the same). It is the first part of 旗袍 and 旗子.
column6: Xuéxiào měitiān zǎoshang shēng qí.
column7: The school raises the flag every morning.
column9: Flag, banner: 國旗 "national flag", 升旗 "raise the flag", 旗桿 "flagpole", 紅旗. The left part 方 stands for the old flag character 㫃, and 其 gives the sound (qí, the same). It is the first part of 旗袍 and 旗子.

column3: Flag, banner, the everyday word: 一面旗子 "a flag", 挥旗子 "wave a flag". 旗 + the neutral suffix 子. The classifier is 面. 旗 alone is for compounds such as 国旗; 旗子 is for the thing in your hand or on a pole.
column6: Háizimen huī zhe xiǎo qízi.
column7: The children are waving little flags.
column9: Flag, banner, the everyday word: 一面旗子 "a flag", 揮旗子 "wave a flag". 旗 + the neutral suffix 子. The classifier is 面. 旗 alone is for compounds such as 國旗; 旗子 is for the thing in your hand or on a pole.

column3: Wife, only in compounds and formal speech: 妻子, 夫妻 "husband and wife", 妻儿 "wife and children", 未婚妻 "fiancée". It is a bound form, so in speech you say 我太太 or 我老婆, not 我妻. 女 "woman" is at the bottom.
column6: Tā hé qīzi yīqǐ lái le.
column7: He came together with his wife.
column9: Wife, only in compounds and formal speech: 妻子, 夫妻 "husband and wife", 妻兒 "wife and children", 未婚妻 "fiancée". It is a bound form, so in speech you say 我太太 or 我老婆, not 我妻. 女 "woman" is at the bottom.

column3: To lead along, to pull: 牵手 "hold hands", 牵狗 "walk a dog", 牵着小孩, 牵车 "wheel a bike". The picture is a person leading an ox 牛 by a rope. And in compounds, "to involve": 牵涉, 牵连. In Taiwan 牵手 also means "spouse".
column6: Tā qiān zhe gǒu zài gōngyuán sànbù.
column7: He is walking his dog in the park.
column9: To lead along, to pull: 牽手 "hold hands", 牽狗 "walk a dog", 牽著小孩, 牽車 "wheel a bike". The picture is a person leading an ox 牛 by a rope. And in compounds, "to involve": 牽涉, 牽連. In Taiwan 牽手 also means "spouse".

column3: To move, to relocate: 搬迁 "move house", 迁移 "migrate", 迁居, 迁都 "move the capital", and "to be promoted" in 升迁. It is a formal verb, mostly in compounds, with 辶 "walk" for the meaning. 搬家 is the spoken word for moving house.
column6: Tāmen jiā bānqiān dào Táizhōng le.
column7: Their family has moved to Taichung.
column9: To move, to relocate: 搬遷 "move house", 遷移 "migrate", 遷居, 遷都 "move the capital", and "to be promoted" in 升遷. It is a formal verb, mostly in compounds, with 辶 "walk" for the meaning. 搬家 is the spoken word for moving house.

column3: Ahead, the front: 前方有车 "there is a car ahead", 前方施工 "roadworks ahead". On signs and in directions, and for a front line in war. 前 "front" + 方 "direction, side". It is more formal than 前面 and more about a place seen from a distance.
column4: 前方有一辆车停在路中间。
column5: 前方有一輛車停在路中間。
column6: Qiánfāng yǒu yī liàng chē tíng zài lù zhōngjiān.
column7: There is a car stopped in the middle of the road ahead.
column9: Ahead, the front: 前方有車 "there is a car ahead", 前方施工 "roadworks ahead". On signs and in directions, and for a front line in war. 前 "front" + 方 "direction, side". It is more formal than 前面 and more about a place seen from a distance.

column3: A strongman in politics, and "a very capable person" at work: 女强人 "a woman who has made it in her career", 政治强人. The sense of a capable woman is the common one. 强 "strong" + 人 "person". The old sense of "bandit" belongs to old novels.
column6: Tā shì gōngsī lǐ de nǚ qiángrén.
column7: She is a powerful career woman at the company.
column9: A strongman in politics, and "a very capable person" at work: 女強人 "a woman who has made it in her career", 政治強人. The sense of a capable woman is the common one. 強 "strong" + 人 "person". The old sense of "bandit" belongs to old novels.

column3: Apology, regret: 表示歉意 "express regret", 深感歉意 "feel deeply sorry". It is a written, polite word and the feeling behind the apology. 歉 "apologetic" + 意 "meaning, feeling". The common set phrase is 向你表示歉意. 欠 "lack" is the meaning part, shared by 歉; you feel that you owe something.
column6: Wǒ duì cǐ shēn biǎo qiànyì.
column7: I am deeply sorry for this.
column9: Apology, regret: 表示歉意 "express regret", 深感歉意 "feel deeply sorry". It is a written, polite word and the feeling behind the apology. 歉 "apologetic" + 意 "meaning, feeling". The common set phrase is 向你表示歉意. 欠 "lack" is the meaning part, shared by 歉; you feel that you owe something.

column3: Front yard, front courtyard: 房子的前院 "the front yard of the house", 前院种着花. 前 "front" + 院 "yard, courtyard". The back yard is 后院.
column4: 他家的前院种了很多花。
column5: 他家的前院種了很多花。
column6: Tā jiā de qiányuàn zhòng le hěn duō huā.
column7: The front yard of his house is planted with lots of flowers.
column9: Front yard, front courtyard: 房子的前院 "the front yard of the house", 前院種著花. 前 "front" + 院 "yard, courtyard". The back yard is 後院.

column3: Ingenious, clever, for a method, a design or a way of speaking: 巧妙的办法 "an ingenious way", 巧妙地回答 "answer cleverly". 巧 "skillful" + 妙 "marvelous". The cleverness is one that solves a problem neatly, not craftiness.
column4: 他巧妙地解决了这个问题。
column5: 他巧妙地解決了這個問題。
column6: Tā qiǎomiào de jiějué le zhège wèntí.
column7: He solved the problem cleverly.
column9: Ingenious, clever, for a method, a design or a way of speaking: 巧妙的辦法 "an ingenious way", 巧妙地回答 "answer cleverly". 巧 "skillful" + 妙 "marvelous". The cleverness is one that solves a problem neatly, not craftiness.

column3: Quiet, softly: it is found doubled in 悄悄 "quietly, secretly", 悄悄话 "whispered words", and in 悄然 "quietly". The doubled word is usually said qiāoqiāo, while the dictionary lists 悄 itself as qiǎo. 忄 "heart" is the meaning part and 肖 gives a sound (xiāo, close to qiāo).
column6: Tā qiāoqiāo de zǒujìn fángjiān.
column7: He walked quietly into the room.
column9: Quiet, softly: it is found doubled in 悄悄 "quietly, secretly", 悄悄話 "whispered words", and in 悄然 "quietly". The doubled word is usually said qiāoqiāo, while the dictionary lists 悄 itself as qiǎo. 忄 "heart" is the meaning part and 肖 gives a sound (xiāo, close to qiāo).

column3: Equipment, materials for a specific activity: 运动器材 "sports equipment", 摄影器材 "camera gear", 实验器材. 器 "utensil, device" + 材 "material". It names the tools and gear used in a sport or a job, not furniture.
column4: 健身房里有很多运动器材。
column5: 健身房裡有很多運動器材。
column6: Jiànshēnfáng lǐ yǒu hěn duō yùndòng qìcái.
column7: The gym has a lot of sports equipment.
column9: Equipment, materials for a specific activity: 運動器材 "sports equipment", 攝影器材 "camera gear", 實驗器材. 器 "utensil, device" + 材 "material". It names the tools and gear used in a sport or a job, not furniture.

column3: At first, originally: 起初我不习惯 "at first I wasn't used to it". It begins the story of a change and is followed by 后来 "later": 起初…后来…. 起 "start" + 初 "beginning". Not used for a plan about the future.
column4: 起初我不习惯这里的天气。
column5: 起初我不習慣這裡的天氣。
column6: Qǐchū wǒ bù xíguàn zhèlǐ de tiānqì.
column7: At first I wasn't used to the weather here.
column9: At first, originally: 起初我不習慣 "at first I wasn't used to it". It begins the story of a change and is followed by 後來 "later": 起初…後來…. 起 "start" + 初 "beginning". Not used for a plan about the future.

column3: Indignant, furious, for anger at something unfair: 非常气愤 "very angry", 令人气愤 "outrageous". 气 "air, temper" + 愤 "resent". It is stronger than 生气 and the cause is usually injustice or an insult, not a small annoyance.
column4: 听到这个消息，他非常气愤。
column5: 聽到這個消息，他非常氣憤。
column6: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, tā fēicháng qìfèn.
column7: When he heard the news he was furious.
column9: Indignant, furious, for anger at something unfair: 非常氣憤 "very angry", 令人氣憤 "outrageous". 氣 "air, temper" + 憤 "resent". It is stronger than 生氣 and the cause is usually injustice or an insult, not a small annoyance.

column3: Atmosphere, mood of a place or a gathering: 气氛很好, 热闹的气氛, 紧张的气氛, 活跃气氛. It is how the room feels. 气 "air" + 氛, which means "vapor, mist" and is only used in this word and 氛围. A party, a meeting or a restaurant has it.
column6: Cāntīng lǐ de qìfēn hěn qīngsōng.
column7: The atmosphere in the restaurant is relaxed.
column9: Atmosphere, mood of a place or a gathering: 氣氛很好, 熱鬧的氣氛, 緊張的氣氛, 活躍氣氛. It is how the room feels. 氣 "air" + 氛, which means "vapor, mist" and is only used in this word and 氛圍. A party, a meeting or a restaurant has it.

column3: To catch fire, of a building or a vehicle: 房子起火了, 起火原因 "the cause of the fire". It is the word of news reports. It can also be said when someone starts to cook or gets angry, but the fire is the sense meant here. 起 "start" + 火 "fire".
column4: 昨晚附近的工厂起火了。
column5: 昨晚附近的工廠起火了。
column6: Zuówǎn fùjìn de gōngchǎng qǐhuǒ le.
column7: A factory nearby caught fire last night.
column9: To catch fire, of a building or a vehicle: 房子起火了, 起火原因 "the cause of the fire". It is the word of news reports. It can also be said when someone starts to cook or gets angry, but the fire is the sense meant here. 起 "start" + 火 "fire".

column3: To clear away, to get rid of: 清除垃圾 "clear out rubbish", 清除障碍 "remove obstacles", 清除病毒. The thing is cleaned out completely. 清 "clean, clear" + 除 "remove". Used for rubbish, snow, files and abstract problems.
column4: 工人正在清除路上的积雪。
column5: 工人正在清除路上的積雪。
column6: Gōngrén zhèngzài qīngchú lùshàng de jīxuě.
column7: Workers are clearing the snow off the road.
column9: To clear away, to get rid of: 清除垃圾 "clear out rubbish", 清除障礙 "remove obstacles", 清除病毒. The thing is cleaned out completely. 清 "clean, clear" + 除 "remove". Used for rubbish, snow, files and abstract problems.

column3: Light, mild, for food that is not oily or strongly seasoned: 清淡的菜 "light dishes", 口味清淡 "likes mild flavors". It is what doctors recommend: 饮食清淡. 清 "clear" + 淡 "weak, light". Also for color and for business that is slow.
column4: 生病的时候要吃清淡的东西。
column5: 生病的時候要吃清淡的東西。
column6: Shēngbìng de shíhou yào chī qīngdàn de dōngxi.
column7: When you are ill you should eat light food.
column9: Light, mild, for food that is not oily or strongly seasoned: 清淡的菜 "light dishes", 口味清淡 "likes mild flavors". It is what doctors recommend: 飲食清淡. 清 "clear" + 淡 "weak, light". Also for color and for business that is slow.

column3: Minor injury: 轻伤, with 重伤 "serious injury": 他只受了轻伤 "he was only slightly hurt". News reports about accidents use it for the count of people hurt: 两人轻伤. 轻 "light" + 伤 "wound". It is used for people hurt, not for damage to things.
column4: 这次车祸只有两个人受了轻伤。
column5: 這次車禍只有兩個人受了輕傷。
column6: Zhè cì chēhuò zhǐyǒu liǎng ge rén shòu le qīngshāng.
column7: Only two people were slightly hurt in the accident.
column9: Minor injury: 輕傷, with 重傷 "serious injury": 他只受了輕傷 "he was only slightly hurt". News reports about accidents use it for the count of people hurt: 兩人輕傷. 輕 "light" + 傷 "wound". It is used for people hurt, not for damage to things.

column3: To look down on, to underestimate: 轻视对手 "underestimate the opponent", 不能轻视 "must not be taken lightly". 轻 "light" + 视 "regard". It means treating someone or something as of little weight, and can be contempt or just carelessness.
column4: 不要轻视任何一个对手。
column5: 不要輕視任何一個對手。
column6: Bù yào qīngshì rènhé yī ge duìshǒu.
column7: Don't underestimate any opponent.
column9: To look down on, to underestimate: 輕視對手 "underestimate the opponent", 不能輕視 "must not be taken lightly". 輕 "light" + 視 "regard". It means treating someone or something as of little weight, and can be contempt or just carelessness.

column3: Love letter: 写情书 "write a love letter", 一封情书. 情 "feeling" + 书 "letter, writing". The measure is 封, as for any letter. Nowadays it may also be a message, but the word keeps the old, handwritten picture.
column6: Tā gěi tā xiě le yī fēng qíngshū.
column7: He wrote her a love letter.
column9: Love letter: 寫情書 "write a love letter", 一封情書. 情 "feeling" + 書 "letter, writing". The measure is 封, as for any letter. Nowadays it may also be a message, but the word keeps the old, handwritten picture.

column3: Clear, distinct, for a picture, a sound or an idea: 画面清晰, 声音清晰, 思路清晰 "a clear line of thought". 清 "clear" + 晰 "distinct", where 晰 has 日 "sun" for brightness. It is written and a touch formal; 清楚 is the spoken word.
column6: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn pāi de hěn qīngxī.
column7: This photo is very sharp.
column9: Clear, distinct, for a picture, a sound or an idea: 畫面清晰, 聲音清晰, 思路清晰 "a clear line of thought". 清 "clear" + 晰 "distinct", where 晰 has 日 "sun" for brightness. It is written and a touch formal; 清楚 is the spoken word.

column3: Tendency, trend, and "to lean toward": 有…的倾向 "have a tendency to", 倾向于 "lean toward", 政治倾向. 倾 "lean, tilt" + 向 "toward". Used for a pattern of behavior or a view: 他有暴力倾向. The verb takes 于.
column6: Tā yǒu tuōyán de qīngxiàng.
column7: He has a tendency to put things off.
column9: Tendency, trend, and "to lean toward": 有…的傾向 "have a tendency to", 傾向於 "lean toward", 政治傾向. 傾 "lean, tilt" + 向 "toward". Used for a pattern of behavior or a view: 他有暴力傾向. The verb takes 於.

column3: Mood, emotional state: 情绪不好 "in a bad mood", 控制情绪, 情绪化 "moody". It points to feelings that come and go, anger, sadness, anxiety. 情 "feeling" + 绪, which has 纟 "thread" for the meaning and 者 for the sound (zhě, not close to xù).
column6: Tā jīntiān qíngxù bù tài hǎo.
column7: He is not in a good mood today.
column9: Mood, emotional state: 情緒不好 "in a bad mood", 控制情緒, 情緒化 "moody". It points to feelings that come and go, anger, sadness, anxiety. 情 "feeling" + 緒, which has 糹 "thread" for the meaning and 者 for the sound (zhě, not close to xù).

column3: To encroach on, to infringe: 侵害权利 "infringe on rights", 侵害隐私, 受到侵害. 侵 "invade" + 害 "harm". The object is a right, an interest or a person's body. It is the word of law and news. 侵 has 亻 "person" and a hand with a broom.
column4: 这样做侵害了别人的隐私。
column5: 這樣做侵害了別人的隱私。
column6: Zhèyàng zuò qīnhài le biérén de yǐnsī.
column7: Doing this infringes on other people's privacy.
column9: To encroach on, to infringe: 侵害權利 "infringe on rights", 侵害隱私, 受到侵害. 侵 "invade" + 害 "harm". The object is a right, an interest or a person's body. It is the word of law and news. 侵 has 亻 "person" and a hand with a broom.

column3: In one's own words, with one's own mouth: 亲口说 "say it personally", 亲口告诉我 "tell me himself". 亲 "personally" + 口 "mouth". It stresses that the person said it, not a rumor: 我亲口听他说的. It goes before verbs of speaking or tasting: 亲口尝一尝.
column6: Zhè shì tā qīnkǒu gàosu wǒ de.
column7: He told me this himself.
column9: In one's own words, with one's own mouth: 親口說 "say it personally", 親口告訴我 "tell me himself". 親 "personally" + 口 "mouth". It stresses that the person said it, not a rumor: 我親口聽他說的. It goes before verbs of speaking or tasting: 親口嘗一嘗.

column3: Hardworking, industrious: 勤劳的人 "a hardworking person", 勤劳的农夫, 勤劳致富. A word of praise and a bit formal, for working steadily and without complaint, as for farmers or a mother. 勤 "diligent" + 劳 "labor". 勤劳 is about the habit, and 努力 is about a push.
column6: Tā shì yī ge qínláo de nóngfū.
column7: He is a hardworking farmer.
column9: Hardworking, industrious: 勤勞的人 "a hardworking person", 勤勞的農夫, 勤勞致富. A word of praise and a bit formal, for working steadily and without complaint, as for farmers or a mother. 勤 "diligent" + 勞 "labor". 勤勞 is about the habit, and 努力 is about a push.

column3: Relative: 亲戚 are the family beyond your household: 走亲戚 "visit relatives", 亲戚朋友. 亲 "close" + 戚 "relatives"; the second syllable is neutral. In the New Year, people visit 亲戚. For a specific one you say the title, such as 舅舅.
column4: 过年的时候我们去看亲戚。
column5: 過年的時候我們去看親戚。
column6: Guònián de shíhou wǒmen qù kàn qīnqi.
column7: At New Year we go to see our relatives.
column9: Relative: 親戚 are the family beyond your household: 走親戚 "visit relatives", 親戚朋友. 親 "close" + 戚 "relatives"; the second syllable is neutral. In the New Year, people visit 親戚. For a specific one you say the title, such as 舅舅.

column3: To invade, to intrude into: 侵入他国领土 "enter another country's territory", 侵入电脑系统 "break into a computer system", 侵入住宅. It means entering where one has no right. 侵 "invade" + 入 "enter". It is in news and legal texts.
column4: 有人侵入了公司的电脑系统。
column5: 有人侵入了公司的電腦系統。
column6: Yǒu rén qīnrù le gōngsī de diànnǎo xìtǒng.
column7: Someone broke into the company's computer system.
column9: To invade, to intrude into: 侵入他國領土 "enter another country's territory", 侵入電腦系統 "break into a computer system", 侵入住宅. It means entering where one has no right. 侵 "invade" + 入 "enter". It is in news and legal texts.

column3: Bedroom, and in schools "dormitory room": 学生寝室, 寝室管理. It is a written word; in a house people say 卧室 or 房间. 寝 "sleep" + 室 "room". 寝 shows a roof 宀 over a bed 丬, so it is the room where one sleeps.
column6: Wǒ de qǐnshì yǒu sì ge rén.
column7: There are four people in my dorm room.
column9: Bedroom, and in schools "dormitory room": 學生寢室, 寢室管理. It is a written word; in a house people say 臥室 or 房間. 寢 "sleep" + 室 "room". 寢 shows a roof 宀 over a bed 爿, so it is the room where one sleeps.

column3: Cheongsam, qipao, the fitted dress with a high collar and side slits: 穿旗袍, 一件旗袍. It is worn for weddings and formal occasions. 旗 "banner" and 袍 "robe": it began as the long gown of the Manchu bannermen. 袍 has 衤 "clothing" and 包 for the sound (bāo, close to páo).
column4: 她穿着一件红色的旗袍。
column5: 她穿著一件紅色的旗袍。
column6: Tā chuān zhe yī jiàn hóngsè de qípáo.
column7: She is wearing a red cheongsam.
column9: Cheongsam, qipao, the fitted dress with a high collar and side slits: 穿旗袍, 一件旗袍. It is worn for weddings and formal occasions. 旗 "banner" and 袍 "robe": it began as the long gown of the Manchu bannermen. 袍 has 衤 "clothing" and 包 for the sound (bāo, close to páo).

column3: To deceive, to cheat: 欺骗顾客, 欺骗感情 "play with someone's feelings", 被欺骗. 欺 "bully, cheat" + 骗 "trick". The object is a person who has trusted you. A stronger word than 说谎, which is just telling a lie. 骗 has 马 "horse" on its left.
column6: Tā qīpiàn le hěn duō lǎorén.
column7: He cheated a lot of old people.
column9: To deceive, to cheat: 欺騙顧客, 欺騙感情 "play with someone's feelings", 被欺騙. 欺 "bully, cheat" + 騙 "trick". The object is a person who has trusted you. A stronger word than 說謊, which is just telling a lie. 騙 has 馬 "horse" on its left.

column3: To discriminate against, discrimination: 种族歧视 "racial discrimination", 性别歧视 "sex discrimination", 歧视外国人. 歧 means "a fork in the road, different", and 视 "regard", so seeing one group as different and lower. 止 "stop" is its meaning part and 支 "branch" the sound.
column4: 我们不应该歧视任何人。
column5: 我們不應該歧視任何人。
column6: Wǒmen bù yīnggāi qíshì rènhé rén.
column7: We should not discriminate against anyone.
column9: To discriminate against, discrimination: 種族歧視 "racial discrimination", 性別歧視 "sex discrimination", 歧視外國人. 歧 means "a fork in the road, different", and 視 "regard", so seeing one group as different and lower. 止 "stop" is its meaning part and 支 "branch" the sound.

column3: To attempt, to try something bad or illegal, and "an attempt": 企图逃跑 "try to escape", 企图抢劫, 犯罪企图. The attempt is one that is disapproved of, so it is not used for your own good plans. 企 "stand on tiptoe" (人 over 止 "foot") + 图 "plan".
column6: Tā qǐtú cóng hòumén táozǒu.
column7: He tried to escape through the back door.
column9: To attempt, to try something bad or illegal, and "an attempt": 企圖逃跑 "try to escape", 企圖搶劫, 犯罪企圖. The attempt is one that is disapproved of, so it is not used for your own good plans. 企 "stand on tiptoe" (人 over 止 "foot") + 圖 "plan".

column3: To propose marriage: 向她求婚 "propose to her", 求婚戒指 "engagement ring". 求 "ask for" + 婚 "marriage". It is a verb and noun with 向: 他向女朋友求婚了. The answer is 答应 "accept". 婚 has 女 "woman" at left.
column6: Tā zài hǎibiān xiàng tā qiúhūn.
column7: He proposed to her at the seaside.
column9: To propose marriage: 向她求婚 "propose to her", 求婚戒指 "engagement ring". 求 "ask for" + 婚 "marriage". It is a verb and noun with 向: 他向女朋友求婚了. The answer is 答應 "accept". 婚 has 女 "woman" at left.

column3: Smell, odor: 难闻的气味 "an unpleasant smell", 香甜的气味. It names what the nose gets from something, good or bad: 房间里有一股气味. The measure is 股. 气 "air" + 味 "taste, smell". 味道 is the everyday word and 气味 is more about odor than about taste.
column4: 房间里有一股奇怪的气味。
column5: 房間裡有一股奇怪的氣味。
column6: Fángjiān lǐ yǒu yī gǔ qíguài de qìwèi.
column7: There is a strange smell in the room.
column9: Smell, odor: 難聞的氣味 "an unpleasant smell", 香甜的氣味. It names what the nose gets from something, good or bad: 房間裡有一股氣味. The measure is 股. 氣 "air" + 味 "taste, smell". 味道 is the everyday word and 氣味 is more about odor than about taste.

column3: Breath, a trace of the air or feel of something: 春天的气息 "the breath of spring", 青春气息, 浓厚的文化气息. It is a literary word for the feel or smell that a season or a place gives off. 气 "air" + 息 "breath". For a real breath 呼吸 is used.
column6: Kōngqì lǐ yǒu chūntiān de qìxī.
column7: There is a breath of spring in the air.
column9: Breath, a trace of the air or feel of something: 春天的氣息 "the breath of spring", 青春氣息, 濃厚的文化氣息. It is a literary word for the feel or smell that a season or a place gives off. 氣 "air" + 息 "breath". For a real breath 呼吸 is used.

column3: To take a wife, to marry a woman, said of the man: 娶老婆 "get married", 娶她回家. The woman's side is 嫁: 嫁给他 "marry him". 娶 combines 取 "take" and 女 "woman", and 取 gives the sound (qǔ, the same). The man marries the woman; the woman is not "married" with this verb.
column6: Tā dǎsuàn míngnián qǔ tā.
column7: He plans to marry her next year.
column9: To take a wife, to marry a woman, said of the man: 娶老婆 "get married", 娶她回家. The woman's side is 嫁: 嫁給他 "marry him". 娶 combines 取 "take" and 女 "woman", and 取 gives the sound (qǔ, the same). The man marries the woman; the woman is not "married" with this verb.

column3: Fist: 握紧拳头 "clench a fist", 一个拳头 "a punch". 拳 "fist" + the neutral suffix 头. Also shows up in fighting: 挥拳头 "swing a fist". 拳 has 手 "hand" at the bottom, and 龹 for the sound (juàn, close to quán). Also 太极拳 and 打拳 are fist arts.
column6: Tā shēngqì de wòjǐn le quántou.
column7: He angrily clenched his fist.
column9: Fist: 握緊拳頭 "clench a fist", 一個拳頭 "a punch". 拳 "fist" + the neutral suffix 頭. Also shows up in fighting: 揮拳頭 "swing a fist". 拳 has 手 "hand" at the bottom, and 龹 for the sound (juàn, close to quán). Also 太極拳 and 打拳 are fist arts.

column3: To be absent from a meeting or an event you ought to attend: 缺席会议, 缺席审判 "trial in absentia", 无故缺席. 缺 "lack" + 席 "seat". The seat is empty. For school and work 请假 or 旷课 are used; 缺席 suits meetings, courts and ceremonies.
column6: Tā jīntiān quēxí le huìyì.
column7: He was absent from the meeting today.
column9: To be absent from a meeting or an event you ought to attend: 缺席會議, 缺席審判 "trial in absentia", 無故缺席. 缺 "lack" + 席 "seat". The seat is empty. For school and work 請假 or 曠課 are used; 缺席 suits meetings, courts and ceremonies.

column3: To tease, to make fun of: 取笑别人 "make fun of others", 被取笑, 不要取笑他. 取 "take" + 笑 "laugh", so you take someone as the object of laughter. It has a mocking feeling, and with friends it can be light teasing.
column4: 大家都取笑他的新发型。
column5: 大家都取笑他的新髮型。
column6: Dàjiā dōu qǔxiào tā de xīn fàxíng.
column7: Everyone teased him about his new hairstyle.
column9: To tease, to make fun of: 取笑別人 "make fun of others", 被取笑, 不要取笑他. 取 "take" + 笑 "laugh", so you take someone as the object of laughter. It has a mocking feeling, and with friends it can be light teasing.

column3: Winding, and figuratively "complicated, full of twists": 曲折的小路 "a winding path", 曲折的故事 "a story with many turns". 曲 "bent" + 折 "turn, fold". A road or a long process can be 曲折. A twist in a plot is also 曲折.
column6: Zhè tiáo shānlù hěn qūzhé.
column7: This mountain road is very winding.
column9: Winding, and figuratively "complicated, full of twists": 曲折的小路 "a winding path", 曲折的故事 "a story with many turns". 曲 "bent" + 折 "turn, fold". A road or a long process can be 曲折. A twist in a plot is also 曲折.

column3: To give way, to concede: 作出让步 "make a concession", 互相让步 "each gives a little", 不肯让步. 让 "yield" + 步 "step", stepping back. In talks and quarrels it means giving up part of your position to find a middle way. It can also be a noun, "a concession".
column6: Shuāngfāng dōu bù kěn ràngbù.
column7: Neither side is willing to give way.
column9: To give way, to concede: 作出讓步 "make a concession", 互相讓步 "each gives a little", 不肯讓步. 讓 "yield" + 步 "step", stepping back. In talks and quarrels it means giving up part of your position to find a middle way. It can also be a noun, "a concession".

column3: To provoke, to stir up, to cause: 惹麻烦 "cause trouble", 惹他生气 "make him angry", 别惹我, 惹人喜欢 "be liked by people". The thing you cause comes after it. 心 "heart" is the bottom part, with 若 as the sound (ruò, not close to rě). Used for trouble and feelings.
column6: Nǐ bié rě tā shēngqì.
column7: Don't make him angry.
column9: To provoke, to stir up, to cause: 惹麻煩 "cause trouble", 惹他生氣 "make him angry", 別惹我, 惹人喜歡 "be liked by people". The thing you cause comes after it. 心 "heart" is the bottom part, with 若 as the sound (ruò, not close to rě). Used for trouble and feelings.

column3: Personality, character, dignity: 人格高尚 "a noble character", 尊重人格 "respect a person's dignity", 人格特质 "personality traits". It is about what kind of person someone is in moral terms, and about the dignity that a person has by right. 人 "person" + 格 "standard, pattern". It is not the word for a lively personality, which is 个性.
column4: 他的人格受到大家的尊敬。
column5: 他的人格受到大家的尊敬。
column6: Tā de réngé shòudào dàjiā de zūnjìng.
column7: His character is respected by everyone.
column9: Personality, character, dignity: 人格高尚 "a noble character", 尊重人格 "respect a person's dignity", 人格特質 "personality traits". It is about what kind of person someone is in moral terms, and about the dignity that a person has by right. 人 "person" + 格 "standard, pattern". It is not the word for a lively personality, which is 個性.

column3: Human warmth, a human touch: 有人情味 "warm and kind", 缺乏人情味 "cold, impersonal". It is used for a place, a company or a person: 这家小店很有人情味. 人情 "human feeling, favors between people" + 味 "flavor".
column6: Zhè jiā xiǎo diàn hěn yǒu rénqíngwèi.
column7: This little shop has a lot of human warmth.
column9: Human warmth, a human touch: 有人情味 "warm and kind", 缺乏人情味 "cold, impersonal". It is used for a place, a company or a person: 這家小店很有人情味. 人情 "human feeling, favors between people" + 味 "flavor".

column3: Human warmth, the same word as 人情味 with the 儿 ending, which in Taiwan is rarely said aloud. In the list it is the mainland form with erhua. 人情味 is the one to learn for Taiwan, with the same meaning: 有人情味 "kind, warm" for a person or a place.
column4: 这个城市很有人情味儿。
column5: 這個城市很有人情味兒。
column6: Zhège chéngshì hěn yǒu rénqíngwèir.
column7: This city has a lot of human warmth.
column9: Human warmth, the same word as 人情味 with the 兒 ending, which in Taiwan is rarely said aloud. In the list it is the mainland form with erhua. 人情味 is the one to learn for Taiwan, with the same meaning: 有人情味 "kind, warm" for a person or a place.

column3: Human rights: 人权组织 "human rights group", 尊重人权, 侵犯人权 "violate human rights". 人 "person" + 权 "right, power". It is a word of news, politics and school civics texts, and it is always plural in sense: the rights every person has.
column6: Měi ge rén dōu yīnggāi yǒu rénquán.
column7: Everyone should have human rights.
column9: Human rights: 人權組織 "human rights group", 尊重人權, 侵犯人權 "violate human rights". 人 "person" + 權 "right, power". It is a word of news, politics and school civics texts, and it is always plural in sense: the rights every person has.

column3: Personnel, human resources, and "human affairs": 人事部门 "the personnel department", 人事调动 "personnel changes", 人事费用. In a company it is the department for hiring, pay and promotion. A different sense is "the ways of the world", as in 不懂人事.
column4: 他在公司的人事部门工作。
column5: 他在公司的人事部門工作。
column6: Tā zài gōngsī de rénshì bùmén gōngzuò.
column7: He works in the company's personnel department.
column9: Personnel, human resources, and "human affairs": 人事部門 "the personnel department", 人事調動 "personnel changes", 人事費用. In a company it is the department for hiring, pay and promotion. A different sense is "the ways of the world", as in 不懂人事.

column3: The human body: 人体结构 "the body's structure", 人体模型 "a model of the human body", 对人体有害 "harmful to the body". It is a scientific and medical word, and 身体 is the everyday word, including for health. 人 "person" + 体 "body". 体 has 亻 on its left and 本 on its right.
column6: Zhè zhǒng dōngxi duì réntǐ yǒuhài.
column7: This stuff is harmful to the human body.
column9: The human body: 人體結構 "the body's structure", 人體模型 "a model of the human body", 對人體有害 "harmful to the body". It is a scientific and medical word, and 身體 is the everyday word, including for health. 人 "person" + 體 "body". 體 has 骨 "bone" on its left.

column3: People's hearts, public feeling: 人心惶惶 "people are in a panic", 得人心 "win people's support", 人心不古 "people have changed for the worse", 人心 stands for what the public feels. It is not one person's heart, which is 心 or 内心. 人 "person" + 心 "heart".
column6: Zhège zhèngcè hěn dé rénxīn.
column7: This policy is popular with the people.
column9: People's hearts, public feeling: 人心惶惶 "people are in a panic", 得人心 "win people's support", 人心不古 "people have changed for the worse", 人心 stands for what the public feels. It is not one person's heart, which is 心 or 內心. 人 "person" + 心 "heart".

column3: To have the heart to: mostly in questions and denials: 我不忍心拒绝他 "I can't bring myself to refuse him", 你怎么忍心？ "how can you be so heartless?". It is about whether you can bear to do a hard thing to someone. 忍 "endure" + 心 "heart"; 忍 itself is a blade 刃 over a heart 心.
column4: 我不忍心看他这么辛苦。
column5: 我不忍心看他這麼辛苦。
column6: Wǒ bù rěnxīn kàn tā zhème xīnkǔ.
column7: I can't bear to see him work so hard.
column9: To have the heart to: mostly in questions and denials: 我不忍心拒絕他 "I can't bring myself to refuse him", 你怎麼忍心？ "how can you be so heartless?". It is about whether you can bear to do a hard thing to someone. 忍 "endure" + 心 "heart"; 忍 itself is a blade 刃 over a heart 心.

column3: Willful, headstrong: 他很任性 "he is willful", 任性的孩子 "a spoiled child". It is said of someone who does what they like and does not listen to others, often a child, a young woman or a favored person. 任 "let be" + 性 "nature, temper": letting one's nature go its own way. Not always bad; sometimes a gentle complaint.
column6: Tā cóngxiǎo jiù hěn rènxìng.
column7: She has been willful since she was small.
column9: Willful, headstrong: 他很任性 "he is willful", 任性的孩子 "a spoiled child". It is said of someone who does what they like and does not listen to others, often a child, a young woman or a favored person. 任 "let be" + 性 "nature, temper": letting one's nature go its own way. Not always bad; sometimes a gentle complaint.

column3: Sidewalk: 走人行道 "walk on the sidewalk", 人行道上停满了机车 "scooters are parked all along the sidewalk". 人 "person" + 行 "walk" + 道 "road", a road for walkers. Here 行 is read xíng. The crossing for walkers is 行人穿越道 or 斑马线 "zebra crossing".
column4: 请走人行道，不要走马路。
column5: 請走人行道，不要走馬路。
column6: Qǐng zǒu rénxíngdào, bù yào zǒu mǎlù.
column7: Please use the sidewalk, don't walk on the road.
column9: Sidewalk: 走人行道 "walk on the sidewalk", 人行道上停滿了機車 "scooters are parked all along the sidewalk". 人 "person" + 行 "walk" + 道 "road", a road for walkers. Here 行 is read xíng. The crossing for walkers is 行人穿越道 or 斑馬線 "zebra crossing".

column3: Later on, in the future: 日后再说 "let's talk about it later", 日后有机会 "if there is a chance later". It speaks of an unspecified time ahead, a little formal. 日 "day" + 后 "after". It is not for tomorrow or next week, but some day to come, and it goes at the start of the sentence or before a verb.
column4: 日后有机会，我们再一起去。
column5: 日後有機會，我們再一起去。
column6: Rìhòu yǒu jīhuì, wǒmen zài yīqǐ qù.
column7: If there's a chance later on, let's go together again.
column9: Later on, in the future: 日後再說 "let's talk about it later", 日後有機會 "if there is a chance later". It speaks of an unspecified time ahead, a little formal. 日 "day" + 後 "after". It is not for tomorrow or next week, but some day to come, and it goes at the start of the sentence or before a verb.

column3: Daily necessities: 买日用品 "buy household goods", 生活日用品 such as soap, paper and toothpaste. 日 "day" + 用 "use" + 品 "goods". A supermarket or a hypermarket sells them. It does not cover food.
column4: 我去超市买一些日用品。
column5: 我去超市買一些日用品。
column6: Wǒ qù chāoshì mǎi yīxiē rìyòngpǐn.
column7: I'm going to the supermarket to buy some daily necessities.
column9: Daily necessities: 買日用品 "buy household goods", 生活日用品 such as soap, paper and toothpaste. 日 "day" + 用 "use" + 品 "goods". A supermarket or a hypermarket sells them. It does not cover food.

column3: To hold, to allow, to tolerate: 容纳 "have room for", 容忍 "tolerate", 容易 "easy", and "appearance" in 笑容 "smile", 美容 "beauty care", 面容. Alone it is rare in speech but common in compounds. 容易 is the word to know first: 不容易 "not easy". 宀 "roof" on top: a place that holds.
column4: 这个房间可以容纳五十个人。
column5: 這個房間可以容納五十個人。
column6: Zhège fángjiān kěyǐ róngnà wǔshí ge rén.
column7: This room can hold fifty people.
column9: To hold, to allow, to tolerate: 容納 "have room for", 容忍 "tolerate", 容易 "easy", and "appearance" in 笑容 "smile", 美容 "beauty care", 面容. Alone it is rare in speech but common in compounds. 容易 is the word to know first: 不容易 "not easy". 宀 "roof" on top: a place that holds.

column3: To melt, to thaw: 冰融化了 "the ice has melted", 雪融化. It is for ice, snow and similar solids that turn liquid with heat, and can be for a feeling. 融 "melt" + 化 "change". 融 has 鬲 "cauldron" on the left, a pot for heating, and 虫 for the sound. For chocolate or ice cream people also say 化了.
column4: 太阳出来后，雪就融化了。
column5: 太陽出來後，雪就融化了。
column6: Tàiyáng chūlái hòu, xuě jiù rónghuà le.
column7: After the sun came out, the snow melted.
column9: To melt, to thaw: 冰融化了 "the ice has melted", 雪融化. It is for ice, snow and similar solids that turn liquid with heat, and can be for a feeling. 融 "melt" + 化 "change". 融 has 鬲 "cauldron" on the left, a pot for heating, and 虫 for the sound. For chocolate or ice cream people also say 化了.

column3: Honored, said politely to someone you meet or serve: 很荣幸认识您 "I am honored to meet you", 这是我的荣幸 "it is my honor". 荣 "glory" + 幸 "fortunate". It belongs to polite and formal talk, to guests and speeches. 荣 shows 艹 and 木 for flourishing, so it began as the glory of a plant in bloom.
column6: Hěn róngxìng rènshi nín.
column7: I am honored to meet you.
column9: Honored, said politely to someone you meet or serve: 很榮幸認識您 "I am honored to meet you", 這是我的榮幸 "it is my honor". 榮 "glory" + 幸 "fortunate". It belongs to polite and formal talk, to guests and speeches. 榮 shows 艹 and 木 for flourishing, so it began as the glory of a plant in bloom.

column3: To enter: a bound form in compounds, 入口 "entrance", 入学 "start school", 入境 "enter a country", 进入 "enter", 加入 "join", 收入 "income". In speech people say 进 for entering. It is also a tone of old Chinese, 入声, which no longer exists in Mandarin.
column6: Rùkǒu zài dàlóu de zuǒbian.
column7: The entrance is on the left side of the building.
column9: To enter: a bound form in compounds, 入口 "entrance", 入學 "start school", 入境 "enter a country", 進入 "enter", 加入 "join", 收入 "income". In speech people say 進 for entering. It is also a tone of old Chinese, 入聲, which no longer exists in Mandarin.

column3: If one says, if we say: 如果说 introduces a statement made for argument or an example: 如果说这件事是他做的，那就麻烦了. It is also the way to bring in a comparison: 如果说…那么… "if X is..., then Y is...". 如果 "if" + 说 "say". More talk-like than writing.
column4: 如果说你不去，我也不去。
column5: 如果說你不去，我也不去。
column6: Rúguǒshuō nǐ bù qù, wǒ yě bù qù.
column7: If you are not going, I'm not going either.
column9: If one says, if we say: 如果說 introduces a statement made for argument or an example: 如果說這件事是他做的，那就麻煩了. It is also the way to bring in a comparison: 如果說…那麼… "if X is..., then Y is...". 如果 "if" + 說 "say". More talk-like than writing.

column3: To enter a country: 入境许可 "entry permit", 办理入境 "go through entry", 入境随俗 "when in Rome, do as the locals do". Used at the airport and customs: the counter for arrivals says 入境. 入 "enter" + 境 "border, territory". Its opposite is 出境. At Taiwan airports 入境审查 is the immigration check.
column4: 请在这里排队办理入境手续。
column5: 請在這裡排隊辦理入境手續。
column6: Qǐng zài zhèlǐ páiduì bànlǐ rùjìng shǒuxù.
column7: Please queue here for entry procedures.
column9: To enter a country: 入境許可 "entry permit", 辦理入境 "go through entry", 入境隨俗 "when in Rome, do as the locals do". Used at the airport and customs: the counter for arrivals says 入境. 入 "enter" + 境 "border, territory". Its opposite is 出境. At Taiwan airports 入境審查 is the immigration check.

column3: To start school, to enter a school: 入学考试 "entrance exam", 入学典礼 "opening ceremony", 小孩入学. It can be a child entering first grade or a student starting at a college. 入 "enter" + 学 "school". The school year starts in September, and 入学 is about then.
column6: Tā jīnnián jiǔyuè rùxué.
column7: He starts school this September.
column9: To start school, to enter a school: 入學考試 "entrance exam", 入學典禮 "opening ceremony", 小孩入學. It can be a child entering first grade or a student starting at a college. 入 "enter" + 學 "school". The school year starts in September, and 入學 is about then.

column3: To stuff in, to plug: 塞住 "plug up", 把东西塞进包包 "stuff things into a bag", 塞满 "stuff full". It is used for tight spaces, and a stopper is a 塞子. Read sāi for the verb, and sè as a word part, 边塞, 闭塞. 土 "earth" is its bottom part, with an old shape of a house stuffed with things above it.
column6: Tā bǎ shū sāi jìn le bèibāo.
column7: He stuffed the books into his backpack.
column9: To stuff in, to plug: 塞住 "plug up", 把東西塞進包包 "stuff things into a bag", 塞滿 "stuff full". It is used for tight spaces, and a stopper is a 塞子. Read sāi for the verb, and sè as a word part, 邊塞, 閉塞. 土 "earth" is its bottom part, with an old shape of a house stuffed with things above it.

column3: Traffic jam: 塞车了, 塞了半小时的车, 上下班塞车. Taiwan says 塞车, the mainland more often 堵车. 塞 is read sāi here, and 车 is the vehicles on the road. 路上塞车 "there is a traffic jam on the road" is the usual excuse for being late.
column4: 路上塞车，我可能会晚到。
column5: 路上塞車，我可能會晚到。
column6: Lùshàng sāichē, wǒ kěnéng huì wǎn dào.
column7: There's a traffic jam, so I may be late.
column9: Traffic jam: 塞車了, 塞了半小時的車, 上下班塞車. Taiwan says 塞車, the mainland more often 堵車. 塞 is read sāi here, and 車 is the vehicles on the road. 路上塞車 "there is a traffic jam on the road" is the usual excuse for being late.

column3: A race in running, and "to race": 赛跑比赛, 跟他赛跑 "race with him", 百米赛跑. 赛 "compete" + 跑 "run". A footrace is 赛跑, and for a race with cars or bikes you use 比赛 or 赛车. A child's sports day has 赛跑.
column4: 我们来赛跑，看谁跑得快。
column5: 我們來賽跑，看誰跑得快。
column6: Wǒmen lái sàipǎo, kàn shéi pǎo de kuài.
column7: Let's have a race and see who runs fastest.
column9: A race in running, and "to race": 賽跑比賽, 跟他賽跑 "race with him", 百米賽跑. 賽 "compete" + 跑 "run". A footrace is 賽跑, and for a race with cars or bikes you use 比賽 or 賽車. A child's sports day has 賽跑.

column3: To lose, to forfeit, for something abstract: 丧失信心 "lose confidence", 丧失能力 "lose an ability", 丧失机会 "lose a chance". It is for something one had and cannot get back, and is formal. 丧 "lose" + 失 "lose". In 丧 the meaning is also mourning: it has 亡 "the dead" at the bottom.
column6: Tā sàngshī le xìnxīn.
column7: He lost his confidence.
column9: To lose, to forfeit, for something abstract: 喪失信心 "lose confidence", 喪失能力 "lose an ability", 喪失機會 "lose a chance". It is for something one had and cannot get back, and is formal. 喪 "lose" + 失 "lose". In 喪 the meaning is also mourning: it shows crying 口口 over 亡 "the dead" at its center.

column3: Triangle: 一个三角形, 等边三角形 "equilateral triangle". 三 "three" + 角 "angle, corner" + 形 "shape", a shape with three corners. In math class you also see 正方形 "square", 长方形 "rectangle" and 圆形 "circle". 角 here is read jiǎo.
column6: Zhège pánzi shì sānjiǎoxíng de.
column7: This plate is triangular.
column9: Triangle: 一個三角形, 等邊三角形 "equilateral triangle". 三 "three" + 角 "angle, corner" + 形 "shape", a shape with three corners. In math class you also see 正方形 "square", 長方形 "rectangle" and 圓形 "circle". 角 here is read jiǎo.

column3: Classifier for ships: 一艘船 "a ship", 两艘军舰 "two warships", 三艘游艇. It is only used for boats and ships, big ones. In Taiwan it is read sāo, as the dictionary also records. 舟 "boat" is the meaning part and 叟 the sound (sǒu).
column6: Gǎngkǒu tíng zhe sān sōu dà chuán.
column7: Three large ships are docked in the harbor.
column9: Classifier for ships: 一艘船 "a ship", 兩艘軍艦 "two warships", 三艘遊艇. It is only used for boats and ships, big ones. In Taiwan it is read sāo, as the dictionary also records. 舟 "boat" is the meaning part and 叟 the sound (sǒu).

column3: Pornography, erotic: 色情网站 "porn site", 色情电影, 色情业. It is a strong word, used in warnings and rules about content: 禁止色情. 色 "color, sex" + 情 "feeling". It is not used for romance, which is 爱情.
column4: 网站上不能出现色情内容。
column5: 網站上不能出現色情內容。
column6: Wǎngzhàn shàng bù néng chūxiàn sèqíng nèiróng.
column7: Pornographic content must not appear on the site.
column9: Pornography, erotic: 色情網站 "porn site", 色情電影, 色情業. It is a strong word, used in warnings and rules about content: 禁止色情. 色 "color, sex" + 情 "feeling". It is not used for romance, which is 愛情.

column3: Sand, and "hoarse": 沙子 "grains of sand", 沙滩 "beach", 沙漠 "desert", 沙发 "sofa" (a loan word from "sofa"), 声音沙哑 "hoarse voice". The character is 氵 "water" with 少 "few, small bits": sand at the water's edge. 少 also gives a sound, close to shā. It is read shā.
column6: Xiézi lǐ jìn le shāzi.
column7: Sand got into my shoes.
column9: Sand, and "hoarse": 沙子 "grains of sand", 沙灘 "beach", 沙漠 "desert", 沙發 "sofa" (a loan word from "sofa"), 聲音沙啞 "hoarse voice". The character is 氵 "water" with 少 "few, small bits": sand at the water's edge. 少 also gives a sound, close to shā. It is read shā.

column3: To haggle, to bargain the price down: 杀价 "knock down the price", 杀价杀得很凶. Used at night markets and traditional markets, where one can bargain. 杀 "kill" + 价 "price", killing the price. 讨价还价 is the full phrase for bargaining back and forth. At fixed-price shops it does not work.
column4: 在夜市买东西可以杀价。
column5: 在夜市買東西可以殺價。
column6: Zài yèshì mǎi dōngxi kěyǐ shājià.
column7: You can haggle when you buy things at a night market.
column9: To haggle, to bargain the price down: 殺價 "knock down the price", 殺價殺得很兇. Used at night markets and traditional markets, where one can bargain. 殺 "kill" + 價 "price", killing the price. 討價還價 is the full phrase for bargaining back and forth. At fixed-price shops it does not work.

column3: Mountainous area, hill country: 山地地区, 山地农业, 山地多平地少 "much mountain and little flat land". 山 "mountain" + 地 "land". 山区 is similar and places more weight on the region.
column6: Táiwān yǒu hěn duō shāndì.
column7: Taiwan has a lot of mountainous land.
column9: Mountainous area, hill country: 山地地區, 山地農業, 山地多平地少 "much mountain and little flat land". 山 "mountain" + 地 "land". 山區 is similar and places more weight on the region.

column3: To be a headache, to be troublesome: 真伤脑筋 "what a headache", 这件事很伤脑筋. It is spoken, for a problem that makes you think hard or worry. 伤 "hurt" + 脑筋 "brains", so it hurts your brain.
column6: Zhège wèntí zhēn shāngnǎojīn.
column7: This problem is a real headache.
column9: To be a headache, to be troublesome: 真傷腦筋 "what a headache", 這件事很傷腦筋. It is spoken, for a problem that makes you think hard or worry. 傷 "hurt" + 腦筋 "brains", so it hurts your brain.

column3: To go on the market, to launch a product, and "to go public" with shares: 新产品上市 "a new product is launched", 公司上市 "a company is listed". 上 "go up, come out" + 市 "market". In Taiwan, a stock listed on the exchange is 上市, and a smaller one on the OTC market is 上柜. For seasonal fruit 上市 means it is now in the shops.
column6: Xīn shǒujī xià ge yuè shàngshì.
column7: The new phone comes out next month.
column9: To go on the market, to launch a product, and "to go public" with shares: 新產品上市 "a new product is launched", 公司上市 "a company is listed". 上 "go up, come out" + 市 "market". In Taiwan, a stock listed on the exchange is 上市, and a smaller one on the OTC market is 上櫃. For seasonal fruit 上市 means it is now in the shops.

column3: The above-mentioned: 上述原因 "the reasons above", 上述内容 "the content above". In reports, notices and exams. 上 "above" + 述 "state, narrate". It refers back to something said earlier in the same text. A formal word that is hardly said aloud.
column4: 由于上述原因，会议改期了。
column5: 由於上述原因，會議改期了。
column6: Yóuyú shàngshù yuányīn, huìyì gǎiqī le.
column7: For the reasons given above, the meeting has been put off.
column9: The above-mentioned: 上述原因 "the reasons above", 上述內容 "the content above". In reports, notices and exams. 上 "above" + 述 "state, narrate". It refers back to something said earlier in the same text. A formal word that is hardly said aloud.

column3: To go on stage, and "to take power": 上台表演 "go on stage to perform", 上台领奖 "go up to receive an award", 新总统上台 "the new president takes office". The opposite is 下台 "step down", also used of a leader. 上 "go up" + 台 "stage, platform".
column4: 他上台领奖的时候很紧张。
column5: 他上台領獎的時候很緊張。
column6: Tā shàngtái lǐng jiǎng de shíhou hěn jǐnzhāng.
column7: He was nervous when he went up to receive the prize.
column9: To go on stage, and "to take power": 上台表演 "go on stage to perform", 上台領獎 "go up to receive an award", 新總統上台 "the new president takes office". The opposite is 下台 "step down", also used of a leader. 上 "go up" + 台 "stage, platform".

column3: The top, the surface, and "those above": 桌子上头 "on top of the table", 上头有人 "someone above me", 上头的意思 "what the higher-ups want". The ending 头 is neutral. It is spoken and can mean the people in charge: 上头交代的 "what the boss told us". 上面 is the plainer word for "on top".
column4: 上头的人要我们明天交报告。
column5: 上頭的人要我們明天交報告。
column6: Shàngtou de rén yào wǒmen míngtiān jiāo bàogào.
column7: The people above want us to hand in the report tomorrow.
column9: The top, the surface, and "those above": 桌子上頭 "on top of the table", 上頭有人 "someone above me", 上頭的意思 "what the higher-ups want". The ending 頭 is neutral. It is spoken and can mean the people in charge: 上頭交代的 "what the boss told us". 上面 is the plainer word for "on top".

column3: Upper reaches, upstream: 河的上游 "the upper river", 往上游走 "go upstream", and for a rank, 力争上游 "strive for the top". 上 "up" + 游 "flow, swim". The opposite is 下游. 游 has 氵 "water" at its left and is used for swimming or the flow of a stream.
column4: 这条河的上游有一座水库。
column5: 這條河的上游有一座水庫。
column6: Zhè tiáo hé de shàngyóu yǒu yī zuò shuǐkù.
column7: There is a reservoir on the upper reaches of this river.
column9: Upper reaches, upstream: 河的上游 "the upper river", 往上游走 "go upstream", and for a rank, 力爭上游 "strive for the top". 上 "up" + 游 "flow, swim". The opposite is 下游. 游 has 氵 "water" at its left and is used for swimming or the flow of a stream.

column3: Girl, young woman, roughly 12 to 20: 少女时代, 一位少女. It is a bit literary and sounds like a story or a song, a girl at an age of dreams. 少 "young" + 女 "female". The 少 is read shào here, while the 少 of "few" is shǎo.
column6: Nàge shàonǚ zài hébiān chànggē.
column7: That girl is singing by the river.
column9: Girl, young woman, roughly 12 to 20: 少女時代, 一位少女. It is a bit literary and sounds like a story or a song, a girl at an age of dreams. 少 "young" + 女 "female". The 少 is read shào here, while the 少 of "few" is shǎo.

column3: Beach, sandy shore: 去沙滩玩 "go play at the beach", 沙滩排球 "beach volleyball", 沙滩裤 "board shorts". 沙 "sand" + 滩 "shoal, beach". 海边 is the general word for the seaside, and 沙滩 is the sand itself.
column6: Wǒmen zhōumò qù shātān wán.
column7: We are going to the beach at the weekend.
column9: Beach, sandy shore: 去沙灘玩 "go play at the beach", 沙灘排球 "beach volleyball", 沙灘褲 "board shorts". 沙 "sand" + 灘 "shoal, beach". 海邊 is the general word for the seaside, and 沙灘 is the sand itself.

column3: Social interaction, socializing: 社交活动 "social events", 社交网站 "social networking site", 社交能力. It covers meeting people in a polite or professional way, and 社交软体 is a social app. 社 "society" + 交 "associate". A shy person is 不擅长社交.
column6: Tā bù tài huì shèjiāo.
column7: He is not very good at socializing.
column9: Social interaction, socializing: 社交活動 "social events", 社交網站 "social networking site", 社交能力. It covers meeting people in a polite or professional way, and 社交軟體 is a social app. 社 "society" + 交 "associate". A shy person is 不擅長社交.

column3: To examine, to review, to censor: 审查文件 "check documents", 资格审查 "qualification review", 审查委员会, 电影审查. It means checking whether something meets the rules before it goes ahead, and it is done by an authority. 审 "examine" + 查 "check". 审 has a roof 宀 above 申.
column4: 评审会正在审查这份申请。
column5: 評審會正在審查這份申請。
column6: Píngshěnhuì zhèngzài shěnchá zhè fèn shēnqǐng.
column7: The panel is reviewing this application.
column9: To examine, to review, to censor: 審查文件 "check documents", 資格審查 "qualification review", 審查委員會, 電影審查. It means checking whether something meets the rules before it goes ahead, and it is done by an authority. 審 "examine" + 查 "check". 審 has a roof 宀 above 番.

column3: Identity, status, capacity: 身分证 "ID card", 他的身分是老师 "he is a teacher by profession", 以学生的身分 "in the capacity of a student", 身分地位 "social standing". Taiwan writes 身分 (身份 is also seen), the mainland 身份. 身 "body, person" + 分 "part, rank", so the rank a person holds. It is used on forms and in law.
column6: Qǐng chūshì nǐ de shēnfèn zhèngmíng.
column7: Please show proof of your identity.
column9: Identity, status, capacity: 身分證 "ID card", 他的身分是老師 "he is a teacher by profession", 以學生的身分 "in the capacity of a student", 身分地位 "social standing". Taiwan writes 身分 (身份 is also seen), the mainland 身份. 身 "body, person" + 分 "part, rank", so the rank a person holds. It is used on forms and in law.

column3: ID card, the national identity card that citizens carry; in Taiwan its number begins with a letter. 带身分证 "bring your ID", 身分证字号 "ID number", 办身分证. 身分 "identity" + 证 "proof". Foreign residents have a 居留证 instead.
column6: Chūmén bié wàng le dài shēnfènzhèng.
column7: Don't forget to take your ID card when you go out.
column9: ID card, the national identity card that citizens carry; in Taiwan its number begins with a letter. 帶身分證 "bring your ID", 身分證字號 "ID number", 辦身分證. 身分 "identity" + 證 "proof". Foreign residents have a 居留證 instead.

column3: Rope, cord: it is a bound form: 绳子 "rope", 跳绳 "jump rope", 鞋绳 "shoelace", 绳索, 麻绳 "hemp rope". On its own it is rare in speech, you say 绳子. 纟 "thread" is the meaning part and 黾 the sound, which has changed a lot (shéng). Things tied with a rope are 绑.
column4: 他用一条粗绳把箱子绑好。
column5: 他用一條粗繩把箱子綁好。
column6: Tā yòng yī tiáo cū shéng bǎ xiāngzi bǎnghǎo.
column7: He tied the box up with a thick rope.
column9: Rope, cord: it is a bound form: 繩子 "rope", 跳繩 "jump rope", 鞋繩 "shoelace", 繩索, 麻繩 "hemp rope". On its own it is rare in speech, you say 繩子. 糹 "thread" is the meaning part and 黽 the sound, which has changed a lot (shéng). Things tied with a rope are 綁.

column3: Rope, string, cord: 一条绳子 "a rope", 跳绳子, 用绳子绑 "tie with a rope". The classifier is 条 or 根. 绳 "rope" + the neutral suffix 子. It is the everyday word, for anything from a thin string to a thick rope.
column6: Qǐng gěi wǒ yī tiáo shéngzi.
column7: Please give me a rope.
column9: Rope, string, cord: 一條繩子 "a rope", 跳繩子, 用繩子綁 "tie with a rope". The classifier is 條 or 根. 繩 "rope" + the neutral suffix 子. It is the everyday word, for anything from a thin string to a thick rope.

column3: So as to avoid, so as not to waste: 早点出门，省得迟到 "leave early so you won't be late", 省得麻烦. It comes in the second part of a sentence and gives a result that is saved or avoided; the 得 is neutral. It is close to 免得, and 省得 stresses saving trouble, time or money.
column4: 你先打个电话，省得白跑一趟。
column5: 你先打個電話，省得白跑一趟。
column6: Nǐ xiān dǎ ge diànhuà, shěngde bái pǎo yī tàng.
column7: Call first, so you don't make the trip for nothing.
column9: So as to avoid, so as not to waste: 早點出門，省得遲到 "leave early so you won't be late", 省得麻煩. It comes in the second part of a sentence and gives a result that is saved or avoided; the 得 is neutral. It is close to 免得, and 省得 stresses saving trouble, time or money.

column3: To upgrade, to be promoted a grade: 升级版 "upgraded version", 软体升级 "software update", 升级成… "upgrade to", and in games "level up". It can also be "to escalate": 冲突升级. 升 "rise" + 级 "level". In a hotel or flight an upgrade is 升等 in Taiwan (on the mainland 升舱 for a flight).
column6: Shǒujī xūyào shēngjí xìtǒng.
column7: The phone needs a system upgrade.
column9: To upgrade, to be promoted a grade: 升級版 "upgraded version", 軟體升級 "software update", 升級成… "upgrade to", and in games "level up". It can also be "to escalate": 衝突升級. 升 "rise" + 級 "level". In a hotel or flight an upgrade is 升等 in Taiwan (on the mainland 升艙 for a flight).

column3: Zodiac animal: the twelve animals of the Chinese zodiac, 鼠牛虎兔龙蛇马羊猴鸡狗猪. 你属什么？ or 你的生肖是什么？ is how people ask someone's year. 生 "born" + 肖 "resemble", the animal you are born resembling. 肖 has 月 and 小.
column6: Nǐ de shēngxiào shì shénme?
column7: What is your zodiac animal?
column9: Zodiac animal: the twelve animals of the Chinese zodiac, 鼠牛虎兔龍蛇馬羊猴雞狗豬. 你屬什麼？ or 你的生肖是什麼？ is how people ask someone's year. 生 "born" + 肖 "resemble", the animal you are born resembling. 肖 has 月 and 小.

column3: To go on to the next level of school: 升学考试 "entrance exam", 升学压力 "pressure to go up", 升学率, 升学主义. It is a familiar worry: from junior high to senior high, from senior high to university. 升 "rise" + 学 "school". It is not for going up one grade, which is 升级.
column4: 很多学生有升学的压力。
column5: 很多學生有升學的壓力。
column6: Hěn duō xuéshēng yǒu shēngxué de yālì.
column7: Many students feel the pressure of getting into the next school.
column9: To go on to the next level of school: 升學考試 "entrance exam", 升學壓力 "pressure to go up", 升學率, 升學主義. It is a familiar worry: from junior high to senior high, from senior high to university. 升 "rise" + 學 "school". It is not for going up one grade, which is 升級.

column3: Spirited, swaggering: 神气十足 "full of spirit", 看起来很神气 "looks impressive", and with some pride or showing off: 别神气了. It can be a good or a mocking word, as 神气活现 "puffed up". 神 "spirit" + 气 "air, bearing".
column4: 他穿上制服，看起来很神气。
column5: 他穿上制服，看起來很神氣。
column6: Tā chuān shàng zhìfú, kàn qǐlái hěn shénqì.
column7: In his uniform he looks very smart.
column9: Spirited, swaggering: 神氣十足 "full of spirit", 看起來很神氣 "looks impressive", and with some pride or showing off: 別神氣了. It can be a good or a mocking word, as 神氣活現 "puffed up". 神 "spirit" + 氣 "air, bearing".

column3: Depth, how deep or shallow: 水的深浅 "how deep the water is", 不知深浅 "not know the limits", 颜色的深浅 "shade of a color". It is the pair 深 "deep" and 浅 "shallow" taken together, as 大小 means "size". It also means "limits of propriety": 说话没有深浅.
column4: 下水之前先试一试水的深浅。
column5: 下水之前先試一試水的深淺。
column6: Xià shuǐ zhīqián xiān shì yī shì shuǐ de shēnqiǎn.
column7: Test how deep the water is before you get in.
column9: Depth, how deep or shallow: 水的深淺 "how deep the water is", 不知深淺 "not know the limits", 顏色的深淺 "shade of a color". It is the pair 深 "deep" and 淺 "shallow" taken together, as 大小 means "size". It also means "limits of propriety": 說話沒有深淺.

column3: Sacred, holy: 神圣的地方 "a sacred place", 神圣的使命 "a sacred mission", 神圣不可侵犯 "sacred and inviolable". It is used in lofty language for a duty, a place or a right. 神 "god" + 圣 "holy".
column4: 保护国家是神圣的责任。
column5: 保護國家是神聖的責任。
column6: Bǎohù guójiā shì shénshèng de zérèn.
column7: Defending the country is a sacred duty.
column9: Sacred, holy: 神聖的地方 "a sacred place", 神聖的使命 "a sacred mission", 神聖不可侵犯 "sacred and inviolable". It is used in lofty language for a duty, a place or a right. 神 "god" + 聖 "holy".

column3: To reach out a hand: 伸手拿 "reach for", 伸出手 "hold out a hand", 伸手不见五指 "so dark you can't see your hand". Figurative: 伸手要钱 "ask for money all the time", 伸手帮忙. 伸 "stretch" + 手 "hand". It is a verb with its object inside: 他伸了伸手.
column6: Tā shēnshǒu ná zhuō shàng de bēizi.
column7: He reached for the cup on the table.
column9: To reach out a hand: 伸手拿 "reach for", 伸出手 "hold out a hand", 伸手不見五指 "so dark you can't see your hand". Figurative: 伸手要錢 "ask for money all the time", 伸手幫忙. 伸 "stretch" + 手 "hand". It is a verb with its object inside: 他伸了伸手.

column3: Immortal, a Daoist spirit: 神仙故事, 像神仙一样 "live like an immortal", and for a carefree person: 逍遥神仙. 神 "god" + 仙 "immortal". The Eight Immortals are 八仙.
column4: 这里的风景像神仙住的地方。
column5: 這裡的風景像神仙住的地方。
column6: Zhèlǐ de fēngjǐng xiàng shénxiān zhù de dìfang.
column7: The scenery here is like the home of immortals.
column9: Immortal, a Daoist spirit: 神仙故事, 像神仙一樣 "live like an immortal", and for a carefree person: 逍遙神仙. 神 "god" + 仙 "immortal". The Eight Immortals are 八仙.

column3: Very late at night: 深夜十二点, 在深夜工作. It is the hours after midnight, or late before. 深 "deep" + 夜 "night". It is written and spoken. For something in the middle of the night 半夜 is the more casual word.
column6: Tā chángcháng gōngzuò dào shēnyè.
column7: He often works until late at night.
column9: Very late at night: 深夜十二點, 在深夜工作. It is the hours after midnight, or late before. 深 "deep" + 夜 "night". It is written and spoken. For something in the middle of the night 半夜 is the more casual word.

column3: Cautious, careful, prudent: 慎重考虑 "consider carefully", 慎重处理, 慎重的态度. It describes a serious decision, a choice or a way of handling something, and it is a bit formal. 慎 "careful" + 重 "heavy, weighty", so one gives it weight. 重 here is read zhòng. 忄 "heart" and 真 in 慎.
column4: 结婚是大事，要慎重考虑。
column5: 結婚是大事，要慎重考慮。
column6: Jiéhūn shì dàshì, yào shènzhòng kǎolǜ.
column7: Marriage is a big matter, so think carefully.
column9: Cautious, careful, prudent: 慎重考慮 "consider carefully", 慎重處理, 慎重的態度. It describes a serious decision, a choice or a way of handling something, and it is a bit formal. 慎 "careful" + 重 "heavy, weighty", so one gives it weight. 重 here is read zhòng. 忄 "heart" and 真 in 慎.

column3: Tongue: 伸出舌头 "stick out one's tongue", 咬到舌头 "bite one's tongue", 舌头打结 "tongue-tied". 舌 "tongue" + the neutral suffix 头. The character 舌 has 口 below, a mouth, and 千 above, which is the tongue sticking out.
column6: Wǒ bù xiǎoxīn yǎo dào le shétou.
column7: I accidentally bit my tongue.
column9: Tongue: 伸出舌頭 "stick out one's tongue", 咬到舌頭 "bite one's tongue", 舌頭打結 "tongue-tied". 舌 "tongue" + the neutral suffix 頭. The character 舌 has 口 below, a mouth, and 千 above, which is the tongue sticking out.

column3: Tongue, a bound form in compounds: 舌头 "tongue", 舌尖 "tip of the tongue", 口舌 "words, argument", 舌苔 "coating on the tongue". On its own it appears in a few set phrases such as 唇枪舌剑 "a war of words". The picture is a mouth 口 with a tongue sticking out of it.
column6: Tā de shéjiān bèi tàngshāng le.
column7: The tip of his tongue was scalded.
column9: Tongue, a bound form in compounds: 舌頭 "tongue", 舌尖 "tip of the tongue", 口舌 "words, argument", 舌苔 "coating on the tongue". On its own it appears in a few set phrases such as 唇槍舌劍 "a war of words". The picture is a mouth 口 with a tongue sticking out of it.

column3: Club, society, association: 学生社团 "student clubs", 参加社团 "join a club", 社团活动 "club activities". At schools and universities 社团 is the normal word for extracurricular groups: 吉他社, 摄影社. 社 "society" + 团 "group". It is also used for a registered civic organization.
column4: 大学生活里，他加入了摄影社团。
column5: 大學生活裡，他加入了攝影社團。
column6: Dàxué shēnghuó lǐ, tā jiārù le shèyǐng shètuán.
column7: At university he joined the photography club.
column9: Club, society, association: 學生社團 "student clubs", 參加社團 "join a club", 社團活動 "club activities". At schools and universities 社團 is the normal word for extracurricular groups: 吉他社, 攝影社. 社 "society" + 團 "group". It is also used for a registered civic organization.

column3: Generation, era, world: a bound form: 世界 "world", 世代 "generation", 一辈子 and 一世 "a lifetime", 世纪 "century", 去世 "pass away". It is a word part, not a stand-alone word in speech. The 世 of 世纪 and 世界 is the same: a stretch of time, then everything within it.
column4: 二十一世纪是网路的世纪。
column5: 二十一世紀是網路的世紀。
column6: Èrshíyī shìjì shì wǎnglù de shìjì.
column7: The twenty-first century is the century of the internet.
column9: Generation, era, world: a bound form: 世界 "world", 世代 "generation", 一輩子 and 一世 "a lifetime", 世紀 "century", 去世 "pass away". It is a word part, not a stand-alone word in speech. The 世 of 世紀 and 世界 is the same: a stretch of time, then everything within it.

column3: To look, to regard: 视 is a bound form in 视力 "eyesight", 视线 "line of sight", 重视 "value", 电视 "television", 近视 "nearsighted", 无视 "ignore". It is mostly met in compounds, and the sense is "to look at, to regard as". 示 "show" is on the left and 见 "see" on the right.
column6: Tā de shìlì yuèláiyuè chà.
column7: His eyesight is getting worse and worse.
column9: To look, to regard: 視 is a bound form in 視力 "eyesight", 視線 "line of sight", 重視 "value", 電視 "television", 近視 "nearsighted", 無視 "ignore". It is mostly met in compounds, and the sense is "to look at, to regard as". 示 "show" is on the left and 見 "see" on the right.

column3: Suitable, appropriate: 适当的方法 "a suitable method", 适当的时候 "at the right moment", 适当休息. It is a formal and common word for something that fits the situation, and an adverb: 适当地 "in a measured way". 适 "fit" + 当 "suit". The last character here is read dàng, as in 恰当, not dāng.
column6: Yùndòng yào shìdàng, bù yào tài lèi.
column7: Exercise in moderation and don't get too tired.
column9: Suitable, appropriate: 適當的方法 "a suitable method", 適當的時候 "at the right moment", 適當休息. It is a formal and common word for something that fits the situation, and an adverb: 適當地 "in a measured way". 適 "fit" + 當 "suit". The last character here is read dàng, as in 恰當, not dāng.

column3: To lose, to miss something you had: 失掉信心 "lose confidence", 失掉机会 "miss a chance", 失掉工作. 失 "lose" + 掉 "drop", where 掉 adds the idea of loss that has already happened. It is spoken. It also fits things such as a taste, a trust or a hope.
column6: Tā shīdiào le yī cì hǎo jīhuì.
column7: He missed a good chance.
column9: To lose, to miss something you had: 失掉信心 "lose confidence", 失掉機會 "miss a chance", 失掉工作. 失 "lose" + 掉 "drop", where 掉 adds the idea of loss that has already happened. It is spoken. It also fits things such as a taste, a trust or a hope.

column3: Right and wrong, and "quarrels, gossip": 明辨是非 "distinguish right from wrong", 是非不分, 惹是非 "stir up trouble", 爱说是非 "likes to gossip". The two senses are very different: judging morality, and trouble talked about behind people's backs. 是 "is, right" + 非 "is not, wrong".
column6: Háizi yào xuéhuì fēnbiàn shìfēi.
column7: Children need to learn to tell right from wrong.
column9: Right and wrong, and "quarrels, gossip": 明辨是非 "distinguish right from wrong", 是非不分, 惹是非 "stir up trouble", 愛說是非 "likes to gossip". The two senses are very different: judging morality, and trouble talked about behind people's backs. 是 "is, right" + 非 "is not, wrong".

column3: Master, teacher of a craft, and a respectful way to address a skilled worker, a monk or a nun: 拜师父 "become someone's apprentice". It is a common address for a taxi driver, a repairman or a cook, and for a Buddhist monk. It is also written 师傅. The second syllable is neutral.
column6: Shīfu jiāo tā zěnme zuò mùgōng.
column7: The master teaches him how to do woodwork.
column9: Master, teacher of a craft, and a respectful way to address a skilled worker, a monk or a nun: 拜師父 "become someone's apprentice". It is a common address for a taxi driver, a repairman or a cook, and for a Buddhist monk. It is also written 師傅. The second syllable is neutral.

column3: Construction, to carry out building work: 施工中 "under construction", 道路施工 "roadworks", 施工安全. A sign at a site says 施工中，请小心. 施 "carry out" + 工 "work". The word is used for roads, buildings and repair work.
column6: Qiánmiàn zài shīgōng, qǐng ràolù.
column7: There are roadworks ahead, please take another road.
column9: Construction, to carry out building work: 施工中 "under construction", 道路施工 "roadworks", 施工安全. A sign at a site says 施工中，請小心. 施 "carry out" + 工 "work". The word is used for roads, buildings and repair work.

column3: Municipal, city-run: 市立医院 "city hospital", 市立图书馆, 市立大学. Used for schools, hospitals and institutions run by a city. 市 "city" + 立 "established". National ones are 国立, county ones 县立, private ones 私立. As in 台北市立动物园.
column6: Zhè shì yī suǒ shìlì túshūguǎn.
column7: This is a municipal library.
column9: Municipal, city-run: 市立醫院 "city hospital", 市立圖書館, 市立大學. Used for schools, hospitals and institutions run by a city. 市 "city" + 立 "established". National ones are 國立, county ones 縣立, private ones 私立. As in 台北市立動物園.
