column7: What did you say just now?
column9: Taiwanese Hokkien-based slang for "what": 蝦米 stands in for 什麼 in casual talk, as in 你說蝦米 "what are you saying". The characters are only a spelling of the sound of the Taiwanese words, so the meaning "shrimp" does not apply: the same two characters also name a small dried shrimp. Keep it for jokes and casual talk with friends, not formal speech.

column3: To dislike something because of a fault, to find it too much: 嫌贵 "find it too expensive", 嫌麻烦 "think it a bother", 嫌弃 "look down on". The thing that bothers you follows 嫌 directly, with no 很. It also means "suspicion" in 嫌犯 "suspect". 女 for the meaning and 兼 "combine" for the sound (xián, the same).
column6: Tā xián zhège fángjiān tài xiǎo.
column7: He finds this room too small.
column9: To dislike something because of a fault, to find it too much: 嫌貴 "find it too expensive", 嫌麻煩 "think it a bother", 嫌棄 "look down on". The thing that bothers you follows 嫌 directly, with no 很. It also means "suspicion" in 嫌犯 "suspect". 女 for the meaning and 兼 "combine" for the sound (xián, the same).

column3: Now, present, existing, mostly as part of other words: 现在 "now", 现代 "modern", 现场 "the scene", 出现 "to appear". On its own it is written-style: 现已退休 "now retired", 现任 "current (holder)". 王 "jade" + 见 "see" in the character; 见 also gives the sound (xiàn and jiàn are close).
column6: Tā xiàn yǐ tuìxiū, zhù zài xiāngxià.
column7: He has now retired and lives in the countryside.
column9: Now, present, existing, mostly as part of other words: 現在 "now", 現代 "modern", 現場 "the scene", 出現 "to appear". On its own it is written-style: 現已退休 "now retired", 現任 "current (holder)". 王 "jade" + 見 "see" in the character; 見 also gives the sound (xiàn and jiàn are close).

column3: Ready-made, already available, nothing to prepare: 现成的饭菜 "ready-made food", 现成的办法 "a ready solution", 现成的材料. It points to something that needs no more work or buying. 现 "present" + 成 "complete".
column6: Bīngxiāng lǐ yǒu xiànchéng de fàncài.
column7: There is ready-made food in the fridge.
column9: Ready-made, already available, nothing to prepare: 現成的飯菜 "ready-made food", 現成的辦法 "a ready solution", 現成的材料. It points to something that needs no more work or buying. 現 "present" + 成 "complete".

column3: Each other, before a verb, in words like 相信 "believe", 相爱 "love each other", 相同 "the same", 互相 "mutually". It is bound, so it is not used alone; it shows the action goes both ways. A different 相 is read xiàng "appearance" (相片, 照相). 木 "tree" and 目 "eye": an eye looking at a tree.
column6: Tāmen xiāng'ài le, juédìng jiéhūn.
column7: They fell in love and decided to marry.
column9: Each other, before a verb, in words like 相信 "believe", 相愛 "love each other", 相同 "the same", 互相 "mutually". It is bound, so it is not used alone; it shows the action goes both ways. A different 相 is read xiàng "appearance" (相片, 照相). 木 "tree" and 目 "eye": an eye looking at a tree.

column3: A lane or alley, the narrow street that runs off a larger one: 小巷 "small lane", 巷口 "the mouth of the lane". In Taiwan's addresses a 巷 comes after the road and before the 弄 and the number: 中山路二段十巷. 巷子 is the spoken word. In 巷, 共 gives the sound (xiàng, gòng).
column6: Wǒ jiā jiù zài zhè tiáo xiàng lǐ.
column7: My home is right in this lane.
column9: A lane or alley, the narrow street that runs off a larger one: 小巷 "small lane", 巷口 "the mouth of the lane". In Taiwan's addresses a 巷 comes after the road and before the 弄 and the number: 中山路二段十巷. 巷子 is the spoken word. In 巷, 共 gives the sound (xiàng, gòng).

column3: An alley or small lane, the spoken word for 巷: 小巷子 "a small alley", 巷子里的小吃店 "the snack shop in the alley". 巷 + 子, with 子 as the usual noun ending, neutral here. Classifier: 条.
column6: Nà jiā xiǎochīdiàn zài xiàngzi lǐ.
column7: That snack shop is in the alley.
column9: An alley or small lane, the spoken word for 巷: 小巷子 "a small alley", 巷子裡的小吃店 "the snack shop in the alley". 巷 + 子, with 子 as the usual noun ending, neutral here. Classifier: 條.

column3: Elephant: 大象 "elephant", 象鼻 "trunk", 象牙 "ivory". The character began as a picture of an elephant with its trunk and legs. The same 象 is in 印象 "impression", 现象 "phenomenon" and 形象 "image", where it means "appearance, shape". The animal itself is usually 大象.
column6: Dòngwùyuán lǐ yǒu yī tóu dàxiàng.
column7: There is an elephant in the zoo.
column9: Elephant: 大象 "elephant", 象鼻 "trunk", 象牙 "ivory". The character began as a picture of an elephant with its trunk and legs. The same 象 is in 印象 "impression", 現象 "phenomenon" and 形象 "image", where it means "appearance, shape". The animal itself is usually 大象.

column3: Unexpected, who would have thought: 想不到你也来了 "I never thought you would come too". It starts the sentence and shows surprise at something that has happened. 想 "think" + 不到 "not reach", so it is a thought that did not reach that result. The 不 in the middle is neutral in the dictionary's reading: xiǎngbudào. 没想到 means the same and is as common.
column6: Xiǎngbudào nǐ yě lái le!
column7: I never thought you would come too!
column9: Unexpected, who would have thought: 想不到你也來了 "I never thought you would come too". It starts the sentence and shows surprise at something that has happened. 想 "think" + 不到 "not reach", so it is a thought that did not reach that result. The 不 in the middle is neutral in the dictionary's reading: xiǎngbudào. 沒想到 means the same and is as common.

column3: Always, all along, about a habit or a past that goes on until now: 他向来很准时 "he is always punctual", 向来如此 "it has always been so". It goes before the verb and often comes with 都. It is a bit more written than 一直 and is used for a fixed trait, not for something that went on without a break.
column6: Tā xiànglái hěn zhǔnshí.
column7: He has always been punctual.
column9: Always, all along, about a habit or a past that goes on until now: 他向來很準時 "he is always punctual", 向來如此 "it has always been so". It goes before the verb and often comes with 都. It is a bit more written than 一直 and is used for a fixed trait, not for something that went on without a break.

column3: A meeting set up to see whether two people suit each other as marriage partners, a blind date arranged by family or friends: 去相亲 "go on a date to meet", 相亲对象 "the person one is introduced to". In Taiwan it is read xiàngqīn, the mainland xiāngqīn. 相 here means "to look at", as in 相片.
column6: Tā xià ge xīngqī yào qù xiāngqīn.
column7: She is going on a blind date next week.
column9: A meeting set up to see whether two people suit each other as marriage partners, a blind date arranged by family or friends: 去相親 "go on a date to meet", 相親對象 "the person one is introduced to". In Taiwan it is read xiàngqīn, the mainland xiāngqīn. 相 here means "to look at", as in 相片, and 親 includes 見 "see".

column3: An idiom for people who are close and warm toward one another: 相亲相爱的一家人 "a loving family", 兄弟姊妹要相亲相爱. It is used for family and friends, and puts 相 "each other" before both 亲 "be close" and 爱 "love". As a phrase it is warm and a little formal, often in wishes and in what a parent tells children.
column6: Xiōngdì jiěmèi yào xiāngqīnxiāng'ài.
column7: Brothers and sisters should love each other.
column9: An idiom for people who are close and warm toward one another: 相親相愛的一家人 "a loving family", 兄弟姊妹要相親相愛. It is used for family and friends, and puts 相 "each other" before both 親 "be close" and 愛 "love". As a phrase it is warm and a little formal, often in wishes and in what a parent tells children.

column3: To respond to a call or proposal by joining in: 响应号召 "answer the call", 响应环保 "support the environmental movement". It is a formal word often met in news about campaigns. 响 "echo, sound" + 应 "answer". 响 has 口 on its left and 向 for the sound; 应 is also the "answer" in 回应 and 反应.
column4: 很多人响应政府的号召。
column5: 很多人響應政府的號召。
column6: Hěn duō rén xiǎngyìng zhèngfǔ de hàozhào.
column7: Many people responded to the government's call.
column9: To respond to a call or proposal by joining in: 響應號召 "answer the call", 響應環保 "support the environmental movement". It is a formal word often met in news about campaigns. 響 "echo, sound" + 應 "answer". 響 has 音 "sound" below it and 鄉 for the sound; 應 is also the "answer" in 回應 and 反應.

column3: To enjoy a right, a benefit or a good thing, in a formal way: 享有权利 "enjoy rights", 享有盛名 "have a great reputation", 享有自由. It is used for things given or earned, such as rights, fame or a standard of living. Not for food or fun: that is 享受. 享 shows a shrine, a place of offerings.
column6: Gōngmín xiǎngyǒu yánlùn zìyóu.
column7: Citizens enjoy freedom of speech.
column9: To enjoy a right, a benefit or a good thing, in a formal way: 享有權利 "enjoy rights", 享有盛名 "have a great reputation", 享有自由. It is used for things given or earned, such as rights, fame or a standard of living. Not for food or fun: that is 享受. 享 shows a shrine, a place of offerings.

column3: To envy and admire someone for what they have or are: 我很羡慕你 "I really envy you", 令人羡慕 "enviable". It has no sense of hate, so it is gentler than 嫉妒. The object can be a person, a life or a talent. 羡 has 羊 "sheep" above and 慕 has 心 "heart" at its bottom: 慕 is a longing of the heart.
column4: 我很羡慕你可以去旅行。
column5: 我很羨慕你可以去旅行。
column6: Wǒ hěn xiànmù nǐ kěyǐ qù lǚxíng.
column7: I really envy you for being able to travel.
column9: To envy and admire someone for what they have or are: 我很羨慕你 "I really envy you", 令人羨慕 "enviable". It has no sense of hate, so it is gentler than 嫉妒. The object can be a person, a life or a talent. 羨 has 羊 "sheep" above and 慕 has 心 "heart" at its bottom: 慕 is a longing of the heart.

column3: Fresh milk, as sold in cartons and shops: 一瓶鲜奶 "a bottle of fresh milk", 鲜奶茶 "milk tea made with fresh milk", 鲜奶油 "cream". It sets fresh milk apart from milk powder; 牛奶 is the general word. 鲜 "fresh" has 鱼 "fish" as its meaning part.
column4: 我每天早上喝一杯鲜奶。
column5: 我每天早上喝一杯鮮奶。
column6: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang hē yī bēi xiānnǎi.
column7: Every morning I drink a glass of fresh milk.
column9: Fresh milk, as sold in cartons and shops: 一瓶鮮奶 "a bottle of fresh milk", 鮮奶茶 "milk tea made with fresh milk", 鮮奶油 "cream". It sets fresh milk apart from milk powder; 牛奶 is the general word. 鮮 "fresh" has 魚 "fish" as its meaning part.

column3: Fresh, bright blood: 鲜血直流 "blood flowing", 鲜血淋漓 "dripping with blood". It is the word used in stories and news of injuries, where 血 alone would be plain. Not used for medicine: the words there are 血液 and 抽血. 鲜 "fresh" + 血 "blood". 血 has a dish 皿 with a drop in it.
column6: Tā de shǒu shàng liúzhe xiānxuè.
column7: Fresh blood is running from his hand.
column9: Fresh, bright blood: 鮮血直流 "blood flowing", 鮮血淋漓 "dripping with blood". It is the word used in stories and news of injuries, where 血 alone would be plain. Not used for medicine: the words there are 血液 and 抽血. 鮮 "fresh" + 血 "blood". 血 has a dish 皿 with a drop in it.

column3: To disappear, to fade, to remove: 消失 "vanish", 消除 "get rid of", 消化 "digest", 消费 "spend", 消息 "news". It is bound, as a base for many words with the sense of becoming less or vanishing. In 不消 it also means "need": 不消说 "it goes without saying". The 氵 "water" is the meaning part and 肖 gives the sound.
column6: Tòngkǔ huì mànmàn xiāoshī.
column7: The pain will slowly go away.
column9: To disappear, to fade, to remove: 消失 "vanish", 消除 "get rid of", 消化 "digest", 消費 "spend", 消息 "news". It is bound, as a base for many words with the sense of becoming less or vanishing. In 不消 it also means "need": 不消說 "it goes without saying". The 氵 "water" is the meaning part and 肖 gives the sound.

column3: Urine, and "to urinate": 小便 and 大便 are the two plain, family words; 验小便 "to test urine". It is the plain, neutral word that fits a clinic or a family talk; 尿 is the blunt word. 小 "small" + 便 "relief, convenience".
column6: Tā jízhe qù xiǎobiàn.
column7: He was in a hurry to go and pee.
column9: Urine, and "to urinate": 小便 and 大便 are the two plain, family words; 驗小便 "to test urine". It is the plain, neutral word that fits a clinic or a family talk; 尿 is the blunt word. 小 "small" + 便 "relief, convenience".

column3: A school bus: 搭校车上学 "take the school bus to school", 校车路线 "bus route". 校 "school" + 车 "vehicle". The 车 is a picture of a cart seen from above.
column4: 孩子们每天搭校车上学。
column5: 孩子們每天搭校車上學。
column6: Háizimen měitiān dā xiàochē shàngxué.
column7: The children take the school bus to school every day.
column9: A school bus: 搭校車上學 "take the school bus to school", 校車路線 "bus route". 校 "school" + 車 "vehicle". The 車 is a picture of a cart seen from above.

column3: To know, a spoken word: 我晓得 "I know", 谁晓得 "who knows", 不晓得 "do not know". It is used like 知道 and is rather colloquial or regional. 晓 means "dawn, to understand", with 日 "sun" beside 尧: the day dawning is understanding. The second syllable is neutral: xiǎode.
column6: Wǒ bù xiǎode tā zhù zài nǎlǐ.
column7: I do not know where he lives.
column9: To know, a spoken word: 我曉得 "I know", 誰曉得 "who knows", 不曉得 "do not know". It is used like 知道 and is rather colloquial or regional. 曉 means "dawn, to understand", with 日 "sun" beside 堯: the day dawning is understanding. The second syllable is neutral: xiǎode.

column3: A street peddler or small vendor: 路边的小贩 "a vendor by the road", 流动小贩 "a mobile vendor". It points to someone selling goods or snacks from a stall or a cart, with no shop. 小 "small" + 贩 "trade", where 贝 "shell, money" stands for goods and 反 gives the sound (fàn).
column6: Yèshì lǐ yǒu hěn duō xiǎofàn.
column7: There are many vendors in the night market.
column9: A street peddler or small vendor: 路邊的小販 "a vendor by the road", 流動小販 "a mobile vendor". It points to someone selling goods or snacks from a stall or a cart, with no shop. 小 "small" + 販 "trade", where 貝 "shell, money" stands for goods and 反 gives the sound (fàn).

column3: The market for a product, how well it sells: 销路很好 "sells well", 打开销路 "open up a market", 销路不佳. 销 "sell" + 路 "road, way", so it is the road along which goods travel to buyers. 销 has 钅 "metal" on the left from the older sense of melting metal. 路 has 足 "foot" for the meaning.
column6: Zhè zhǒng chǎnpǐn de xiāolù hěn hǎo.
column7: This product sells very well.
column9: The market for a product, how well it sells: 銷路很好 "sells well", 打開銷路 "open up a market", 銷路不佳. 銷 "sell" + 路 "road, way", so it is the road along which goods travel to buyers. 銷 has 釒 "metal" on the left from the older sense of melting metal. 路 has 足 "foot" for the meaning.

column3: Wheat: 小麦粉 "wheat flour", 小麦田 "wheat field". 大麦 is barley. Bread, noodles and dumpling wrappers are made from it. The character 麦 has 龶 above 夂.
column6: Miànbāo shì yòng xiǎomài zuò de.
column7: Bread is made from wheat.
column9: Wheat: 小麥粉 "wheat flour", 小麥田 "wheat field". 大麥 is barley. Bread, noodles and dumpling wrappers are made from it. The character 麥 has 來 above 夂, and 來 was once also a picture of wheat.

column3: To wipe out, to destroy completely: 消灭敌人 "wipe out the enemy", 消灭蚊子 "kill off the mosquitoes", 消灭贫穷. It is a strong word for doing away with something harmful, so that it no longer exists. 消 "melt away" + 灭 "extinguish". 灭 has 一 above 火 "fire".
column6: Wǒmen yào xiāomiè wénzi.
column7: We must wipe out the mosquitoes.
column9: To wipe out, to destroy completely: 消滅敵人 "wipe out the enemy", 消滅蚊子 "kill off the mosquitoes", 消滅貧窮. It is a strong word for doing away with something harmful, so that it no longer exists. 消 "melt away" + 滅 "extinguish". 滅 has 氵 "water" for putting out a fire, as its 烕 shows a flame.

column3: Stingy, petty, and "narrow-minded": 他很小气 "he is stingy", 小气鬼 "a miser". It may be about money, or about not letting things go. Its opposite is 大方 "generous". 小 "small" + 气 "spirit", so it is a small-spirited person.
column6: Tā hěn xiǎoqì, cónglái bù qǐngkè.
column7: He is stingy and never treats anyone.
column9: Stingy, petty, and "narrow-minded": 他很小氣 "he is stingy", 小氣鬼 "a miser". It may be about money, or about not letting things go. Its opposite is 大方 "generous". 小 "small" + 氣 "spirit", so it is a small-spirited person. 氣 has 米 "rice" inside it.

column3: A smile, an expression of smiling: 脸上带着笑容 "a smile on one's face", 露出笑容 "show a smile". The smile that is seen on a face, as against 笑 the act. 笑 "laugh" + 容 "appearance". 容 also means "hold" and shows up in 内容 and 容易.
column4: 她脸上带着温暖的笑容。
column5: 她臉上帶著溫暖的笑容。
column6: Tā liǎn shàng dàizhe wēnnuǎn de xiàoróng.
column7: She has a warm smile on her face.
column9: A smile, an expression of smiling: 臉上帶著笑容 "a smile on one's face", 露出笑容 "show a smile". The smile that is seen on a face, as against 笑 the act. 笑 "laugh" + 容 "appearance". 容 also means "hold" and shows up in 內容 and 容易.

column3: The lower leg, from knee to ankle, the calf and shin: 小腿很痠 "the calves ache", 小腿肌肉 "calf muscle". The thigh is 大腿. 腿 "leg" has ⺼ "flesh" on the left for a body part and 退 on the right for the sound, which sounds close (tuǐ, tuì).
column4: 走了一天的路，我的小腿很酸。
column5: 走了一天的路，我的小腿很痠。
column6: Zǒu le yī tiān de lù, wǒ de xiǎotuǐ hěn suān.
column7: After walking all day, my calves ache.
column9: The lower leg, from knee to ankle, the calf and shin: 小腿很痠 "the calves ache", 小腿肌肉 "calf muscle". The thigh is 大腿. 腿 "leg" has ⺼ "flesh" on the left for a body part and 退 on the right for the sound, which sounds close (tuǐ, tuì).

column3: A late-night snack, the meal eaten after dinner and before bed: 吃消夜 "have a late-night snack", 去吃消夜. It is written both 消夜 and 宵夜; they are the same word.
column4: 我们看完电影去吃消夜。
column5: 我們看完電影去吃消夜。
column6: Wǒmen kàn wán diànyǐng qù chī xiāoyè.
column7: After the movie we go for a late-night snack.
column9: A late-night snack, the meal eaten after dinner and before bed: 吃消夜 "have a late-night snack", 去吃消夜. It is written both 消夜 and 宵夜; they are the same word.

column3: A late-night snack: 吃宵夜 "have a snack late at night", 宵夜场. 宵 means "night" and has 宀 "roof" with 肖 as the sound, and 夜 is "night" too. It is the same word as 消夜, which is also seen. It is a meal taken after the evening meal.
column6: Yèshì lǐ de xiāoyè hěn hǎochī.
column7: The late-night snacks at the night market are delicious.
column9: A late-night snack: 吃宵夜 "have a snack late at night", 宵夜場. 宵 means "night" and has 宀 "roof" with 肖 as the sound, and 夜 is "night" too. It is the same word as 消夜, which is also seen. It is a meal taken after the evening meal.

column3: A schoolmate, someone from the same school: 校友会 "alumni association", 杰出校友 "an outstanding alumnus". It names a person who studied at the same school, usually after they have graduated. 校 "school" + 友 "friend". 友 is two hands 又, joined.
column4: 我们学校的校友遍布世界各地。
column5: 我們學校的校友遍布世界各地。
column6: Wǒmen xuéxiào de xiàoyǒu biànbù shìjiè gèdì.
column7: Our school's alumni are found all over the world.
column9: A schoolmate, someone from the same school: 校友會 "alumni association", 傑出校友 "an outstanding alumnus". It names a person who studied at the same school, usually after they have graduated. 校 "school" + 友 "friend". 友 is two hands 又, joined.

column3: A colloquial word for a boy or fellow, often playful or a bit disrespectful: 这小子 "this guy", 臭小子 "you little rascal", 小子 as how an older person addresses a youth. 子 is neutral in this word, xiǎozi. It is not used politely and not in writing; with strangers it could sound rude. 小 "small" + 子 "son, child".
column6: Zhè xiǎozi zhēn cōngmíng!
column7: This kid is really clever!
column9: A colloquial word for a boy or fellow, often playful or a bit disrespectful: 這小子 "this guy", 臭小子 "you little rascal", 小子 as how an older person addresses a youth. 子 is neutral in this word, xiǎozi. It is not used politely and not in writing; with strangers it could sound rude. 小 "small" + 子 "son, child".

column3: To play chess: 下象棋 "play Chinese chess", 下围棋 "play go", 下西洋棋 "play Western chess". The verb for board games is 下, not 玩 or 打: you "go down" a piece. Card games take 打 (打牌), and the board games here take 下. 棋 has 木 "wood" for the pieces, with 其 for the sound (qí, the same).
column4: 爷爷喜欢在公园里下棋。
column5: 爺爺喜歡在公園裡下棋。
column6: Yéye xǐhuān zài gōngyuán lǐ xiàqí.
column7: Grandpa likes playing chess in the park.
column9: To play chess: 下象棋 "play Chinese chess", 下圍棋 "play go", 下西洋棋 "play Western chess". The verb for board games is 下, not 玩 or 打: you "go down" a piece. Card games take 打 (打牌), and the board games here take 下. 棋 has 木 "wood" for the pieces, with 其 for the sound (qí, the same).

column3: Afternoon tea: 喝下午茶 "have afternoon tea", 下午茶时间, 下午茶套餐 "an afternoon tea set". It is a light meal of cakes, sandwiches and drinks in the afternoon, often at a cafe with friends. 下午 "afternoon" + 茶 "tea". 午 "noon" is an old picture of a pestle.
column4: 我们约好星期六一起喝下午茶。
column5: 我們約好星期六一起喝下午茶。
column6: Wǒmen yuē hǎo xīngqīliù yīqǐ hē xiàwǔchá.
column7: We have arranged to have afternoon tea together on Saturday.
column9: Afternoon tea: 喝下午茶 "have afternoon tea", 下午茶時間, 下午茶套餐 "an afternoon tea set". It is a light meal of cakes, sandwiches and drinks in the afternoon, often at a cafe with friends. 下午 "afternoon" + 茶 "tea". 午 "noon" is an old picture of a pestle.

column3: The lower reaches of a river, and in a business sense the later steps: 河的下游 "the lower part of the river", 下游厂商 "firms later in the supply chain", the reverse of 上游. 下 "down" + 游, here "reaches" of the stream. 游 has 氵 "water" and also means "swim", as in 游泳.
column4: 这条河的下游有很多村庄。
column5: 這條河的下游有很多村莊。
column6: Zhè tiáo hé de xiàyóu yǒu hěn duō cūnzhuāng.
column7: There are many villages on the lower reaches of this river.
column9: The lower reaches of a river, and in a business sense the later steps: 河的下游 "the lower part of the river", 下游廠商 "firms later in the supply chain", the reverse of 上游. 下 "down" + 游, here "reaches" of the stream. 游 has 氵 "water" and also means "swim", as in 游泳.

column3: A cell, in biology: 细胞分裂 "cell division", 脑细胞 "brain cell", 癌细胞 "cancer cell". 细 "fine, tiny" + 胞 "womb, sac". 胞 has ⺼ "flesh" and 包 "wrap" and appears in 同胞 "compatriot, born of the same mother". It is the basic unit living things are made of.
column4: 动物和植物都由细胞组成。
column5: 動物和植物都由細胞組成。
column6: Dòngwù hé zhíwù dōu yóu xìbāo zǔchéng.
column7: Animals and plants are all made of cells.
column9: A cell, in biology: 細胞分裂 "cell division", 腦細胞 "brain cell", 癌細胞 "cancer cell". 細 "fine, tiny" + 胞 "womb, sac". 胞 has ⺼ "flesh" and 包 "wrap" and appears in 同胞 "compatriot, born of the same mother". It is the basic unit living things are made of.

column3: A blood vessel, a vein or an artery: 血管破裂 "a vessel bursts", 心血管疾病 "cardiovascular disease", 血管很细. 血 "blood" + 管 "pipe". 管 has 竹 "bamboo" above it, for the pipe. Health words use it a lot: 心血管 "heart and blood vessels", 脑血管.
column6: Xuèguǎn lǐ liúdòngzhe xuèyè.
column7: Blood flows in the blood vessels.
column9: A blood vessel, a vein or an artery: 血管破裂 "a vessel bursts", 心血管疾病 "cardiovascular disease", 血管很細. 血 "blood" + 管 "pipe". 管 has 竹 "bamboo" above it, for the pipe. Health words use it a lot: 心血管 "heart and blood vessels", 腦血管.

column3: Blood type: 你是什么血型 "what is your blood type", A型, B型, O型, AB型. 血 "blood" + 型 "type, model". 型 has 土 "earth" below because it began as a mold made of clay.
column6: Nǐ shì shénme xuèxíng?
column7: What is your blood type?
column9: Blood type: 你是什麼血型 "what is your blood type", A型, B型, O型, AB型. 血 "blood" + 型 "type, model". 型 has 土 "earth" below because it began as a mold made of clay.

column3: Blood, as a bodily fluid, the technical and written word: 血液循环 "blood circulation", 血液检查 "blood test", 血液病. 血 is the plain word for blood; 血液 is used in medicine and in articles. It can also mean "lifeblood" of a business. 液 "liquid" has 氵 "water" and 夜 for the sound (yè, the same).
column6: Yīshēng yào jiǎnchá tā de xuèyè.
column7: The doctor is going to examine his blood.
column9: Blood, as a bodily fluid, the technical and written word: 血液循環 "blood circulation", 血液檢查 "blood test", 血液病. 血 is the plain word for blood; 血液 is used in medicine and in articles. It can also mean "lifeblood" of a business. 液 "liquid" has 氵 "water" and 夜 for the sound (yè, the same).

column3: A son's wife, a daughter-in-law: 娶媳妇 "take a wife for the son", 媳妇儿. The dictionary also lists "wife of a younger brother". Both characters are female 女: 妇 has 女 beside 彐, and 媳 has 息 for the sound (xī, the same). Your own 老婆 or 太太 is "wife"; this word is for your son's.
column6: Tā shì wǒ jiā de xífù.
column7: She is the wife of the son in our family.
column9: A son's wife, a daughter-in-law: 娶媳婦 "take a wife for the son", 媳婦兒. The dictionary also lists "wife of a younger brother". Both characters are female 女: 婦 has a woman with a broom 帚, and 媳 has 息 for the sound (xī, the same). Your own 老婆 or 太太 is "wife"; this word is for your son's.

column3: Wine at a wedding, and so the wedding feast: 吃喜酒 or 喝喜酒 "to go to a wedding banquet", 请你吃喜酒 "I am inviting you to my wedding". It is what you say when you tell friends of a marriage: they will be invited to drink the happy wine. 喜 "joy" + 酒 "alcohol". 酒 has the water 氵 and a jar 酉.
column4: 下个月我们请你吃喜酒。
column5: 下個月我們請你吃喜酒。
column6: Xià ge yuè wǒmen qǐng nǐ chī xǐjiǔ.
column7: Next month we will invite you to our wedding feast.
column9: Wine at a wedding, and so the wedding feast: 吃喜酒 or 喝喜酒 "to go to a wedding banquet", 請你吃喜酒 "I am inviting you to my wedding". It is what you say when you tell friends of a marriage: they will be invited to drink the happy wine. 喜 "joy" + 酒 "alcohol". 酒 has the water 氵 and a jar 酉.

column3: Bacteria, germs: 细菌感染 "bacterial infection", 杀死细菌 "kill bacteria", 有益的细菌. 细 "tiny" + 菌 "fungus, microbe". 菌 has 艹 "plant" above, and the word 菌 alone also means "mushroom, fungus". 病毒 is a virus, a different thing from 细菌.
column4: 手上有很多细菌，吃饭前要洗手。
column5: 手上有很多細菌，吃飯前要洗手。
column6: Shǒu shàng yǒu hěn duō xìjūn, chīfàn qián yào xǐshǒu.
column7: There are many germs on your hands, so wash them before eating.
column9: Bacteria, germs: 細菌感染 "bacterial infection", 殺死細菌 "kill bacteria", 有益的細菌. 細 "tiny" + 菌 "fungus, microbe". 菌 has 艹 "plant" above, and the word 菌 alone also means "mushroom, fungus". 病毒 is a virus, a different thing from 細菌.

column3: The itinerary or schedule of a trip, and the distance travelled: 行程表 "itinerary", 安排行程 "arrange the schedule", 今天的行程 "today's plans". It is about the plan for a trip and also for a busy day of a person. 行 is read xíng here, "to travel", and 程 "distance, course".
column4: 旅行社帮我们安排了行程。
column5: 旅行社幫我們安排了行程。
column6: Lǚxíngshè bāng wǒmen ānpái le xíngchéng.
column7: The travel agency has arranged the itinerary for us.
column9: The itinerary or schedule of a trip, and the distance travelled: 行程表 "itinerary", 安排行程 "arrange the schedule", 今天的行程 "today's plans". It is about the plan for a trip and also for a busy day of a person. 行 is read xíng here, "to travel", and 程 "distance, course".

column3: Starlight: 星光闪闪 "stars twinkling", 在星光下 "under the starlight", 星光大道. It is the light of the stars. 星 "star" + 光 "light". 光 shows a person with fire above their head.
column4: 晚上我们在星光下散步。
column5: 晚上我們在星光下散步。
column6: Wǎnshang wǒmen zài xīngguāng xià sànbù.
column7: In the evening we walked under the starlight.
column9: Starlight: 星光閃閃 "stars twinkling", 在星光下 "under the starlight", 星光大道. It is the light of the stars. 星 "star" + 光 "light". 光 shows a person with fire above their head.

column3: The mind and spirit, the inner self: 心灵鸡汤 "chicken soup for the soul", 心灵成长 "personal growth", 心灵受伤 "an emotional hurt". It talks of what is inside a person, deeper than 心情 "mood". 心 "heart" + 灵 "spirit". 灵 has 彐 on top and 火 "fire" below.
column4: 这本书能安慰人的心灵。
column5: 這本書能安慰人的心靈。
column6: Zhè běn shū néng ānwèi rén de xīnlíng.
column7: This book can comfort people's souls.
column9: The mind and spirit, the inner self: 心靈雞湯 "chicken soup for the soul", 心靈成長 "personal growth", 心靈受傷 "an emotional hurt". It talks of what is inside a person, deeper than 心情 "mood". 心 "heart" + 靈 "spirit". 靈 has 雨 "rain" on top, three mouths and 巫 "shaman" below.

column3: In one's eyes, in one's mind, how someone sees or rates a person: 在我心目中 "in my eyes", 在他心目中，妈妈最重要. It always appears in the pattern 在 + someone + 心目中. 心 "heart" + 目 "eye" + 中 "within". It is used for ideals and ranking: someone's picture of how things are or should be.
column4: 在我心目中，妈妈是最伟大的人。
column5: 在我心目中，媽媽是最偉大的人。
column6: Zài wǒ xīnmùzhōng, māma shì zuì wěidà de rén.
column7: In my eyes, my mother is the greatest person.
column9: In one's eyes, in one's mind, how someone sees or rates a person: 在我心目中 "in my eyes", 在他心目中，媽媽最重要. It always appears in the pattern 在 + someone + 心目中. 心 "heart" + 目 "eye" + 中 "within". It is used for ideals and ranking: someone's picture of how things are or should be.

column3: What a person really feels inside, their inner voice: 说出心声 "speak one's mind", 倾听心声 "listen to what is in their hearts", 孩子的心声. It is a written word for feelings that are rarely told. 心 "heart" + 声 "voice". 声 has 士 on top.
column4: 老师愿意倾听学生的心声。
column5: 老師願意傾聽學生的心聲。
column6: Lǎoshī yuànyì qīngtīng xuésheng de xīnshēng.
column7: The teacher is willing to listen to what students really feel.
column9: What a person really feels inside, their inner voice: 說出心聲 "speak one's mind", 傾聽心聲 "listen to what is in their hearts", 孩子的心聲. It is a written word for feelings that are rarely told. 心 "heart" + 聲 "voice". 聲 has 耳 "ear" below, and its upper part 殸 gives the sound (shēng, the same).

column3: New in style, of the latest type: 新式汽车 "the latest model car", 新式教育, 新式武器. It is used for a pattern or a type in contrast with 旧式. 新 "new" + 式 "style, type". 式 is a typical suffix in Chinese for style: 日式 "Japanese-style", 中式 "Chinese-style", 西式 "Western-style". 新 shows an axe 斤 and a tree: freshly cut.
column4: 这是一种新式的洗衣机。
column5: 這是一種新式的洗衣機。
column6: Zhè shì yī zhǒng xīnshì de xǐyījī.
column7: This is a new type of washing machine.
column9: New in style, of the latest type: 新式汽車 "the latest model car", 新式教育, 新式武器. It is used for a pattern or a type in contrast with 舊式. 新 "new" + 式 "style, type". 式 is a typical suffix in Chinese for style: 日式 "Japanese-style", 中式 "Chinese-style", 西式 "Western-style". 新 shows an axe 斤 and a tree: freshly cut.

column3: Salary, pay: 领薪水 "to draw a salary", 薪水很高 "a high salary", 加薪水. Literally it is "firewood and water", the daily needs. 薪水 is the spoken word; 薪资 appears in more formal writing and job ads.
column6: Tā de xīnshuǐ bù tài gāo.
column7: His salary is not very high.
column9: Salary, pay: 領薪水 "to draw a salary", 薪水很高 "a high salary", 加薪水. Literally it is "firewood and water", the daily needs. 薪水 is the spoken word; 薪資 appears in more formal writing and job ads.

column3: Heartbeat, and "to beat" of the heart: 心跳加快 "the heart beats faster", 量心跳 "take the pulse", 心跳声. 心 "heart" + 跳 "jump". It is a word of the body and also of feelings: 心跳加速 may be fear or love. 跳 has 足 "foot" for jumping and 兆 for the sound (tiào, zhào, close).
column6: Wǒ jǐnzhāng de xīntiào hěn kuài.
column7: I was so nervous that my heart beat fast.
column9: Heartbeat, and "to beat" of the heart: 心跳加快 "the heart beats faster", 量心跳 "take the pulse", 心跳聲. 心 "heart" + 跳 "jump". It is a word of the body and also of feelings: 心跳加速 may be fear or love. 跳 has 足 "foot" for jumping and 兆 for the sound (tiào, zhào, close).

column3: Newly arisen, emerging: 新兴产业 "an emerging industry", 新兴市场 "emerging markets", 新兴国家. It goes before a noun and describes something that is rising now, usually in business, news and economics. 新 "new" + 兴 "rise". 兴 also is in 兴趣 "interest", where it is read xìng, but here it is xīng.
column6: Xīnxīng hángyè yuèláiyuè duō.
column7: There are more and more emerging industries.
column9: Newly arisen, emerging: 新興產業 "an emerging industry", 新興市場 "emerging markets", 新興國家. It goes before a noun and describes something that is rising now, usually in business, news and economics. 新 "new" + 興 "rise". 興 also is in 興趣 "interest", where it is read xìng, but here it is xīng.

column3: A belief, faith, usually religious: 宗教信仰 "religious belief", 有信仰 "have a faith", 信仰自由 "freedom of belief". It can also be a firm conviction that guides a life. 信 "believe" + 仰 "look up to", so it is a belief one looks up to. Both characters have 亻 "person" on the left.
column4: 每个人都有自己的信仰。
column5: 每個人都有自己的信仰。
column6: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de xìnyǎng.
column7: Everyone has their own faith.
column9: A belief, faith, usually religious: 宗教信仰 "religious belief", 有信仰 "have a faith", 信仰自由 "freedom of belief". It can also be a firm conviction that guides a life. 信 "believe" + 仰 "look up to", so it is a belief one looks up to. Both characters have 亻 "person" on the left.

column3: Trustworthiness, credit: 守信用 "keep one's word", 没有信用 "cannot be trusted", 信用卡 "credit card", 信用不好 "bad credit". It covers both a person's good name for keeping promises and the credit a bank gives. 信 "trust" + 用 "use".
column4: 他很守信用，说到就做到。
column5: 他很守信用，說到就做到。
column6: Tā hěn shǒu xìnyòng, shuō dào jiù zuò dào.
column7: He keeps his word and does what he says.
column9: Trustworthiness, credit: 守信用 "keep one's word", 沒有信用 "cannot be trusted", 信用卡 "credit card", 信用不好 "bad credit". It covers both a person's good name for keeping promises and the credit a bank gives. 信 "trust" + 用 "use".

column3: The heart as an organ: 心脏病 "heart disease", 心脏不好 "a weak heart", 心脏手术. 心 alone is the word for the heart in feelings, and 心脏 is the one for the body part. In 脏 the ⺼ "flesh" shows an organ, and 庄 gives the sound. 脏 is also the organ in 肺脏 and 内脏.
column6: Yéye de xīnzàng bù tài hǎo.
column7: Grandpa's heart is not very good.
column9: The heart as an organ: 心臟病 "heart disease", 心臟不好 "a weak heart", 心臟手術. 心 alone is the word for the heart in feelings, and 心臟 is the one for the body part. In 臟 the ⺼ "flesh" shows an organ, and 藏 gives the sound (zàng, the same). 臟 is also the organ in 肺臟 and 內臟.

column3: To take in, to absorb, and in particular to draw out a lesson or nourishment: 吸取教训 "learn the lesson", 吸取经验 "draw on experience", 吸取养分. It usually takes 教训 or 经验 as its object. 吸 "inhale" + 取 "take". 取 shows a hand 又 taking an ear 耳, an old hunting rite.
column4: 我们要从失败中吸取教训。
column5: 我們要從失敗中吸取教訓。
column6: Wǒmen yào cóng shībài zhōng xīqǔ jiàoxùn.
column7: We must learn a lesson from our failure.
column9: To take in, to absorb, and in particular to draw out a lesson or nourishment: 吸取教訓 "learn the lesson", 吸取經驗 "draw on experience", 吸取養分. It usually takes 教訓 or 經驗 as its object. 吸 "inhale" + 取 "take". 取 shows a hand 又 taking an ear 耳, an old hunting rite.

column3: To take in by sucking or inhaling, mostly drugs: 吸食毒品 "take drugs", and for an insect, to feed on nectar or blood. It is used in news and in the law, not for ordinary eating or drinking, where you say 吃, 喝 or, for tobacco, 抽烟. 吸 "inhale" + 食 "eat". 食 is a dish with a lid on top.
column6: Xīshí dúpǐn shì fànfǎ de.
column7: Taking drugs is against the law.
column9: To take in by sucking or inhaling, mostly drugs: 吸食毒品 "take drugs", and for an insect, to feed on nectar or blood. It is used in news and in the law, not for ordinary eating or drinking, where you say 吃, 喝 or, for tobacco, 抽菸. 吸 "inhale" + 食 "eat". 食 is a dish with a lid on top.

column3: To correct and amend, a formal word for fixing a plan, text or rule: 修正错误 "correct mistakes", 修正案 "an amendment", 修正方案. It is for something already made that is changed to make it right. 修 "mend" + 正 "right, correct". 正 has a foot 止 above a line, to go straight toward a goal.
column4: 老师请我修正报告里的错误。
column5: 老師請我修正報告裡的錯誤。
column6: Lǎoshī qǐng wǒ xiūzhèng bàogào lǐ de cuòwù.
column7: The teacher asked me to correct the mistakes in my report.
column9: To correct and amend, a formal word for fixing a plan, text or rule: 修正錯誤 "correct mistakes", 修正案 "an amendment", 修正方案. It is for something already made that is changed to make it right. 修 "mend" + 正 "right, correct". 正 has a foot 止 above a line, to go straight toward a goal.

column3: Tiny, very fine: 细小的声音 "a tiny sound", 细小的零件 "tiny parts", 细小的伤口. It is used for size and detail, and is written style. 细 "thin, fine" + 小 "small", two words of one meaning put together. 细 has 糸 "thread" on the left; the right part 田 is not the field but an old part standing for the sound.
column4: 这块手表的零件非常细小。
column5: 這塊手錶的零件非常細小。
column6: Zhè kuài shǒubiǎo de língjiàn fēicháng xìxiǎo.
column7: The parts of this watch are very tiny.
column9: Tiny, very fine: 細小的聲音 "a tiny sound", 細小的零件 "tiny parts", 細小的傷口. It is used for size and detail, and is written style. 細 "thin, fine" + 小 "small", two words of one meaning put together. 細 has 糸 "thread" on the left; the right part 田 is not the field but an old part standing for the sound.

column3: To allow, to permit: 不许 "do not allow", 允许, 也许 "perhaps", 或许, 许多 "many". On its own it is more literary than 让 or 准. 不许 is the form you will most often hear, as in a strict order: 不许说话. It also means "to promise" in 许诺 and 许愿. 讠 "speech" is the meaning part and 午 the sound (xǔ, wǔ).
column6: Tā bù xǔ háizi wán shǒujī.
column7: He does not let the child play with a phone.
column9: To allow, to permit: 不許 "do not allow", 允許, 也許 "perhaps", 或許, 許多 "many". On its own it is more literary than 讓 or 准. 不許 is the form you will most often hear, as in a strict order: 不許說話. It also means "to promise" in 許諾 and 許願. 言 "speech" is the meaning part and 午 the sound (xǔ, wǔ).

column3: To hang, to be suspended: 悬在空中 "hang in the air", 悬挂, 悬崖 "cliff". It also means "to be unresolved, hanging": 悬案 "an unsolved case". It is a written word; to hang up a picture you say 挂. The character began as just 县 (today "county"); 心 "heart" was added below it later.
column6: Yuèliàng gāogāo xuán zài tiānkōng zhōng.
column7: The moon hangs high in the sky.
column9: To hang, to be suspended: 懸在空中 "hang in the air", 懸掛, 懸崖 "cliff". It also means "to be unresolved, hanging": 懸案 "an unsolved case". It is a written word; to hang up a picture you say 掛. The character began as just 縣 (today "county"); 心 "heart" was added below it later.

column3: Boots: 一双靴 "a pair of boots", 皮靴 "leather boots", 雨靴. It is the character in names of kinds of boots, while the spoken word for a pair is 靴子. 靴 has 革 "leather" on the left, since boots were made of it, and 化 on the right for the sound (xuē, huà; the sound has changed).
column6: Tā chuānzhe yī shuāng hēisè de xuē.
column7: She is wearing a pair of black boots.
column9: Boots: 一雙靴 "a pair of boots", 皮靴 "leather boots", 雨靴. It is the character in names of kinds of boots, while the spoken word for a pair is 靴子. 靴 has 革 "leather" on the left, since boots were made of it, and 化 on the right for the sound (xuē, huà; the sound has changed).

column3: Boots, the spoken word: 一双靴子 "a pair of boots", 穿靴子 "wear boots", 长靴 "tall boots". 靴 "boot" + 子, the common noun ending, which is neutral here: xuēzi.
column6: Dōngtiān tā xǐhuan chuān xuēzi.
column7: In winter she likes to wear boots.
column9: Boots, the spoken word: 一雙靴子 "a pair of boots", 穿靴子 "wear boots", 長靴 "tall boots". 靴 "boot" + 子, the common noun ending, which is neutral here: xuēzi.

column3: Snowflakes: 雪花飘落 "snowflakes drift down", 一片雪花. Also in 雪花冰, a Taiwanese shaved-ice dessert. 雪 "snow" + 花 "flower", so snow flowers. Of the characters, 雪 has 雨 "rain" on top, as other weather words do (雷, 雾).
column4: 雪花一片一片地落下来。
column5: 雪花一片一片地落下來。
column6: Xuěhuā yī piàn yī piàn de luò xiàlái.
column7: The snowflakes fall one by one.
column9: Snowflakes: 雪花飄落 "snowflakes drift down", 一片雪花. Also in 雪花冰, a Taiwanese shaved-ice dessert. 雪 "snow" + 花 "flower", so snow flowers. Of the characters, 雪 has 雨 "rain" on top, as other weather words do (雷, 霧).

column3: To cut down, to reduce, a formal word for amounts and spending: 削减预算 "cut the budget", 削减人员 "cut staff", 大幅削减. The thing cut is often money or a number of people. 削 "pare, cut" + 减 "reduce". 削 has 刂 "knife" on the right; here it is read xuē, though the same character is xiāo in 削皮 "peel".
column6: Gōngsī juédìng xuējiǎn kāizhī.
column7: The company has decided to cut spending.
column9: To cut down, to reduce, a formal word for amounts and spending: 削減預算 "cut the budget", 削減人員 "cut staff", 大幅削減. The thing cut is often money or a number of people. 削 "pare, cut" + 減 "reduce". 削 has 刂 "knife" on the right; here it is read xuē, though the same character is xiāo in 削皮 "peel".

column3: Educational background, the level of schooling someone has: 高学历 "high qualifications", 大学学历, 学历证明. It is the word on job ads: 学历不限 "no education requirement". 学 "study" + 历 "pass through, experience". Compare 经历 "experience" and 历史 "history", with the same 历.
column4: 这份工作要求大学以上学历。
column5: 這份工作要求大學以上學歷。
column6: Zhè fèn gōngzuò yāoqiú dàxué yǐshàng xuélì.
column7: This job requires a university education or higher.
column9: Educational background, the level of schooling someone has: 高學歷 "high qualifications", 大學學歷, 學歷證明. It is the word on job ads: 學歷不限 "no education requirement". 學 "study" + 歷 "pass through, experience". Compare 經歷 "experience" and 歷史 "history", with the same 歷.

column3: One's studies or schoolwork: 学业成绩 "academic results", 完成学业 "finish one's studies", 学业压力 "pressure from schoolwork". It speaks of studying as a whole, over years, and is more formal than 功课, which is homework. 学 "study" + 业 "work, task". 学 shows a building with a child under it.
column4: 为了学业，他搬到了台北。
column5: 為了學業，他搬到了台北。
column6: Wèile xuéyè, tā bāndào le Táiběi.
column7: He moved to Taipei for his studies.
column9: One's studies or schoolwork: 學業成績 "academic results", 完成學業 "finish one's studies", 學業壓力 "pressure from schoolwork". It speaks of studying as a whole, over years, and is more formal than 功課, which is homework. 學 "study" + 業 "work, task". 學 shows a building with a child under it.

column3: To seek, to look for: 寻找 "look for", 寻求 "seek", 寻人启事 "a notice for a missing person", 寻宝. It is a written verb, and it is bound in most uses. In speech people say 找.
column6: Wǒ dàochù xúnzhǎo wǒ de yàoshi.
column7: I looked everywhere for my keys.
column9: To seek, to look for: 尋找 "look for", 尋求 "seek", 尋人啟事 "a notice for a missing person", 尋寶. It is a written verb, and it is bound in most uses. In speech people say 找.

column3: To circulate, to go round and round: 血液循环 "blood circulation", 恶性循环 "a vicious circle", 空气循环, 循环使用 "reuse". It describes a cycle that returns to its beginning. 循 "follow" + 环 "ring". 环 has 王 "jade" on the left, since a ring or bracelet is made of jade, and 不 for the sound.
column4: 这个系统可以让水不断循环。
column5: 這個系統可以讓水不斷循環。
column6: Zhège xìtǒng kěyǐ ràng shuǐ bùduàn xúnhuán.
column7: This system keeps the water circulating.
column9: To circulate, to go round and round: 血液循環 "blood circulation", 惡性循環 "a vicious circle", 空氣循環, 循環使用 "reuse". It describes a cycle that returns to its beginning. 循 "follow" + 環 "ring". 環 has 王 "jade" on the left, since a ring or bracelet is made of jade, and 睘 for the sound (huán).

column3: To make a wish, to wish upon something: 许愿 "make a wish", 许愿池 "wishing well", 对流星许愿 "wish on a shooting star". At a temple it can also mean to promise the gods something in return, 许愿 and then 还愿. 许 "promise" + 愿 "wish". 愿 has 心 "heart" for the mind and 原 for the sound (yuàn, yuán).
column6: Tā duìzhe liúxīng xǔyuàn.
column7: She made a wish on a shooting star.
column9: To make a wish, to wish upon something: 許願 "make a wish", 許願池 "wishing well", 對流星許願 "wish on a shooting star". At a temple it can also mean to promise the gods something in return, 許願 and then 還願. 許 "promise" + 願 "wish". 願 has 頁 "head" for the mind and 原 for the sound (yuàn, yuán).

column3: Notes or points one has to know: 乘客须知 "notice to passengers", 入园须知 "visitor rules", 考试须知. It is a heading on signs and printed instructions that lists what people must do or know. 须 "must" + 知 "know". 须 shows hair 彡 on a head 页, a beard; 知 has 口 "mouth" and 矢.
column6: Qǐng xiān yuèdú chéngkè xūzhī.
column7: Please read the notice for passengers first.
column9: Notes or points one has to know: 乘客須知 "notice to passengers", 入園須知 "visitor rules", 考試須知. It is a heading on signs and printed instructions that lists what people must do or know. 須 "must" + 知 "know". 須 shows hair 彡 on a head 頁, a beard; 知 has 口 "mouth" and 矢.

column3: Along, "to follow along": 沿着河边走 "walk along the river", 沿路 "along the road", 沿海 "the coast", 沿途. It comes before the place or line that something follows and links with 着. As a verb it also means "to carry on": 沿用 "go on using". 氵 "water" fits the idea of going along a river.
column6: Wǒmen yán zhe hébiān sànbù.
column7: We took a walk along the riverside.
column9: Along, "to follow along": 沿著河邊走 "walk along the river", 沿路 "along the road", 沿海 "the coast", 沿途. It comes before the place or line that something follows and links with 著. As a verb it also means "to carry on": 沿用 "go on using". 氵 "water" fits the idea of going along a river.

column3: Salt, the spoken word: 加点盐巴 "add a little salt", 一撮盐巴. 盐 is the written name and 盐巴 the everyday one. The ending 巴 adds no meaning (compare 尾巴, 下巴) and is not stressed: yánba. The character 盐 has 圤 above 皿.
column6: Tāng lǐ zài jiā yīdiǎn yánba.
column7: Add a little more salt to the soup.
column9: Salt, the spoken word: 加點鹽巴 "add a little salt", 一撮鹽巴. 鹽 is the written name and 鹽巴 the everyday one. The ending 巴 adds no meaning (compare 尾巴, 下巴) and is not stressed: yánba. The character 鹽 has 鹵 "salt" for the meaning and 監 for the sound.

column3: To itch, to tickle: 很痒 "itchy", 痒痒的 "tickly", 抓痒 "scratch an itch", 发痒. It goes with the body: 我的手好痒 and with mosquito bites. 痒 has 疒 "sickness" on the outside, as other ailments do (痛, 病), and 羊 for the sound. The tickle that makes you laugh is also 痒.
column6: Wénzi yǎo de dìfang hěn yǎng.
column7: The place where the mosquito bit is very itchy.
column9: To itch, to tickle: 很癢 "itchy", 癢癢的 "tickly", 抓癢 "scratch an itch", 發癢. It goes with the body: 我的手好癢 and with mosquito bites. 癢 has 疒 "sickness" on the outside, as other ailments do (痛, 病), and 養 for the sound (yǎng, the same). The tickle that makes you laugh is also 癢.

column3: To cover up, to hide a fact or feeling: 掩盖事实 "cover up the truth", 掩盖真相, 掩盖不了 "cannot be hidden". The object is often a mistake, a fact or a smell. It has the meaning of hiding something wrong. 掩 "cover" with 扌 "hand" + 盖 "cover"; 盖 also means "put a lid on" and, in speech, "build" (盖房子).
column6: Tā xiǎng yǎngài shìshí de zhēnxiàng.
column7: He wants to cover up the truth of the matter.
column9: To cover up, to hide a fact or feeling: 掩蓋事實 "cover up the truth", 掩蓋真相, 掩蓋不了 "cannot be hidden". The object is often a mistake, a fact or a smell. It has the meaning of hiding something wrong. 掩 "cover" with 扌 "hand" + 蓋 "cover"; 蓋 also means "put a lid on" and, in speech, "build" (蓋房子).

column3: A sample of a product: 免费样品 "a free sample", 寄样品 "send a sample", 样品屋 "a show house". It is a thing given to a buyer to look at before ordering or to try. 样 "pattern, kind" + 品 "goods". 品 is three mouths 口, meaning many things, and shows up in 产品, 商品 and 作品.
column6: Gōngsī jìlái le yī fèn yàngpǐn.
column7: The company sent over a sample.
column9: A sample of a product: 免費樣品 "a free sample", 寄樣品 "send a sample", 樣品屋 "a show house". It is a thing given to a buyer to look at before ordering or to try. 樣 "pattern, kind" + 品 "goods". 品 is three mouths 口, meaning many things, and shows up in 產品, 商品 and 作品.

column3: Oxygen: 氧气不足 "short of oxygen", 吸氧气, 氧气瓶 "oxygen tank". 氧 "oxygen" + 气 "gas". 氧 is a science character made up for the element: 气 "gas" is the meaning part, and 羊 stands in for the sound of 养 (yǎng).
column6: Shānshàng de yǎngqì bǐjiào shǎo.
column7: There is less oxygen on the mountain.
column9: Oxygen: 氧氣不足 "short of oxygen", 吸氧氣, 氧氣瓶 "oxygen tank". 氧 "oxygen" + 氣 "gas". 氧 is a science character made up for the element: 气 "gas" is the meaning part, and 羊 stands in for the sound of 養 (yǎng).

column3: A banquet or a dinner party: 参加宴会 "attend a banquet", 婚宴 "wedding banquet", 宴会厅 "banquet hall". It is for a large and formal meal with guests, in a hotel or a hall, for celebration or business. 宴 has 宀 "roof" above, as the party is held inside a building. 会 means "meeting" here.
column4: 今天晚上公司有一场宴会。
column5: 今天晚上公司有一場宴會。
column6: Jīntiān wǎnshang gōngsī yǒu yī chǎng yànhuì.
column7: There is a banquet at the company tonight.
column9: A banquet or a dinner party: 參加宴會 "attend a banquet", 婚宴 "wedding banquet", 宴會廳 "banquet hall". It is for a large and formal meal with guests, in a hotel or a hall, for celebration or business. 宴 has 宀 "roof" above, as the party is held inside a building. 會 means "meeting" here.

column3: To hate, to feel disgust for: 厌恶说谎 "loathe lying", 令人厌恶 "disgusting". It is stronger than 讨厌 "dislike" and is more at home in writing; the thing hated is often a kind of behavior or a thing. 厌 "weary of" + 恶 "evil". Note that 恶 is read è as "evil" and wù as "to hate" here.
column6: Wǒ hěn yànwù shuōhuǎng de rén.
column7: I really loathe people who lie.
column9: To hate, to feel disgust for: 厭惡說謊 "loathe lying", 令人厭惡 "disgusting". It is stronger than 討厭 "dislike" and is more at home in writing; the thing hated is often a kind of behavior or a thing. 厭 "weary of" + 惡 "evil". Note that 惡 is read è as "evil" and wù as "to hate" here.

column3: To play an instrument, in a performance: 演奏钢琴 "play the piano", 演奏会 "a concert", 现场演奏 "a live performance". It is for playing music in a performance or recording. 演 "perform" + 奏 "play (music)".
column4: 她在音乐会上演奏钢琴。
column5: 她在音樂會上演奏鋼琴。
column6: Tā zài yīnyuèhuì shàng yǎnzòu gāngqín.
column7: She plays the piano at the concert.
column9: To play an instrument, in a performance: 演奏鋼琴 "play the piano", 演奏會 "a concert", 現場演奏 "a live performance". It is for playing music in a performance or recording. 演 "perform" + 奏 "play (music)".

column3: To sway, to swing from side to side, and to waver: 树枝摇摆 "branches sway", 摇摆不定 "wavering, undecided". It is for things that go back and forth, such as plants, a tail or a decision. 摇 "shake" + 摆 "swing", both with 扌 "hand". 摆 appears also in 摆动 and 摆脱.
column6: Shùzhī zài fēng zhōng yáobǎi.
column7: The branches sway in the wind.
column9: To sway, to swing from side to side, and to waver: 樹枝搖擺 "branches sway", 搖擺不定 "wavering, undecided". It is for things that go back and forth, such as plants, a tail or a decision. 搖 "shake" + 擺 "swing", both with 扌 "hand". 擺 appears also in 擺動 and 擺脫.

column3: Otherwise and "how about", for offering another plan: 要不我们去看电影吧？ "how about going to a movie?", 快点，要不就来不及了 "hurry, or we will be too late". It starts a clause, with 要不然 as a longer form. When it offers an alternative it works like "or else". Note that 不 is at its base tone here: yàobù.
column6: Yàobù wǒmen qù kàn diànyǐng ba?
column7: How about we go and see a movie?
column9: Otherwise and "how about", for offering another plan: 要不我們去看電影吧？ "how about going to a movie?", 快點，要不就來不及了 "hurry, or we will be too late". It starts a clause, with 要不然 as a longer form. When it offers an alternative it works like "or else". Note that 不 is at its base tone here: yàobù.

column3: A prescription written by a doctor: 开药方 "write a prescription", 一张药方, 中医药方 "a traditional Chinese medicine prescription". It is also used for a traditional Chinese formula. 药 "medicine" + 方 "formula, method". 药 has 艹 "plant", for plants, which were the main medicines.
column6: Yīshēng kāi le yī zhāng yàofāng.
column7: The doctor wrote out a prescription.
column9: A prescription written by a doctor: 開藥方 "write a prescription", 一張藥方, 中醫藥方 "a traditional Chinese medicine prescription". It is also used for a traditional Chinese formula. 藥 "medicine" + 方 "formula, method". 藥 has 艹 "plant", for plants, which were the main medicines.

column3: To be on good terms, close friends: 他们很要好 "they are good friends", 要好的朋友 "close friends". It is about the bond between people and used for friends, schoolmates and siblings. It can also mean eager to do well and improve oneself: 他很要好 "he is a striver". 要 "want" + 好 "good".
column4: 他们两个从小就很要好。
column5: 他們兩個從小就很要好。
column6: Tāmen liǎng ge cóngxiǎo jiù hěn yàohǎo.
column7: The two of them have been good friends since they were small.
column9: To be on good terms, close friends: 他們很要好 "they are good friends", 要好的朋友 "close friends". It is about the bond between people and used for friends, schoolmates and siblings. It can also mean eager to do well and improve oneself: 他很要好 "he is a striver". 要 "want" + 好 "good".

column3: Extremely, terribly, after 得: 热得要命 "terribly hot", 痛得要命 "painfully sore", 忙得要命 "swamped". It is a spoken way to say "extremely" with something unpleasant or tiring. It also means "to be the death of": 要人命. 要 "want" + 命 "life", so "ask for your life".
column6: Jīntiān rè de yàomìng.
column7: It is terribly hot today.
column9: Extremely, terribly, after 得: 熱得要命 "terribly hot", 痛得要命 "painfully sore", 忙得要命 "swamped". It is a spoken way to say "extremely" with something unpleasant or tiring. It also means "to be the death of": 要人命. 要 "want" + 命 "life", so "ask for your life".

column3: To oppress, to put pressure on: 压迫人民 "oppress the people", 长期受到压迫, and in the body 压迫神经 "press on a nerve". It is for force by power over others and for physical pressing. 压 "press" + 迫 "force". 压 has 土 "earth" under 厂 and shows soil crushed down, and 迫 has 辶 "walk" for moving.
column6: Tāmen chángqī shòudào yāpò.
column7: They have been oppressed for a long time.
column9: To oppress, to put pressure on: 壓迫人民 "oppress the people", 長期受到壓迫, and in the body 壓迫神經 "press on a nerve". It is for force by power over others and for physical pressing. 壓 "press" + 迫 "force". 壓 has 土 "earth" under 厭 and shows soil crushed down, and 迫 has 辶 "walk" for moving.

column3: Wild, open country, and "uncultivated, wild": 野外 "the outdoors", 野花 "wildflower", 野生 "wild", 野餐 "picnic", and 野 for rude in 粗野. It rarely stands alone and is a base for many words about the outdoors. 野 has 里 "village" and 予, with 予 giving the sound (yě, yǔ).
column6: Wǒmen zhōumò qù yěwài lùyíng.
column7: This weekend we are going camping in the outdoors.
column9: Wild, open country, and "uncultivated, wild": 野外 "the outdoors", 野花 "wildflower", 野生 "wild", 野餐 "picnic", and 野 for rude in 粗野. It rarely stands alone and is a base for many words about the outdoors. 野 has 里 "village" and 予, with 予 giving the sound (yě, yǔ).

column3: A leaf: 树叶 "leaf", 叶子 "leaf" (the spoken form), 落叶 "fallen leaves", 一片叶子 "a leaf". Also a classifier for small boats, as in 一叶扁舟. 叶 has 口 on its left and 十 on its right.
column6: Qiūtiān shùyè huì biàn huáng.
column7: In autumn the leaves turn yellow.
column9: A leaf: 樹葉 "leaf", 葉子 "leaf" (the spoken form), 落葉 "fallen leaves", 一片葉子 "a leaf". Also a classifier for small boats, as in 一葉扁舟. 葉 has 艹 "plant" at the top, and 枼 below, which was the old picture and now gives the sound (yè, the same).

column3: A night view, the lights of a city at night: 夜景很美 "the night view is beautiful", 欣赏夜景 "enjoy the night view", 看夜景. 夜 "night" + 景 "view". 景 has 日 "sun" above 京 and meant sunlight at first.
column6: Cóng shānshàng kàn yèjǐng hěn piàoliang.
column7: The night view from the mountain is beautiful.
column9: A night view, the lights of a city at night: 夜景很美 "the night view is beautiful", 欣賞夜景 "enjoy the night view", 看夜景. 夜 "night" + 景 "view". 景 has 日 "sun" above 京 and meant sunlight at first.

column3: A wild animal, a beast: 森林里的野兽 "beasts of the forest", 凶猛的野兽 "a fierce beast". It is for dangerous large animals more than 野生动物, which is the neutral word. It also describes a fierce person in speech: 像野兽一样. 兽 has 丷 and 田 on top, with 一 and 口 below.
column6: Sēnlín lǐ yǒu gèzhǒng yěshòu.
column7: There are all kinds of wild animals in the forest.
column9: A wild animal, a beast: 森林裡的野獸 "beasts of the forest", 凶猛的野獸 "a fierce beast". It is for dangerous large animals more than 野生動物, which is the neutral word. It also describes a fierce person in speech: 像野獸一樣. 獸 has 犬 "dog" for the animal and 嘼 for the sound.

column3: Ambition, and sometimes a wild scheme: 野心勃勃 "full of ambition", 有野心 "ambitious", 野心很大. Where English "ambition" is a good quality, 野心 often sounds negative, a greedy hunger for power or position; for a positive goal, 志向 or 抱负 are better. 野 "wild" + 心 "heart", so a wild heart.
column4: 他很有野心，想当总经理。
column5: 他很有野心，想當總經理。
column6: Tā hěn yǒu yěxīn, xiǎng dāng zǒngjīnglǐ.
column7: He is very ambitious and wants to become general manager.
column9: Ambition, and sometimes a wild scheme: 野心勃勃 "full of ambition", 有野心 "ambitious", 野心很大. Where English "ambition" is a good quality, 野心 often sounds negative, a greedy hunger for power or position; for a positive goal, 志向 or 抱負 are better. 野 "wild" + 心 "heart", so a wild heart.

column3: Easy, and "to exchange", mostly in other words: 容易 "easy", 交易 "a deal", 简易 "simple", 贸易 "trade", 易于 "easy to" and 不易 "not easy". By itself it is written style: 此事不易. As a suffix it forms adjectives like English "-able": 易燃 "flammable", 易碎 "fragile". The character had once a picture of a container being poured.
column6: Tāmen dáchéng le yī bǐ jiāoyì.
column7: They reached a deal.
column9: Easy, and "to exchange", mostly in other words: 容易 "easy", 交易 "a deal", 簡易 "simple", 貿易 "trade", 易於 "easy to" and 不易 "not easy". By itself it is written style: 此事不易. As a suffix it forms adjectives like English "-able": 易燃 "flammable", 易碎 "fragile". The character had once a picture of a container being poured.

column3: Medical, medicine, to treat: 学医 "study medicine", 中医 "traditional Chinese medicine", 西医 "Western medicine", 医院, 医生. It stays bound in words. 医 has 匸 around 矢.
column6: Tā cóngxiǎo jiù lìzhì xuéyī.
column7: Since she was little she has been determined to study medicine.
column9: Medical, medicine, to treat: 學醫 "study medicine", 中醫 "traditional Chinese medicine", 西醫 "Western medicine", 醫院, 醫生. It stays bound in words. 醫 has 酉 "wine" at the bottom, for the medicinal wine, and 殹 above, for the sound (yī, the same).

column3: Generally speaking, at the start of a sentence: 一般而言，台湾的夏天很热 "generally speaking, Taiwan's summers are hot". It introduces a rule that has exceptions, and is a written, formal opening. 一般 "ordinary, general" + 而言 "as far as it is concerned"; 而言 also appears in 对…而言 "for…, as far as … is concerned".
column4: 一般而言，台湾的夏天很热。
column5: 一般而言，台灣的夏天很熱。
column6: Yībān'éryán, Táiwān de xiàtiān hěn rè.
column7: Generally speaking, Taiwan's summers are hot.
column9: Generally speaking, at the start of a sentence: 一般而言，台灣的夏天很熱 "generally speaking, Taiwan's summers are hot". It introduces a rule that has exceptions, and is a written, formal opening. 一般 "ordinary, general" + 而言 "as far as it is concerned"; 而言 also appears in 對…而言 "for…, as far as … is concerned".

column3: Very early in the morning, at the crack of dawn: 一大早就出门 "set out at the crack of dawn", 一大早起床. It goes before the verb and has 就 after it. 一 here adds emphasis, "one whole early morning", and 大 stresses "very": 早 shows the sun 日 over a line.
column6: Tā yīdàzǎo jiù chūmén le.
column7: He went out first thing in the morning.
column9: Very early in the morning, at the crack of dawn: 一大早就出門 "set out at the crack of dawn", 一大早起床. It goes before the verb and has 就 after it. 一 here adds emphasis, "one whole early morning", and 大 stresses "very": 早 shows the sun 日 over a line.

column3: A parliament or council: 县市议会 "a county or city council", 议会制度, 议会通过. In Taiwan 议会 is today mainly the elected councils of cities and counties, while the national legislature is called 立法院. 议 "discuss" + 会 "assembly". 议 has 讠 "speech" on its left and 义 for the sound (yì, the same).
column4: 市议会通过了新的预算。
column5: 市議會通過了新的預算。
column6: Shì yìhuì tōngguò le xīn de yùsuàn.
column7: The city council passed the new budget.
column9: A parliament or council: 縣市議會 "a county or city council", 議會制度, 議會通過. In Taiwan 議會 is today mainly the elected councils of cities and counties, while the national legislature is called 立法院. 議 "discuss" + 會 "assembly". 議 has 言 "speech" on its left and 義 for the sound (yì, the same).

column3: Married, as a status: 已婚 versus 未婚 "unmarried", 已婚人士 "married people", 已婚男子. It is the word of forms and writing: 已婚、未婚、离婚 are the options you tick. 已 "already" + 婚 "marry". In speech people say 结婚了 "is married".
column6: Tā yǐhūn, yǒu liǎng ge háizi.
column7: She is married and has two children.
column9: Married, as a status: 已婚 versus 未婚 "unmarried", 已婚人士 "married people", 已婚男子. It is the word of forms and writing: 已婚、未婚、離婚 are the options you tick. 已 "already" + 婚 "marry". In speech people say 結婚了 "is married".

column3: One side, one face, and "while… while…": 一面…一面… "doing one thing while doing another", as in 一面走路一面看手机 "walking while looking at a phone"; also 一面 "one side" of a thing, and 见一面 "meet once". The first sense joins two actions at the same time with the same person. 面 is a face with an eye drawn in the middle.
column4: 他一面走路，一面看手机。
column5: 他一面走路，一面看手機。
column6: Tā yīmiàn zǒulù, yīmiàn kàn shǒujī.
column7: He looks at his phone while walking.
column9: One side, one face, and "while… while…": 一面…一面… "doing one thing while doing another", as in 一面走路一面看手機 "walking while looking at a phone"; also 一面 "one side" of a thing, and 見一面 "meet once". The first sense joins two actions at the same time with the same person. 面 is a face with an eye drawn in the middle.

column3: To print, and a seal, a mark: 印出来 "print it out", 印表机 "printer", 印名片 "print business cards", 盖印 "put a stamp". It also means an impression left behind: 脚印 "footprint", 印象 "impression". The character shows a hand 爪 pressing a person 卩, and in time came to mean a stamp pressed on something.
column6: Qǐng bǎ zhè fèn wénjiàn yìn chūlái.
column7: Please print out this document.
column9: To print, and a seal, a mark: 印出來 "print it out", 印表機 "printer", 印名片 "print business cards", 蓋印 "put a stamp". It also means an impression left behind: 腳印 "footprint", 印象 "impression". The character shows a hand 爪 pressing a person 卩, and in time came to mean a stamp pressed on something.

column3: To drink, bound in written words: 饮料 "drink", 饮水 "drinking water", 饮食 "diet", 饮酒 "drink alcohol", 饮用 "to drink". Alone it is literary and rare; in speech you say 喝. 饣 "food" on the left shows eating and drinking.
column6: Tā cóng bù yǐn jiǔ.
column7: He never drinks alcohol.
column9: To drink, bound in written words: 飲料 "drink", 飲水 "drinking water", 飲食 "diet", 飲酒 "drink alcohol", 飲用 "to drink". Alone it is literary and rare; in speech you say 喝. 飠 "food" on the left shows eating and drinking.

column3: To set off, to cause: 引发讨论 "spark discussion", 引发争议 "cause controversy", 引发火灾 "start a fire". It describes something that a first event brings about, often a problem or a strong reaction. 引 "draw" + 发 "emit, start". 引 shows a bow 弓 being drawn, and 发 had a bow shooting.
column4: 这件事引发了很多讨论。
column5: 這件事引發了很多討論。
column6: Zhè jiàn shì yǐnfā le hěn duō tǎolùn.
column7: This matter set off a lot of discussion.
column9: To set off, to cause: 引發討論 "spark discussion", 引發爭議 "cause controversy", 引發火災 "start a fire". It describes something that a first event brings about, often a problem or a strong reaction. 引 "draw" + 發 "emit, start". 引 shows a bow 弓 being drawn, and 發 had a bow shooting.

column3: A shadow, an image, a trace; mostly met in compounds: 电影 "film", 影子 "shadow", 影响 "influence", 影片 "a film clip", 摄影 "photography". The 彡 at the right of 影 is the part for light and shadow, and 景 on the left gives the sound (yǐng, jǐng). The old meaning of the character is "shadow".
column6: Wǒmen zhōumò qù kàn diànyǐng.
column7: We are going to see a film on the weekend.
column9: A shadow, an image, a trace; mostly met in compounds: 電影 "film", 影子 "shadow", 影響 "influence", 影片 "a film clip", 攝影 "photography". The 彡 at the right of 影 is the part for light and shadow, and 景 on the left gives the sound (yǐng, jǐng). The old meaning of the character is "shadow".

column3: A copy of a document made by a copier: 身分证影本 "a copy of an ID card", 影本一份 "one copy", 附上影本 "attach a copy". It is the word in Taiwan for a photocopy that is handed in with an application (the mainland says 复印件), as opposed to 正本 "the original". 影 "image" + 本 "copy, original". 本 is 木 "tree" with a mark at its root.
column6: Qǐng fùshàng shēnfènzhèng yǐngběn.
column7: Please attach a copy of your ID card.
column9: A copy of a document made by a copier: 身分證影本 "a copy of an ID card", 影本一份 "one copy", 附上影本 "attach a copy". It is the word in Taiwan for a photocopy that is handed in with an application (the mainland says 複印件), as opposed to 正本 "the original". 影 "image" + 本 "copy, original". 本 is 木 "tree" with a mark at its root.

column3: A baby, an infant: 婴儿车 "stroller", 婴儿床 "crib", 新生婴儿 "newborn", 婴儿奶粉 "baby formula". It is the general written word for a child under about one year; in speech 宝宝 "baby" is used. 婴 has 女 "woman" below it. 儿 shows a child with the soft spot on the skull.
column6: Yīng'ér zài chuáng shàng shuìzháo le.
column7: The baby has fallen asleep in the crib.
column9: A baby, an infant: 嬰兒車 "stroller", 嬰兒床 "crib", 新生嬰兒 "newborn", 嬰兒奶粉 "baby formula". It is the general written word for a child under about one year; in speech 寶寶 "baby" is used. 嬰 has 女 "woman" below it. 兒 shows a child with the soft spot on the skull.

column3: To deal with, to cope with a task, person or situation, sometimes in a perfunctory way: 应付考试 "cope with an exam", 应付客人 "handle the guests", 随便应付 "do it half-heartedly". When it is not strong, it just means to manage. 应 "respond" + 付 "give over". The second syllable is neutral: yìngfu. Read the first character as yìng, not yīng.
column4: 我得想办法应付这次考试。
column5: 我得想辦法應付這次考試。
column6: Wǒ děi xiǎng bànfǎ yìngfu zhè cì kǎoshì.
column7: I have to find a way to cope with this exam.
column9: To deal with, to cope with a task, person or situation, sometimes in a perfunctory way: 應付考試 "cope with an exam", 應付客人 "handle the guests", 隨便應付 "do it half-heartedly". When it is not strong, it just means to manage. 應 "respond" + 付 "give over". The second syllable is neutral: yìngfu. Read the first character as yìng, not yīng.

column3: A hero: 民族英雄 "a national hero", 英雄人物, 英雄主义, 英雄本色. 英 "outstanding" + 雄 "male, brave"; the word is used of men and women alike today. 雄 has 隹 "bird" for the meaning, the male of birds.
column4: 他是大家心目中的英雄。
column5: 他是大家心目中的英雄。
column6: Tā shì dàjiā xīnmùzhōng de yīngxióng.
column7: In everyone's eyes he is a hero.
column9: A hero: 民族英雄 "a national hero", 英雄人物, 英雄主義, 英雄本色. 英 "outstanding" + 雄 "male, brave"; the word is used of men and women alike today. 雄 has 隹 "bird" for the meaning, the male of birds.

column3: At someone's invitation: 应邀出席 "attend by invitation", 应邀参加 "be invited to take part", 应邀演讲 "give a talk on invitation". It is a formal phrase of news and notices, with the subject first and a verb after it. 应 "respond" + 邀 "invite". It is read yìngyāo, not yīng.
column4: 他应邀参加了这场会议。
column5: 他應邀參加了這場會議。
column6: Tā yìngyāo cānjiā le zhè chǎng huìyì.
column7: He attended this meeting at the invitation.
column9: At someone's invitation: 應邀出席 "attend by invitation", 應邀參加 "be invited to take part", 應邀演講 "give a talk on invitation". It is a formal phrase of news and notices, with the subject first and a verb after it. 應 "respond" + 邀 "invite". It is read yìngyāo, not yīng.

column3: To photocopy: 影印一份 "photocopy one", 影印机 "photocopier", 影印店 "copy shop", 影印费. 影 "image" + 印 "print". It is the word for copying at a copy shop or a convenience store's copier.
column4: 我去便利商店影印文件。
column5: 我去便利商店影印文件。
column6: Wǒ qù biànlì shāngdiàn yǐngyìn wénjiàn.
column7: I go to the convenience store to photocopy documents.
column9: To photocopy: 影印一份 "photocopy one", 影印機 "photocopier", 影印店 "copy shop", 影印費. 影 "image" + 印 "print". It is the word for copying at a copy shop or a convenience store's copier.

column3: A factor, an element in a result: 影响因素 "factors that influence", 不确定因素 "uncertain factors", 重要因素, 人为因素 "human factors". It is a word of writing and analysis for what makes something happen. 因 "cause" + 素 "element, basic". 素 here is "basic part", as in 元素 "element" and 维生素 "vitamin".
column4: 天气是影响收成的重要因素。
column5: 天氣是影響收成的重要因素。
column6: Tiānqì shì yǐngxiǎng shōucheng de zhòngyào yīnsù.
column7: The weather is an important factor in the harvest.
column9: A factor, an element in a result: 影響因素 "factors that influence", 不確定因素 "uncertain factors", 重要因素, 人為因素 "human factors". It is a word of writing and analysis for what makes something happen. 因 "cause" + 素 "element, basic". 素 here is "basic part", as in 元素 "element" and 維生素 "vitamin".

column3: A seal, a signet, and a stamp that is pressed: 盖印章 "stamp with a seal", 刻印章 "have a seal carved", 印章店. In Taiwan a seal is still commonly used in place of a signature for bank forms and receipts. 印 + 章 are two words for "seal".
column4: 银行要你盖印章才能办手续。
column5: 銀行要你蓋印章才能辦手續。
column6: Yínháng yào nǐ gài yìnzhāng cáinéng bàn shǒuxù.
column7: The bank needs your seal before it can handle the matter.
column9: A seal, a signet, and a stamp that is pressed: 蓋印章 "stamp with a seal", 刻印章 "have a seal carved", 印章店. In Taiwan a seal is still commonly used in place of a signature for bank forms and receipts. 印 + 章 are two words for "seal".

column3: Aside, the side: 站在一旁 "stand to one side", 一旁的人 "the people nearby", 把书放在一旁 "put the book aside". It describes where someone or something is relative to the main action, and it does not need a noun: 在一旁看着. 旁 "side" has 方 for the sound (páng, fāng). Compare 旁边, which needs a person or thing before it.
column6: Tā zhàn zài yīpáng, méiyǒu shuōhuà.
column7: He stood to one side and said nothing.
column9: Aside, the side: 站在一旁 "stand to one side", 一旁的人 "the people nearby", 把書放在一旁 "put the book aside". It describes where someone or something is relative to the main action, and it does not need a noun: 在一旁看著. 旁 "side" has 方 for the sound (páng, fāng). Compare 旁邊, which needs a person or thing before it.

column3: An instrument, an apparatus for measuring or testing: 精密仪器 "precision instruments", 医疗仪器 "medical instruments", 测量仪器. It names equipment in a laboratory, a hospital or a factory. 仪 "apparatus" + 器 "tool, vessel". 器 has four mouths 口 around a dog 犬 and appears in 机器, 武器 and 容器.
column4: 医院里有很多精密的仪器。
column5: 醫院裡有很多精密的儀器。
column6: Yīyuàn lǐ yǒu hěn duō jīngmì de yíqì.
column7: There are many precision instruments in the hospital.
column9: An instrument, an apparatus for measuring or testing: 精密儀器 "precision instruments", 醫療儀器 "medical instruments", 測量儀器. It names equipment in a laboratory, a hospital or a factory. 儀 "apparatus" + 器 "tool, vessel". 器 has four mouths 口 around a dog 犬 and appears in 機器, 武器 and 容器.

column3: At the same time, all together: 大家一齐唱 "everyone sings together", 一齐出发 "set out all together", 一齐动手. It goes before a verb and means that the action is done by many people at once, in unison. 一 "one" + 齐 "even, in order". 齐 shows stalks of grain growing evenly, and also appears in 整齐 "tidy" and 齐全 "complete".
column4: 大家一齐唱起了生日歌。
column5: 大家一齊唱起了生日歌。
column6: Dàjiā yīqí chàngqǐ le shēngrì gē.
column7: Everyone started to sing the birthday song together.
column9: At the same time, all together: 大家一齊唱 "everyone sings together", 一齊出發 "set out all together", 一齊動手. It goes before a verb and means that the action is done by many people at once, in unison. 一 "one" + 齊 "even, in order". 齊 shows stalks of grain growing evenly, and also appears in 整齊 "tidy" and 齊全 "complete".

column3: Clothes, in the speech of some regions: 洗衣裳 "wash clothes", 新衣裳 "new clothes". Today 衣服 is the everyday word, and 衣裳 sounds old-style or from a story or a dialect. 衣 "clothes" + 裳, which is the old word for a lower garment. The second syllable is neutral: yīshang.
column4: 奶奶给孩子做了一件新衣裳。
column5: 奶奶給孩子做了一件新衣裳。
column6: Nǎinai gěi háizi zuò le yī jiàn xīn yīshang.
column7: Grandma made the child a set of new clothes.
column9: Clothes, in the speech of some regions: 洗衣裳 "wash clothes", 新衣裳 "new clothes". Today 衣服 is the everyday word, and 衣裳 sounds old-style or from a story or a dialect. 衣 "clothes" + 裳, which is the old word for a lower garment. The second syllable is neutral: yīshang.

column3: A ceremony: 结婚仪式 "wedding ceremony", 开幕仪式 "opening ceremony", 毕业仪式, 举行仪式 "hold a ceremony". 仪 "etiquette, ceremony" + 式 "form". The verb that goes with it is 举行, and the participants 参加 it. 仪 has 亻 "person" and 义 for the sound (yí, yì).
column6: Jiéhūn yíshì zài jiàotáng jǔxíng.
column7: The wedding ceremony takes place in the church.
column9: A ceremony: 結婚儀式 "wedding ceremony", 開幕儀式 "opening ceremony", 畢業儀式, 舉行儀式 "hold a ceremony". 儀 "etiquette, ceremony" + 式 "form". The verb that goes with it is 舉行, and the participants 參加 it. 儀 has 亻 "person" and 義 for the sound (yí, yì).

column3: All day long, from morning to night: 他一天到晚都在玩 "he plays all day long". It is an idiom that uses 一天 "one day", 到 "until" and 晚 "evening", and it often goes with a complaint about something repeated again and again: 一天到晚抱怨. It stands before the verb, usually with 都.
column4: 他一天到晚都在玩手机。
column5: 他一天到晚都在玩手機。
column6: Tā yītiāndàowǎn dōu zài wán shǒujī.
column7: He plays on his phone all day long.
column9: All day long, from morning to night: 他一天到晚都在玩 "he plays all day long". It is an idiom that uses 一天 "one day", 到 "until" and 晚 "evening", and it often goes with a complaint about something repeated again and again: 一天到晚抱怨. It stands before the verb, usually with 都.

column3: One by one, each in turn: 一一介绍 "introduce one by one", 一一回答 "answer each in turn", 一一检查. The doubled 一 stresses that every item is dealt with separately. It goes before a verb, in speech and in writing. It is read yīyī.
column4: 老师把大家的名字一一念了出来。
column5: 老師把大家的名字一一念了出來。
column6: Lǎoshī bǎ dàjiā de míngzi yīyī niàn le chūlái.
column7: The teacher read out everyone's name one by one.
column9: One by one, each in turn: 一一介紹 "introduce one by one", 一一回答 "answer each in turn", 一一檢查. The doubled 一 stresses that every item is dealt with separately. It goes before a verb, in speech and in writing. It is read yīyī.

column3: A wish, a desire: 个人意愿 "personal wish", 尊重意愿 "respect someone's wish", 愿意 "be willing", 不违背意愿. It is a noun for a person's own will on a matter, about marriage, work or a choice, and is the noun behind 愿意 "be willing". 意 "intention" + 愿 "wish". 意 has 心 "heart" at the bottom.
column6: Wǒmen huì zūnzhòng nǐ de yìyuàn.
column7: We will respect your wishes.
column9: A wish, a desire: 個人意願 "personal wish", 尊重意願 "respect someone's wish", 願意 "be willing", 不違背意願. It is a noun for a person's own will on a matter, about marriage, work or a choice, and is the noun behind 願意 "be willing". 意 "intention" + 願 "wish". 意 has 心 "heart" at the bottom.

column3: Use, usefulness: 有用处 "useful", 没有用处 "of no use", 用处很大 "very useful". The thing is judged by what it can be used for. 用 "use" + 处 "place, aspect", so it is the place where it is useful. 处 is read chù here, as a noun, and chǔ in 处理 "handle". The second syllable is neutral in the dictionary: yòngchu.
column4: 这个东西没有什么用处。
column5: 這個東西沒有什麼用處。
column6: Zhège dōngxi méiyǒu shénme yòngchu.
column7: This thing is of no use.
column9: Use, usefulness: 有用處 "useful", 沒有用處 "of no use", 用處很大 "very useful". The thing is judged by what it can be used for. 用 "use" + 處 "place, aspect", so it is the place where it is useful. 處 is read chù here, as a noun, and chǔ in 處理 "handle". The second syllable is neutral in the dictionary: yòngchu.

column3: Need, to be necessary in a question or a negative: 用不着 "no need", 用得着吗？ "is it necessary?", 哪用得着 "why bother". It is a spoken pattern; with 用不着 the speaker says something is not needed. 用得着 is also "can be used", with 着 read zháo like 找着 and 睡着. Often in the pattern 哪里用得着, "there is no need".
column4: 这点小事哪里用得着你来做？
column5: 這點小事哪裡用得著你來做？
column6: Zhè diǎn xiǎoshì nǎlǐ yòngdezháo nǐ lái zuò?
column7: Why would a little matter like this need you to do it?
column9: Need, to be necessary in a question or a negative: 用不著 "no need", 用得著嗎？ "is it necessary?", 哪用得著 "why bother". It is a spoken pattern; with 用不著 the speaker says something is not needed. 用得著 is also "can be used", with 著 read zháo like 找著 and 睡著. Often in the pattern 哪裡用得著, "there is no need".

column3: To support, to back, to be loyal to: 拥护政府 "support the government", 拥护领袖, 深受拥护 "widely supported". The object is a leader, a policy or a cause, and the word is formal, often in political talk. 拥 "hold" + 护 "protect". Both have a part for sound: 用 in 拥 and 户 in 护 (hù), with 扌 in each.
column4: 大多数人都拥护这项新政策。
column5: 大多數人都擁護這項新政策。
column6: Dàduōshù rén dōu yōnghù zhè xiàng xīn zhèngcè.
column7: Most people support this new policy.
column9: To support, to back, to be loyal to: 擁護政府 "support the government", 擁護領袖, 深受擁護 "widely supported". The object is a leader, a policy or a cause, and the word is formal, often in political talk. 擁 "hold" + 護 "protect". Both have a part for sound: 雍 in 擁 and 蒦 in 護 (hù), with 言 "speech" in 護.

column3: Crowded, packed, and "to crowd": 很拥挤 "very crowded", 拥挤的捷运 "a packed MRT", 交通拥挤. It is used for trains at rush hour, for markets and for roads. 拥 "hold" + 挤 "squeeze". 挤 has 扌 "hand" for pushing and 齐 for the sound (jǐ, qí).
column4: 下班时间捷运非常拥挤。
column5: 下班時間捷運非常擁擠。
column6: Xiàbān shíjiān jiéyùn fēicháng yōngjǐ.
column7: The MRT is very crowded at the end of the work day.
column9: Crowded, packed, and "to crowd": 很擁擠 "very crowded", 擁擠的捷運 "a packed MRT", 交通擁擠. It is used for trains at rush hour, for markets and for roads. 擁 "hold" + 擠 "squeeze". 擠 has 扌 "hand" for pushing and 齊 for the sound (jǐ, qí).

column3: Tools or equipment for a purpose: 运动用具 "sports equipment", 清洁用具 "cleaning supplies", 学习用具 "school supplies", 烹饪用具. It names the things used for a task as a group. 用 "use" + 具 "tool". 具 is in 工具 "tool" and 家具 "furniture", where it also means a tool or fitting.
column4: 这家店卖各种运动用具。
column5: 這家店賣各種運動用具。
column6: Zhè jiā diàn mài gèzhǒng yùndòng yòngjù.
column7: This shop sells all kinds of sports equipment.
column9: Tools or equipment for a purpose: 運動用具 "sports equipment", 清潔用具 "cleaning supplies", 學習用具 "school supplies", 烹飪用具. It names the things used for a task as a group. 用 "use" + 具 "tool". 具 is in 工具 "tool" and 家具 "furniture", where it also means a tool or fitting.

column3: To use effort, to push hard: 用力推 "push hard", 用力拉 "pull hard", 用力一点 "a bit harder", 用力过度 "overdo it". It comes before the verb and describes how much strength is put into an action. 用 "use" + 力 "strength". 力 was a picture of a plow or a bent arm, and strength.
column6: Qǐng yònglì tuī mén.
column7: Please push the door hard.
column9: To use effort, to push hard: 用力推 "push hard", 用力拉 "pull hard", 用力一點 "a bit harder", 用力過度 "overdo it". It comes before the verb and describes how much strength is put into an action. 用 "use" + 力 "strength". 力 was a picture of a plow or a bent arm, and strength.

column3: Diligence, careful attention, and motive: 很用心 "very attentive", 用心读书 "study with care", 用心良苦 "painstaking intention", 别有用心 "have an ulterior motive". It can be praise for trying hard or, in the idiom 别有用心, a hint of a hidden plan. 用 "use" + 心 "heart".
column6: Tā dúshū hěn yòngxīn.
column7: He studies with great care.
column9: Diligence, careful attention, and motive: 很用心 "very attentive", 用心讀書 "study with care", 用心良苦 "painstaking intention", 別有用心 "have an ulterior motive". It can be praise for trying hard or, in the idiom 別有用心, a hint of a hidden plan. 用 "use" + 心 "heart".

column3: A postman: 邮差先生 "Mr. Postman", 邮差送信 "the postman delivers letters". It is the everyday word for a mail carrier. 邮 "mail" + 差 "errand, messenger". Here 差 is read chāi "send, messenger", and chà in 差不多 "almost" and cī in 参差.
column4: 邮差每天早上都会来送信。
column5: 郵差每天早上都會來送信。
column6: Yóuchāi měitiān zǎoshang dōu huì lái sòngxìn.
column7: The postman comes every morning to deliver the mail.
