column9: A postman: 郵差先生 "Mr. Postman", 郵差送信 "the postman delivers letters". It is the everyday word for a mail carrier. 郵 "mail" + 差 "errand, messenger". Here 差 is read chāi "send, messenger", and chà in 差不多 "almost" and cī in 參差.

column3: To be related to, to concern: 与…有关 "to be related to", 有关人员 "the people concerned", 有关部门 "the departments concerned", 有关系. It is used with 与 or 和: 这件事与你无关. 有关 "have concern" is the opposite of 无关. As a prefix 有关 also means "relating to": 有关这件事 "regarding this matter".
column6: Zhè jiàn shì hé nǐ yǒuguān.
column7: This matter has to do with you.
column9: To be related to, to concern: 與…有關 "to be related to", 有關人員 "the people concerned", 有關部門 "the departments concerned", 有關係. It is used with 與 or 和: 這件事與你無關. 有關 "have concern" is the opposite of 無關. As a prefix 有關 also means "relating to": 有關這件事 "regarding this matter".

column3: Greasy, oily, in a bad sense: 太油腻 "too greasy", 油腻的食物 "greasy food", 吃得很油腻. It describes food heavy with oil, so that you feel full and sick of it, which is not praise. 油 "oil" + 腻 "greasy". 油 has 氵 for liquid, and 腻 has ⺼ "flesh" for the meaning.
column4: 这道菜太油腻了，我吃不下。
column5: 這道菜太油膩了，我吃不下。
column6: Zhè dào cài tài yóunì le, wǒ chī bù xià.
column7: This dish is too greasy and I cannot eat it.
column9: Greasy, oily, in a bad sense: 太油膩 "too greasy", 油膩的食物 "greasy food", 吃得很油膩. It describes food heavy with oil, so that you feel full and sick of it, which is not praise. 油 "oil" + 膩 "greasy". 油 has 氵 for liquid, and 膩 has ⺼ "flesh" for the meaning.

column3: A march or demonstration: 上街游行 "march in the street", 游行示威 "demonstrate", 抗议游行, and also a parade for a festival: 庆典游行. It can be a political march or a religious procession, like Taiwan's 妈祖绕境. 游 "wander" + 行 "go", with 氵 on the left. The 行 is read xíng here, as in 旅行.
column4: 很多人上街游行，要求加薪。
column5: 很多人上街遊行，要求加薪。
column6: Hěn duō rén shàngjiē yóuxíng, yāoqiú jiāxīn.
column7: Many people marched in the street demanding a pay rise.
column9: A march or demonstration: 上街遊行 "march in the street", 遊行示威 "demonstrate", 抗議遊行, and also a parade for a festival: 慶典遊行. It can be a political march or a religious procession, like Taiwan's 媽祖遶境. 遊 "wander" + 行 "go", with 辶 "walk" under the meaning. The 行 is read xíng here, as in 旅行.

column3: Melancholy, gloomy and low in spirit: 忧郁症 "depression", 神情忧郁 "a gloomy look", 忧郁的天气. It describes a dark mood that does not go away, and 忧郁症 is the term for clinical depression. 忧 "worry" + 郁 "gloomy, pent up". 郁 has 有 on its left and 阝 on its right.
column4: 最近他心情忧郁，不想说话。
column5: 最近他心情憂鬱，不想說話。
column6: Zuìjìn tā xīnqíng yōuyù, bù xiǎng shuōhuà.
column7: Lately he has been low in spirit and does not want to talk.
column9: Melancholy, gloomy and low in spirit: 憂鬱症 "depression", 神情憂鬱 "a gloomy look", 憂鬱的天氣. It describes a dark mood that does not go away, and 憂鬱症 is the term for clinical depression. 憂 "worry" + 鬱 "gloomy, pent up". 鬱 is a complicated character with 林 "forest" inside it.

column3: Superior, excellent, advantageous: 优越的条件 "superior conditions", 优越感 "a feeling of superiority", 优越的环境 "a good environment". It describes conditions or position that are better than others', and 优越感 is not always a nice thing. 优 "excellent" + 越 "surpass". 越 has 走 "walk" and 戉 for the sound (yuè, the same), as it means to go over or past.
column4: 这里的地理位置非常优越。
column5: 這裡的地理位置非常優越。
column6: Zhèlǐ de dìlǐ wèizhì fēicháng yōuyuè.
column7: The location here is excellent.
column9: Superior, excellent, advantageous: 優越的條件 "superior conditions", 優越感 "a feeling of superiority", 優越的環境 "a good environment". It describes conditions or position that are better than others', and 優越感 is not always a nice thing. 優 "excellent" + 越 "surpass". 越 has 走 "walk" and 戉 for the sound (yuè, the same), as it means to go over or past.

column3: Originally, at first: 原本打算去 "originally planned to go", 原本如此 "it was so from the start". As an adverb it tells how things were planned or stood before a change, and as a noun, "the original": 原本 versus 影本 "the copy". 原 "source" + 本 "root". 原 shows a spring 泉 coming out of a cliff 厂.
column4: 我原本打算今天去，后来下雨了。
column5: 我原本打算今天去，後來下雨了。
column6: Wǒ yuánběn dǎsuàn jīntiān qù, hòulái xiàyǔ le.
column7: I originally planned to go today, but then it rained.
column9: Originally, at first: 原本打算去 "originally planned to go", 原本如此 "it was so from the start". As an adverb it tells how things were planned or stood before a change, and as a noun, "the original": 原本 versus 影本 "the copy". 原 "source" + 本 "root". 原 shows a spring 泉 coming out of a cliff 厂.

column3: Far-reaching, grand and lofty, said of a plan, ambition or vision: 远大的目标 "a lofty goal", 志向远大 "great ambitions", 前程远大. It is a positive adjective for aims and futures, not distance in space, for which you say 远. 远 "far" + 大 "big". 远 has 辶 "walk" for the meaning, and 元 for the sound (yuǎn, yuán).
column4: 他从小就有远大的理想。
column5: 他從小就有遠大的理想。
column6: Tā cóngxiǎo jiù yǒu yuǎndà de lǐxiǎng.
column7: He has had lofty ideals since he was a child.
column9: Far-reaching, grand and lofty, said of a plan, ambition or vision: 遠大的目標 "a lofty goal", 志向遠大 "great ambitions", 前程遠大. It is a positive adjective for aims and futures, not distance in space, for which you say 遠. 遠 "far" + 大 "big". 遠 has 辶 "walk" for the meaning, and 袁 for the sound (yuǎn, yuán).

column3: A reason, a cause: 缘故 "reason", 什么缘故 "for what reason", 因为…的缘故 "because of…". It is a written noun for the cause of something, often used to explain: 由于天气的缘故. 缘 "cause" + 故 "reason". 缘 has 纟 "thread" and 彖 for the sound (yuán).
column4: 因为下雨的缘故，比赛取消了。
column5: 因為下雨的緣故，比賽取消了。
column6: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ de yuángù, bǐsài qǔxiāo le.
column7: The match was cancelled because of the rain.
column9: A reason, a cause: 緣故 "reason", 什麼緣故 "for what reason", 因為…的緣故 "because of…". It is a written noun for the cause of something, often used to explain: 由於天氣的緣故. 緣 "cause" + 故 "reason". 緣 has 糹 "thread" and 彖 for the sound (yuán).

column3: To accuse wrongly, treat unjustly: 冤枉好人 "wrong an innocent person", 被冤枉了 "was falsely accused", 太冤枉了 "so unfair". It is also "not worth it": 白跑一趟真冤枉 "it was a waste to go". The second syllable is neutral: yuānwang. 冤 has 兔 "rabbit" under 冖 "cover", and 枉 "crooked" has 木 "wood" with 王 for the sound.
column4: 你冤枉我了，我什么都没做！
column5: 你冤枉我了，我什麼都沒做！
column6: Nǐ yuānwang wǒ le, wǒ shénme dōu méi zuò!
column7: You have wronged me, I did nothing!
column9: To accuse wrongly, treat unjustly: 冤枉好人 "wrong an innocent person", 被冤枉了 "was falsely accused", 太冤枉了 "so unfair". It is also "not worth it": 白跑一趟真冤枉 "it was a waste to go". The second syllable is neutral: yuānwang. 冤 has 兔 "rabbit" under 冖 "cover", and 枉 "crooked" has 木 "wood" with 王 for the sound.

column3: Round, circular, in shape: 圆形的桌子 "a round table", 圆形广场 "a circular square". 圆 "round" + 形 "shape". It is an adjective before a noun, and gives the shape; the shapes include 方形 "square", 三角形 "triangle" and 椭圆形 "oval". 圆 is 员 inside a frame 囗, with 员 for the sound.
column4: 我们家有一张圆形的桌子。
column5: 我們家有一張圓形的桌子。
column6: Wǒmen jiā yǒu yī zhāng yuánxíng de zhuōzi.
column7: We have a round table at home.
column9: Round, circular, in shape: 圓形的桌子 "a round table", 圓形廣場 "a circular square". 圓 "round" + 形 "shape". It is an adjective before a noun, and gives the shape; the shapes include 方形 "square", 三角形 "triangle" and 橢圓形 "oval". 圓 is 員 inside a frame 囗, with 員 for the sound.

column3: In principle, as a rule: 原则上同意 "agree in principle", 原则上可以 "in principle it is allowed", usually followed by a but or an exception. The speaker says that a thing is true as a rule and leaves room for exceptions. 原则 "principle" + 上 "on the level of". The 上 is neutral in the dictionary: yuánzéshang.
column4: 原则上我同意，但还要再想一想。
column5: 原則上我同意，但還要再想一想。
column6: Yuánzéshang wǒ tóngyì, dàn hái yào zài xiǎng yī xiǎng.
column7: In principle I agree, but I still have to think about it.
column9: In principle, as a rule: 原則上同意 "agree in principle", 原則上可以 "in principle it is allowed", usually followed by a but or an exception. The speaker says that a thing is true as a rule and leaves room for exceptions. 原則 "principle" + 上 "on the level of". The 上 is neutral in the dictionary: yuánzéshang.

column3: A ballpoint pen, the everyday pen: 一支原子笔 "a ballpoint pen", 原子笔芯 "refill". It is the usual word in Taiwan, while the mainland says 圆珠笔. 原子 "atom" + 笔 "pen". 笔 has ⺮ "bamboo", as brushes were made of bamboo, and 毛 below.
column6: Qǐng yòng yuánzǐbǐ xiě míngzi.
column7: Please write your name with a ballpoint pen.
column9: A ballpoint pen, the everyday pen: 一支原子筆 "a ballpoint pen", 原子筆芯 "refill". It is the usual word in Taiwan, while the mainland says 圓珠筆. 原子 "atom" + 筆 "pen". 筆 has 竹 "bamboo", as brushes were made of bamboo, and 聿 for the writing brush.

column3: Intonation, tone of voice: 语调很温柔 "a gentle tone of voice", 语调上扬 "a rising intonation", 用不同的语调说. It describes how pitch moves in a whole sentence, apart from the lexical tones. 语 "speech" + 调 "tune". Both have 讠 "speech" on their left, as other words of speaking do.
column6: Tā shuōhuà de yǔdiào hěn wēnróu.
column7: Her tone of voice is very gentle.
column9: Intonation, tone of voice: 語調很溫柔 "a gentle tone of voice", 語調上揚 "a rising intonation", 用不同的語調說. It describes how pitch moves in a whole sentence, apart from the lexical tones. 語 "speech" + 調 "tune". Both have 言 "speech" on their left, as other words of speaking do.

column3: To book or fix beforehand: 预定时间 "a set time", 预定计划 "the planned schedule", 预定目标. It is about a plan that was fixed in advance. 预订 (with 订 "to order") is the word for reserving a room or ticket, and the two are said the same way. 预 "in advance" + 定 "set".
column4: 会议预定在下午三点开始。
column5: 會議預定在下午三點開始。
column6: Huìyì yùdìng zài xiàwǔ sān diǎn kāishǐ.
column7: The meeting is scheduled to begin at three in the afternoon.
column9: To book or fix beforehand: 預定時間 "a set time", 預定計畫 "the planned schedule", 預定目標. It is about a plan that was fixed in advance. 預訂 (with 訂 "to order") is the word for reserving a room or ticket, and the two are said the same way. 預 "in advance" + 定 "set".

column3: Month, as in a named month or in a count: 这个月分 "this month", 十二月分, 月分牌 "a wall calendar". The same word is also written 月份. It is a measure word of months, used after a number or a named month to mean the month as a period. 月 "moon, month" + 分 "part".
column6: Nǐ shì jǐ yuèfèn chūshēng de?
column7: Which month were you born in?
column9: Month, as in a named month or in a count: 這個月分 "this month", 十二月分, 月分牌 "a wall calendar". The same word is also written 月份. It is a measure word of months, used after a number or a named month to mean the month as a period. 月 "moon, month" + 分 "part".

column3: Moonlight: 月光下 "under the moonlight", 月光皎洁 "bright moonlight". 月 "moon" + 光 "light". 光 shows a person 儿 under a flame, a torch carrier, and appears in 阳光 "sunlight" and 灯光 "lamplight".
column6: Yuèguāng zhào zài húmiàn shàng.
column7: The moonlight shines on the lake.
column9: Moonlight: 月光下 "under the moonlight", 月光皎潔 "bright moonlight". 月 "moon" + 光 "light". 光 shows a person 儿 under a flame, a torch carrier, and appears in 陽光 "sunlight" and 燈光 "lamplight".

column3: Entertainment, recreation: 娱乐活动 "recreational activities", 娱乐新闻 "entertainment news", 娱乐圈 "show business", 娱乐场所. As a verb it means to amuse: 自娱自乐 "amuse oneself". 娱 "enjoy" + 乐 "fun". 乐 is read lè here, "happy", and yuè as in 音乐 "music". 乐 shows strings 丝 on a piece of wood, an instrument.
column4: 周末我们喜欢做一些娱乐活动。
column5: 週末我們喜歡做一些娛樂活動。
column6: Zhōumò wǒmen xǐhuān zuò yīxiē yúlè huódòng.
column7: On weekends we like to do some recreational activities.
column9: Entertainment, recreation: 娛樂活動 "recreational activities", 娛樂新聞 "entertainment news", 娛樂圈 "show business", 娛樂場所. As a verb it means to amuse: 自娛自樂 "amuse oneself". 娛 "enjoy" + 樂 "fun". 樂 is read lè here, "happy", and yuè as in 音樂 "music". 樂 shows strings 絲 on a piece of wood, an instrument.

column3: Dizzy, to faint: 头晕 "dizzy", 晕车 "carsick", 晕船 "seasick", 晕倒 "faint", 晕过去. The reading changes in some words: it is yūn for the feeling of dizziness, but yùn in 晕车 and 晕船. The character has 日 "sun" and 军 for the sound; it first meant the halo around the sun.
column6: Wǒ zuò chē huì yūn.
column7: I get carsick when I ride in a vehicle.
column9: Dizzy, to faint: 頭暈 "dizzy", 暈車 "carsick", 暈船 "seasick", 暈倒 "faint", 暈過去. The reading changes in some words: it is yūn for the feeling of dizziness, but yùn in 暈車 and 暈船. The character has 日 "sun" and 軍 for the sound; it first meant the halo around the sun.

column3: To transport, to carry goods: 运送货物 "carry goods", 运送食品, 运送费 "shipping fee". It is for moving goods or people from one place to another with a vehicle, by truck, ship or plane. 运 "carry" + 送 "send". 运 has 辶 "walk" and 云 for sound (yùn, yún); 送 has 辶 and shows a person sending another on their way.
column4: 货车把水果运送到各个城市。
column5: 貨車把水果運送到各個城市。
column6: Huòchē bǎ shuǐguǒ yùnsòng dào gègè chéngshì.
column7: Trucks carry the fruit to the different cities.
column9: To transport, to carry goods: 運送貨物 "carry goods", 運送食品, 運送費 "shipping fee". It is for moving goods or people from one place to another with a vehicle, by truck, ship or plane. 運 "carry" + 送 "send". 運 has 辶 "walk" and 軍 for sound (yùn, jūn); 送 has 辶 and shows a person sending another on their way.

column3: To permit, to allow: 允许进入 "allow entry", 不允许 "not allowed", 如果时间允许 "if time permits". It is more formal than 让 or 可以 and is common in rules and notices. 允 "agree" + 许 "permit", both with the sense of letting. The subject can also be the situation: 条件允许 "conditions permit".
column6: Zhèlǐ bù yǔnxǔ chōuyān.
column7: Smoking is not allowed here.
column9: To permit, to allow: 允許進入 "allow entry", 不允許 "not allowed", 如果時間允許 "if time permits". It is more formal than 讓 or 可以 and is common in rules and notices. 允 "agree" + 許 "permit", both with the sense of letting. The subject can also be the situation: 條件允許 "conditions permit".

column3: To operate, to run, of machines and systems, and to revolve: 机器运转 "the machine runs", 运转正常 "operating normally", 运转顺畅 "running smoothly". It can also be used for an organization or the economy. 运 "move" + 转 "turn", the first having 辶 "walk" and the second 车 "cart".
column4: 这台机器运转得很顺利。
column5: 這台機器運轉得很順利。
column6: Zhè tái jīqì yùnzhuǎn de hěn shùnlì.
column7: This machine runs very smoothly.
column9: To operate, to run, of machines and systems, and to revolve: 機器運轉 "the machine runs", 運轉正常 "operating normally", 運轉順暢 "running smoothly". It can also be used for an organization or the economy. 運 "move" + 轉 "turn", the first having 辶 "walk" and the second 車 "cart".

column3: Rather than… (better to…): 与其…不如… "rather than X, better Y", as in 与其等待，不如行动 "rather than wait, act". It is used in a pair: 与其 sets the thing you drop and 不如 gives the choice you prefer. It can also be 与其说…不如说… "it is not so much… as…". 与其 often starts a sentence in writing and speech.
column4: 与其等待，不如主动去做。
column5: 與其等待，不如主動去做。
column6: Yǔqí děngdài, bùrú zhǔdòng qù zuò.
column7: Rather than wait, it is better to take the initiative.
column9: Rather than… (better to…): 與其…不如… "rather than X, better Y", as in 與其等待，不如行動 "rather than wait, act". It is used in a pair: 與其 sets the thing you drop and 不如 gives the choice you prefer. It can also be 與其說…不如說… "it is not so much… as…". 與其 often starts a sentence in writing and speech.

column3: Tone, manner of speaking, the attitude in how something is said: 语气很重 "a harsh tone", 用客气的语气 "in a polite tone", 语气词 "a modal particle" like 吗 or 吧. It tells the speaker's attitude in the words, as in a request that sounds like an order. 语 "speech" + 气 "air, spirit". 气 is read qì here, as in 空气.
column4: 他的语气听起来很生气。
column5: 他的語氣聽起來很生氣。
column6: Tā de yǔqì tīng qǐlái hěn shēngqì.
column7: His tone sounds very angry.
column9: Tone, manner of speaking, the attitude in how something is said: 語氣很重 "a harsh tone", 用客氣的語氣 "in a polite tone", 語氣詞 "a modal particle" like 嗎 or 吧. It tells the speaker's attitude in the words, as in a request that sounds like an order. 語 "speech" + 氣 "air, spirit". 氣 is read qì here, as in 空氣.

column3: A budget: 预算不足 "the budget is not enough", 编预算 "draw up a budget", 预算有限 "limited budget", 超出预算 "over the budget". It is the money planned in advance for a project or a household. 预 "in advance" + 算 "calculate". 算 has 竹 "bamboo" at the top, perhaps for counting rods.
column4: 这次旅行的预算是两万元。
column5: 這次旅行的預算是兩萬元。
column6: Zhè cì lǚxíng de yùsuàn shì liǎng wàn yuán.
column7: The budget for this trip is twenty thousand dollars.
column9: A budget: 預算不足 "the budget is not enough", 編預算 "draw up a budget", 預算有限 "limited budget", 超出預算 "over the budget". It is the money planned in advance for a project or a household. 預 "in advance" + 算 "calculate". 算 has 竹 "bamboo" at the top, perhaps for counting rods.

column3: Beforehand, in advance: 预先通知 "give notice in advance", 预先准备 "prepare beforehand", 预先付款. It goes before a verb and is written-style. The everyday word is 先 or 事先. 预 "in advance" + 先 "first". 先 shows a foot 止 stepping out ahead of a person 儿.
column4: 请预先通知我们您的到达时间。
column5: 請預先通知我們您的到達時間。
column6: Qǐng yùxiān tōngzhī wǒmen nín de dàodá shíjiān.
column7: Please let us know your arrival time in advance.
column9: Beforehand, in advance: 預先通知 "give notice in advance", 預先準備 "prepare beforehand", 預先付款. It goes before a verb and is written-style. The everyday word is 先 or 事先. 預 "in advance" + 先 "first". 先 shows a foot 止 stepping out ahead of a person 儿.

column3: In advance, beforehand, a prefix that starts many words: 预习 "preview a lesson", 预防 "prevent", 预约 "make an appointment", 预算 "budget", 预报 "forecast", 预期 "expect". Alone it is not a free word. The right half 页 "head" is the meaning part, and 予 gives the sound (yù, the same).
column4: 他在考试前预习了课文。
column5: 他在考試前預習了課文。
column6: Tā zài kǎoshì qián yùxí le kèwén.
column7: He previewed the text before the exam.
column9: In advance, beforehand, a prefix that starts many words: 預習 "preview a lesson", 預防 "prevent", 預約 "make an appointment", 預算 "budget", 預報 "forecast", 預期 "expect". Alone it is not a free word. The right half 頁 "head" is the meaning part, and 予 gives the sound (yù, the same).

column3: To smash, to pound something so that it breaks or falls hard: 砸破玻璃 "smash a window", 砸东西 "smash things", 被砸伤 "be hurt by something falling". It also means "to bungle" in speech: 搞砸了 "messed it up", 考砸了 "flunked the exam". 石 "stone" is the meaning part; 匝 gives the sound (zá, the same).
column6: Tā bù xiǎoxīn zá pò le bōli.
column7: He accidentally smashed the glass.
column9: To smash, to pound something so that it breaks or falls hard: 砸破玻璃 "smash a window", 砸東西 "smash things", 被砸傷 "be hurt by something falling". It also means "to bungle" in speech: 搞砸了 "messed it up", 考砸了 "flunked the exam". 石 "stone" is the meaning part; 匝 gives the sound (zá, the same).

column3: Mixed, miscellaneous: 杂志 "magazine", 复杂 "complicated", 杂乱 "messy", 杂货 "sundries", 杂费 "incidental fees". It is seldom free on its own, and mostly forms words with a sense of "mixed, of various kinds". 杂 combines 衣 "clothes" with 集 "gather", which stood for a mix of colors.
column6: Wǒ měi ge yuè mǎi yī běn zázhì.
column7: I buy a magazine every month.
column9: Mixed, miscellaneous: 雜誌 "magazine", 複雜 "complicated", 雜亂 "messy", 雜貨 "sundries", 雜費 "incidental fees". It is seldom free on its own, and mostly forms words with a sense of "mixed, of various kinds". 雜 combines 衣 "clothes" with 集 "gather", which stood for a mix of colors.

column3: To carry, to load, to give a ride to: 载客 "carry passengers", 载货 "carry goods", 载我一程 "give me a lift". The vehicle is the subject: 这辆车可以载五个人. This reading is zài. A different reading, zǎi, is "year" in the written 记载 "record" and 千载难逢 "once in a thousand years". The cart 车 is the meaning part.
column6: Zhè liàng chē kěyǐ zài wǔ ge rén.
column7: This car can carry five people.
column9: To carry, to load, to give a ride to: 載客 "carry passengers", 載貨 "carry goods", 載我一程 "give me a lift". The vehicle is the subject: 這輛車可以載五個人. This reading is zài. A different reading, zǎi, is "year" in the written 記載 "record" and 千載難逢 "once in a thousand years". The cart 車 is the meaning part.

column3: Once again: 再度当选 "be elected again", 再度出现 "appear again", 再度发生. It comes before a verb and is more written than 又 and 再, and suggests that something happens another time after an earlier time. 再 "again" + 度 "time, occasion". The character 度 is also "degree" in 温度 and "to spend" in 度假.
column6: Tā zàidù dāngxuǎn shìzhǎng.
column7: He was elected mayor once again.
column9: Once again: 再度當選 "be elected again", 再度出現 "appear again", 再度發生. It comes before a verb and is more written than 又 and 再, and suggests that something happens another time after an earlier time. 再 "again" + 度 "time, occasion". The character 度 is also "degree" in 溫度 and "to spend" in 度假.

column3: Put off till later; moreover: 以后再说 "let's talk about it later", 先吃饭再说 "eat first and we'll see". In the first use it puts off a decision. It also introduces an extra reason, 再说 "besides": 太贵了，再说我也不需要. 再 "again" + 说 "say".
column6: Zhè jiàn shì yǐhòu zàishuō ba.
column7: Let's talk about this later.
column9: Put off till later; moreover: 以後再說 "let's talk about it later", 先吃飯再說 "eat first and we'll see". In the first use it puts off a decision. It also introduces an extra reason, 再說 "besides": 太貴了，再說我也不需要. 再 "again" + 說 "say".

column3: A funeral: 参加葬礼 "attend a funeral", 举行葬礼 "hold a funeral", 葬礼进行中. 葬 "bury" + 礼 "ceremony". It is the general word for the burial or cremation ceremony. 葬 shows a dead person 死 laid under grass 艹, the old way of burying, and 礼 has 礻 "altar" and 乚 for the sound.
column4: 我们去参加了他的葬礼。
column5: 我們去參加了他的葬禮。
column6: Wǒmen qù cānjiā le tā de zànglǐ.
column7: We went to his funeral.
column9: A funeral: 參加葬禮 "attend a funeral", 舉行葬禮 "hold a funeral", 葬禮進行中. 葬 "bury" + 禮 "ceremony". It is the general word for the burial or cremation ceremony. 葬 shows a dead person 死 laid under grass 艹, the old way of burying, and 禮 has 礻 "altar" and 豊 for the sound.

column3: To praise, to speak highly of: 赞美神 "praise God", 赞美她的歌声 "praise her singing", 受到赞美. It is stronger and more formal than 夸, and the one used for praising God, nature or art. 赞 "praise" + 美 "beauty". 赞 has 兟 for the sound and 贝 for the meaning.
column6: Lǎoshī zànměi le tā de nǔlì.
column7: The teacher praised his effort.
column9: To praise, to speak highly of: 讚美神 "praise God", 讚美她的歌聲 "praise her singing", 受到讚美. It is stronger and more formal than 誇, and the one used for praising God, nature or art. 讚 "praise" + 美 "beauty". 讚 has 言 "speech" for words of praise and 贊 as its sound. Also written 贊美.

column3: To agree with, to approve of an opinion or action: 赞同你的看法 "agree with your view", 赞同这个办法, 不赞同. It is a formal word that expresses support for an idea, and it takes an opinion or plan as object, not a person. 赞 "assist" + 同 "same".
column6: Dàjiā dōu zàntóng zhège bànfǎ.
column7: Everyone agrees with this method.
column9: To agree with, to approve of an opinion or action: 贊同你的看法 "agree with your view", 贊同這個辦法, 不贊同. It is a formal word that expresses support for an idea, and it takes an opinion or plan as object, not a person. 贊 "assist" + 同 "same".

column3: To suffer something unwelcome, to meet with: 遭到拒绝 "be refused", 遭到反对 "be opposed", 遭到攻击 "be attacked". The object is a bad thing that happens to the subject, and the sentence has a sense of passive, like 受到. 遭 "meet with" + 到 "reach". 遭 has 辶 "walk" because you meet things on the way.
column6: Tā de jìhuà zāodào le fǎnduì.
column7: His plan met with opposition.
column9: To suffer something unwelcome, to meet with: 遭到拒絕 "be refused", 遭到反對 "be opposed", 遭到攻擊 "be attacked". The object is a bad thing that happens to the subject, and the sentence has a sense of passive, like 受到. 遭 "meet with" + 到 "reach". 遭 has 辶 "walk" because you meet things on the way.

column3: Making a sentence, a school exercise: 用这个词造句 "make a sentence with this word", 造句练习. It is the exercise where you put a new word into a sentence of your own, a common homework and language class task. 造 "make" + 句 "sentence". 句 is also the classifier for sentences: 一句话. 造 has 辶 "walk".
column4: 老师要我们用这个词造句。
column5: 老師要我們用這個詞造句。
column6: Lǎoshī yào wǒmen yòng zhège cí zàojù.
column7: The teacher asks us to make a sentence with this word.
column9: Making a sentence, a school exercise: 用這個詞造句 "make a sentence with this word", 造句練習. It is the exercise where you put a new word into a sentence of your own, a common homework and language class task. 造 "make" + 句 "sentence". 句 is also the classifier for sentences: 一句話. 造 has 辶 "walk".

column3: To suffer, to be subjected to a loss, damage or misfortune: 遭受损失 "suffer losses", 遭受打击 "take a blow", 遭受攻击, 遭受水灾 "hit by a flood". The object is always bad, so it is for harm only, and is formal. 遭 "meet with" + 受 "receive". Compare 遭到, which is used with a sentence-like object: 遭到拒绝.
column4: 这个地区遭受了严重的水灾。
column5: 這個地區遭受了嚴重的水災。
column6: Zhège dìqū zāoshòu le yánzhòng de shuǐzāi.
column7: This area suffered serious flooding.
column9: To suffer, to be subjected to a loss, damage or misfortune: 遭受損失 "suffer losses", 遭受打擊 "take a blow", 遭受攻擊, 遭受水災 "hit by a flood". The object is always bad, so it is for harm only, and is formal. 遭 "meet with" + 受 "receive". Compare 遭到, which is used with a sentence-like object: 遭到拒絕.

column3: To meet with, to run into trouble, and "what one goes through": 遭遇困难 "meet difficulties", 遭遇车祸 "have a car accident", 悲惨的遭遇 "a miserable fate". As a noun it means experiences, most often hard ones. 遭 "meet with" + 遇 "encounter". 遇 is also in 遇到 "run into" and 相遇 "meet".
column4: 他在旅途中遭遇了很多困难。
column5: 他在旅途中遭遇了很多困難。
column6: Tā zài lǚtú zhōng zāoyù le hěn duō kùnnan.
column7: He ran into many difficulties on the trip.
column9: To meet with, to run into trouble, and "what one goes through": 遭遇困難 "meet difficulties", 遭遇車禍 "have a car accident", 悲慘的遭遇 "a miserable fate". As a noun it means experiences, most often hard ones. 遭 "meet with" + 遇 "encounter". 遇 is also in 遇到 "run into" and 相遇 "meet".

column3: A classifier for pieces of news, notices, jokes and short passages: 一则新闻 "a piece of news", 一则笑话 "a joke", 一则广告 "an ad". It counts items that are short and written or told. In writing, 则 is also "a rule" (规则, 原则) and "then" in 否则 "otherwise". The character has 刂 "knife" beside 贝, a rule cut in.
column4: 我看到一则有趣的新闻。
column5: 我看到一則有趣的新聞。
column6: Wǒ kàndào yī zé yǒuqù de xīnwén.
column7: I saw an interesting piece of news.
column9: A classifier for pieces of news, notices, jokes and short passages: 一則新聞 "a piece of news", 一則笑話 "a joke", 一則廣告 "an ad". It counts items that are short and written or told. In writing, 則 is also "a rule" (規則, 原則) and "then" in 否則 "otherwise". The character has 刂 "knife" beside 貝, a rule cut in.

column3: How: 怎么办 "what shall we do", 怎么了 "what happened", 怎么走 "how do I get there", 怎样. It is not free on its own and is nearly always 怎么 or 怎样. In 怎么 it asks about manner or reason. 怎 has 心 "heart" at the bottom and 乍 above it for the sound (zěn, zhà).
column6: Zhè dào tí gāi zěnme zuò?
column7: How should this problem be solved?
column9: How: 怎麼辦 "what shall we do", 怎麼了 "what happened", 怎麼走 "how do I get there", 怎樣. It is not free on its own and is nearly always 怎麼 or 怎樣. In 怎麼 it asks about manner or reason. 怎 has 心 "heart" at the bottom and 乍 above it for the sound (zěn, zhà).

column3: A free gift, a premium: 买一送一的赠品 "buy one get a gift", 附赠品 "comes with a gift", 赠品兑换. It is something given along with a purchase, for free, as a promotion. 赠 "give" + 品 "goods". 赠 has 贝 "shell, money" and 曾 for the sound (zèng, zēng).
column4: 买两罐咖啡就送一个赠品。
column5: 買兩罐咖啡就送一個贈品。
column6: Mǎi liǎng guàn kāfēi jiù sòng yī ge zèngpǐn.
column7: Buy two cans of coffee and you get a free gift.
column9: A free gift, a premium: 買一送一的贈品 "buy one get a gift", 附贈品 "comes with a gift", 贈品兌換. It is something given along with a purchase, for free, as a promotion. 贈 "give" + 品 "goods". 贈 has 貝 "shell, money" and 曾 for the sound (zèng, zēng).

column3: Narrow: 窄路 "a narrow road", 窄巷, 很窄. It is about width, the opposite of 宽. It can also mean narrow-minded: 心胸窄. 窄 has 穴 "hole" above and 乍 below for the sound (zhǎi, zhà: close), so the narrow space of a hole.
column4: 这条路很窄，车子开不进去。
column5: 這條路很窄，車子開不進去。
column6: Zhè tiáo lù hěn zhǎi, chēzi kāi bù jìnqù.
column7: This road is narrow and cars cannot drive in.
column9: Narrow: 窄路 "a narrow road", 窄巷, 很窄. It is about width, the opposite of 寬. It can also mean narrow-minded: 心胸窄. 窄 has 穴 "hole" above and 乍 below for the sound (zhǎi, zhà: close), so the narrow space of a hole.

column3: A battlefield: 战场上的士兵 "soldiers on the battlefield", 上战场 "go to war", 战场如商场 "business is war". The word is also used in figurative speech for any place of fierce competition. 战 "fight" + 场 "field, place". 场 has 土 "earth" on its left and 勿 on its right.
column6: Shìbīng zài zhànchǎng shàng shòu le shāng.
column7: The soldier was wounded on the battlefield.
column9: A battlefield: 戰場上的士兵 "soldiers on the battlefield", 上戰場 "go to war", 戰場如商場 "business is war". The word is also used in figurative speech for any place of fierce competition. 戰 "fight" + 場 "field, place". 場 has 土 "earth" and 昜 for the sound (chǎng, yáng).

column3: To put on display, to exhibit: 画作展出 "paintings are shown", 展出作品 "exhibit works", 展出时间 "exhibition dates". Used for a museum, a gallery or a trade fair. 展 "unfold, display" + 出 "out". 出 shows a sprout coming out of a container.
column6: Zhèxiē huà zài měishùguǎn zhǎnchū.
column7: These paintings are on display at the art museum.
column9: To put on display, to exhibit: 畫作展出 "paintings are shown", 展出作品 "exhibit works", 展出時間 "exhibition dates". Used for a museum, a gallery or a trade fair. 展 "unfold, display" + 出 "out". 出 shows a sprout coming out of a container.

column3: A chapter, and a section: 第三章 "chapter three", 这本书有十章, 章节 "chapters and sections". It is also a seal or a badge (图章, 徽章) and a regulation (规章). 章 shows 音 "sound" over 十: one explanation sees the ten movements of a piece of music, hence a section.
column6: Zhè běn shū yīgòng yǒu shí zhāng.
column7: This book has ten chapters in all.
column9: A chapter, and a section: 第三章 "chapter three", 這本書有十章, 章節 "chapters and sections". It is also a seal or a badge (圖章, 徽章) and a regulation (規章). 章 shows 音 "sound" over 十: one explanation sees the ten movements of a piece of music, hence a section.

column3: One's elders, the older generation of a family or of a place: 长辈 versus 晚辈, 尊敬长辈 "respect one's elders", 给长辈拜年 "pay New Year's greetings to elders". It is the term for relatives of an older generation, parents, uncles and aunts, and so on. 长 here is read zhǎng "to grow, elder", not cháng "long". 辈 gives "generation".
column4: 过年的时候要给长辈拜年。
column5: 過年的時候要給長輩拜年。
column6: Guònián de shíhou yào gěi zhǎngbèi bàinián.
column7: At New Year you wish your elders a happy New Year.
column9: One's elders, the older generation of a family or of a place: 長輩 versus 晚輩, 尊敬長輩 "respect one's elders", 給長輩拜年 "pay New Year's greetings to elders". It is the term for relatives of an older generation, parents, uncles and aunts, and so on. 長 here is read zhǎng "to grow, elder", not cháng "long". 輩 gives "generation".

column3: A bill, a statement of what is owed: 信用卡帐单 "credit card statement", 水电帐单 "utility bill", 结账 "pay the bill". In a restaurant you ask to pay with 买单 or 结账. 帐 "account" + 单 "slip, list". 帐 has 巾 "cloth" and 长 for the sound (zhàng, zhǎng).
column4: 服务生把帐单拿给了我。
column5: 服務生把帳單拿給了我。
column6: Fúwùshēng bǎ zhàngdān ná gěi le wǒ.
column7: The waiter brought me the bill.
column9: A bill, a statement of what is owed: 信用卡帳單 "credit card statement", 水電帳單 "utility bill", 結帳 "pay the bill". In a restaurant you ask to pay with 買單 or 結帳. 帳 "account" + 單 "slip, list". 帳 has 巾 "cloth" and 長 for the sound (zhàng, zhǎng).

column3: To open out, to spread open: 张开嘴 "open one's mouth", 张开手臂 "spread one's arms", 张开眼睛 "open one's eyes". It is for things that open outward from a closed state, like the mouth, wings or a net. 张 "stretch" + 开 "open". 张 has 弓 "bow" for the stretching, and is also a surname and the classifier for flat things: 一张纸.
column4: 他张开嘴巴，却说不出话来。
column5: 他張開嘴巴，卻說不出話來。
column6: Tā zhāngkāi zuǐba, què shuō bù chū huà lái.
column7: He opened his mouth but could not say a word.
column9: To open out, to spread open: 張開嘴 "open one's mouth", 張開手臂 "spread one's arms", 張開眼睛 "open one's eyes". It is for things that open outward from a closed state, like the mouth, wings or a net. 張 "stretch" + 開 "open". 張 has 弓 "bow" for the stretching, and is also a surname and the classifier for flat things: 一張紙.

column3: Applause: 热烈的掌声 "warm applause", 响起掌声 "applause rings out", 赢得掌声 "win applause", 献上掌声. 掌 "palm" + 声 "sound", so the sound of palms. Applause itself is 鼓掌 as a verb: 大家鼓掌. 掌 has 手 "hand" below and 尚 for the sound (zhǎng, shàng).
column4: 观众给了他热烈的掌声。
column5: 觀眾給了他熱烈的掌聲。
column6: Guānzhòng gěi le tā rèliè de zhǎngshēng.
column7: The audience gave him warm applause.
column9: Applause: 熱烈的掌聲 "warm applause", 響起掌聲 "applause rings out", 贏得掌聲 "win applause", 獻上掌聲. 掌 "palm" + 聲 "sound", so the sound of palms. Applause itself is 鼓掌 as a verb: 大家鼓掌. 掌 has 手 "hand" below and 尚 for the sound (zhǎng, shàng).

column3: As usual, as normal: 照常上班 "go to work as usual", 照常营业 "open for business as usual", 照常举行 "go ahead as planned". It goes before the verb and says that things carry on unchanged despite something, such as bad weather. 照 "according to" + 常 "usual". 照 has 灬 "fire" for the light, as the "shine" meaning.
column6: Míngtiān zhàocháng shàngbān, bù fàngjià.
column7: Tomorrow is a normal workday, with no day off.
column9: As usual, as normal: 照常上班 "go to work as usual", 照常營業 "open for business as usual", 照常舉行 "go ahead as planned". It goes before the verb and says that things carry on unchanged despite something, such as bad weather. 照 "according to" + 常 "usual". 照 has 灬 "fire" for the light, as the "shine" meaning.

column3: To convert into, to amount to: 折合台币 "equal so many NT dollars", 折合成美元 "converted into US dollars", 折合起来 "all in all". It is used for exchange and conversion between currencies or units. 折 "turn into, convert" + 合 "add up". 折 has 扌 "hand" and 斤 "axe", a hand with an axe cutting.
column4: 这笔钱折合台币一万元。
column5: 這筆錢折合台幣一萬元。
column6: Zhè bǐ qián zhéhé táibì yī wàn yuán.
column7: This sum comes to ten thousand Taiwan dollars.
column9: To convert into, to amount to: 折合台幣 "equal so many NT dollars", 折合成美元 "converted into US dollars", 折合起來 "all in all". It is used for exchange and conversion between currencies or units. 折 "turn into, convert" + 合 "add up". 折 has 扌 "hand" and 斤 "axe", a hand with an axe cutting.

column3: A discount: 打折 "give a discount", 打八折 "20% off", 有折扣 "there is a discount", 折扣券 "a discount coupon". Be careful with the number: 八折 means you pay 80 percent, so it is 20 percent off, and 打对折 means half price. 折 is "fold, cut" and 扣 means "to deduct".
column6: Zhè jiàn yīfu yǒu zhékòu ma?
column7: Is there a discount on this piece of clothing?
column9: A discount: 打折 "give a discount", 打八折 "20% off", 有折扣 "there is a discount", 折扣券 "a discount coupon". Be careful with the number: 八折 means you pay 80 percent, so it is 20 percent off, and 打對折 means half price. 折 is "fold, cut" and 扣 means "to deduct".

column3: To torment, to cause suffering again and again: 折磨人 "torment people", 受折磨 "suffer torment", 病痛折磨 "tortured by illness". It can be physical or mental pain that goes on for a long time. 折 "break" + 磨 "grind", so being ground down slowly. The second syllable of 折磨 is read mó. 磨 has 石 "stone", from the stone of a mill.
column4: 这种疼痛折磨了他好几年。
column5: 這種疼痛折磨了他好幾年。
column6: Zhè zhǒng téngtòng zhémó le tā hǎo jǐ nián.
column7: This pain tormented him for several years.
column9: To torment, to cause suffering again and again: 折磨人 "torment people", 受折磨 "suffer torment", 病痛折磨 "tortured by illness". It can be physical or mental pain that goes on for a long time. 折 "break" + 磨 "grind", so being ground down slowly. The second syllable of 折磨 is read mó. 磨 has 石 "stone", from the stone of a mill.

column3: To shake, to vibrate, and also to shock: 手机震动 "the phone vibrates", 震动模式 "vibrate mode", 全国震动 "the whole country was shaken". An earthquake is 地震; 震动 is more general. 震 "shake" + 动 "move". 震 has 雨 "rain".
column6: Shǒujī zhèndòng le yīxià.
column7: The phone vibrated once.
column9: To shake, to vibrate, and also to shock: 手機震動 "the phone vibrates", 震動模式 "vibrate mode", 全國震動 "the whole country was shaken". An earthquake is 地震; 震動 is more general. 震 "shake" + 動 "move". 震 has 雨 "rain".

column3: To open the eyes wide: 睁开眼睛 "open one's eyes", 睁大眼睛 "open one's eyes wide", 睁一只眼闭一只眼 "turn a blind eye". It goes with 眼睛 and takes a result like 开 or 大. 睁 has 目 "eye" for the meaning and 争 for the sound (zhēng, the same).
column6: Tā mànmàn zhēngkāi le yǎnjing.
column7: He slowly opened his eyes.
column9: To open the eyes wide: 睜開眼睛 "open one's eyes", 睜大眼睛 "open one's eyes wide", 睜一隻眼閉一隻眼 "turn a blind eye". It goes with 眼睛 and takes a result like 開 or 大. 睜 has 目 "eye" for the meaning and 爭 for the sound (zhēng, the same).

column3: Policy, a government plan: 政府的政策 "government policy", 制定政策 "make a policy", 政策改变 "policy change", 新政策. 政 "government" + 策 "plan". 策 has 竹 "bamboo" above, as writing slips of bamboo were once used, and it also means "whip" in an older sense.
column6: Zhèngfǔ gōngbù le xīn de zhèngcè.
column7: The government announced a new policy.
column9: Policy, a government plan: 政府的政策 "government policy", 制定政策 "make a policy", 政策改變 "policy change", 新政策. 政 "government" + 策 "plan". 策 has 竹 "bamboo" above, as writing slips of bamboo were once used, and it also means "whip" in an older sense.

column3: A political party: 政党政治 "party politics", 执政党 "the ruling party", 在野党 "the opposition", 加入政党. 政 "politics" + 党 "party". 党 has 尚 for the sound and 兄 below.
column6: Táiwān yǒu hěn duō zhèngdǎng.
column7: There are many political parties in Taiwan.
column9: A political party: 政黨政治 "party politics", 執政黨 "the ruling party", 在野黨 "the opposition", 加入政黨. 政 "politics" + 黨 "party". 黨 has 黑 "black" at the bottom and 尚 for the sound; the old sense is "dark".

column3: A square: 一个正方形 "a square", 正方形的桌子. 正 "regular, true" + 方 "square" + 形 "shape". It is distinct from 长方形 "rectangle", 圆形 "circle" and 三角形 "triangle". Here 正 means exact and equal on every side. 形 has 彡 on its right, a part for shape and patterns.
column6: Zhè zhāng zhǐ shì zhèngfāngxíng de.
column7: This sheet of paper is a square.
column9: A square: 一個正方形 "a square", 正方形的桌子. 正 "regular, true" + 方 "square" + 形 "shape". It is distinct from 長方形 "rectangle", 圓形 "circle" and 三角形 "triangle". Here 正 means exact and equal on every side. 形 has 彡 on its right, a part for shape and patterns.

column3: Neat and tidy, clean and orderly: 整洁的房间 "a tidy room", 保持整洁 "keep neat", 环境整洁. It praises how things are arranged and kept clean, for places and for one's dress. 整 "in order" + 洁 "clean". 洁 has 氵 "water" for washing and 吉 for the sound (jié, jí: close).
column6: Tā de fángjiān zǒngshì hěn zhěngjié.
column7: Her room is always neat and tidy.
column9: Neat and tidy, clean and orderly: 整潔的房間 "a tidy room", 保持整潔 "keep neat", 環境整潔. It praises how things are arranged and kept clean, for places and for one's dress. 整 "in order" + 潔 "clean". 潔 has 氵 "water" for washing and 絜 for the sound (jié, xié: close).

column3: Serious, proper, and "decent": 一本正经 "with a straight face", 正经事 "serious business", 正经人 "a decent person", 说正经的 "seriously now". It can describe a person or a manner as solemn, or work as proper and honorable. 正 "straight" + 经 "path, classic".
column4: 他说话很正经，不像在开玩笑。
column5: 他說話很正經，不像在開玩笑。
column6: Tā shuōhuà hěn zhèngjīng, bù xiàng zài kāi wánxiào.
column7: He speaks very seriously and does not seem to be joking.
column9: Serious, proper, and "decent": 一本正經 "with a straight face", 正經事 "serious business", 正經人 "a decent person", 說正經的 "seriously now". It can describe a person or a manner as solemn, or work as proper and honorable. 正 "straight" + 經 "path, classic".

column3: The front, the front side, and "positive, direct": 房子的正面 "the front of the house", 正面的评价 "positive evaluation", 正面回答 "give a straight answer", 正面思考 "think positively". The opposite is 反面 "the back side, the negative side" or 背面. 正 "right, facing" + 面 "side, face". 面 is a picture of a face with an eye.
column6: Fángzi de zhèngmiàn duìzhe mǎlù.
column7: The front of the house faces the road.
column9: The front, the front side, and "positive, direct": 房子的正面 "the front of the house", 正面的評價 "positive evaluation", 正面回答 "give a straight answer", 正面思考 "think positively". The opposite is 反面 "the back side, the negative side" or 背面. 正 "right, facing" + 面 "side, face". 面 is a picture of a face with an eye.

column3: A whole number, an integer: 请算到整数 "round to a whole number", 正整数 "positive integer", 整数部分. It is a maths word, and contrasts with 小数 "decimal" and 分数 "fraction". 整 "whole" + 数 "number". Here 数 is read shù "number", and shǔ means "to count".
column4: 请把答案四舍五入到整数。
column5: 請把答案四捨五入到整數。
column6: Qǐng bǎ dá'àn sìshěwǔrù dào zhěngshù.
column7: Please round the answer to a whole number.
column9: A whole number, an integer: 請算到整數 "round to a whole number", 正整數 "positive integer", 整數部分. It is a maths word, and contrasts with 小數 "decimal" and 分數 "fraction". 整 "whole" + 數 "number". Here 數 is read shù "number", and shǔ means "to count".

column3: The first month of the lunar year: 农历正月 "the first lunar month", 正月初一 "the first day of the lunar year", 过正月. 正 is read zhēng here, not zhèng, as in 正月 only and a few other words about the first month. 月 shows a crescent moon.
column6: Zhēngyuè chū yī shì Chūnjié.
column7: The first day of the first lunar month is the Spring Festival.
column9: The first month of the lunar year: 農曆正月 "the first lunar month", 正月初一 "the first day of the lunar year", 過正月. 正 is read zhēng here, not zhèng, as in 正月 only and a few other words about the first month. 月 shows a crescent moon.

column3: A symptom of a disease: 感冒的症状 "cold symptoms", 症状轻微 "mild symptoms", 出现症状 "show symptoms", 没有症状. 症 "illness sign" + 状 "state, shape". 症 has 疒 "sickness" and 正 for the sound (zhèng, the same). 状 has 犬 "dog" and 丬 as the sound.
column4: 感冒的症状有咳嗽和发烧。
column5: 感冒的症狀有咳嗽和發燒。
column6: Gǎnmào de zhèngzhuàng yǒu késou hé fāshāo.
column7: The symptoms of a cold are coughing and fever.
column9: A symptom of a disease: 感冒的症狀 "cold symptoms", 症狀輕微 "mild symptoms", 出現症狀 "show symptoms", 沒有症狀. 症 "illness sign" + 狀 "state, shape". 症 has 疒 "sickness" and 正 for the sound (zhèng, the same). 狀 has 犬 "dog" and 爿 as the sound.

column3: A detective: 私家侦探 "private detective", 侦探小说 "detective novel", 侦探片 "detective film". As a verb 侦探 means "to investigate in secret". 侦 "detect" + 探 "explore". 侦 has 亻 "person" and 贞 for the sound (zhēn, the same); 探 has 扌 "hand", the hand reaching out to feel.
column4: 这个侦探找到了真正的小偷。
column5: 這個偵探找到了真正的小偷。
column6: Zhège zhēntàn zhǎodào le zhēnzhèng de xiǎotōu.
column7: The detective found the real thief.
column9: A detective: 私家偵探 "private detective", 偵探小說 "detective novel", 偵探片 "detective film". As a verb 偵探 means "to investigate in secret". 偵 "detect" + 探 "explore". 偵 has 亻 "person" and 貞 for the sound (zhēn, the same); 探 has 扌 "hand", the hand reaching out to feel.

column3: A period of time, a while: 前一阵子 "a while ago", 这阵子 "lately", 好一阵子 "quite a while", 一阵子 "a spell". It is a time span of unclear length, about some days to weeks. 阵 "formation, spell" + 子. 子 is neutral: zhènzi. 这阵子 and 前阵子 are very common.
column6: Qián yī zhènzi wǒ hěn máng.
column7: A while ago I was very busy.
column9: A period of time, a while: 前一陣子 "a while ago", 這陣子 "lately", 好一陣子 "quite a while", 一陣子 "a spell". It is a time span of unclear length, about some days to weeks. 陣 "formation, spell" + 子. 子 is neutral: zhènzi. 這陣子 and 前陣子 are very common.

column3: To stop, to halt: 停止 "stop", 禁止 "prohibit", 制止, 止痛 "stop pain", 到此为止 "that is enough". It is mostly a base for compounds, and means to come to a stop or limit. The meaning "only" is rare today. 止 started as a picture of a foot.
column6: Yǔ zhōngyú tíngzhǐ le.
column7: The rain finally stopped.
column9: To stop, to halt: 停止 "stop", 禁止 "prohibit", 制止, 止痛 "stop pain", 到此為止 "that is enough". It is mostly a base for compounds, and means to come to a stop or limit. The meaning "only" is rare today. 止 started as a picture of a foot.

column3: To throw, to toss, especially dice or something light: 掷骰子 "throw dice", 掷硬币 "toss a coin", 掷标枪 "throw a javelin". It is a literary or formal verb; people say 丢 in daily speech. 扌 "hand" for the meaning and 郑 for the sound. In Taiwan this is read zhí.
column6: Tā zhì le yīxià shǎizi.
column7: He rolled the dice once.
column9: To throw, to toss, especially dice or something light: 擲骰子 "throw dice", 擲硬幣 "toss a coin", 擲標槍 "throw a javelin". It is a literary or formal verb; people say 丟 in daily speech. 扌 "hand" for the meaning and 鄭 for the sound. In Taiwan this is read zhí.

column3: Of, a literary particle, and "him, her, it": 三分之一 "one third", 百分之五十 "fifty percent", 总之 "in short", 之后 "after", 之前 "before", 之间 "between". It works like 的 in fixed phrases, and is the pattern for fractions and percentages: N分之M. It is not for plain speech apart from these phrases.
column4: 全班有三分之一的人迟到了。
column5: 全班有三分之一的人遲到了。
column6: Quánbān yǒu sānfēnzhīyī de rén chídào le.
column7: A third of the class was late.
column9: Of, a literary particle, and "him, her, it": 三分之一 "one third", 百分之五十 "fifty percent", 總之 "in short", 之後 "after", 之前 "before", 之間 "between". It works like 的 in fixed phrases, and is the pattern for fractions and percentages: N分之M. It is not for plain speech apart from these phrases.

column3: To designate, to appoint, to assign: 指定地点 "the appointed place", 指定的时间, 指定座位 "assigned seating", 指定作业 "assigned homework". It describes picking something out by authority or in advance. 指 "point" + 定 "fix". 指 has 扌 "hand" and 旨 which also gives the sound (zhǐ, the same).
column4: 老师指定我们读这本书。
column5: 老師指定我們讀這本書。
column6: Lǎoshī zhǐdìng wǒmen dú zhè běn shū.
column7: The teacher assigned us this book to read.
column9: To designate, to appoint, to assign: 指定地點 "the appointed place", 指定的時間, 指定座位 "assigned seating", 指定作業 "assigned homework". It describes picking something out by authority or in advance. 指 "point" + 定 "fix". 指 has 扌 "hand" and 旨 which also gives the sound (zhǐ, the same).

column3: And so on, and the like: 苹果、香蕉之类的水果 "fruits such as apples and bananas", 书本之类 "books and the like". It comes at the end of a list of examples, with 的 before a noun. 之 "of" + 类 "kind", so "of that kind". 类 has 米 above 大.
column4: 我喜欢水果，像苹果、香蕉之类。
column5: 我喜歡水果，像蘋果、香蕉之類。
column6: Wǒ xǐhuan shuǐguǒ, xiàng píngguǒ, xiāngjiāo zhīlèi.
column7: I like fruit, such as apples, bananas and the like.
column9: And so on, and the like: 蘋果、香蕉之類的水果 "fruits such as apples and bananas", 書本之類 "books and the like". It comes at the end of a list of examples, with 的 before a noun. 之 "of" + 類 "kind", so "of that kind". 類 has 頁 "head" on its right.

column3: A check (cheque): 开支票 "write a check", 支票簿, 兑现支票 "cash a check", 空头支票 "a bad check, an empty promise". 支 "pay out, branch" + 票 "ticket, note". 票 is also in 车票, 邮票 and 发票.
column4: 他开了一张支票给房东。
column5: 他開了一張支票給房東。
column6: Tā kāi le yī zhāng zhīpiào gěi fángdōng.
column7: He wrote the landlord a check.
column9: A check (cheque): 開支票 "write a check", 支票簿, 兌現支票 "cash a check", 空頭支票 "a bad check, an empty promise". 支 "pay out, branch" + 票 "ticket, note". 票 is also in 車票, 郵票 and 發票.

column3: Ambition, spirit, backbone: 有志气 "has drive", 没志气 "has no backbone", 志气高 "high-minded". It says a person has pride and determination to do well and not give in. 志 "will" + 气 "spirit". 志 has 心 "heart" under 士, and the top gives the sound.
column6: Zhè háizi hěn yǒu zhìqì.
column7: This child has real spirit.
column9: Ambition, spirit, backbone: 有志氣 "has drive", 沒志氣 "has no backbone", 志氣高 "high-minded". It says a person has pride and determination to do well and not give in. 志 "will" + 氣 "spirit". 志 has 心 "heart" under 士, and the top gives the sound.

column3: Order, orderliness: 维持秩序 "keep order", 遵守秩序 "follow the rules", 社会秩序 "public order", 秩序井然 "in perfect order". It speaks of things in their right order and proper arrangement, and of people behaving in line. 秩 "order" + 序 "sequence". 秩 has 禾 "grain" and 失 for sound; the old sense was grain piled in order.
column4: 请大家遵守秩序，排队上车。
column5: 請大家遵守秩序，排隊上車。
column6: Qǐng dàjiā zūnshǒu zhìxù, páiduì shàngchē.
column7: Everyone, please keep order and line up to board.
column9: Order, orderliness: 維持秩序 "keep order", 遵守秩序 "follow the rules", 社會秩序 "public order", 秩序井然 "in perfect order". It speaks of things in their right order and proper arrangement, and of people behaving in line. 秩 "order" + 序 "sequence". 秩 has 禾 "grain" and 失 for sound; the old sense was grain piled in order.

column3: To support, to back with people or supplies: 支援灾区 "support the disaster area", 支援前线 "support the front", 技术支援 "tech support", 互相支援. 支 "support" + 援 "help". 援 has 扌 "hand" and 爰 as its sound (yuán, the same), and 爰 itself means to lead by hand.
column4: 各地的朋友都来支援我们。
column5: 各地的朋友都來支援我們。
column6: Gèdì de péngyou dōu lái zhīyuán wǒmen.
column7: Friends from everywhere came to support us.
column9: To support, to back with people or supplies: 支援災區 "support the disaster area", 支援前線 "support the front", 技術支援 "tech support", 互相支援. 支 "support" + 援 "help". 援 has 扌 "hand" and 爰 as its sound (yuán, the same), and 爰 itself means to lead by hand.

column3: To make, to manufacture, mostly the second part of a word: 木制 "made of wood", 制造 "manufacture", 制作 "make", 制品 "product", 自制 "homemade", 手工制 "handmade". 制 has 巾 on its left and 刂 on its right.
column6: Zhè zhāng zhuōzi shì mùzhì de.
column7: This table is made of wood.
column9: To make, to manufacture, mostly the second part of a word: 木製 "made of wood", 製造 "manufacture", 製作 "make", 製品 "product", 自製 "homemade", 手工製 "handmade". 製 has 衣 "clothes" below, and 制 above gives the sound.

column3: Paper, said of its kind and quality: 纸张的品质 "the quality of the paper", 纸张很厚 "thick paper", 浪费纸张 "waste paper", 印刷纸张. It names paper as a material, apart from 纸 for a sheet. 纸 "paper" + 张, the classifier for flat things, so a word for paper by the sheet. 纸 has 纟 "silk" as its meaning part.
column6: Zhè zhǒng zhǐzhāng yòu hòu yòu yìng.
column7: This kind of paper is thick and stiff.
column9: Paper, said of its kind and quality: 紙張的品質 "the quality of the paper", 紙張很厚 "thick paper", 浪費紙張 "waste paper", 印刷紙張. It names paper as a material, apart from 紙 for a sheet. 紙 "paper" + 張, the classifier for flat things, so a word for paper by the sheet. 紙 has 糹 "silk" as its meaning part.

column3: To stop, to put a stop to someone's act: 制止暴力 "stop violence", 制止他们吵架 "stop them from quarreling", 无法制止. The subject is someone with the power or duty to stop what another is doing. 制 "control" + 止 "stop".
column6: Lǎoshī zhìzhǐ le tāmen chǎojià.
column7: The teacher stopped them from arguing.
column9: To stop, to put a stop to someone's act: 制止暴力 "stop violence", 制止他們吵架 "stop them from quarreling", 無法制止. The subject is someone with the power or duty to stop what another is doing. 制 "control" + 止 "stop".

column3: Read zhòng, "to hit the mark, to win, to be struck by": 中奖 "win a prize", 中毒 "be poisoned", 中风 "have a stroke", 猜中 "guess right", 打中 "hit". It goes with a result: 他中奖了 "he won a prize". The usual reading of 中 is zhōng "middle", so watch for this one.
column6: Tā zhòng le yī ge dàjiǎng.
column7: He won a big prize.
column9: Read zhòng, "to hit the mark, to win, to be struck by": 中獎 "win a prize", 中毒 "be poisoned", 中風 "have a stroke", 猜中 "guess right", 打中 "hit". It goes with a result: 他中獎了 "he won a prize". The usual reading of 中 is zhōng "middle", so watch for this one.

column3: Swollen, and "to swell": 肿起来 "swell up", 肿了 "swollen", 红肿 "red and swollen", 肿瘤 "a tumor". It is for injuries, insect bites and infections where part of the body puffs up. 肿 has ⺼ "flesh" and 中 for the sound (zhǒng, zhōng).
column6: Wǒ de jiǎohuái zhǒng qǐlái le.
column7: My ankle has swollen up.
column9: Swollen, and "to swell": 腫起來 "swell up", 腫了 "swollen", 紅腫 "red and swollen", 腫瘤 "a tumor". It is for injuries, insect bites and infections where part of the body puffs up. 腫 has ⺼ "flesh" and 重 for the sound (zhǒng, zhòng).

column3: A serious injury: 受重伤 "be seriously injured", 重伤者 "the seriously injured", 重伤不治 "die of one's wounds". It is a word of news about accidents and crime, the opposite of 轻伤. 重 "heavy" + 伤 "wound", with 重 read zhòng, not chóng. 伤 has 亻 "person" and a part that sounds like shāng.
column6: Tā zài chēhuò zhōng shòu le zhòngshāng.
column7: He was seriously injured in the car accident.
column9: A serious injury: 受重傷 "be seriously injured", 重傷者 "the seriously injured", 重傷不治 "die of one's wounds". It is a word of news about accidents and crime, the opposite of 輕傷. 重 "heavy" + 傷 "wound", with 重 read zhòng, not chóng. 傷 has 亻 "person" and a part that sounds like shāng.

column3: Midway, partway: 中途离开 "leave halfway", 中途下车 "get off along the way", 中途放弃 "give up halfway". It is the time or place between the start and the end of a journey or an activity, and is often used for stopping before the finish. 中 "middle" + 途 "way". 途 has 辶 "walk" for travel and 余 for the sound (tú, yú).
column6: Tā zhōngtú líkāi le jiàoshì.
column7: He left the classroom partway through.
column9: Midway, partway: 中途離開 "leave halfway", 中途下車 "get off along the way", 中途放棄 "give up halfway". It is the time or place between the start and the end of a journey or an activity, and is often used for stopping before the finish. 中 "middle" + 途 "way". 途 has 辶 "walk" for travel and 余 for the sound (tú, yú).

column3: Focus, the main emphasis, and the center of gravity in physics: 工作重心 "the focus of work", 把重心放在… "put the emphasis on…", 失去重心 "lose one's balance". 重 "heavy, weighty" + 心 "center". It speaks of what matters most in a plan or a talk.
column4: 这次会议的重心是环境保护。
column5: 這次會議的重心是環境保護。
column6: Zhè cì huìyì de zhòngxīn shì huánjìng bǎohù.
column7: The focus of this meeting is environmental protection.
column9: Focus, the main emphasis, and the center of gravity in physics: 工作重心 "the focus of work", 把重心放在… "put the emphasis on…", 失去重心 "lose one's balance". 重 "heavy, weighty" + 心 "center". It speaks of what matters most in a plan or a talk.

column3: Race, an ethnic group in the sense of a people: 种族歧视 "racial discrimination", 种族问题, 不同种族. It is the term for groups of people of a common origin, as with 种族歧视 in the news. 种 "kind" + 族 "clan". 族 has 方 "flag" and 矢 "arrow", a people gathering under a flag. 种 is read zhǒng "kind", not zhòng "to plant".
column6: Zhǒngzú qíshì shì bù duì de.
column7: Racial discrimination is wrong.
column9: Race, an ethnic group in the sense of a people: 種族歧視 "racial discrimination", 種族問題, 不同種族. It is the term for groups of people of a common origin, as with 種族歧視 in the news. 種 "kind" + 族 "clan". 族 has 方 "flag" and 矢 "arrow", a people gathering under a flag. 種 is read zhǒng "kind", not zhòng "to plant".

column3: A state or a province, in names: 美国的五十个州 "the fifty US states", 加州 "California", 德州 "Texas". As a division of a country it is used for the US, Australia and others. The character shows land in a river, an islet, and also in 洲 (a continent) with 氵 "water" added.
column6: Měiguó yǒu wǔshí ge zhōu.
column7: The United States has fifty states.
column9: A state or a province, in names: 美國的五十個州 "the fifty US states", 加州 "California", 德州 "Texas". As a division of a country it is used for the US, Australia and others. The character shows land in a river, an islet, and also in 洲 (a continent) with 氵 "water" added.

column3: Congee, rice porridge: 喝粥 "eat porridge", 白粥 "plain congee", 皮蛋瘦肉粥 "century egg and pork congee", 海鲜粥. Plain rice porridge is also called 稀饭. 粥 shows 米 "rice" between two 弓, the steam rising from the pot.
column6: Zǎocān wǒ hē le yī wǎn zhōu.
column7: For breakfast I had a bowl of congee.
column9: Congee, rice porridge: 喝粥 "eat porridge", 白粥 "plain congee", 皮蛋瘦肉粥 "century egg and pork congee", 海鮮粥. Plain rice porridge is also called 稀飯. 粥 shows 米 "rice" between two 弓, the steam rising from the pot.

column3: Thoughtful and thorough, said of service, planning or care: 服务周到 "attentive service", 考虑周到 "thorough thought", 想得很周到. It praises someone who has attended to every detail so nothing is missed. 周 "all around" + 到 "reach", so it reaches all corners.
column4: 他做事很周到，从不遗漏。
column5: 他做事很周到，從不遺漏。
column6: Tā zuòshì hěn zhōudào, cóngbù yílòu.
column7: He is very thorough in what he does and never misses anything.
column9: Thoughtful and thorough, said of service, planning or care: 服務周到 "attentive service", 考慮周到 "thorough thought", 想得很周到. It praises someone who has attended to every detail so nothing is missed. 周 "all around" + 到 "reach", so it reaches all corners.

column3: Bamboo: 竹子 "bamboo", 竹笋 "bamboo shoot", 竹林 "bamboo grove", 竹篮 "bamboo basket". As the top part 竹 becomes ⺮ in 笔, 笑, 算, 箱: words about writing, counting, and objects made of bamboo.
column6: Xióngmāo zuì xǐhuan chī zhúzi.
column7: Pandas love eating bamboo most.
column9: Bamboo: 竹子 "bamboo", 竹筍 "bamboo shoot", 竹林 "bamboo grove", 竹籃 "bamboo basket". As the top part 竹 becomes ⺮ in 筆, 笑, 算, 箱: words about writing, counting, and objects made of bamboo.

column3: To earn, to make a profit: 赚钱 "make money", 赚了不少 "made a good profit", 赚外快 "earn a bit on the side". The reverse is 赔 "lose money". 赚 has 贝 "shell, money" and 兼 for the sound (zhuàn, jiān).
column6: Tā yī ge yuè zhuàn wǔ wàn yuán.
column7: He earns fifty thousand dollars a month.
column9: To earn, to make a profit: 賺錢 "make money", 賺了不少 "made a good profit", 賺外快 "earn a bit on the side". The reverse is 賠 "lose money". 賺 has 貝 "shell, money" and 兼 for the sound (zhuàn, jiān).

column3: To relay or rebroadcast, to broadcast live: 现场转播 "live broadcast", 转播比赛 "broadcast a match", 电视转播. It names the sending out of an event by radio or TV from the place it happens. 转 "turn, pass on" + 播 "broadcast, sow". 播 has 扌 "hand" and 番 which gives the sound and also means seeds sown.
column6: Zhè chǎng bǐsài huì xiànchǎng zhuǎnbō.
column7: This match will be broadcast live.
column9: To relay or rebroadcast, to broadcast live: 現場轉播 "live broadcast", 轉播比賽 "broadcast a match", 電視轉播. It names the sending out of an event by radio or TV from the place it happens. 轉 "turn, pass on" + 播 "broadcast, sow". 播 has 扌 "hand" and 番 which gives the sound and also means seeds sown.

column3: To pass on a message, to convey words from one person to another: 转达谢意 "pass on thanks", 转达问候 "pass on greetings", 请代为转达. It is polite and formal, used when you take someone's message to a third party. 转 "turn, pass" + 达 "reach". 达 has 辶 "walk".
column4: 请你替我向他转达谢意。
column5: 請你替我向他轉達謝意。
column6: Qǐng nǐ tì wǒ xiàng tā zhuǎndá xièyì.
column7: Please pass on my thanks to him.
column9: To pass on a message, to convey words from one person to another: 轉達謝意 "pass on thanks", 轉達問候 "pass on greetings", 請代為轉達. It is polite and formal, used when you take someone's message to a third party. 轉 "turn, pass" + 達 "reach". 達 has 辶 "walk".

column3: Strong, sturdy, robust: 身体壮 "strong in body", 长得又高又壮 "tall and sturdy", 壮汉 "a burly man", 壮观 "magnificent". It can also mean to make stronger: 壮胆 "pluck up courage". 壮 has 丬 on the left, which gives the sound (zhuàng, the same), and 士 "man" is the meaning part.
column4: 这个孩子长得又高又壮。
column5: 這個孩子長得又高又壯。
column6: Zhège háizi zhǎng de yòu gāo yòu zhuàng.
column7: This child has grown tall and strong.
column9: Strong, sturdy, robust: 身體壯 "strong in body", 長得又高又壯 "tall and sturdy", 壯漢 "a burly man", 壯觀 "magnificent". It can also mean to make stronger: 壯膽 "pluck up courage". 壯 has 爿 on the left, which gives the sound (zhuàng, the same), and 士 "man" is the meaning part.

column3: Two things: a turn for the better, and to change planes on a trip: 有转机 "there is a turn for the better", 一线转机 "a ray of hope"; 在东京转机 "change planes in Tokyo", 转机时间 "layover". 转 "turn" + 机 "opportunity, machine".
column6: Wǒmen yào zài Dōngjīng zhuǎnjī.
column7: We have to change planes in Tokyo.
column9: Two things: a turn for the better, and to change planes on a trip: 有轉機 "there is a turn for the better", 一線轉機 "a ray of hope"; 在東京轉機 "change planes in Tokyo", 轉機時間 "layover". 轉 "turn" + 機 "opportunity, machine".

column3: A person assigned to one job: 专人负责 "someone is in charge", 派专人送货 "send someone specially to deliver", 专人接待. It means a person set apart for a task, not a specialist in the field. 专 "special, devoted" + 人 "person".
column6: Gōngsī huì pài zhuānrén sòng huò.
column7: The company will send someone specially to deliver.
column9: A person assigned to one job: 專人負責 "someone is in charge", 派專人送貨 "send someone specially to deliver", 專人接待. It means a person set apart for a task, not a specialist in the field. 專 "special, devoted" + 人 "person".

column3: A household or resident of a building: 住户 "residents", 住户大会 "a residents' meeting", 这栋大楼的住户. It is used for who lives in an apartment block or a street, counted as households. 住 "live" + 户 "household, door". 户 is one half of 门 "double door".
column6: Zhè dòng dàlóu de zhùhù hěn duō.
column7: There are many residents in this building.
column9: A household or resident of a building: 住戶 "residents", 住戶大會 "a residents' meeting", 這棟大樓的住戶. It is used for who lives in an apartment block or a street, counted as households. 住 "live" + 戶 "household, door". 戶 is one half of 門 "double door".

column3: The lead role, the protagonist: 电影的主角 "the lead of a film", 男主角 "male lead", 女主角 "female lead", 故事的主角 "the main character in the story". It is also the star of any event: 今天的主角 "the star of the day". Read jué here, as in 角色 "role", not jiǎo "horn, corner". 主 "main" + 角 "role".
column4: 她是这部电影的女主角。
column5: 她是這部電影的女主角。
column6: Tā shì zhè bù diànyǐng de nǚ zhǔjué.
column7: She is the female lead of this film.
column9: The lead role, the protagonist: 電影的主角 "the lead of a film", 男主角 "male lead", 女主角 "female lead", 故事的主角 "the main character in the story". It is also the star of any event: 今天的主角 "the star of the day". Read jué here, as in 角色 "role", not jiǎo "horn, corner". 主 "main" + 角 "role".

column3: An admission ticket for an exam: 考试要带准考证 "bring the admission ticket", 准考证号码 "ticket number". 准 "permit" + 考 "exam" + 证 "certificate". 证 has 讠 "speech" and 正 for the sound (zhèng, the same).
column4: 考试的时候要带准考证。
column5: 考試的時候要帶准考證。
column6: Kǎoshì de shíhou yào dài zhǔnkǎozhèng.
column7: You must bring your admission ticket to the exam.
column9: An admission ticket for an exam: 考試要帶准考證 "bring the admission ticket", 准考證號碼 "ticket number". 准 "permit" + 考 "exam" + 證 "certificate". 證 has 言 "speech" and 登 for the sound (zhèng, dēng).

column3: To catch, to seize: 捉住 "catch", 捉小偷 "catch a thief", 捉虫 "catch bugs", 捉迷藏 "hide and seek". It is for something that moves or tries to escape, such as animals or a thief; also 捉弄 "play tricks on". 捉 has 扌 "hand" and 足 "foot" for the sound (zhuō, zú).
column6: Māo zhuō dào le yī zhī lǎoshǔ.
column7: The cat caught a mouse.
column9: To catch, to seize: 捉住 "catch", 捉小偷 "catch a thief", 捉蟲 "catch bugs", 捉迷藏 "hide and seek". It is for something that moves or tries to escape, such as animals or a thief; also 捉弄 "play tricks on". 捉 has 扌 "hand" and 足 "foot" for the sound (zhuō, zú).

column3: A residence, a dwelling: 住宅区 "residential area", 住宅大楼 "apartment block", 公共住宅 "public housing", 商业住宅. It is a written, official noun for the place where people live, as against shops or offices. 住 "live" + 宅 "house". 宅 has 宀 "roof".
column6: Zhè yīdài dōu shì zhùzhái qū.
column7: This area is all residential.
column9: A residence, a dwelling: 住宅區 "residential area", 住宅大樓 "apartment block", 公共住宅 "public housing", 商業住宅. It is a written, official noun for the place where people live, as against shops or offices. 住 "live" + 宅 "house". 宅 has 宀 "roof".

column3: Tap water: 喝自来水 "drink tap water", 自来水厂 "water works", 自来水管 "water pipe". 自来 "come by itself" + 水 "water", so water that comes by itself. People usually boil tap water before drinking it, or use a filter.
column4: 我们家的自来水要煮开才能喝。
column5: 我們家的自來水要煮開才能喝。
column6: Wǒmen jiā de zìláishuǐ yào zhǔ kāi cái néng hē.
column7: In our home the tap water has to be boiled before it can be drunk.
column9: Tap water: 喝自來水 "drink tap water", 自來水廠 "water works", 自來水管 "water pipe". 自來 "come by itself" + 水 "water", so water that comes by itself. People usually boil tap water before drinking it, or use a filter.

column3: Subtitles, captions: 中文字幕 "Chinese subtitles", 英文字幕, 加字幕 "add subtitles". 字 "character" + 幕 "screen, curtain", so characters on the screen. 幕 has 巾 "cloth" for a curtain, and is also in 开幕 "opening" and 夜幕 "night's curtain".
column6: Zhè bù diànyǐng yǒu Zhōngwén zìmù.
column7: This film has Chinese subtitles.
column9: Subtitles, captions: 中文字幕 "Chinese subtitles", 英文字幕, 加字幕 "add subtitles". 字 "character" + 幕 "screen, curtain", so characters on the screen. 幕 has 巾 "cloth" for a curtain, and is also in 開幕 "opening" and 夜幕 "night's curtain".

column3: Selfish: 很自私 "very selfish", 自私自利 "selfish and self-serving", 自私的人. It is a bad quality and is said of someone who thinks only of himself. 自 "self" + 私 "private". 私 has 禾 "grain" and 厶, which was the original character for "private" and gives the sound (sī).
column6: Tā hěn zìsī, zhǐ xiǎngdào zìjǐ.
column7: He is very selfish and thinks only of himself.
column9: Selfish: 很自私 "very selfish", 自私自利 "selfish and self-serving", 自私的人. It is a bad quality and is said of someone who thinks only of himself. 自 "self" + 私 "private". 私 has 禾 "grain" and 厶, which was the original character for "private" and gives the sound (sī).

column3: The self, oneself, mostly as a prefix: 自我介绍 "introduce oneself", 自我要求 "demands on oneself", 自我感觉良好 "feel good about oneself", 自我保护. It points the action back at the speaker. In psychology 自我 is "the ego". 自 "self" + 我 "I". Compare 自己, which is the plain "oneself".
column4: 请先做一个简单的自我介绍。
column5: 請先做一個簡單的自我介紹。
column6: Qǐng xiān zuò yī ge jiǎndān de zìwǒ jièshào.
column7: Please start with a short introduction of yourself.
column9: The self, oneself, mostly as a prefix: 自我介紹 "introduce oneself", 自我要求 "demands on oneself", 自我感覺良好 "feel good about oneself", 自我保護. It points the action back at the speaker. In psychology 自我 is "the ego". 自 "self" + 我 "I". Compare 自己, which is the plain "oneself".

column3: Information: 旅游资讯 "travel information", 资讯科技 "information technology", 提供资讯 "provide information". This is the word for information in Taiwan, where the mainland says 信息. 资 "resources" + 讯 "news". 讯 has 讠 "speech" and 卂 for the sound.
column4: 这个网站有很多旅游资讯。
column5: 這個網站有很多旅遊資訊。
column6: Zhège wǎngzhàn yǒu hěn duō lǚyóu zīxùn.
column7: This website has a lot of travel information.
column9: Information: 旅遊資訊 "travel information", 資訊科技 "information technology", 提供資訊 "provide information". This is the word for information in Taiwan, where the mainland says 信息. 資 "resources" + 訊 "news". 訊 has 言 "speech" and 卂 for the sound.

column3: An aisle, a corridor between rows, a passageway: 走道很窄 "the aisle is narrow", 靠走道的座位 "an aisle seat", 把行李放在走道上. On a plane, train or in a theater it is the narrow path between seats; also a path beside a building. 走 "walk" + 道 "road". 走 shows a man 土 above 止 "foot", running.
column4: 请不要把行李放在走道上。
column5: 請不要把行李放在走道上。
column6: Qǐng bù yào bǎ xíngli fàng zài zǒudào shàng.
column7: Please do not leave your luggage in the aisle.
column9: An aisle, a corridor between rows, a passageway: 走道很窄 "the aisle is narrow", 靠走道的座位 "an aisle seat", 把行李放在走道上. On a plane, train or in a theater it is the narrow path between seats; also a path beside a building. 走 "walk" + 道 "road". 走 shows a man 土 above 止 "foot", running.

column3: To smuggle: 走私香烟 "smuggle cigarettes", 走私毒品 "smuggle drugs", 走私犯 "a smuggler", 查获走私. It is for bringing goods across a border without paying duty or against the law. 走 "go" + 私 "private, secret". The 私 here is the secret side of "private".
column4: 他因为走私被警察抓了。
column5: 他因為走私被警察抓了。
column6: Tā yīnwèi zǒusī bèi jǐngchá zhuā le.
column7: He was arrested by the police for smuggling.
column9: To smuggle: 走私香菸 "smuggle cigarettes", 走私毒品 "smuggle drugs", 走私犯 "a smuggler", 查獲走私. It is for bringing goods across a border without paying duty or against the law. 走 "go" + 私 "private, secret". The 私 here is the secret side of "private".

column3: Foot, leg, and "enough, sufficient", bound in many words: 足够 "enough", 满足 "satisfy", 足球 "football", 足迹 "footprint", 手足 "brothers (lit. hand and foot)", 十足 "full, utter". By itself in modern speech it is rare.
column4: 我们的钱足够买一台电脑。
column5: 我們的錢足夠買一台電腦。
column6: Wǒmen de qián zúgòu mǎi yī tái diànnǎo.
column7: We have enough money to buy a computer.
column9: Foot, leg, and "enough, sufficient", bound in many words: 足夠 "enough", 滿足 "satisfy", 足球 "football", 足跡 "footprint", 手足 "brothers (lit. hand and foot)", 十足 "full, utter". By itself in modern speech it is rare.

column3: To drill, to bore, and to get into: 钻洞 "drill a hole", 钻进去 "crawl in", 钻研 "study deeply", 钻牛角尖 "split hairs". Here zuān. In 钻石 it is read zuàn, as a noun. 钻 has 钅 "metal" for the drill and 占 for the sound (zuān, zhān).
column4: 他用电钻在墙上钻了一个洞。
column5: 他用電鑽在牆上鑽了一個洞。
column6: Tā yòng diànzuàn zài qiáng shàng zuān le yī ge dòng.
column7: He drilled a hole in the wall with a power drill.
column9: To drill, to bore, and to get into: 鑽洞 "drill a hole", 鑽進去 "crawl in", 鑽研 "study deeply", 鑽牛角尖 "split hairs". Here zuān. In 鑽石 it is read zuàn, as a noun. 鑽 has 釒 "metal" for the drill and 贊 for the sound (zuān, zàn).

column3: A diamond: 钻石戒指 "a diamond ring", 钻石项炼, 一颗钻石. 钻 here is read zuàn, not zuān as in "to drill", as a noun; 石 is "stone". 石 shows a rock below a cliff 厂.
column6: Zhè kē zuànshí fēicháng dà.
column7: This diamond is very large.
column9: A diamond: 鑽石戒指 "a diamond ring", 鑽石項鍊, 一顆鑽石. 鑽 here is read zuàn, not zuān as in "to drill", as a noun; 石 is "stone". 石 shows a rock below a cliff 厂.

column3: Homeland, mother country: 祖国的语言 "the language of one's homeland", 离开祖国 "leave one's homeland", 祖国的土地. The word is used by emigrants and overseas Chinese to speak of the country they came from. 祖 "ancestor" + 国 "country". 国 has 囗 "border" around 玉.
column4: 他离开祖国已经十年了。
column5: 他離開祖國已經十年了。
column6: Tā líkāi zǔguó yǐjīng shí nián le.
column7: He left his homeland ten years ago.
column9: Homeland, mother country: 祖國的語言 "the language of one's homeland", 離開祖國 "leave one's homeland", 祖國的土地. The word is used by emigrants and overseas Chinese to speak of the country they came from. 祖 "ancestor" + 國 "country". 國 has 囗 "border" around 或, an older word for a territory.

column3: A crime, guilt, fault, and also sin: 犯罪 "commit a crime", 有罪 "guilty", 无罪 "not guilty", 罪名 "the charge", 罪恶 "sin, evil". It can be crime in law, guilt in a verdict, or blame: 这不是你的罪. 罪 has 罒 "net" over 非 "wrong", a net for wrongdoers.
column6: Tā chéngrèn zìjǐ yǒu zuì.
column7: He admitted that he was guilty.
column9: A crime, guilt, fault, and also sin: 犯罪 "commit a crime", 有罪 "guilty", 無罪 "not guilty", 罪名 "the charge", 罪惡 "sin, evil". It can be crime in law, guilt in a verdict, or blame: 這不是你的罪. 罪 has 罒 "net" over 非 "wrong", a net for wrongdoers.

column3: At least, at the minimum: 最少要一个小时 "it takes at least an hour", 最少三个人 "at least three people". It is the minimum amount, and goes before a number word or a verb of quantity. 最 "most" + 少 "few". 至少 "at least" is used in much the same way.
column4: 这道菜最少要煮一个小时。
column5: 這道菜最少要煮一個小時。
column6: Zhè dào cài zuìshǎo yào zhǔ yī ge xiǎoshí.
column7: This dish takes at least an hour to cook.
column9: At least, at the minimum: 最少要一個小時 "it takes at least an hour", 最少三個人 "at least three people". It is the minimum amount, and goes before a number word or a verb of quantity. 最 "most" + 少 "few". 至少 "at least" is used in much the same way.

column3: To visit as a guest, to stay with someone: 到朋友家作客 "visit a friend's home", 作客他乡 "live as a guest in a foreign land". The phrase is used in the sense of visiting a family or being a guest for a time. Also written 做客. 作 "do" + 客 "guest". 客 has 宀 "roof" and 各 for the sound (kè, gè).
column4: 周末我们去朋友家作客。
column5: 週末我們去朋友家作客。
column6: Zhōumò wǒmen qù péngyou jiā zuòkè.
column7: This weekend we are visiting a friend's home.
column9: To visit as a guest, to stay with someone: 到朋友家作客 "visit a friend's home", 作客他鄉 "live as a guest in a foreign land". The phrase is used in the sense of visiting a family or being a guest for a time. Also written 做客. 作 "do" + 客 "guest". 客 has 宀 "roof" and 各 for the sound (kè, gè).

column3: Enough to, sufficient to: 足以证明 "enough to prove", 足以应付 "enough to deal with", 不足以 "not enough to". It comes before a verb and says that a fact or a thing is enough for that result. It is written style. 足 "sufficient" + 以 "to, by means of". 以 was an old picture of a person carrying something.
column4: 这些证据足以证明他是无辜的。
column5: 這些證據足以證明他是無辜的。
column6: Zhèxiē zhèngjù zúyǐ zhèngmíng tā shì wúgū de.
column7: This evidence is enough to prove he is innocent.
column9: Enough to, sufficient to: 足以證明 "enough to prove", 足以應付 "enough to deal with", 不足以 "not enough to". It comes before a verb and says that a fact or a thing is enough for that result.
